en: Nature was her domain,
Love was her song,
Family was her devotion,
Knowledge was her gift.
flavourtext:AMothersPartingGift.Text.zh:
自然是她的領域，
愛情是她的旋律，
親情是她的奉獻，
知識是她曾經的贈禮。

en: Each of us are destined
to do what we do... forever.
flavourtext:AbominationMapFlavour.Text.zh:
我們每個人都注定
做著自己該做的事…永遠…

en: The dormant carrier lies
still as death.
flavourtext:AbyssPinnacleNodeFlavour.Tex.zh:
蟄伏的宿主靜靜躺著，
宛如死亡般沉寂。

en: "A bit short in the arm, are you?
Then you'll be short of a head soon enough."
- Daresso the Daring
flavourtext:Amulet13.Text.zh:
「你揮劍的手似乎不夠長吧？
那你很快就人頭落地了。」
- 無畏者德瑞索

en: "We are the soldiers of Faith, armoured in devotion.
Let the sinners come, for we - the Pure - shall endure!"
- Voll of Thebrus, at the Battle of the Bridge
flavourtext:Amulet14.Text.zh:
「懷抱信仰的戰士！今日我們揭起正義之師，
盡斬操術罪惡之人，捍衛永恆純粹之誓！」
- 席布魯斯的福爾於長橋之役

en: "Grind your words into sharp thoughts.
Grind your thoughts into the sharpest of deeds."
- Victario, the People's Poet
flavourtext:Amulet15.Text.zh:
「讓激昂的文字化作敏銳的思緒，
接著塑造出善業的先驅。」
- 人民詩人維多里奧

en: These Archives were among the first constructed by the Templars.
There are more books here than I could read in a lifetime...
flavourtext:ArchivesResearch.Text.zh:
這些檔案是聖殿騎士團最早建造的之一。
這裡的書籍比我一生都無法閱讀完...

en: By the time their eyes meet,
the dark deal has long since been made,
and his fate long since sealed.
flavourtext:AssassinsFavor.Text.zh:
當他們的雙眼交會時
黑暗的交易將同時簽下
他的命運也將同時終結

en: In a realm of crimson madness,
the Queen lives on.
flavourtext:AtziriAtlasNodeFlavour.Text.zh:
在猩紅瘋狂的領域裡，
女王仍然存活。

en: A monument to hubris,
in more ways than one.
flavourtext:AtzoatlNodeFlavour.Text.zh:
一座傲慢的紀念碑，
而且不只一種意義。

en: <size:27>{A jolt, and it moves. Or smolders.
A current, and it lives. Or dies.
A surge, and it transcends.
Or... not.
Only one way to find out.}
flavourtext:Audacity.Text.zh:
<size:27>{一瞬跳電，使其亦然震動，或是短路起煙
一道電流，使其重獲生命，或是永遠沉眠
一股湧電，使其向上超越...或者悄然無息
唯有一種方式才能得到解答}

en: Her beauty did not fade
her humanity did not survive.
flavourtext:BeautyThroughDeath.Text.zh:
他的美貌沒有逝去
他的人性沒有留下。

en: The ancient will of the Blightheart
festers and spreads...
flavourtext:BlightedLands.Text.zh:
凋落之心的古老意志
正在腐爛滋長……並持續蔓延。

en: "It's risky not knowing where your wares come from. That's why I source my own."
- Klayver, the Antiquarian
flavourtext:BlindVenture.Text.zh:
"不清楚自己貨物的來源是件相當危險的事情。這就是為什麼我總是親自查驗。"
- 克雷佛，古董收藏家

en: The gateway of flesh, horror unbound,
requires a key of madness and pain.
flavourtext:BloodCrucibleFlavourText.Tex.zh:
血肉之門，恐怖無所拘束，
需要一把瘋狂和痛苦的鑰匙。

en: <size:28>{Wreathed in the skin and bones
of the beasts she slew,
her gift came from what she lost:
her humanity.}
flavourtext:BoonOfTheFirstOnes.Text.zh:
<size:28>{在她所殺野獸的
皮膚和骨頭纏著，
來自她已遺失的禮物：
她的人性。}

en: <size:28>{A map is similar
to a pair of eyes,
without one you stumble
around, unable to find your way.}
flavourtext:CartographersDelight.Text.zh:
<size:28>{地圖就像
一雙眼睛，
若失去它你將
蹣跚，找不到去路。}

en: This was the first cathedral that Innocence ever built,
made to honour himself. It is gilded with stolen wealth.
flavourtext:CathedralResearch.Text.zh:
這是純真神創建的第一座大教堂，
為了讚美自己而建。它被用偷來的財富鍍金。

en: An heirloom of the champions of Wraeclast
Lies forgotten in an abandoned reliquary
Born of a starry void from which time cannot escape
flavourtext:CelestialVaultKey.Text.zh:
瓦爾克拉斯冠軍的傳家寶
遺忘在廢棄聖物箱中的謊言
誕生於時間無法逃脫的星空虛空

en: Lay bare our flesh under the
searing light of the Torus Eternal.
flavourtext:ChayulaBodyPart1.Text.zh:
將我們的肉體赤裸的放置在
永恆之環熾熱的光輝下。

en: Unity... must have... the flesh...
must draw closer...
flavourtext:ChayulaBodyPart10.Text.zh:
合一……必須擁有……血肉……
必須……更近……

en: Silent thoughts chitter in the dark,
lashing our minds into agonised ecstasy.
flavourtext:ChayulaBodyPart2.Text.zh:
寂靜的思緒在黑暗中呢喃，
將我們的心智鞭笞至痛苦的狂喜。

en: We crawl on our faces in burning ash,
choking, eating, until our throats bleed.
flavourtext:ChayulaBodyPart3.Text.zh:
我們匍匐於燃燒的灰燼上，
窒息、啃食，直至喉嚨血流不止。

en: We give of our flesh so that
the Lords may thrive.
flavourtext:ChayulaBodyPart5.Text.zh:
吾等獻上血肉，
唯願諸主得以昌盛。

en: Let the Grey Winds
take the Foulborn.
flavourtext:ChayulaBodyPart6.Text.zh: 讓灰風帶走那穢生邪物。

en: Let the Mother's love
embrace our flesh.
flavourtext:ChayulaBodyPart7.Text.zh: 母親的愛擁抱吾等血肉。

en: "It That Was Vruun failed...
It That Will Be Vruun... will not.
Vengeance will be ours..."
flavourtext:ChayulaBodyPart8.Text.zh:
昔之弗倫已敗……
未來之弗倫……絕不再敗。
復仇將屬於我等……

en: The flesh exists for one reason, and one
reason alone... to perpetuate itself.
flavourtext:ChayulaBodyPart9.Text.zh:
血肉存在的唯一理由，
唯有延續自身。

en: The craftsman rots.
His tools rust.
But his legacy cuts through the ages.
flavourtext:ChestForgottenReliquary.Text.zh:
工匠的身軀腐爛，
他的工具漸漸生鏽，
但他的傳奇將崁入歷史。

en: The words of a man, delicate like life, pass on feebly into forgotten verse,
but his creations... his craft shall be championed agelessly.
flavourtext:ChestForgottenReliquary2.Tex.zh:
一個像生命一樣細膩的人的話，無力地寫進被遺忘的詩句，
但是他的創作...他的手藝將永遠地得到支持。

en: Those we idolise are not gods.
They were men, with flaws.
They made... mistakes.
flavourtext:ChestForgottenReliquaryBenev.zh:
「那些被我們奉為偶像的人，並非神明。
 他們只是凡人，也有缺陷。
 他們也會……犯錯。」

en: Some wounds, we do not let heal.
Some wounds, we poke and prod,
simply to keep the feeling alive.
flavourtext:ChestForgottenReliquaryIgnor.zh:
「有些傷口，我們不願讓它癒合。
 有些傷口，我們不斷撥弄，
 只為讓那種感覺繼續存在。」

en: You are not the first champion to receive this gift,
and you will likely not be the last.
flavourtext:ChestForgottenReliquaryMaven.zh:
你不是第一個收到這份禮物的冠軍，
也不會是最後一個。

en: A touch on the shoulder.
A smile on a sunny day.
An idle conversation...
flavourtext:ChestForgottenReliquaryNegle.zh:
「肩上的一抹輕觸。
 晴日裡的一抹微笑。
 一次漫不經心的閒談……」

en: To a being of the stars, Time is irrelevant,
and memories are but a collection of present moments.
flavourtext:ChestForgottenReliquarySeari.zh:
對於一個星辰存在，時間無關緊要，
記憶不過是當下瞬間的集合。

en: Though you might not see it, a sliver of my soul remains,
and I am trying with all my strength to get back to you.
flavourtext:ChestForgottenReliquarySirus.zh:
雖然你可能看不到，但我的靈魂還殘留著一小部分，
我正在竭盡全力想要回到你身邊。

en: You did not slay me.
You saved me.
I forgive you.
flavourtext:ChestForgottenReliquaryUberS.zh:
你沒有殺我。
你救了我。
我原諒你。

en: Time is a river, forking forever into infinite unknowns.
Nothing is ever truly gone.
It is merely taking a different route to the sea.
flavourtext:ChestForgottenReliquaryVaal..zh:
時間是一條河，持續向無數未知的地方前進。
沒有什麼是真正消失的。
它只是走了一條通往大海的不同路線。

en: It is not regret that stalks me now...
merely the child of my sins.
flavourtext:ChestForgottenReliquaryVenar.zh:
現在纏著我的不是後悔……
只是我罪孽的孩子。

en: Their courage and heroism
became their downfall.
flavourtext:CitadelMapFlavour.Text.zh:
他們的勇氣與英勇
最終成了他們的覆滅。

en: From the corona of an ancient star,
the Searing Exarch seeks to master the Atlas.
flavourtext:CleansingFireBossKeyFlavourT.zh:
從一顆古老恆星的日冕中，
灼烙總督試圖掌握輿圖。

en: Once within the grasp of the Black Star,
there can be no escape.
flavourtext:CleansingFireKeyFlavourText..zh:
一旦落入黯星的掌控之中，
就無法逃脫。

en: "The supposed heroes of history now rot.
I am alive, and I choose my own destiny."
flavourtext:CoinDesecration.Text.zh:
"歷史中所謂的英雄如今已然腐朽。
我仍然活著，並選擇自己的命運。"

en: "Power and skill can be outsmarted...
I wish for intellect beyond compare."
flavourtext:CoinKnowledge.Text.zh:
"力量與技藝都能被智謀所勝…
我渴求無與倫比的智慧。"

en: "Knowledge and speed are useless without the
strength to wield them. I wish for power!"
flavourtext:CoinPower.Text.zh:
"沒有能與之執掌的力量，知識
與速度皆毫無意義。我渴望力量！"

en: "Drain away the sands of Time,
restore that which is now mine!"
flavourtext:CoinRestoration.Text.zh:
"抽乾時間的流沙，
奪回如今屬於我的一切！"

en: "Strong and slow, clever and weak. I fear neither.
I wish for the skill to overcome them both."
flavourtext:CoinSkill.Text.zh:
"強者緩慢，智者孱弱。我皆無所畏懼。
我渴求能同時超越兩者的技巧。"

en: Dark as obsidian with a red-hot core,
the geode hums with mysterious energy.
flavourtext:CrucibleGeode.Text.zh:
黑得像黑曜石，中心火熱的晶洞，
發出神秘的能量嗡嗡聲。

en: Kalandra watched as the almighty titans fell,
relegated to the innermost depths of the world,
where horrific abominations awaited them.
flavourtext:CrucibleMap.Text.zh:
卡蘭德看著萬能的泰坦倒下，
被放逐到世界最深處，
在那裡恐怖的怪物在等待著他們。

en: It isn't the twisted transformative power of corruption that makes it so dangerous.
It is its ability to hide in plain sight.
flavourtext:CurrencyHarvestBossKey.Text.zh:
使腐敗如此危險的不是扭曲的變革力量。
它是隱藏在視線中的能力。

en: Follow the strands of a web to its center,
and you'll find Death lying in wait...
flavourtext:CurrencyMastermindBossFragme.zh:
依循網陣的絲線來到中心，
你會發現死亡在此蟄伏等候……

en: On the edge of existence,
he watches with ire.
flavourtext:CurrencyRitualBossFragment.T.zh:
在存亡的邊緣，
他憤怒地看著。

en: <size:31>{The end of the old,
the beginning of the new.
A unique opportunity for transformation,
for those with the power
to grasp it.}
flavourtext:Death.Text.zh:
<size:31>{歷史的終結
未來的開端
一個轉變的絕佳機會
只給那些有能力的人
掌握在手}

en: Merrick the Wanting's dark desires forced the Brinerot to maroon him. So
he walked to the bottom of the sea, and made himself a new crew.
flavourtext:DeepwaterAbyssCurrency.Text.zh:
渴求者．莫里克黑暗的私慾迫使布琳洛特將他放逐。
於是，他徒步走向海底，為自己重組了一批新的船員。

en: A noble Eternal who gave up his name to join the Brinerots. He climbed
the ranks with calculated savagery like Pondium had never seen.
flavourtext:DeepwaterAttributeSwap.Text.zh:
一位高貴的永恆帝國人，他放棄了自己的名字以加入布琳洛特。
他以龐迪姆從未見過的精明與殘暴，一路爬上了權力的頂峰。

en: To appease Tsoatha, they tossed it to sea, but the storm grew ever madder.
None returned to shore. Yet the vessel sails on, and its captain is merry.
flavourtext:DeepwaterBlankCurrency_.Text.zh:
為了平息特索塔的憤怒，他們將其拋入海中，然而暴風雨卻愈發狂暴。
沒有任何人重回岸上。然而，那艘船仍在繼續航行，而它的船長卻無比歡愉。

en: Telesia carved the earth with her oars, and filled the seas with her tears.
The waters, still as stone, began to dance and flow to cheer her.
flavourtext:DeepwaterChartReroll.Text.zh:
特雷西亞用她的船槳雕刻大地，用她的淚水填滿海洋。
那原本如磐石般靜止的海水，為了取悅她而開始起舞與流動。

en: Mirthful Ukatoa travelled the world to teach it the Way. He ventured south,
and came back changed, a sombre husk filled with unearthly arcana.
flavourtext:DeepwaterEldritch.Text.zh:
歡愉的烏卡圖瓦曾周遊列國以傳授天道。當他決意南征，
歸來之時卻已面目全非—成了一具填滿異界秘術、憂鬱而沉重的軀殼。

en: Before his work in Atzoatl, Tzamoto travelled the world in search of
forbidden arcana. He believed spirits held many untapped secrets.
flavourtext:DeepwaterGhostbuster.Text.zh:
在前往阿茲瓦特展開研究前，薩摩特曾周遊列國尋求禁忌秘術。
他深信，靈魂之中蘊藏著許多尚未被發掘的秘密。

en: Vaal Kishara sailed the seas, seeking her equal. None were worthy. From
each contender she took a carnal gift, and thus, the Brinerot clan was born.
flavourtext:DeepwaterItemSplit.Text.zh:
瓦爾人奇夏拉航行於群海之上，尋找著能與她匹敵的對手。然而無人
配得上她。她從每一位挑戰者身上奪走了一份肉體，布琳洛特氏族便由此誕生。

en: Kylian Cyaxan sold every vice known to man, and more. Wares tailored to
break man's will. Every customer returned, or died from deprivation.
flavourtext:DeepwaterMercenaryCurrency.T.zh:
奇里安．塞亞珊販售世人所知的每一種惡行，甚至更多。商品皆是為了
擊垮人的意志而精心打造。每位顧客不是再次光臨，就是因戒斷而死。

en: Brinehook Vex inspired the Brinerot name. He fought the sea. Sailed with
gods. Drank with heroes. Wed a dozen wives, and the Leviathan, too.
flavourtext:DeepwaterPantheon.Text.zh:
布琳霍克．維克斯給布琳洛特之名帶來啟發。他曾與大海搏鬥、
與神明同航、與英雄對酌。他娶了十二任妻子，甚至連利維坦巨獸也是他的新娘。

en: Under Weylam, the Brinerots had become soft and aimless. Lussi
"Rotmother" Roth saw her opportunity, and took it. Blood be damned.
flavourtext:DeepwaterSaboteur.Text.zh:
在威廉的領導下，布琳洛特變得軟弱且失去了方向。
腐母露西．羅斯看到了她的機會，並果斷出手。血脈親情？去他的吧。

en: A thousand ships litter the eastern seabed. All Katakohi's doing. His fleet would
board, fast as lightning. Every captive saved, every slaver butchered.
flavourtext:DeepwaterTatttoo.Text.zh:
數以千計的船隻殘骸散落在東方海底。這全是卡塔科希的傑作。
他的艦隊登船突襲，迅捷如雷。救下每一位俘虜，屠盡每一個奴隸販子。

en: What are you talking about?
The Atlas was always like this.
flavourtext:DeliriumScarabOfDelusions.Te.zh: 你在說什麼？輿圖一向如此。

en: They're so loud! Why are they so loud?!
All you can do is scream!
flavourtext:DeliriumScarabOfMania.Text.zh: 牠們好吵！牠們在吵什麼？！除了尖叫別無他法！

en: <size:30>{"Let us not forget the most important lesson the Vaal taught us:
Nothing is eternal."
- Siosa Foaga, Imperial Scholar}
flavourtext:DestinedToCrumble.Text.zh:
<size:30>{"我們不能忘記瓦爾教過我們最重要的一課:
沒有任何事物是永恆的。"
- 薩歐賽．佛耶葛, 皇家學者}

en: <size:28>{A symbol of beauty and innocence
The gems corrupted her mind
Malachai corrupted her gems
All but a glimmer of
greatness lost in madness}
flavourtext:DiallasSubjugation.Text.zh:
<size:28>{美麗與純潔的象徵
寶石汙染了她的神智
瑪拉凱腐敗了她的寶石
瘋狂吞噬了僅存的榮耀。}

en: <size:26>{All things slow under winter's
onslaught - even life itself.}
flavourtext:DivinationCardAChillingWind..zh:
<size:26>{萬物在寒冬的壟罩下緩慢生長
 - 即使是生命。}

en: The mighty huntress always called for her share,
But what we shared was a lifelong bond.
flavourtext:DivinationCardAFamiliarCall_.zh:
強大的女獵手總是要求分享她的力量，
但是我們分享的是一生羈絆。

en: <size:25>{Cede all power and wealth to me and serve me in perpetuity.
A minor inconvenience I assure you.}
flavourtext:DivinationCardAModestRequest.zh:
<size:25> {放棄一切力量和財富給我，永遠為我服務。
我向你保證只會有一點不方便。}

en: <size:30>{The artist is long dead,
the lyrics are long forgotten,
yet the Song of War longs to be sung again}
flavourtext:DivinationCardANoteInTheWind.zh:
<size:30> {這位藝術家已經死了，
歌詞早已被遺忘，
但戰爭之歌渴望再次演唱}

en: The world is ever-changing.
Once-lush woods now lost beneath shifting sands,
Great cities now drown beneath turbulent waters.
Adapt or perish.
flavourtext:DivinationCardAcclimatisatio.zh:
世界在不斷變化。
曾經茂密的樹林現在迷失在流沙之下，
大城市如今淹沒在動蕩的海水之下。
適應或滅亡。

en: <size:28>{The hatungo know many answers to the same question,
for time itself is a tangled web.}
flavourtext:DivinationCardAkilsProphecy..zh:
<size:28> {同個問題，靈語者知曉眾多解法，
時間本身就是個盤纏交錯的問題。

en: <size:28>{A treasure worth killing for
is a treasure worth dying for.}
flavourtext:DivinationCardAlluringBounty.zh:
<size:28>{殺頭生意有人做
賠錢生意無人做。}

en: "Sometimes, the most beautiful treasures...are the ones you cannot have."
- Beryl, Survivor from the Azurite Mines
flavourtext:DivinationCardAloneInTheDark.zh:
"有時，最美麗的寶藏...是你無法擁有的。"
- 碧藍礦坑倖存者，貝羅

en: <size:24>{The Ezomytes,
buried beneath flaming mountains
by the First Ones.
The Vaal,
undone by a cataclysm
of their own making.
Are all empires fated to fall to hubris?}
flavourtext:DivinationCardApocalypse.Tex.zh:
<size:24>{伊澤麥族，
被初始之靈埋葬在
燃燒的群山之下。
瓦爾族，
被自己一手造成的災變
給徹底毀滅。
難道所有帝國都注定因傲慢而傾覆嗎？}

en: <size:32>{What matters are
the Marks of your life,
not its Longevity.}
flavourtext:DivinationCardAssassinsGift..zh:
<size:32>{重要的是
你生命的印記，
而不是它的長久。}

en: For a time, we had something stronger than eldritch evil.
We had each other.
flavourtext:DivinationCardAstralProtecti.zh:
有一段時間，我們擁有比可怕的邪惡更強大的東西。
我們曾經有過彼此。

en: <size:30>{"Gaze upon the mirrors of what may come and step backward into infinity."
- Dexion, Thaumetic Aspirant}
flavourtext:DivinationCardAuspiciousAmbi.zh:
<size:30>{"凝視可能發生事情的鏡子，然後退回到無限。"
- 迪克西翁．奇術上人}

en: Blazing through the night
Longing for infinite flight
Awaiting dawn's first light
flavourtext:DivinationCardAvianPursuit.T.zh:
揭起黑夜的帷幕
期望一睹
旭日初升的莊嚴肅穆

en: <size:28>{The mask hides his identity
but also makes it hard to read...}
flavourtext:DivinationCardAzureRage.Text.zh:
<size:28>{面具隱藏了他的身份，
但也讓人難以讀懂他…}

en: Method transcends shape and size. Do something in parallel long enough, and you will always find
another way.
flavourtext:DivinationCardAzyransReward..zh: 模式超越了形狀和大小。並行做足夠長的事情，你總能找到其他方式。

en: <size:30>{In battle we burn together
or not at all.}
flavourtext:DivinationCardBoundByFlame.T.zh:
<size:30>{在戰場上，我們要嘛一同燃燒，
 要嘛同歸於盡。}

en: <size:25>{Seeking shelter from the night,
in the warmth of the run-down inn,
erstwhile foes put aside the fight,
to bond over whiskey and gin.}
flavourtext:DivinationCardBrotherhoodInE.zh:
<size:25>{在夜晚，在破敗旅館的
溫暖中尋找庇護所，昔日的敵人
將戰鬥擱置一旁，
用威士忌酒和杜松子酒粘合。}

en: <size:23>{Even though his flame has burned out,
he will never fade away.}
flavourtext:DivinationCardBrothersGift__.zh:
<size:23>{即使他的輝煌燃燒殆盡，
但他仍會留傳下去。}

en: Even though he found the stash just in time,
He would trade it all away and then some to have him back.
flavourtext:DivinationCardBrothersStash..zh:
即使他及時發現了倉庫，
他會把這一切全部交易出去，然後再把它換回來。

en: <size:28>{There's a place where up is down,
where right is wrong,
where pleasure is agony,
and where the living wish only for death.}
flavourtext:DivinationCardBurningBlood.T.zh:
<size:28>{這是個上下相反， 
是非顛倒， 
快樂與苦痛錯亂，
且生靈只求死的地方。}

en: "There are two ways to pay, Gold and Blood. I'll take my share in both."
-Cameria the Coldblooded
flavourtext:DivinationCardCameriasCut.Te.zh:
"有兩種方式可以還債，黃金和鮮血。兩個我都要。"

- 冷血卡麥歷亞

en: <size:30>{A King Loved By All,
A Shadow Awaiting Nightfall,
A Speaker Howling Away,
A Hunter Seeking Prey}
flavourtext:DivinationCardCouncilOfCats_.zh:
<size:30> {被所有人愛戴的國王，
等待黃昏的陰影，
演講者嚎叫著，
尋找獵物的獵人}

en: Blood and death lead
the way to hell.
flavourtext:DivinationCardDamnation.Text.zh:
鮮血和死亡引導著
前往地獄的路途

en: "Only a fool looks to the occult for power and expects to be spared from its wrath."
- Voll, Emperor of Purity
flavourtext:DivinationCardDarkTemptation.zh:
"只有愚民才追求神秘的力量，並希望能夠倖免於它的憤怒。"
- 純淨帝王福爾

en: <size:27>{"Be fast. That is all that matters."
- Rita of the Asylum}
flavourtext:DivinationCardDeadlyJoy.Text.zh:
<size:27> {"要快。這很重要。"
-庇護所的瑞塔}

en: <size:28>{I never truly understood the depths of my insanity,
until I realized the voices beckoning me towards the abyss,
were none other than my own.}
flavourtext:DivinationCardDementophobia..zh:
<size:28>{我從來沒有真正理解過我瘋狂的深度，
直到我意識到召喚我走向深淵的聲音，
正是我自己的。}

en: <size:25>{Awoken virtuous slivers of the void,
defiled by the avaricious,
seized by the tyrannical.}
flavourtext:DivinationCardDesecratedVirt.zh:
<size:25> {喚醒了虛空善良的裂片，
被貪婪玷汙，
被暴君逮住。}

en: <size:30>{In a land far away lived
a maiden most fair.
Her smile melted the coldest
of hearts, her song made
men and beast cry,
her beauty unparalleled;
Divine.}
flavourtext:DivinationCardDivineBeauty_..zh:
<size:30>{在遙遠的地方
住著一位最美麗的少女。
她的笑容融化了最冰冷的心，
她的歌聲讓人和野獸哭泣，
她的美貌無與倫比的；
神聖。}

en: <size:26>{Sin sought to contain Divinity
so that no mortal would gain
such monstrous power ever again.}
flavourtext:DivinationCardDivineShard.Te.zh:
<size:26>{罪試圖封存神性，
使凡人永遠不再獲得
如此駭人的力量。}

en: The suit I wear,
Is heavy and bare.
A canvas, it seems, breathing life into dreams.
flavourtext:DivinationCardDrapedInDreams.zh:
我的穿著，
沉重且赤裸。
似乎是一塊帆布，將生活帶入了夢想。

en: Embrace horror.
Bathe in its beauty.
flavourtext:DivinationCardEldritchPerfec.zh:
擁抱恐懼。
沐浴在它的美麗中。

en: To my number one fan.
- Griffin, with love
flavourtext:DivinationCardEnergySword.Te.zh:
給我的頭號粉絲。
——格里芬，獻上愛意

en: Separate, stories untold.
Together, memories unfold.
flavourtext:DivinationCardEternalBonds.T.zh:
分開，不為人知的故事。
一起，回憶展開。

en: <size:26>{Some people act as beacons, illuminating the path for others. I was lucky to meet one such person.
- Anton to Zhenya}
flavourtext:DivinationCardFatefulMeeting.zh:
<size:26>{有些人作為燈塔，為其他人照亮了道路。我很幸運認識一位這樣的人。

- 從安東到仁亞}

en: <size:26>{Faith sparks the flame,
a frenzy on the wind;
a fervour that drives us wildly onward.}
flavourtext:DivinationCardFireOfUnknownO.zh:
<size:26>{信仰點燃了火焰，
風中的狂熱；
一種熱情將我們瘋狂地推向前。}

en: <size:30>{"Set your life on fire.
Seek those who
fan your flames"
-Rumi of the Vaal}
flavourtext:DivinationCardFriendship.Tex.zh:
<size:30>{"點燃你生命之火。
尋找那些
為你火焰著迷之人"

- 瓦爾之魯米}

en: When you can only have one, which shall it be?
Red?
Blue?
Probably Green.
flavourtext:DivinationCardGemcuttersMerc.zh:
當你只能選一個時，要選哪個呢？
紅？
藍？
含淚選綠。

en: In the dead of night you may elude your shadows,
but they will always find you by dawn.
flavourtext:DivinationCardHauntingShadow.zh:
在夜深人靜中，你可能會躲開陰影，
但它們總會在黎明之前找到你。

en: The future is oft-foretold
in records of the past.
flavourtext:DivinationCardHistory.Text.zh:
舊事不忘，
後事之師。

en: <size:28>{There are countless people,
countless stories,
and countless eras,
but there is one place that,
for a time, each of us loved
and was loved. It matters.
We matter.}
flavourtext:DivinationCardHome.Text.zh:
<size:28>{無數的人，無數的故事，
無數的時代，但有一個地方，
曾幾何時，
我們每個人都曾愛過，
也曾被愛過。這很重要。
我們很重要。}

en: <size:34>{"Where does the light go
when it is dark?"}
flavourtext:DivinationCardISeeBrothers.T.zh:
<size:34>{「當黑暗來臨，
光明去了哪裡？」}

en: "Everything I have done has been for Wraeclast. You would pledge your life to me if you saw things my way... and soon, you will."
- High Templar Venarius
flavourtext:DivinationCardJustifiedAmbit.zh:
"我所做的一切都是為了瓦爾克拉斯。如果你以我的方式看待事情，你會向我保證你的生命...很快，你會的。"
- 聖宗維那利斯

en: With great power comes...
...Even greater power.
flavourtext:DivinationCardKeepersCorrupt.zh:
強大的力量來了...

…甚至更大的力量。

en: Return with your shield...
or on it.
flavourtext:DivinationCardLastStand__.Te.zh:
與你的戰盾一同歸來……
不論死活。

en: A true warrior fights
for those who cannot
fight for themselves.
flavourtext:DivinationCardLonelyWarrior..zh:
一名貨真價實的戰士
始終為無力自我保護的人
奮戰不懈。

en: "I know one lady for whose sake I will rip out my heart"
- Derrok, the Dreamer
flavourtext:DivinationCardLoveThroughIce.zh:
"我認識一位令我為之傾心的女人"

-夢想家德羅克

en: Discipline forged our unbreakable Rampart.
Bastion against Despair.
flavourtext:DivinationCardLuckyBastion.T.zh:
紀律鑄就了我們堅不可摧的城壁。
抵擋絕望的壁壘。

en: <size:24>{Plenty enter, dreaming of treasure
Twenty bled, slain as they fled
Shadows loom, half left doomed
The blind cries, five lost eyes
Careless twins, a lich's new prize
One as a decoy, none pass the king
Gehennix feeds only on whispers}
flavourtext:DivinationCardLuminousTrove..zh:
<size:24> {大量闖入，夢想著寶藏
二十人流血，逃亡時被殺
陰影交織，注定要剩下一半
盲目哭泣，五人失明
粗心的雙胞胎，巫妖的新獎
一個作為誘餌，沒有一個通過國王
吉漢尼斯只以耳語為食}

en: <size:28>{I cannot contain myself,
but I can barely squeak,
so many words I'd have for you,
if I could only speak!}
flavourtext:DivinationCardMatryoshka.Tex.zh:
<size:28>{我控制不了自己，
但我卻只能發出微弱的聲音，
如果我能說話，
我有太多的話要對你說！}

en: <size:30>{He wandered the bone-filled depths hoping each corner would be his last.
Eventually, he found Light.}
flavourtext:DivinationCardMiseryInDarkne.zh:
<size:30>{他在滿是骨頭的深處徘徊，希望每個角落都是他的最後一個角落。
最終，他找到了光。}

en: <size:28>{"You cannot portray the world using just one colour. Together, you and I, we will paint our world into perfection."
- Kyra, renegade thaumaturgist}
flavourtext:DivinationCardMonochrome.Tex.zh:
<size:28>{"你不能只使用一種顏色描繪世界。你和我一起，我們將把我們的世界描繪完美無暇。" 
- 判變奇術師，奇拉}

en: <size:28>{Every skull was once a person.
Though 'Who?' is rarely asked.
Friends, who wear
the crown of Nook,
Never need to ask.
They remember.}
flavourtext:DivinationCardNooksCrown.Tex.zh:
<size:28>{每個亡顱都曾經是個生靈。 
雖然「是誰？」這問題很少被問。
帶上邊緣之冠
的朋友啊 
從不需要提問。 
他們仍記得。}

en: <size:30>{You want to know how
I haven't been caught?
It's not just speed.
You need some luck.}
flavourtext:DivinationCardOneLastScore.T.zh:
<size:30>{想知道我為什麼從沒被抓到嗎？
 不只是速度，還得靠一點運氣。}

en: The prize vanished.
No trail, no struggle.
Just a single, rust-red hair.
flavourtext:DivinationCardOutfoxed.Text.zh:
獎品消失了。
 沒有痕跡，沒有掙扎。
 只留下了一根鏽紅色的髮絲。

en: <size:26>{The unknowledgable know not
what treasures lie so closely
within their feeble reach.}
flavourtext:DivinationCardPearlsBeforeSw.zh:
<size:26>{無知者並不知曉
何等珍寶近在咫尺，
就在他們孱弱可及之處。}

en: Upon silent paws and masked by the reeds,
Farrul's hunt begins as the light recedes.
flavourtext:DivinationCardPrideOfTheFirs.zh:
寂靜的利爪被蘆葦所遮蔽，
當陽光消逝後，費爾羅的狩獵正式開始。

en: <size:28>{"For all your struggles, all your achievements, even for the greatest of us, a story is all that remains. Write it well."
-Julius Perandus, Father of Chitus}
flavourtext:DivinationCardRemembrance.Te.zh:
<size:28> {”對於你所有的掙扎，你所有的成就，即使對於我們中最偉大的人來說，所遺留下的就是個故事。好好寫。”

-朱利葉斯普蘭德思，切特斯之父}

en: If you believe hard enough,
you'll win.
flavourtext:DivinationCardRunicLuck.Text.zh:
堅定不移的信念
是獲勝的關鍵

en: <size:34>{He dispels dark realms
until mortal sufferings
yield to hopeful light.}
flavourtext:DivinationCardSambodhisVow.T.zh:
<size:34> {他驅散了黑暗疆域
直到凡人受難
屈服於希望的光芒。}

en: <size:28>{No blade conquers sin;
guide a sinner to virtue,
unveil their lost sight—
your eyes, too, see in
everyone the inner child,
no matter their might.}
flavourtext:DivinationCardSambodhisWisdo.zh:
<size:28>{沒有刀刃可以戰勝罪惡；
引導罪人走向美德，
揭開他迷失的眼光—
你的眼睛也一樣，
可以看到每個人的內在童貞，
無論他們的力量如何。}

en: Cry havoc!
Unleash pandemonium!
<size:28>{We live to dream of worlds we aren't in,
a false narrative that we use to fill our souls
with doubt;
The world is already beautiful,
there's no need to dream.}
flavourtext:DivinationCardSocietysRemors.zh:
<size:28>{我們為自己不屬於的世界而夢想，
這是一種虛假的敘述，
使我們充滿了懷疑。
世界已經美麗，
沒有夢想。}

en: Good things come
to those who wait;
but, greatness seeks
those who do not come.
flavourtext:DivinationCardTemperance.Tex.zh:
櫐櫐結果
有賴漫長等待；
豐功偉業
見證苦盡甘來。

en: <size:26>{"Such dedication for so many years,
all for a couple extra letters at the front of your name..."}
flavourtext:DivinationCardTheAcademic.Te.zh:
<size:26> {”這麼多年的奉獻精神，
只需在你的姓名前面加上幾個額外的字...”}

en: <size:26>{Those Exiles that survive Wraeclast
dream not of home, but of power.}
flavourtext:DivinationCardTheAspirant.Te.zh:
<size:26>{那些在瓦爾克拉斯倖存下來的流亡者
夢想的不是家，而是權力。}

en: <size:24>{They would say that he was a dangerous man,
unbound by the sense of morality,
but what does this matter,
when his love for humanity is undeniable
and completion of his work would benefit everyone?}
flavourtext:DivinationCardTheAstromancer.zh:
<size:24>{他們會說他是一個危險的人，
不受道德感約束，
但是當他對人類的愛不可否認
並且他的工作
完成將使所有人受益時，這有什麼關係呢?}

en: <size:24>{For the blessed bear in the cave,
A hundred days pass in silence and darkness,
until moon begins its fourth passage,
the bear sheds her beastly fur,
and is reborn, human and whole.}
flavourtext:DivinationCardTheBearWoman.T.zh:
<size:24>{對於山中那隻有被受祝福的熊，
在寂靜和黑暗中經過了一百天，
直到月亮開始第四次穿越，
熊才掉下野獸的皮毛，
重生了人類和整個身體。}

en: <size:23>{Vintage or crafted, Glittering and shiny
Dusty or glittering, huge or tiny
Secured within a chest
or unearthed from your mining
Find jewellery everywhere,
no need for divining!
So why is it so hard
to figure out which one to wear?
This one makes me stronger,
but does it match my hair?}
flavourtext:DivinationCardTheCache.Text.zh:
<size:23> {復古或手工製作，閃閃發光和有光澤
塵土飛揚或閃閃發光，巨大或微小
固定在胸部
或從你的採礦中發掘出來
隨處可見珠寶，
無需占卜！
那為什麼這麼難
找出穿哪一件？
這使我更堅強
但是它和我的頭髮匹配嗎？}

en: <size:28>{Souls along a conduit of blood,
from one vessel to the next.}
flavourtext:DivinationCardTheDamned.Text.zh:
<size:28> {沿著血管的靈魂，
從一艘船到下一艘。}

en: "I'm going for a walk. I'll be back soon."
- Blonca's last words
flavourtext:DivinationCardTheEasyStroll..zh:
"我出去走走。一下就回來。"

- 布隆卡的遺言

en: <size:28>{"Boss said to get rid of him, didn't say not to make a mess."
- Rune The Goon}
flavourtext:DivinationCardTheEnforcer.Te.zh:
<size:28>{"老闆說要除掉他，但沒說不要亂來。"
- 符文惡棍}

en: <size:25>{"Glimmers of benevolence,
Shrouded a lacquered lust for power,
Yet still they followed his influence."}
flavourtext:DivinationCardTheEnthusiasts.zh:
<size:25> {"仁慈的眼神，
籠罩著漆黑的慾望，
但是他們仍然跟隨著他的影響。"}

en: The Atlas invites us all
to a lifelong journey.
It would be unwise
to overstay our welcome.
flavourtext:DivinationCardTheEverlasting.zh:
輿圖邀請我們所有人
踏上這趟終生之旅。
但在此流連忘返
實為不智之舉。

en: It's about working smarter,
not harder.
flavourtext:DivinationCardTheForbiddenFr.zh:
重點在於聰明行事，
而非一味苦幹。

en: <size:26>{The fortunate find
generosity in the divine.}
flavourtext:DivinationCardTheFortunate.T.zh:
<size:26>{幸運的人在
神聖中尋找慷慨。}

en: <size:28>{I thought love stronger than all,
but time and isolation broke
that which madness could not.}
flavourtext:DivinationCardTheGulf.Text.zh:
<size:28> {我以為愛比所有東西厲害，
但是時間和孤獨打破了
瘋狂無法做到的。}

en: Gaze upon the Lake
Gaze upon your Reflection
Your full Potential
flavourtext:DivinationCardTheLake____.Te.zh:
「凝視湖面，
 凝視你的倒影——
 那是真正的潛能所在。」

en: <size:24>{Holding fast when shadows fall,
Over ruins, jesters call.
Nothing breaks their twisted cheer,
Kings of chaos, friends sincere.}
flavourtext:DivinationCardTheLastLaugh.T.zh:
<size:24>{暗影降臨仍緊握不放，
 廢墟之間，小丑放聲吟唱。
 無物能摧其扭曲的歡愉，
 混沌之王，摯友如初。}

en: <size:28>{Ancient behemoths swam the
depths of the oceans long
before Man walked these lands.}
flavourtext:DivinationCardTheLeviathan.T.zh:
<size:28>{遠在人類踏上這片土地之前，
遠古巨獸就優游在海洋深處。}

en: "The process of eternal youth is a give and take. You give them death and take their youth."
- Zerphi of the Vaal
flavourtext:DivinationCardTheLifeThief.T.zh:
"永恆青春的過程就是付出與收獲。你給他們死亡並帶走他們的青春。"
- 瓦爾的澤佛依

en: "This was the proudest moment of my life."
"... so far"
flavourtext:DivinationCardTheLongCon.Tex.zh:
"這是我一生中最驕傲的時刻。"

"…至今"

en: <size:28>{Through the eyes of a person,
you can see their soul
Through the eyes of a jewel,
you can see the universe}
flavourtext:DivinationCardTheMindsEyes.T.zh:
<size:28>{通過一個人的眼睛，
你可以看到他們的靈魂
透過寶石的眼睛，
你可以看到宇宙}

en: Despite arriving early,
her silly seraphim
couldn't be happier.
Octavia, 2023
flavourtext:DivinationCardTheMiracle.Tex.zh:
儘管提早到來，
她那傻氣的熾天使
依然無比幸福。
奧克塔維亞，2023

en: <size:28>{Charmed by beautiful stones
Consumed with the
pursuit of perfection
Ever deeper into the waiting dark}
flavourtext:DivinationCardTheMountain.Te.zh:
被美麗的岩石迷惑
被追求完美而消耗
極度深入等待的黑暗

en: <size:30>{Savor life's missing pieces.
To complete one's final goal
is to take one's last breath.}
flavourtext:DivinationCardTheOneThatGotA.zh:
<size:30>{品嚐生活中缺失的部分。
完成一個人的最終目標
就是嚥下最後一口氣。}

en: We play at God with our necromancy,
but forces far more potent
sleep within these stones.
flavourtext:DivinationCardThePrimordial..zh:
我們利用巫術扮演上帝，
但潛力無盡的力量 
沉睡在這些石頭中。

en: Born beneath silver light, bearing Lunaris' mark.
Conjuring all his might, the Prodigy turned light to dark.
flavourtext:DivinationCardTheProgenyOfLu.zh:
誕生於銀光下，帶著月耀之印。
神童施展奇術，把光明變成了黑暗。

en: He thought she was all
he ever wanted,
yet his heart yearned
for something more.
flavourtext:DivinationCardTheReflectiono.zh:
他原以為她就是
自己渴求的一切，
然而他的內心
卻期盼著更多事物。

en: From silly pondering
comes legend,
and from legend,
horned fortune
flavourtext:DivinationCardTheSillyBoy.Te.zh:
傻氣的沉思
造就了傳奇，
而從傳奇之中，
誕生了犄角之財

en: He slumbers...
But soon he will awaken.
flavourtext:DivinationCardTheSlumberingB.zh:
牠正沉眠著……
但不久即將甦醒。

en: <size:30>{"I am not alone in this. I have God by my side! And... you help sometimes, I suppose."
- Sister Cassia}
flavourtext:DivinationCardTheTirelessExt.zh:
<size:30>{"我並不孤單。我有上帝在我身邊！而且...你有時會幫忙，我猜。"
- 修女卡西亞}

en: <size:26>{They came from far and wide under a common banner.
They sought companionship and competition,
but found a treasure none had foreseen.}
flavourtext:DivinationCardTheUnexpectedP.zh:
<size:26>{他們來自世界各地，有著共同的旗幟。
他們尋求同伴和競爭，
但發現沒有預見到的寶藏。}

en: <size:25>{They thought winter had come early,
that snow blanketed the land,
but in truth, all their chickens
had come home to roost.}
flavourtext:DivinationCardTheWhiteout.Te.zh:
<size:28>{他們認為冬天來得早，
大雪覆蓋了土地，
但實際上，他們的所有雞隻
已經回家棲息。}

en: <size:28>{A ravenous mind can readily take in ideas from any source.
Fortunately for the scholars, he has already learned about sustainability.}
flavourtext:DivinationCardThirstForKnowl.zh:
<size:28>{貪婪的心智可以輕易的接受任何想法。
對於學者來說幸運的是，他已經了解持之以恆。}

en: A beast even Einhar
will not hunt.
flavourtext:DivinationCardToxicTidings.T.zh:
一頭連埃哈
都不願狩獵的野獸。

en: <size:23>{The cities of the Empire were plundered
by those who came after... all but one.}
flavourtext:DivinationCardTreasuresOfThe.zh:
<size:23>{帝國的城市被後來者
掠奪…只剩一處。}

en: <size:26>{The pale flame of his heart disappeared in his azure reflection.
The work of a life.
Ambitious, and unfinished.}
flavourtext:DivinationCardUnrequitedLove.zh:
<size:26> {他湛藍的反射中消失了他內心蒼白的火焰。
一生工作。
雄心勃勃且未結束。}

en: <size:24>{Dread and danger
makes the air feel thin.
Above, power slumbers, tempting fate.
Greed and ambition
draws countless in,
For those who seek power
can never wait.}
flavourtext:DivinationCardVilePower.Text.zh:
<size:24> {恐懼和危險
讓空氣稀薄。
在權力沉睡，誘人的命運之上。
貪婪和野心
吸引無數，
對於那些尋求權力的人
永遠不能等待。}

en: In their fiery union,
the storm left the rivers
forever changed.
flavourtext:DivinationCardWhenCurrentsBl.zh:
在他們猛烈交會的同時，
激起的風暴讓諸河川舊景不在。

en: <size:23>{In the midst
of unrelenting requests,
the blacksmith's forge
conjures the unpredictable
Countless voices, countless desires –
yielding weapons as diverse
as those who ask}
flavourtext:DivinationCardWhoAsked.Text.zh:
<size:23>{在不居於停歇的
請求之中，
鐵匠的熔爐
召喚了不可預測的
無數聲音，無數慾望 -
產生了多樣的武器，
如同提出請求的人們一樣}

en: <size:29>{Come home to me, my sweet.
Oh, how long you've been!
Lie with me in the frozen dark.
I may yet find forgiveness
Now that fear has left you.}
flavourtext:DivinationCardWintersEmbrace.zh:
<size:29> {親愛的，請到我的懷中。
哦，你走了多久了！
在冰冷的黑暗中與我說謊。
我可能仍會發現寬恕
現在，恐懼已經離開了你。}

en: Power is a curious thing.
It can be contained, hidden, locked away,
and yet it always breaks free.
flavourtext:DivineVessel.Text.zh:
力量是一種神奇的存在，
雖然可以拘束、隱藏或封鎖起來，
但最後還是能將一切阻礙掰開。

en: When the demon Goat plays his flute,
And cloven hooves clip-clop your path,
Pray the gods will hold you mute,
And bless the fire on your hearth.
flavourtext:DivineVesselAbberath.Text.zh:
當惡魔山羊吹響笛子並向你走來時，
祈禱眾神會幫你靜音。

en: There is a story held by the ancient Vaal, in which the
beautiful seductress Arakaali strode through towns, stealing
the hearts of men, and turning to ash their lovers' desires.
- "Legends of the Vaal" by Eramir, Scholar at Theopolis
flavourtext:DivineVesselArakaali1.Text.zh:
"一則古代瓦爾的故事，在其中
美麗的誘惑者艾爾卡莉大步穿過城鎮，
偷竊男人的心，將他們情人的渴望轉為塵埃。"
-"瓦爾傳說"費歐普羅斯學者，艾米爾

en: When the cold was at its strongest, Arakaali came,
and like a farmer leading cattle to the slaughter,
she drove her victims into the outer darkness.
- "Legends of the Vaal" by Eramir, Scholar at Theopolis
flavourtext:DivineVesselArakaali2.Text.zh:
"每當寒冷至極時，艾爾卡莉前來，
像個農人領導著牲畜前去屠宰，
她把她的受害者驅逐到外面的黑暗中。"
-"瓦爾傳說"費歐普羅斯學者，艾米爾

en: Records of Arakaali's violent reign suggest she kept her citizens
sedated with 'juices of lust' and venoms of the spider. Perhaps her
guise of seductress was in fact her way of farming those 'juices'.
- "Legends of the Vaal" by Eramir, Scholar at Theopolis
flavourtext:DivineVesselArakaali3.Text.zh:
"艾爾卡莉暴力的統治，就像她利用了某種蜘蛛魔液
使她的公民迷幻。誘惑也許只是她生產這些“果汁”的幌子。
-"瓦爾傳說"費歐普羅斯學者，艾米爾

en: Though his mind decayed with each passing wave,
the Brine King stood steadfast in his hatred,
and wore it like a shell, protecting himself
from his failure to sire a worthy heir.
flavourtext:DivineVesselBrineKing1.Text.zh:
即使他的思想隨著浪潮衰退，
海洋之主堅定的立於憎恨之中，
將它做為外殼，保護著自己不再失敗，
不再找尋下一位繼承者。

en: The fish-wives of Tsoatha rejoiced loudly as
the Brine King descended into the great abyss,
making merry while his blasphemous offspring
slithered 'neath the icy waters...
flavourtext:DivineVesselBrineKing2.Text.zh:
當海王沒入了無盡的深淵，
特索塔的魚夫人大聲歡呼，
然而海王褻瀆的後代，
在冰冷的水域裡滑行著。

en: Slumbering in the breach between worlds,
the Brine King dreamt of a day he would rise,
in triumph from the shivering depths and take
back the Kingdom he once so ruthlessly culled.
flavourtext:DivineVesselBrineKing3.Text.zh:
在異界間的裂痕沉睡，
海王夢想著甦醒那天，
從寒栗的深處奪回
曾經無情剔除他的王國。

en: Garukhan wished once more for the skies. If she were to die,
she wanted it to be up there in the clouds. This world had never
been her home. She required greater things. She required adventure.
But die she would, here in the dirt...
flavourtext:DivineVesselGarukhan.Text.zh:
卡洛翰希望再次登上天空。
如果她死了，她希望能死於雲層。
這個世界從來不是她的家，
她需要更多的東西。她需要冒險。
但她將在泥土中死去…

en: The earth shakes, moon eclipses black.
Graveyards quake, crops turn to ash,
as the grieving mother weeps.
Oceans boil and wind ravages home.
We feel famine inside our bones,
as the grieving mother, Gruthkul weeps.
flavourtext:DivineVesselGruthkul.Text.zh:
大地震盪，月亮日灼黑。
墓地震動，農物化作灰，
悲傷的母親流淚。
海洋沸騰、風災家園。
當悲傷的母親，葛魯斯寇哭泣時。

en: Once beneath a moonlit sky, Lunaris bathed her child in the ocean's tide.
Though the waters were frigid with icy death, the boy was sick and
couldn't be healthy until he was silent, clean and still...
flavourtext:DivineVesselLunaris1.Text.zh:
月光下，月影在大海的潮水中沐浴著她的孩子。
雖然海水冰冷，但男孩卻病了，
他將在沉默，清潔和靜止到來後，獲得救贖。

en: And so it was, that Lunaris, in her compulsion to nurture and protect,
killed her son beneath the light of a waning moon. She stood silent, in
trial before her tribe, as her fiery sister fought in vain to defend her...
flavourtext:DivineVesselLunaris2.Text.zh:
就這樣，月影在她的培育和保護的本性下，
在一個月亮殘月的光線下殺死了他的兒子。
她沉默著在她的部落之前，她火熱的姐姐妄圖捍衛她.....

en: But Lunaris refused to admit any wrongdoing. She'd saved her child, had she not?
He was safe now, buried beneath the dirt. Conviction gnarled around her fragile mind,
and in her pride she rose to seat a deathless throne.
flavourtext:DivineVesselLunaris3.Text.zh:
月影拒絕承認自己做出了任何不當行為，
她救了她的孩子，不是嗎？
他現在很安全，埋在泥土下面。
她脆弱的周圍，充滿了定罪的聲響。
而她驕傲地坐上了一個死去的寶座。

en: "Lock the gates and build the walls!" came the rallying cry,
"Let those of Ralakesh take care of those of Ralakesh!"
- The God Behind The Wall
flavourtext:DivineVesselRalakesh.Text.zh:
"關了大門！建造城牆！"激勵的戰吼喊著
"讓那些芮勒蓋許自相殘殺！"
-城牆後面的神

en: Ryslatha was flushed with pride as she watched her mindless spawn
mature. Sharpening their mandibles, her children slithered from the hive,
eager to devour all the creatures that frequented the ancient woods.
flavourtext:DivineVesselRyslatha.Text.zh:
瑞斯拉薩自豪地看著無意識的卵成熟
她的孩子們磨尖了下頜，
渴望吞噬所有經常光顧古樹林的生物。

en: "So it's true." Shakari thought, as she took her final breath.
"My father, Sin, wishes me dead. And he has sent his rabid dog to do it..."
flavourtext:DivineVesselShakari.Text.zh:
"是真的。“夏卡莉想著並嚥下了最後一口氣。
“我的父親，罪，希望我死去。而且他派了病犬......“

en: The mud is cracked and dry. The fields now burn beneath the blistering sun.
Even our children are dying in the streets! We've angered Solaris and so
we pay tribute to appease her fiery heart...
flavourtext:DivineVesselSolaris1.Text.zh:
泥土破裂乾燥，田野在炎陽下燃燒。
我們的孩子在街上死去！我們激怒了日耀，
現在我們必須付出代價..

en: When Solaris is angered, there must always be sacrifice. Our women
have taken to mourning, they drag themselves through ash and glass,
not wanting to give up our youth to the all-consuming flame.
flavourtext:DivineVesselSolaris2.Text.zh:
當日耀受激怒時，我們將會附出代價。
女人們哀悼，他們拖曳自己通過灰燼和玻璃，
抗拒將青春交付於燃燒一切的火焰。

en: To take from the sun is to invite her wrath, and we've more than warranted her curse.
The granaries were vacant, so we lessened our tribute to the sun thinking it would
save our children, but they will die now regardless.
flavourtext:DivineVesselSolaris3.Text.zh:
奪取陽光就像是邀請她發怒，
我們已經受到了她的詛咒。
糧倉已空，我們必須減少貢獻，
但已無所謂，我們終將死亡。

en: Tukohama stood in the door, blocking the sunlight
from Hikatomanga and his family. The Father of War's
retribution was inevitable, for it is known - man
cannot cheat the gods without consequence...
flavourtext:DivineVesselTukohama.Text.zh:
圖克哈瑪站在門外，擋住了西卡圖瑪卡與家人的陽光，
戰爭之父的報應是不可避免的，因為這是人所共知的
欺騙神…絕不會帶來好的結局。

en: In nature, there are many feelings exclusive only to man. But terror is not one.
Terror flourishes in our world, transcending all things. It is the bedrock on
which our great cosmos is formed. I am Yugul and I deign to understand this
mystery, to explore its depths and unlock its secrets...
flavourtext:DivineVesselYugul.Text.zh:
在本質上，存在只有男人才有的感受，
但是恐懼並非其中之一。
恐懼在我們的世界繁榮，超越一切。
這是基礎偉大的宇宙形成的基石。
我是伊果，我必須了解這神秘的事實，
探索其深度，揭開其秘密......

en: In the heart of a true warrior,
the war never ends.
flavourtext:DomainTimelessFlavour.Text.zh:
在真正戰士的心中，
戰爭永不止息。

en: The minds of men are but motes
on a sea of infinite madness.
flavourtext:DreamFurnaceFlavourText.Text.zh:
人的思想不過是無限瘋狂的
海洋上的一粒粒塵埃。

en: The cosmos birthed from nothing,
and to nothing it shall Decay.
flavourtext:ElderAtlasNodeFlavour.Text.zh:
宇宙自虛無中誕生，
也終將歸於虛無而腐朽。

en: True to his title,
Voll, newly crowned,
had many of the
Eternal Empire's signature
extravagances destroyed.
flavourtext:EmperorOfPurity.Text.zh:
與其頭銜名符其實，
新登基者，福爾
摧毀許多
不朽帝國著名的
奢侈與浮華。

en: With the right tools and a precise hand, the manipulation of the crystals
can be made predictable.
flavourtext:EssenceScarabOfStability.Tex.zh:
有了正確的工具和精準的雙手，
便可人為預測並操縱晶體。

en: "Darkness lurks within us all. The void from beyond
Time ever seeks to reclaim what we have stolen. Do
you think your fate will be any different from mine?"
flavourtext:FaridunBossKey.Text.zh:
「黑暗潛伏於我們所有人心中。來自時間彼岸的虛無，
始終試圖奪回我們偷走的一切。你真以為你的命運會與我不同嗎？」

en: Kaom guided his Karui across the sea
and spilled their blood on foreign soil.
flavourtext:FatedUnique1.Text.zh:
岡姆引領他的卡魯穿越海洋
使他們血灑於異國之地。

en: Giant's blood you cannot tame,
as wild as an unwatched flame.
flavourtext:FatedUnique10.Text.zh:
巨人之血無法被訓服，
像森林大火般狂野。

en: Let it pierce you, let blood flow.
Make more room for the soul to grow.
flavourtext:FatedUnique11.Text.zh:
讓他將你刺穿，讓血液流出。
讓你的靈魂有更多生長的空間。

en: Flesh may freeze and rot,
but the soul remains unbroken.
flavourtext:FatedUnique16.Text.zh:
軀體會結凍、腐蝕，
但靈魂不被摧毀。

en: "The Vaal, a thousand years ago,
came up with more delightful methods of murder
than I could ever wish for."
- Koralus Doomfletch
flavourtext:FatedUnique19_.Text.zh:
「瓦爾，千年以前，
發明了在我想像之外
更加令人興奮的謀殺方式。」
- 「毀滅之弦」寇拉盧斯

en: Where steel-grey clouds gather and crash together,
a storm is sure to follow.
flavourtext:FatedUnique21.Text.zh:
當鋼鐵般的烏雲聚集結合時，
一場風暴肯定將要來臨。

en: The last sweet music to touch Hrimnor's ears
passed right beneath his chin.
flavourtext:FatedUnique22.Text.zh:
雷姆諾最後聽到的甜蜜之樂
從他下巴之下穿越。

en: "The flames are surely coming.
I just pray I am long dead before they arrive."
- Archbishop Geofri
flavourtext:FatedUnique24.Text.zh:
「火焰必定到來。
我只祈禱我不會活到那一天。」
- 大主教吉爾菲

en: The soldiers stormed her throne room.
The guards held them at bay.
The peasants overwhelmed the guards.
The nobles paid for their lives.
The nobles took her throne,
and so she fled to the woods.
flavourtext:FatedUnique25.Text.zh:
士兵攻破她的皇室大廳。
衛兵將它們抵擋於海灣。
民眾擊潰了衛兵。
貴族付出生命為代價。
貴族奪取了她的王位，
而她朝叢林中逃竄。

en: "A taste of Midnight, and you may never see the dawn."
- Inquisitor Maligaro
flavourtext:FatedUnique26.Text.zh:
"午夜的味道，你可能永遠看不到黎明。"
- 審判者馬雷葛蘿

en: "At last, my beauty is beyond reproach."
- Atziri, Queen of the Vaal
flavourtext:FatedUnique27.Text.zh:
"至少我的美麗是不容疑義的。"
- 瓦爾女王阿茲里

en: It was Doedre who learned that pain is just
as much about fear as it is about injury.
flavourtext:FatedUnique28.Text.zh:
德瑞知道疼痛和恐懼
都和受創有關聯。

en: You cannot control the storm,
but you can utilise it.
flavourtext:FatedUnique29_.Text.zh:
你無法控制風暴，
但你可以利用它。

en: "Laws are for city folk.
Can't try a man for murder if you can't find him."
- Taruk, Last of the Wildmen
flavourtext:FatedUnique31.Text.zh:
"法律是用在人民身上的。
如果你無法找到他，就無法定他的罪。"
- 最後的野人塔盧克

en: Beneath the frozen eye of Lunaris
a new world will be born.
A crystalline, perfectly still utopia.
flavourtext:FatedUnique32.Text.zh:
在月影神被冰封的雙眼下
一個新世界將誕生。
清澈、完美的烏托邦。

en: Burning goddess, shine so bright.
Set the world 'fore you alight.
flavourtext:FatedUnique34.Text.zh:
燃燒的女神，閃耀如此燦爛。
讓世界擺脫眼前的處境。

en: An open mouth, a blinding shriek,
Your mind goes dark, your body weak.
flavourtext:FatedUnique35.Text.zh:
張開的嘴巴，盲目的尖叫，
你的心智被黑暗侵蝕，身體越來越虛弱。

en: Embrace your burning ambition.
Embrace your frozen heart.
You will be transformed.
flavourtext:FatedUnique36.Text.zh:
接受你燃起的野心。
接受你被冰封的心。
你將會被改變。

en: "Even for the great Magi,
time passes without relent."
- Doryani, Queen's Thaumaturgist
flavourtext:FatedUnique37.Text.zh:
“即使是偉大的賢者，
時間也沒有留情。“
- 女王奇術師多里亞尼

en: "The most dizzying heights are surrounded by precipitous falls.
Progress cannot be eternal."
- Doryani of the Vaal
flavourtext:FatedUnique38.Text.zh:
"最令人暈眩的高地被陡峭的瀑布所環繞。
進步不可能是永恆的。"
- 瓦爾多里亞尼

en: "Cut down the tallest tree,
and another becomes the tallest."
- Old Ezomyte saying
flavourtext:FatedUnique39.Text.zh:
“砍下最高的樹，
讓另一個成為最高的。“
- 艾茲麥的古老智慧

en: The Karui boats were closing the gap,
but Shavronne had laid for them one final trap.
flavourtext:FatedUnique4.Text.zh:
卡魯的船隻越來越接近，
但薛朗為他們準備了最後一個陷阱。

en: Follow your most basic instincts.
The rest will come naturally.
flavourtext:FatedUnique40.Text.zh:
跟隨你最原始的直覺，
剩下的都會自然湧現。

en: Asenath loosed arrows with almost musical rhythm,
a rhythm matched by her nearly inaudible whispers,
and the crunch of the dead hitting the dust.
flavourtext:FatedUnique41.Text.zh:
安賽娜絲幾乎失去音樂的韻律，
這個韻律跟她難以聽見的低語吻合，
死亡正嘎吱撞擊著塵土。

en: "Make a man believe he is doing the world a good deed,
and there is nothing you can't make him do."
- Malachai, the Soulless
flavourtext:FatedUnique42.Text.zh:
讓一個人相信他正在為世界做一件好事，
那就沒有什麼是你不能讓他做的。
- 卑鄙的瑪拉凱

en: There is no cost too great to pay for power.
Merely men who lack the conviction to pay it.
flavourtext:FatedUnique43.Text.zh:
沒有足夠的代價可以支付力量。
僅有那些缺少罪孽的人可以應付。

en: By light we are shadowed,
in darkness we are bound.
flavourtext:FatedUnique45.Text.zh:
我們之於光明是影子，
在黑暗中我們受到約束。

en: Few men command an army better
than the Great Meginord of the North
flavourtext:FatedUnique46.Text.zh:
只有少數人能夠指揮他的軍隊
像是北方的梅吉諾德

en: Few men can guide their people
like the Great Meginord of the North
flavourtext:FatedUnique47.Text.zh:
只有少數人能夠帶領他的人民
像是北方的梅吉諾德

en: Hyrri's quick thinking led to victory,
but it came at the cost of respect.
flavourtext:FatedUnique49.Text.zh:
西里的果斷贏得了勝利，
但是以尊重為代價。

en: The overture stretches thin,
The chorus gathers to begin.
Stacatto, drone, a rest drawn long,
Another hears Death's final song.
flavourtext:FatedUnique5.Text.zh:
序曲即將終結，
合唱即將開始。
突然的，低沉的，延長的休止符，
接著而來為最終的死亡之歌。

en: Make a man hot, and his heart will skip a beat.
Set a man on fire, and his heart will skip all beats.
flavourtext:FatedUnique50.Text.zh:
讓男人起心，他的心會漏一拍。
讓男人動念，他的心將停止跳動。

en: The night dances on
Wine continues to flow
Your skin looking pale
Your soul letting go
flavourtext:FatedUnique51.Text.zh:
在夜晚舞動
酒繼續流動
你的皮膚很蒼白
你的靈魂放手了

en: "Confess your sins to me. My god will not be nearly so forgiving."
- Archbishop Geofri of Phrecia Cathedral
flavourtext:FatedUnique52.Text.zh:
"向我坦承你的罪行。我的神沒那麼容易寬恕。"
- 費西亞大教堂的大主教吉爾菲

en: "Please, take whatever you want. Just don't kill me"
"But then I wouldn't have everything I want, would I?"
flavourtext:FatedUnique53.Text.zh:
"求求你拿走任何你想要的東西。留我一命。"
"但我沒有想要的東西，是吧?"

en: Legend tells of a time when Solaris will
burst forth from Lunaris,
and night will be eternally banished.
flavourtext:FatedUnique55.Text.zh:
傳說日耀神將會
從月影神爆裂出來，
這時夜晚將永被驅逐。

en: One more partner by the hand,
Let your steps entwine.
Spin together, swing as one,
And dance with death in trine.
flavourtext:FatedUnique56.Text.zh:
又一個夥伴搭著手，
你們的步伐交纏在一起。
一同旋轉，合而為一，
與死亡跳著三人舞。

en: "Stand steadfast in the face of destruction.
The Council cannot afford to falter."
- Mauritius, the Iron Heart
flavourtext:FatedUnique57.Text.zh:
面對破壞，堅定不移。
議會不能動搖。
- 鋼鐵之心，馬里求斯

en: The weight of faith is great
Yet it is never borne alone.
flavourtext:FatedUnique58.Text.zh:
信仰是沉重的
但它從來不獨自承擔。

en: Even the dead dare not
trespass into Ullr's dominion.
flavourtext:FatedUnique59_.Text.zh:
即使死亡也不敢
侵犯烏勒爾的統治權。

en: "Though Geofri's beacon was extinguished,
his embers may yet light our way."
- Victario, The People's Poet
flavourtext:FatedUnique60.Text.zh:
"即使吉爾菲的光輝被撲滅，
他的餘燼能會照亮我們的道路。"
- 人民詩人維多里奧

en: Fire spreads thick and fast.
The first spark is never the last.
flavourtext:FatedUnique8.Text.zh:
火焰迅速竄升漫延。
最初的火花永遠不是最終。

en: Flames to guide the Great Spirit to the site of the dead,
and smoke to carry them into the sky.
flavourtext:FatedUnique9.Text.zh:
火焰引領偉大得靈魂至亡者的世界，
煙帶領他們飄向天空。

en: "Darnaw is stupid and confident.
I am certain he will have recorded his misdeeds."
flavourtext:Faustus1.Text.zh:
"達爾奈是愚蠢而自信的。
我相信他會記錄自己的過失。"

en: "Fidium's fealty to fairness
makes him the perfect pawn in my plan.
Our plan. Perfect pawn in OUR plan."
flavourtext:Faustus2.Text.zh:
菲迪恩對公平的忠誠使
他成為我計劃中的完美典當。
我們的計劃。 我們計劃的完美典當。

en: Machinery is merely the shaping
of reality by the mind.
flavourtext:FortressMapFlavour.Text.zh:
機械不過是心智
對現實的塑形。

en: When hunger can never be satiated, the
act of eating becomes the only solace.
flavourtext:FragmentUniqueAmulet1_2.Text.zh: 當飢餓無法平息，進食成了唯一的慰藉。

en: Our Lady Dialla,
as a symbol of our progress,
shines greater than all the gems.
flavourtext:GiftOfTheGemlingQueen.Text.zh:
我們的達拉夫人
是顯示我們進步的標誌
即使是寶石，也不比她的光芒來得耀眼

en: Of ash and avalanche,
in storm and flesh,
we dream of unity.
The time approaches...
flavourtext:GraspingMailFlavourText.Text.zh:
灰燼和雪崩，
在暴風雨中，
我們夢想團結。
時間到了…

en: <size:29>{Shrieking souls locked away
Hate splits frozen cells asunder
The knot of corruption
undone at last}
flavourtext:HarmonyOfSouls.Text.zh:
<size:29>{尖嘯之魂被囚禁
仇恨將冰凍的囚房四分五裂
腐敗的結
最終仍被解開}

en: "As warm as living flesh, and smelling strongly of sulphite.
Morbid curiosity compels me to add it to my collection of oddities."
flavourtext:HeistAbberathine Horns.Text.zh:
“像活的肉一樣溫暖，並強烈地聞到硫酸。
病態的好奇心迫使我將其添加到我的奇特收藏中。"

en: "When hope was but a memory, the twin sister Sekhemas Solerai and Lundara arose to unite the Maraketh.
They wielded the essence of gold and silver. The Spear is one of the two weapons that forged us."
flavourtext:HeistAdiyah1.Text.zh:
“當希望不過是記憶的時候，雙胞胎姊妹絲克瑪索拉萊和倫達拉站起來團結了馬拉克斯。
他們運用了黃金和白銀的精髓。 矛是鍛造我們的兩把武器之一。"

en: "Wraeclast is harsh, and the Plains of Vastiri are unforgiving. We Maraketh can
ill afford an internal war. We must prove that Nashta is behind these attacks."
flavourtext:HeistAdiyah2.Text.zh:
“ 瓦爾克拉斯很殘酷，瓦斯提里平原也不能原諒。我們馬拉克斯可以
不能承受內戰。 我們必須證明納什塔是這些攻擊的幕後黑手。"

en: "Admiral Proclar wreaked havoc on my smuggling routes for two full decades. Now that he's dead,
it's a matter of thieves' honour to check whether my product was in his pipe."
flavourtext:HeistAdmiralProclarsPipe.Tex.zh:
"普克勒上將在我的走私路線上造成了整整二十年的破壞。現在他死了，
檢查我的產品是否在他的煙斗中是竊賊的榮幸。"

en: "The chalice holds certain properties that make scientists quite possessive and irrational.
It's best if you don't ask too many questions about this one."
flavourtext:HeistAlchemicalChalice.Text.zh:
"聖杯擁有某些特性，使科學家變得佔有慾和非理性。
最好不要對這個問題問太多問題。"

en: "At first glance, this seal seems no more than an ornament. But when one
looks closer, one realizes the design is from no culture we yet know of."
flavourtext:HeistAncientSeal.Text.zh:
"乍看之下，這種印章似乎不過是一種裝飾品。但是當
人們近距離觀察時，人們會意識到這種設計並非來自我們尚不了解的文化。"

en: "In the early days of his religion, Innocence told his followers to drink of his blood and
enjoy eternal life. If that power holds in his ancient ichor, I hope that it can resurrect as well."
flavourtext:HeistBloodOfInnocence.Text.zh:
"宗教信仰的初期，無罪告訴他的追隨者喝血並享受永生。
如果這種力量在他古老的棒汞中依然存在，我希望它也能複活。"

en: "Allegedly turns water to Lethe. That makes it my competition.
I don't like competition."
flavourtext:HeistBoxofTripyxis.Text.zh:
"據說是把水交給萊特。使得它成為我的競賽。
我不喜歡競爭。"

en: "This unassuming rock reportedly fell from the sky a few centuries ago. Sounds impossible,
but the men who are guarding it obviously believe the tale, so I do, too."
flavourtext:HeistCelestialStone.Text.zh:
"據說這不起眼的岩石是幾個世紀前從天上掉下來的。聽起來是不可能的，
但是守衛它的人顯然相信這個故事，我也是。"

en: "A symbol of my birthright and claim to my fiefdom.
I must have it if I am to return my family to its rightful place."
flavourtext:HeistCrestofEzomyr.Text.zh:
“象徵我與生俱來的權利，並宣稱擁有我的領地。
如果我要讓家人回到其應有的地位，我必須擁有它。"

en: "A simple ornament from the days when Keth's trade empire was the
glory of the world. Protectors at the massive toll gates wore these."
flavourtext:HeistDekharasResolve.Text.zh:
“從凱斯的貿易帝國成為世界榮耀的日子起，
這是一件簡單的裝飾品。收費站旁的保護者戴著這些裝飾品。"

en: "The Eldritch Blade is one half of a pair. Together, the two are said to drive men
insane by revealing the truth of the world to them. I wish to know this truth."
flavourtext:HeistEldritchBlade.Text.zh:
"異能之劍是一對的一半。據說這兩個人通過向他們
揭示世界的真相來使人發瘋。我希望知道這個真相。"

en: "Caspiro was a master of presentation. He maintained peace in Wraeclast through displays
of strength that, sadly, had no meaning to the dark presence that dismembered him..."
flavourtext:HeistEmperorCaspiro.Text.zh:
"卡斯皮羅是演講的大師。他通過展示力量來保持在瓦爾克拉斯的和平，
可悲的是，這種力量對肢解他的黑暗存在毫無意義…"

en: "I currently possess four-hundred and forty-four pieces of this ancient
and puzzling device. A few seem to be missing. This part is crucial."
flavourtext:HeistEnigmaticAssemblyA.Text.zh:
"我目前擁有這種古老而令人費解的裝置的
四百四十四件。似乎缺少了一些。這部分至關重要。"

en: "There is no telling what this device may do when completed, but I
have made it my life's work. There must be a deeper meaning!"
flavourtext:HeistEnigmaticAssemblyB.Text.zh:
"有任何消息說這台設備完成後會做什麼，
但是我已經把它變成了我的一生。必須有更深的含義！"

en: "I have spent my family's entire fortune in the pursuit of this device.
Assembling it and turning it on is all I have left."
flavourtext:HeistEnigmaticAssemblyC.Text.zh:
"我全家人的財產都花在了購買該設備上。
我只剩下組裝並打開它了。"

en: "My schematics are clear. Once the Enigmatic Assembly is complete, it
will be a weapon to rival the gods! It must be... it has to be..."
flavourtext:HeistEnigmaticAssemblyD.Text.zh:
"我的示意圖很清晰。神秘大會一旦完成，
它將是與眾神抗衡的武器！必須是...它必須是…"

en: "Trust in scientists to create tools for better drug distillation. They don't know the
worth of the beautiful tools they have. Let's make sure it stays that way."
flavourtext:HeistEssenceBurner.Text.zh:
"科學家們為創造更好的藥物蒸餾工具而感到信任。
他們不知道自己擁有的精美工具的價值。讓我們確保它保持這種狀態。"

en: "A true curiosity. Matches no known language, yet its illustrations hint at knowledge
only rediscovered hundreds of years after the death of its unknown author."
flavourtext:HeistEzMyraeTome.Text.zh:
“真正的好奇心。任何語言都無法符合，但其暗示了知識
直到其不知名的作者去世數百年後才重新被發現。"

en: "Long ago, a traitor was promised this mythical elixir. We consider her a fool for
believing it exists, but if it does... I would certainly like to take a sip and find out."
flavourtext:HeistFlaskOfWelakath.Text.zh:
"很久以前，就向叛徒許諾過這個神話般的長生不老藥。
我們認為她是個傻瓜，因為相信它存在，但如果確實存在，我肯定會一口找出來。"

en: "The lamp is said to contain Aziza, the Fourth Servant of Water. I doubt the tale
is true, but I cannot allow one of our artifacts to fall into Kondor's hands."
flavourtext:HeistForbiddenLamp.Text.zh:
"說那盞燈包含水的第四僕人阿齊扎。我懷疑這個故事是真的，
但我不能讓我們的一件手工藝品落入康多的手中。"

en: "I heard the script will send any who attempt to perform it mad,
but other than that, it is very good."
flavourtext:HeistGianna1.Text.zh:
"我聽說劇本會發任何試圖瘋狂執行該劇本的人，
但除此之外，它非常好。"

en: "Make sure it'll fit a small man, or a very large child.
And check for stains! Knew a few people who'd use them for-...
...Just check for stains."
flavourtext:HeistGianna2.Text.zh:
"確保適合小個子或一個大孩子。
並檢查是否有污漬！ 知道一些將它們用於...的人
...只需檢查污漬即可。"

en: "The relief depicts some sort of forgotten Maraketh goddess. I have no idea what
the context is. The important thing is that you steal it before Bazira does."
flavourtext:HeistGoddessOfWater.Text.zh:
"浮雕描繪了某種被遺忘的馬拉克斯女神。
我不知道背景是什麼。重要的是，你要在巴齊拉之前偷走它。"

en: "I found the tomb in the first place, and they had the nerve to empty it without me!
Reckon it'll make a fine trophy for my efforts."
flavourtext:HeistGoldenIdol1.Text.zh:
"我首先找到了那個墳墓，他們沒有我的勇氣就把它清空了！
認為它會為我的努力錦上添花。"

en: "One must, as one should, admire the lasting works of those who came before.
The Vaal were the uncontested greatest architects until we,
and Matatl soared above their best."
flavourtext:HeistGoldenIdol2.Text.zh:
"必須，應該敬佩那些來世的人們的持久著作。
瓦爾是無可爭議的最偉大的建築師，直到我們
麥塔爾飆升至最高水平。"

en: "I believe she was a beautiful maiden.
Kind, virtuous and devout through-and-through.
Such a gift will set me apart from all other suitors."
flavourtext:HeistGoldenIdol3.Text.zh:
"我相信她是個美麗的少女。
善良，美德和虔誠。
這樣的禮物會讓我與所有其他追求者脫穎而出。"

en: "Victims of war, the indebted, and the irredeemably shamed
were to live their lives in servitude. Some rose above their station.
This individual, it seems, was all but deified."
flavourtext:HeistGoldenIdol4.Text.zh:
"戰爭的受害者，負債累累，無法挽回的羞恥，
是要使自己的生活陷入奴役狀態。有些人升上了崗位。
看來，這個人幾乎已經神化了。"

en: "Heard if you put a drop of blood in its mouth,
it'll whisper the secrets of immortality.
Doesn't have to be your own blood, does it?"
flavourtext:HeistGoldenIdol5.Text.zh:
"聽見，如果你在嘴裡滴一滴血，
它會低語不朽的秘密。
不必一定是你自己的血，是嗎？"

en: "I'll give it to her and tell her
'It once held the reflection of a Queen, and now it will once more.'
Anton can cross the Vastiri on his family fruits
if he thinks he loves her like I do."
flavourtext:HeistGoldenIdol6.Text.zh:
我會把它給她，然後告訴她：
“曾經有女王的倒影，現在又會了。”
安東可以靠他的家庭水果渡過瓦斯提里
如果他認為自己像我一樣愛她。

en: "It is said that the Golden Ibis was forged before time itself, before writing, or even
oral history. That's nonsense, of course, but it's still very old, and therefore noteworthy."
flavourtext:HeistGoldenToucan.Text.zh:
"據說這是早在時間本身，寫作之前甚至甚至是口述歷史之前就已經鑄就的黃金愛必斯。
當然，這是胡說八道，但是它仍然很古老，因此值得關注。"

en: "Balabus Arimor was a little-known preacher during the days of Emperor Chitus,
who believed eternal life could be achieved through ritual sacrifice.
We shall see whether he was a prophet - or a charlatan."
flavourtext:HeistHandofArimor.Text.zh:
“ 巴拉巴斯阿里摩爾在切特斯帝國時代是一位鮮為人知的傳教士，
相信永生可以通過祭祀來實現。
我們將看看他是先知還是騙子。"

en: "There are very few devices in this world that can act as a heart for a
machine. This one is an ancient remnant of the work of Vaal engineers."
flavourtext:HeistHeartCoil.Text.zh:
"這個世界上很少有設備可以充當機
器的心臟。這是瓦爾工程師工作的古老殘餘。"

en: "Lost touch with a mate of mine when
he got recruited into some secret squad.
Just want to see how he's doing."
flavourtext:HeistHuck1.Text.zh:
"當她被招募到某個秘密小隊時，
與我的同伴失去了聯繫。
只想看看他的狀況如何。"

en: "Enoch deserved better.
This is the least I can do."
flavourtext:HeistHuck2.Text.zh:
"以諾值得更好的。
這是我至少可以做的。"

en: "The world is governed by certain natural laws. Science and thaumaturgy are one
and the same. But the crystal... it shouldn't exist. It's not from here. We must have it."
flavourtext:HeistImpossibleCrystal.Text.zh:
"世界受某些自然法則支配。科學和奇幻術是一成不變的。
但是水晶…它不應該存在。它不是從這裡來的。我們必須擁有它。"

en: "Sap of the Aturi tree, known only to grow at the meeting point of the seven waters.
Nothing since its disappearance has smelled as wondrous."
flavourtext:HeistIncenseofKeth.Text.zh:
"阿圖里樹的樹液，僅在七個水域的匯合點生長。
自消失以來，沒有什麼聞起來像奇妙的。"

en: ...the blueprints for my Extreme Warmth Beam, my Storm Wooing Rod,
the Mind Sublimator, and the Unbreakable...!
flavourtext:HeistIsla2.Text.zh:
...我的極限保暖裝備，暴風雨之杖，
心靈昇華器和不破者的藍圖…！

en: "They were me granddaddy's.
Could break into any house as quick and silent as a Cardinal's fart."
flavourtext:HeistKarst1.Text.zh:
"他們是我爺爺的。
可以像紅衣主教的放屁一樣迅速而安靜地闖入任何房屋。"

en: "Traitorous scum took the life I could've had.
I ain't usually the forgiving type,
but I feel in this case that I owe him a little gift."
flavourtext:HeistKarst2.Text.zh:
"恐怖的敗類奪走了我本來可以擁有的生命。
我通常不是寬容的人
但在這種情況下，我覺得我欠他一點禮物。"

en: "Are we the only ones who understand the danger? The fools! Living ice absorbs heat
and grows. We must control it properly, lest it spread across all of Wraeclast."
flavourtext:HeistLivingIce.Text.zh:
"我們是唯一了解危險的人嗎？笨蛋！活冰吸收熱量並生長。
我們必須妥善控制它，以免它散佈在整個瓦爾克拉斯。"

en: "If we can prove Jamanra existed, then the Faridun may have a chance to rejoin the
Maraketh. I, for one, would like to meet my parents. I have many questions..."
flavourtext:HeistNenet1.Text.zh:
“如果我們可以證明賈嫚拉的存在，那麼法里登也許有機會重新加入
馬拉克斯我想與我的父母見面。 我有很多問題...“

en: "There is nothing quite so exquisite as a forced confession. The sufferer will
say anything to make the pain stop, and that's the point. Guilt is irrelevant."
flavourtext:HeistNiles1.Text.zh:
“沒有什麼比強迫認罪更加精緻了。
說出什麼來止痛，這就是重點。 內疚則無關緊要。"

en: "It supposedly causes enormous plants to grow from almost any soil. The myth claims we
need to sacrifice a baby to make it function, but that's a bit grotesque, even for me."
flavourtext:HeistNiles2.Text.zh:
“據推測，這使巨大的植物幾乎可以在任何土壤中生長。
需要犧牲一個嬰兒才能使其正常運轉，但這對我來說還是有點怪誕的。"

en: "Those Eternal bastards looted everything that wasn't bolted to the floor when we
finally drove them from our island! That candelabra belongs with us!"
flavourtext:HeistOghamCandelabra.Text.zh:
"那些永恆的雜種搶劫了我們最終從島
上驅趕他們的所有未拴住的東西！那個燭台屬於我們！"

en: "The relief was the first ever depiction of some Maraketh girl named Orbala undertaking her
fifth great adventure. I don't particularly care about the story, I just don't want Bazira to have it."
flavourtext:HeistOrbalasFifthAdventure.T.zh:
"解說是有史以來第一次描寫馬拉克斯女孩奧爾巴拉進行的第五次大冒險。
我並不特別在意這個故事，我只是不想巴齊拉擁有它。"

en: "My accursed father owes his children this heirloom. We deserve
to know our culture, just like you full-blooded humans do."
flavourtext:HeistSeaPearlHeirloom.Text.zh:
"我那位應有盡有的父親欠他的孩子這個傳家寶。
我們應該了解我們的文化，就像你們全人類一樣。"

en: "I have a suspicion that the Maraketh Sekhema of legend, Lundara, is the same historical
figure as the Azmeri and Eternal goddess Lunaris. The Seal may prove that."
flavourtext:HeistSealOfLunaris.Text.zh:
"我懷疑傳說中的馬拉克斯絲克瑪．倫達拉與
阿茲莫里和永恆女神月影神是同一歷史人物。封印可能證明了這一點。"

en: "It is my belief that Solerai, from the Maraketh legend, is Solaris herself in another system of
myths. If I can prove that, I can begin piecing together a true history of the Winter of the World."
flavourtext:HeistSealOfSolaris.Text.zh:
"我相信馬拉喀什傳奇中的索拉萊就是日耀神神話中的她自己。
如果我能證明這一點，我就可以開始將世界冬季的歷史拼湊起來。"

en: "The history of the order of Sin Eaters is shrouded in secrecy and shame.
Nevertheless, history demands truth, even if it takes centuries to be revealed."
flavourtext:HeistStaffOfTheFirstSinEater.zh:
"罪惡嗜者的歷史被機密和恥辱所籠罩。
然而，歷史需要真理，即使要花幾個世紀才能揭示出來。"

en: "By all accounts, the Sword of the Inverse Relic was found aged and rusted,
but is becoming less weathered over time. We really must study its properties."
flavourtext:HeistSwordOfTheInverseRelic..zh:
"從所有方面來看，逆遺之劍被發現已經老化並且生鏽了，
但是隨著時間的流逝其風化變得越來越小。我們確實必須研究其性質。"

en: "Loved her like she was my own daughter.
I just want to know she's safe."
flavourtext:HeistTibbs1.Text.zh:
"愛她，就像她是我自己的女兒一樣。
我只想知道她是安全的。"

en: "Damn near everything I've earned.
Worth every little bit."
flavourtext:HeistTibbs2.Text.zh:
"該死，我賺到的一切都差不多。
一切都值得。"

en: "If the skull is real, and not a forgery, then it may show that my people are not the
abominations others believe us to be. The word 'human' may have a broader meaning."
flavourtext:HeistTuskedHominidSkull.Text.zh:
"如果頭骨是真實的，而不是偽造的，那麼這可能表明我的人民
不是別人相信我們的可憎之物。'人類'一詞可能具有更廣泛的含義。"

en: "The Faridun cannot earn burial in the sky.
They have other ways of keeping the dead."
flavourtext:HeistUrnOfFarud.Text.zh:
"法里登無法在空中獲得埋葬。
他們還有其他辦法可以使死者喪生。"

en: "A great fire once swept the land, and our leaders were turned to ash where they stood.
The urn contains exactly what you think it does, and serves as proof of our long lineage."
flavourtext:HeistUrnOfTheOriginalAshes.T.zh:
"大火一度席捲了大地，我們的領導人被化為灰燼。
骨灰盒完全包含你所認為的功能，並作為我們長期血統的證明。"

en: "Just the usual highly-illegal compounds.
Don't drop them. It's fine if you do, but don't."
flavourtext:HeistVinderi1.Text.zh:
"只是通常的非法混合物。
不要丟下它們。 可以，但是不要。"

en: "I wish I could say this was the first time I've forgotten to restock on this thing.
I forget what it was, but I'm sure I'll remember by the time we need to get it.
Was it beetles? Bottles? I think it began with 'B'.
Or it had no 'B'."
flavourtext:HeistVinderi2.Text.zh:
"我希望我能說這是我第一次忘記對此物品進行補貨。
我忘記了那是什麼，但是我敢肯定我會記得我們需要的時候。
是甲蟲嗎？ 瓶子？ 我認為它以' 甲”開頭。
或沒有'甲'。"

en: To her beauty you submit,
lest your neck the great Queen slit.
flavourtext:HerMask.Text.zh:
臣服在女王的美麗之下
至少你還能獻出頸項讓她劃破

en: <size:26>{Black and White, Silver and Gold
Let us see the world Unfold
Red and Blue, Yellow and Green
Let us remake it in colours Unseen}
flavourtext:Heterochromia.Text.zh:
<size:27>{黑白，金銀
讓我們見證世界的真相
紅藍，黃綠
讓我們再造無人見過之色彩}

en: Countless voices murmur,
singing of the Hive...
flavourtext:HiveBrainNodeFlavourText.Tex.zh: 無數低語回盪，吟唱著巢裔的頌歌……

en: "This one? It is NOT for sale. You would sooner pry it from my lifeless hand."
- Jonfé Darontos, Ringmaker
flavourtext:Hubris.Text.zh: "這一件嗎？這個是非賣品。但我想你總有一天會從我已死亡的雙手中搶走。" - 強菲．達隆托斯，戒指鍛造師

en: Primed, curved and sleek.
Decisive and final.
For malice and righteousness.
There's but one solution.
flavourtext:HuntersResolve.Text.zh:
蓄勢待發的，極致的圓滑
毅然決然的，篤定的瞬間
既是惡意，既是正義
唯有一條，解決之道

en: With great tragedy and power,
the dead are netted in anguish.
flavourtext:IncursionVialBossFlask.Text.zh:
巨大的悲劇和力量，
亡者都遭受了痛苦。

en: It is not our flesh, our thoughts, or our soul that limits us;
it is the distinction between them.
flavourtext:IncursionVialBossJewel.Text.zh:
這不是我們的肉體，我們的思想或我們的靈魂限制我們；
這是他們之間的區別。

en: Ancient myths of flame, frost and thunder.
Will we ever know the way forward?
flavourtext:IncursionVialFire.Text.zh:
古老火、霜和雷的神話。
我們會知道前進的方向嗎？

en: The ritual creates order.
Both in the minds of men and gods.
The ritual creates order.
flavourtext:IncursionVialLightning.Text.zh:
儀式產生秩序。
都存在於人類和神的意志中。
儀式產生秩序。

en: Your actions live but a moment;
their repercussions never die.
flavourtext:IncursionVialMinion.Text.zh:
你的行為只是暫時存在；
他們的影響永遠不會消失。

en: Blood, slaves and stone.
The timeless edifice of Dominance.
flavourtext:IncursionVialTrap.Text.zh:
鮮血、奴力和石頭。
永恆的統治建築。

en: Turn the crank,
close your eyes,
and pray to the gods
for a pleasant surprise.
flavourtext:JackInTheBox.Text.zh:
轉動曲柄， 
閉上雙眼，
向眾神默禱 
祈求愉悅驚喜。

en: The Sun, magnanimous on its throne, gifts
heat and light to all those it surveys.
flavourtext:KalguuranRune1.Text.zh:
太陽在它的寶座上盡顯慷慨，為
所有它所俯視的人提供溫暖和光芒。

en: Sometimes, it is the connections between, rather
than the things themselves, that matters most.
flavourtext:KalguuranRune2.Text.zh:
有時，最重要的是事物之間的
聯繫，而不是事物本身。

en: All living things move and change in patterns
that cannot be seen until they are gone.
flavourtext:KalguuranRune3.Text.zh:
所有生物都會移動並改變行為模式，
這在他們逝去之前是看不到的。

en: No energy in this world stands alone.
There is always an opposite.
flavourtext:KalguuranRune4__.Text.zh:
這世上沒有獨自存在的能量。
永遠會有它的對立面。

en: Though you may not know
your destination, it exists.
flavourtext:KalguuranRune7.Text.zh:
雖然你可能不清楚你的
目的地，但它確實存在。

en: The difference between here and
there is merely a single climb.
flavourtext:KalguuranRune8.Text.zh:
這裡和那裡的區別
只不過是一次攀爬。

en: "A symbolic piece of history,
from a time when people of all backgrounds
united against a common enemy."
flavourtext:Kurai1.Text.zh:
"具有象徵意義的歷史，
從各個背景的人們團結起來
反對一個共同的敵人的時代開始。"

en: "I won't be bullied.
We must get Hana back."
flavourtext:Kurai3.Text.zh:
"我不會被欺負。
我們必須讓哈娜回來。"

en: A snake cannot survive without its head.
But neither can the head survive without the body.
flavourtext:LabyrinthBaneOfTheLoyal.Text.zh:
無頭之蛇不得活
無身之頭亦不可活

en: Take a cog here, place a cog there,
and the great machine grinds to a halt.
flavourtext:LabyrinthCogsOfDisruption.Te.zh:
這裡拿個齒輪，那裡放個齒輪
然後偉大的機器就此消磨殆盡

en: All living things need a heart,
even those made of stone.
No heart, no life.
flavourtext:LabyrinthHeartOfTheGargoyle..zh:
所有的生物都需要一顆心臟
即使是石頭所做的也是如此
沒有心臟，就沒有生命

en: The best way to keep out an unwanted guest
Is to simply close the door.
flavourtext:LabyrinthPortalShredder.Text.zh:
要攔下討厭的客人
最好的方式就是關上門

en: <smaller>{They fought the storm together as one,
Until the longest of days was done.
Their love grew stronger
with every breath,
Until it was broken apart in death.}
flavourtext:LantadorsLostLove.Text.zh:
<size:27>{他們合而為一抵抗最強大的暴風，直到最漫長的日子結束。
隨著每一次的呼吸氣息，他們的愛情變得更加深厚，
直到死亡將他們分離。}

en: <size:30>{Many strive for greatness,
but it is challenge, unforeseen,
that forges heroes.}
flavourtext:LeftToFate.Text.zh:
<size:30>{許多人都在追求偉大，
但正是挑戰，出乎意料，
造就了英雄。}

en: Time and change
shall naught avail,
To dim the Light
of Truth's fair grail.
flavourtext:LightAndTruth.Text.zh:
即使光陰的變遷
也將無法黯淡
真理清澈的光芒

en: Never dying, yet not living,
Endlessly they wander
beneath the harvest moon.
flavourtext:LingeringRemnants.Text.zh:
永遠不滅亡，卻非生者，
秋分月光下，徘徊不休。

en: <size:27>{"There are worlds that lie beyond the edge of my page, the edge of my understanding. Worlds of wonder. Worlds of terror."
Aramil - Cartographer to Emperor Chitus}
flavourtext:LostWorlds.Text.zh:
<size:27>{"在超出我書頁的範圍，超出我所理解的地方，有著其它的世界。奇妙的世界，恐怖的世界。"
阿拉米爾 - 給切斯特大帝的製圖}

en: Bound by fate,
inseparable by choice.
flavourtext:Loyalty.Text.zh:
因命運相繫
因選擇相依

en: They can't be THAT lucky,
or they'd still be here!
flavourtext:LuckOfTheVaal.Text.zh:
真沒那麼幸運，
否則他們現在可還在呢!

en: So many memories,
so much pain in
such a small token.
Drown it in blood
so you can forget.
flavourtext:LysahsRespite.Text.zh:
許多回憶，
許多苦痛
充斥著小圖騰。
淹沒在血液之中
才能使你遺忘。

en: They came for enlightenment,
but were imprisoned by madness.
flavourtext:MapWorldsAcademy.Text.zh:
他們尋求啟示而來，
最後卻受癡迷與瘋狂監禁。

en: Clear water springs forth.
A moment of purity before it too gathers filth.
flavourtext:MapWorldsAcidLakes.Text.zh:
清澈的泉水湧出。
在它混入過多污穢之前有一刻的純潔。

en: An unwashed gutter, where wretches
cut purses and throats alike.
flavourtext:MapWorldsAlleyways.Text.zh:
那汙穢的水溝，
苦命人的咽喉像錢包一樣被劃開。

en: This was not the first
civilization to believe itself
the greatest. And it will
not be the last.
flavourtext:MapWorldsAncientCity.Text.zh:
這不是第一個
以自己為
中心的文明，也將不會是
最後一個。

en: Man is not the only beast to
bend nature to its will.
flavourtext:MapWorldsArachnidNest.Text.zh:
人類並非唯一
會扭曲大自然的生物。

en: They feel your every move,
your every breath,
with a million little wires.
flavourtext:MapWorldsArachnidTomb.Text.zh:
成千上萬令人作噁的觸鬚，
牠們能感受到
你最細微的動作。

en: We create so that some part
of us may remain after death.
flavourtext:MapWorldsArcade.Text.zh:
我們之所以創作與製造，
是為了在死亡後還能夠留下什麼。

en: The sound of a thousand calls
for blood echo for eternity.
flavourtext:MapWorldsArena.Text.zh:
嗜血觀眾的呼喊，
將永遠在此處迴盪，

en: Water vanishes; an impromptu
prison becomes a tomb.
flavourtext:MapWorldsAridLake.Text.zh:
潮水退去；
暫時的監獄成為了墳墓。

en: There is no war. There is no army.
Only fear lingers.
flavourtext:MapWorldsArmoury.Text.zh:
沒有戰爭，沒有軍隊，
只有恐懼縈繞。

en: There is no war. There is no army.
Only rage lingers.
flavourtext:MapWorldsArsenal.Text.zh:
沒有戰爭，沒有軍隊，
只有憤怒縈繞。

en: Desperately reaching skyward
and digging downwards.
Sustenance is an
eternal struggle.
flavourtext:MapWorldsAshenWood.Text.zh:
死命向上延伸的同時
也不忘瘋狂向下挖掘。
維繫生命是
永不停歇的鬥爭。

en: Time turns even the vicious
volcanoes to hollow shells.
flavourtext:MapWorldsAtoll.Text.zh:
即使是最險惡的火山，
時間也能使它淪為空窟。

en: Whispers from
a world apart
Speak my name
beyond the tomb;
Bound within
the Maelström's heart,
Will they grant me
strength or doom?
flavourtext:MapWorldsAtollUnique.Text.zh:
冥府陰語
聲聲喚
墳內呼喊
墳外驚聞；
漩渦浩劫
步步難
我得倖存，
或成亡魂？

en: Man burrows for only
the eternal hibernation.
flavourtext:MapWorldsBarrows.Text.zh:
人類只會在永眠時
挖掘洞穴。

en: Built so the prayers would echo.
A resonance no god could hear.
flavourtext:MapWorldsBasilica.Text.zh:
禱告迴響樑間，
無神回應諧振。

en: A paradise, forever replenished by
endless waves teeming with life.
flavourtext:MapWorldsBeach.Text.zh:
充斥著生命的波浪
帶給了這座樂園無止盡的生機。

en: Bells are rung in celebration, and in sorrow.
And, finally, in despair.
flavourtext:MapWorldsBelfry.Text.zh:
鐘聲為慶典響起，
悲傷地。最終，而絕望。

en: Layer upon layer of death and rot.
Disgusting.
flavourtext:MapWorldsBog.Text.zh:
一堆又一堆的腐敗死屍。
令人作噁。

en: The dead ask to be remembered,
but such requests
are seldom met.
flavourtext:MapWorldsBoneCrypt.Text.zh:
死者僅希望能夠被記得，
然而這樣的請求
幾乎得不到回應。

en: They flew, and leapt,
and clambered over,
They crawled, and swam,
and slithered under.
Still its ancient secrets
await unclaimed
And of this hidden temple,
only legends remain.
flavourtext:MapWorldsBoneCryptUnique.Tex.zh:
他們飛翔騰躍，
攀爬在上，
他們匍匐群聚，
蛇行在下。
古老秘密
依舊待人發現
隱密神廟中，
徒留傳奇流言。

en: The faintest traces of civilisation
defiantly resist nature's scouring tendrils.
An admirable, but futile, effort.
flavourtext:MapWorldsBramblefall.Text.zh:
最弱小的文明
痕跡頑強地抵抗了大自然的鞭笞。
令人欽佩但徒勞的努力。

en: Vile fiends hide beneath
the peaceful plains.
flavourtext:MapWorldsBurialChambers.Text.zh:
貌似平靜的平原底下，
藏匿著醜陋的魔鬼。

en: Does the land reject the dead,
or do the dead reject their fate?
flavourtext:MapWorldsBurn.Text.zh:
大地拒絕死者，
還是死者拒絕命運？

en: Treat a man like a wild animal,
and he will soon learn to bite.
flavourtext:MapWorldsCage.Text.zh:
若你對待一個人與你對待動物一樣，
那他將會學會啃咬。

en: From the heart of fire, rivers
of burning rage billow forth.
flavourtext:MapWorldsCaldera.Text.zh:
從烈焰心中，
燃燒憤怒的河流向前奔騰。

en: A deep wound in the land.
One that will never heal.
flavourtext:MapWorldsCanyon.Text.zh:
此地有如大地
永不癒合的創口。

en: Life's wet, reproductive stink abates,
relenting to death's chaste ritual of decay.
flavourtext:MapWorldsCarcass.Text.zh:
生命的濕潤，繁衍的惡臭退散，
貶低死亡的腐朽儀式。

en: When the castle falls,
it has failed its only purpose.
flavourtext:MapWorldsCastleRuins.Text.zh:
當城堡崩壞的同時，
也辜負了它唯一的任務。

en: Life crushed together.
Left to crumble to dust.
flavourtext:MapWorldsCells.Text.zh:
不被重視的生命，集中於一處，
受到遺忘直到瓦解，灰飛煙滅。

en: Some dead have long
envied the living.
When given the chance,
they take from us what they can.
So we offer our suffrage.
In return, they give
only suffering.
flavourtext:MapWorldsCemeteryUnique.Text.zh:
死者仰慕著
生人。
試著奪取
一切。
我們為它們
祈禱，
卻只帶給自己苦難。

en: A constant malign presence, glowering,
hateful, wounding... the folly of belief.
flavourtext:MapWorldsChambersOfImpurity..zh:
惡意激起仇恨、創傷、
猜疑……信仰終究無以為繼。

en: The stone cannot stop the torrent.
It can only divert it.
flavourtext:MapWorldsChannel.Text.zh:
岩石無法停止激流，
僅能使它轉向。

en: Forget kings and emperors;
He who holds the coin holds all the power.
flavourtext:MapWorldsChateauUnique.Text.zh:
國王跟君主算得上什麼；
手握金幣的人才能掌握天下。

en: One of my captors hid a beast within his heart.
Now his true self can be seen by all.
flavourtext:MapWorldsChimera.Text.zh:
虜擄我的其中一位罪人，體內禁錮了一頭野獸。
現在已經可以看見他的真面目。

en: Countless generations have
walked these time-worn stones.
flavourtext:MapWorldsCitySquare.Text.zh:
無數的世代已經走過這些
受時間摧殘的石路。

en: Ice forges a fickle path,
as those beneath its veil can attest.
flavourtext:MapWorldsColdRiver.Text.zh:
冰開闢出一條破碎的道路，
面紗下面的人可以證明。

en: Small minds demand
the largest structures.
flavourtext:MapWorldsColonnade.Text.zh:
最狹窄的胸襟，
卻要求最宏偉的建築。

en: Life means as little as a passing
moment of entertainment.
Let them rot.
flavourtext:MapWorldsColosseum.Text.zh:
這裡，生命的價值就和逝去的
娛樂般低廉。
放任活著的屍體腐爛吧！

en: Ornate, elaborate, ostentatious...
and dripping with death.
flavourtext:MapWorldsConservatory.Text.zh:
華麗、精工、耀眼…
和充滿死亡。

en: Thrust above the waves, still teeming
with horrors from the depths.
flavourtext:MapWorldsCoralRuins.Text.zh:
在海浪之上推進，
仍然充滿著來自深淵的恐怖。

en: Black monstrous bridges cross oily rivers,
leading nowhere. Nothing as it should be.
flavourtext:MapWorldsCore.Text.zh:
具大的黑色橋梁橫跨充滿焦油的河流，
引領著我們。前往無處。

en: Justice born of love is a surrender.
Justice born of law is a punishment.
flavourtext:MapWorldsCourthouse.Text.zh:
由愛而生的正義是屈服，
法律而生的正義是懲罰。

en: An elaborate, beautiful garden,
hidden from the public. Selfish.
flavourtext:MapWorldsCourtyard.Text.zh:
多麼美麗，多麼精緻的花園，
卻藏的這麼的隱密。自私。

en: To the east,
it cannot be seen.
To the west,
it cannot be touched.
To the south,
it cannot be remembered.
And to the north,
it cannot be contained.
flavourtext:MapWorldsCourtyardUnique.Tex.zh:
往東，
你看不見它。
往西，
你摸不著它。
往南，
你記不得它。
往北，
你留不住它。

en: The dark seas swallow the careless
and spit them against sharp rocks.
flavourtext:MapWorldsCoves.Text.zh:
黑暗的海域吞沒大意的外來者，
並將他們投向尖銳的石壁。

en: Rain will wash away the stains,
but the madness and memories will never fade.
flavourtext:MapWorldsCrimsonTownship.Tex.zh:
雨水會洗去污漬，
但瘋狂和回憶永遠不會消失。

en: As the torch flickers, brilliance
emerges in boundless variance.
flavourtext:MapWorldsCrystalOre_.Text.zh:
火把在暗中閃爍的同時，
周圍散發出無窮的輝芒。

en: Saints and heathens look the same
once the rot takes hold.
flavourtext:MapWorldsCursedCrypt.Text.zh:
聖徒或異教徒，
屍體腐蝕後外表也不會有差別。

en: For his sins
he was hunted in his sleep,
judgement wrought
of twisted nightmare.
The Coward bound
his dreams to stone,
awaiting another to walk
the path of true atonement.
flavourtext:MapWorldsCursedCryptUnique.T.zh:
罪孽深重，
不得安眠，
難逃審判，
夢魘連連。
此人懦怯，
無視警夢，
等待他人，
贖罪道中。

en: The trees grow twisted and gnarled,
without a hint of light.
A curse lingers here.
flavourtext:MapWorldsDarkForest.Text.zh:
此地生長的樹木，畸形、扭曲、粗糙。
沒有一絲的光源。
詛咒在此徘徊。

en: Crafted with reverence.
Defiled with ease.
flavourtext:MapWorldsDefiledCathedral.Te.zh:
精心製作，
輕鬆玷污。

en: Heat. Dust. Wind. These are what
forge strong minds and bodies.
flavourtext:MapWorldsDesert.Text.zh:
艷陽、塵土、熱浪。
鍛造出堅強的毅力和體格。

en: As mirage becomes reality,
hardship is briefly quenched.
flavourtext:MapWorldsDesertSpring.Text.zh:
隨著幻景成為現實，
苦難短暫的澆滅。

en: A hollow echo of bygone times
in a land where none lived long.
flavourtext:MapWorldsDig.Text.zh:
過去的空虛回響
在一個沒有長久生長的土地上。

en: Where once waves crashed with crushing force,
brittle wooden bones tell tall tales.
flavourtext:MapWorldsDrySea.Text.zh:
一旦海浪以粉碎力轟然倒下，
脆弱的木骨頭就會傳出高高的傳說。

en: Shifting, morphing, expanding. A reminder
of the virtues of an agile mind.
flavourtext:MapWorldsDunes.Text.zh:
迅速思考、伺機變向、擴張，
都是靈敏心靈應有的屬性。

en: A penitentiary for those who are not penitent
is nothing more than an inn for the evil.
flavourtext:MapWorldsDungeon.Text.zh:
對於那些毫無懺悔之意的人們，
監獄只不過是惡魔的客棧。

en: Where land springs from water,
life will shortly follow.
flavourtext:MapWorldsEstuary.Text.zh:
生命緊隨水份
充裕的土壤。

en: Two unexplored frontiers remain:
The skies and the soil.
flavourtext:MapWorldsExcavation.Text.zh:
天空、土壤；
兩個尚未開發的邊疆。

en: Repetition. Convention. Duplication.
Creation distilled to perfection.
flavourtext:MapWorldsFactory.Text.zh:
不斷的重複、複製，
才能淬煉出完美的創作。

en: They pleaded for the gods to bless their land.
Now they lie under the soil.
flavourtext:MapWorldsFields.Text.zh:
他們曾懇求上帝保佑作物。
然而現在他們躺在土壤之下。

en: In darkness, beast and man
alike clamour to survive.
flavourtext:MapWorldsFloodedMine.Text.zh:
在黑暗中，人、獸
皆為了生存而掙扎。

en: Every instinct wills you to sleep through the bitter cold;
a certain death. Those that yet survive must fight
through every aching movement.
flavourtext:MapWorldsForbiddenWoods.Text.zh:
每一種本能都會使您在嚴酷的寒冷中入睡；一定的死亡。
那些倖存下來的人
必須參加每一次痛苦的移動。

en: Great stone towers tore at the natural order
and were promptly put in their place.
flavourtext:MapWorldsForkingRiver.Text.zh:
偉大的石塔被自然破壞，
並被及時安置。

en: The fleet lay stranded in the winter wastes,
those aboard to never again see the light of day.
flavourtext:MapWorldsFrozenCabins.Text.zh:
艦隊被困在冬天的廢棄中，
那些船上的再也看不到白天了。

en: Vibrant colours dash across the grey,
consuming Man's work.
flavourtext:MapWorldsGardens.Text.zh:
豐富的色彩橫掃灰階之地，
耗費了無數工匠的生命。

en: Many hands may
move a mountain.
flavourtext:MapWorldsGeode.Text.zh:
徒手也能
使山移動。

en: Amongst the rabble,
brutality is the law.
flavourtext:MapWorldsGhetto.Text.zh:
烏合之眾間，
蠻橫與暴力就是法則。

en: We must all walk the narrow, winding path.
The end is always the same.
flavourtext:MapWorldsGorge.Text.zh: 少數人的手中有如此大的權力。

en: Unknown legacies.
Untold stories.
flavourtext:MapWorldsGraveyard.Text.zh:
無人知曉的傳說。
未聽訴說的故事。

en: Trapped in absolute darkness.
Despair. Panic. Terror.
flavourtext:MapWorldsGrotto.Text.zh:
困在絕對黑暗中，
面臨絕望、恐慌、恐懼。

en: Forlorn and sorrowful, this once opulent
ruin conceals the sins of a fallen line.
flavourtext:MapWorldsHauntedMansion.Text.zh:
荒涼和悲痛，
曾經大片的遺跡掩蓋了罪孽的脈絡。

en: One of my captors wore many faces,
yet kept her true face hidden.
Now she cannot escape her true face.
flavourtext:MapWorldsHydra.Text.zh:
虜擄我的其中一位罪人，扮演不同的面具，
真實的她卻抑制在心中。
現在，她必須無時無刻面對自己的臉龐。

en: Icy fangs seek tender hulls
to sink themselves into.
flavourtext:MapWorldsIceberg.Text.zh:
冰獠牙尋找著
下一個受害的船體。

en: Should we feel disgusted at how the weak predate
the strong, or should we feel... admiration?
flavourtext:MapWorldsInfestedValley.Text.zh:
我們是否應該感到厭惡弱者先於強者，
還是應該感到欽佩？

en: Man and nature intertwined,
but only for the chosen few.
flavourtext:MapWorldsIvoryTemple.Text.zh:
少數選中之人，
與大自然糾纏。

en: My last waking moments looked very
much like this place... I miss it. I miss her.
flavourtext:MapWorldsLaboratory.Text.zh:
我最後的時刻看起來非常像這個地方。
我想念它。我想念她。

en: In darkness, the alpha rises. The companionship
of beasts is fragile indeed.
flavourtext:MapWorldsLair.Text.zh:
黑暗中為了領頭而鬥爭，
野獸的羈絆不過如此的脆弱。

en: Fiend and fortune-hunter alike turned to ash.
A sorry alliance of unending agony.
flavourtext:MapWorldsLavaChamber.Text.zh:
魔物、財富獵人、惡魔、野獸一齊化為灰燼。
痛苦的聯盟，苦痛的合輯。

en: At the heart of a peaceful, secluded valley,
an island of burning, consuming fury.
flavourtext:MapWorldsLavaLake.Text.zh:
在一個和平、幽靜峽古的中心，
一個燃燒的島嶼，憤怒正在消耗。

en: Amidst the barren wastes,
a slender strand of life blooms.
flavourtext:MapWorldsLeyline.Text.zh:
貧瘠的荒廢中，
一絲生命努力綻放。

en: Fire ignites the sky.
A signal to keep away.
An invitation to invade.
flavourtext:MapWorldsLighthouse.Text.zh:
點燃天色的火光。
是遠離的警示。
也是侵略的邀請。

en: A glorious vista once exclusive
to emperors. Not anymore.
flavourtext:MapWorldsLookout.Text.zh:
帝王曾經的輝煌遠景，
已不復存在。

en: Boils swell from the earth.
Foul malignant flesh
without purpose.
flavourtext:MapWorldsMalformation.Text.zh:
地面冒出無數膿腫。
除了噁心
毫無用處。

en: Embraced by mud. Grasped by roots.
The careless are silently swallowed.
flavourtext:MapWorldsMarshes.Text.zh:
濕泥環抱、樹根纏繞，
粗心大意的過客將默默的受到吞噬。

en: A vault for the dead, as if
they were valuable. Pathetic.
flavourtext:MapWorldsMausoleum.Text.zh:
為死者提供保險庫，
好像它們很有價值似的。真可憐。

en: They live trapped forever in darkness
and confusion. We are no different.
flavourtext:MapWorldsMaze.Text.zh:
他們受困，生活在黑暗與混亂之中。
和我們沒有甚麼不同。

en: Barren and sun-bleached.
Emptiness as far as
the eye can reach.
flavourtext:MapWorldsMesa.Text.zh:
受太陽熾灼的荒地。
放眼望去
除了空虛別無它物。

en: God's jar of raw materials.
Life lying dormant,
waiting to sprout.
flavourtext:MapWorldsMineralPools.Text.zh:
生命材料的寶甕。
靜靜沉睡著，
等待時機萌芽。

en: One of my captors felt no emotion.
He did not hesitate to inflict pain.
Now all he feels is intense, unstoppable agony.
flavourtext:MapWorldsMinotaur.Text.zh:
虜擄我的其中一位罪人，感受不到任何情感，
他毫不猶豫地施以痛苦。
現在他唯一能感受的，只有劇烈苦痛。

en: Night's promises are dark, for
even the stars must be harvested.
flavourtext:MapWorldsMoonTemple.Text.zh:
夜晚的承諾很黑暗，
就連星星也被收割。

en: In the shadow of war,
all are eclipsed.
flavourtext:MapWorldsMoonTempleUnique.Te.zh:
在戰爭的陰影下，
一切都黯然失色。

en: Filth springs forth like blood
from a severed jugular.
flavourtext:MapWorldsMudGeyser.Text.zh:
此地汙泥有如血液
從破裂的動脈一樣湧出。

en: Ancient artifacts and beautiful baubles.
All paid for in blood.
flavourtext:MapWorldsMuseum.Text.zh:
古代文物、珍稀裝飾，盡是些用血
作為代價得來的玩具。

en: Please take out your blades,
your whips, and your spikes.
Class is now in session.
flavourtext:MapWorldsMuseumUnique.Text.zh:
拿出你的刀刃，
拿出你的刑鞭，別忘了狼牙棒，
授課即將開始。

en: Even in death, we long to
be close to one another.
flavourtext:MapWorldsNecropolis.Text.zh:
即便死後，
我們還是盼望彼此相近。

en: So the raiders danced,
leading their foe ever west,
