towards certain death.
flavourtext:MapWorldsNecropolisUnique.Te.zh:
侵略者們擄掠燒殺，
引領仇家
踏向死亡。

en: Only fear remains unforgotten, where once
magnificent rites drew important crowds.
flavourtext:MapWorldsOvergrownRuin.Text.zh:
曾經吸引貴重賓客的儀式之地，
所剩下的僅剩恐懼的記憶。

en: A once great monument,
now a forgotten memorial.
flavourtext:MapWorldsOvergrownShrine.Tex.zh:
曾經偉大的豐碑，
如今只是個被遺忘的記念石塊。

en: Curious, she shook it then,
And tiny screams emerged.
Curiouser, she shook again,
And an eerie silence purred.
flavourtext:MapWorldsOvergrownShrineUniq.zh:
她很好奇搖一搖，
從內部傳出細微叫聲。
她更好奇再搖搖，
從死寂傳出哀嚎駭人，

en: Death forces even the most
determined of despots to
pass the crown.
flavourtext:MapWorldsPalace.Text.zh:
在死亡的面前
即使是暴君
也將放棄他的王冠。

en: Slaves held like cattle. A blood-soaked
revolution, just waiting to happen.
flavourtext:MapWorldsPen.Text.zh:
奴隸、家畜，
血洗革命只是遲早。

en: The farmer no longer plows
or sows. Only the flattened
soil remains.
flavourtext:MapWorldsPeninsula.Text.zh:
農夫不再是農夫，
不再播種、不再犁田。
留下扁平的惡土。

en: Every movement is watched,
recorded, remembered.
flavourtext:MapWorldsPhantasmagoria.Text.zh:
每一舉被仔細監視，
每一動被詳細記載。

en: One of my captors refused redemption.
He did not see value in a new life.
Now new life surrounds him.
flavourtext:MapWorldsPhoenix.Text.zh:
虜擄我的其中一位罪人，拒絕了救贖。
他無法看見新生的珍貴。
現在他必須時刻體驗重來。

en: Man's reach extends into
the ocean, clawing at
its infinite depths.
flavourtext:MapWorldsPier.Text.zh:
人類征服了
海面，海底深淵
卻始終無觸可及。

en: Steep cliffs divide where the trees
may grow, and where they may not.
flavourtext:MapWorldsPlateau.Text.zh:
無情的懸崖清楚地
劃分生命與死亡的分界點。

en: The wealthy foolishly battle
the ocean for domain.
flavourtext:MapWorldsPort.Text.zh:
愚昧的人類，
產生了和海洋爭奪地盤的想法。

en: Crushed together and fenced in,
to live out their lives like cattle.
flavourtext:MapWorldsPrecinct.Text.zh:
集體遺棄圍欄中，
像牲畜般的生存著。

en: A dough of bad blood.
A yeast of ill will.
flavourtext:MapWorldsPrimordialPool.Text.zh:
穢血製成的麵糰。
惡意是其最佳酵母。

en: Even the greatest achievements
will eventually be abandoned.
flavourtext:MapWorldsPromenade.Text.zh:
即使是最大的成就，
最終還是會被遺棄。

en: The grandest and greatest
ever to fight,
Divine the champions stand tall.
But match their power,
best their might,
And even the immortal may fall.
flavourtext:MapWorldsPromenadeUnique.Tex.zh:
在這最為盛大及
偉大的戰場，
神聖的英靈們在此屹立不搖。
面對他們壓倒性強大的力量，
是否有人能斬斷那
永恆枷鎖？

en: A wall is the surest sign for raiders
that there is something of value to take.
flavourtext:MapWorldsRamparts.Text.zh:
對入侵者來說城牆的存在
意旨有貴重的物品能夠奪取。

en: Each plank of rotting wood,
each dead sailor,
feeds the island and makes it grow.
flavourtext:MapWorldsReef.Text.zh:
每片漂浮木、船骸、
水手的每具浮屍，
將成為助長島嶼的養份。

en: Relics of a forbidden past.
Hidden away. Forgotten.
flavourtext:MapWorldsRelicChambers.Text.zh:
過去禁止的古物，
藏起來，忘記它。

en: Knowledge balanced atop a vast pit. Hold on,
or perish in the darkness of ignorance.
flavourtext:MapWorldsScriptorium.Text.zh:
知識建立於無知的深淵之上。
抓緊了，或在黑中滅亡。

en: Lives come and go.
Only bones and dust remain.
flavourtext:MapWorldsSepulchre.Text.zh:
生命無常，
只存白骨與塵埃。

en: The stone and lumber sleeps.
The captains are long dead.
Only the sea knows their end.
flavourtext:MapWorldsShipyard.Text.zh:
石材、木材、船帆、甲板。
長眠的船長。
只有大海知道它們的終結。

en: The Treasures of the Tides
wait in agony
at the End of the World.
flavourtext:MapWorldsShoreUnique.Text.zh:
遭棄水手，
死不瞑目，
葬身海域，冰冷鹹苦。

en: Grim blessings whispered in the deepest,
most secret of places.
flavourtext:MapWorldsSilo.Text.zh:
冷酷最深的祝福，
最秘密的地方。

en: Each branch, each leaf,
an extension of a web
that spans sanity.
flavourtext:MapWorldsSpiderForest.Text.zh:
每根樹枝，每片葉子，
都成為蛛網的延伸，
挑戰著獵物的理智。

en: Panic only hastens the venom's
passage to the heart.
flavourtext:MapWorldsSpiderLair.Text.zh:
恐慌只會加快
劇毒攻心的速度。

en: The water brings life,
the poison takes it away.
flavourtext:MapWorldsSprings.Text.zh:
水帶來生命，
毒藥將它奪走。

en: Aided by unrelenting rain,
rot devours new life at the first fumble.
flavourtext:MapWorldsStagnation_.Text.zh:
在不間斷的降雨的幫助下，
腐爛在第一次失誤中吞噬了新生命。

en: Nothing good washes up
on this dark shore.
flavourtext:MapWorldsStrand.Text.zh:
被衝上這岩灘的
不會是甚麼好東西。

en: We all began life in darkness,
we shall all end it there.
flavourtext:MapWorldsStrandUnique.Text.zh:
生命源於黑暗，
必也終於黑暗。

en: The creatures that prowl the wildest extremes,
nature anoints with cruel efficacy to defend her.
flavourtext:MapWorldsSulphurVents.Text.zh:
在極其瘋狂的自然界中，
以殘忍的手段膏抹著她。

en: We are swept ever upwards by our ambition,
with no thought of what awaits us at the peak.
flavourtext:MapWorldsSummit.Text.zh:
雄心壯志使我們一路向上，
往往沒想到顛峰將會有甚麼等待著我們。

en: From the walls, water, and ferns...
Death comes crawling on ancient steps.
flavourtext:MapWorldsSunkenCity.Text.zh:
從牆壁、水源、植物…
死亡爬上古老的階梯。

en: Immaculate white stone rises
from the abyss. Perfection.
flavourtext:MapWorldsTemple.Text.zh:
無暇的白色石頭
從深淵中浮現，完美。

en: Laughs of all the twisted
Echo through these
halls of gold.
In this cold forgotten void
They wander, forever uncontrolled.
flavourtext:MapWorldsTempleUnique.Text.zh:
瘋人狂者哄堂大笑
在黃金大廳
迴盪喧鬧。
寒冽失落的虛無之中
他們不停遊蕩，永遠失控。

en: A garden on a stone pedestal.
An incredible, and foolish, feat.
flavourtext:MapWorldsTerrace.Text.zh:
在石座上的花園。
一個令人讚嘆，卻愚昧的壯舉。

en: Ever does man look to emulate his creator,
only to match his indifference.
flavourtext:MapWorldsThaumaturgistsLair..zh:
每個人看上去都模仿他的創造者，
只是為了配上他的冷漠。

en: Little light enters.
No life escapes.
flavourtext:MapWorldsThicket.Text.zh:
微光能夠滲透。
不代表任何生命能活著離開。

en: Who is the true criminal, the one behind
bars, or the one who tortures him?
flavourtext:MapWorldsTortureChamber.Text.zh:
真正的罪犯受困於鐵杵後方，
還是牢籠外無情的處刑者。

en: "Here the soil is more deadly
than any swing of the axe."
- Oba of the Karui,
Conqueror of Corruption.
flavourtext:MapWorldsTortureChamberUniqu.zh:
「此處的土壤
比任何揮動的斧頭更加致命。」
- 腐化征服者
卡魯勇士歐霸

en: Affluence and effluence, separated
by a few feet of soil.
flavourtext:MapWorldsToxicSewer.Text.zh:
富裕和奢侈的分別，
僅是幾尺的土壤。

en: The temptations of paradise
draw forth the good
and the bad alike.
flavourtext:MapWorldsTropicalIsland.Text.zh:
樂園的誘惑
同時引出最純淨
和最邪惡的意圖。

en: Life, like still water, becomes trapped.
Stagnant. Foul.
flavourtext:MapWorldsUndergroundRiver.Te.zh:
靜止的生命，仿佛受困的水池，
死氣沉沉，散發著惡臭。

en: Howls and laughter
They hide in the day
They smell you, they watch you
They track their new prey
flavourtext:MapWorldsUndergroundRiverUni.zh:
狼嚎和笑聲
他們在白晝下躲藏
而他們聞得到你，看得到你
他們追蹤著新的獵物

en: Silent stillness. The waters are
as cold as they are black.
flavourtext:MapWorldsUndergroundSea.Text.zh:
寂靜的水，
它的溫度有如黑色般寒冷。

en: A good slave is driven by
only two thoughts:
service and sacrifice.
flavourtext:MapWorldsVaalPyramid.Text.zh:
一個稱職的奴隸
僅須明白兩件事：
服侍、犧牲。

en: "Should I depart this mortal coil,
so shall all of my treasures."
- Atziri, Queen of the Vaal
flavourtext:MapWorldsVaalPyramidUnique.T.zh:
「當我的靈魂離開肉身，
我的寶藏將隨我而去。」
- 瓦爾女王阿茲里

en: Voices. Visions. Violence.
They will haunt these grounds for all of eternity.
flavourtext:MapWorldsVaalTemple.Text.zh:
殘暴的聲響、暴力的願景，
它們將永遠的詛咒此地。

en: Wealth beyond imagining,
locked beyond reach.
flavourtext:MapWorldsVault.Text.zh:
超乎想像的財富，
堅鎖在超乎想像的寶庫。

en: Wealth is powerless to stop
the corroding force of time.
flavourtext:MapWorldsVilla.Text.zh:
就算是財富
也無法阻止時間的侵蝕。

en: Verdant life blossoms
amidst death.
flavourtext:MapWorldsWastePool.Text.zh:
生機從死亡中
自然綻放。

en: A white bone stripped of its fertile flesh.
Life spirals towards its end.
flavourtext:MapWorldsWasteland.Text.zh:
血腥的肉塊從白骨上脫落，
生命的痕跡一同消逝。

en: A river in the sky, far from that
which so desperately needs it.
flavourtext:MapWorldsWaterways.Text.zh:
專屬天空的河道，壯麗，
卻距離真正需要的荒土十萬八千里。

en: Reach out into the abyss,
and the abyss reaches back.
flavourtext:MapWorldsWharf.Text.zh:
對著深淵招手，
它正等著你。

en: It would be foolish to obey the Maven's demands.
It would also be foolish not to.
flavourtext:MavenKey.Text.zh:
聽從釋界的要求是愚蠢的。
但不照做也是愚蠢的。

en: Precious and perilous,
Tantalising and terrible.
flavourtext:MavenKeyFragment.Text.zh:
珍貴而危險，
誘人並可怕。

en: For those who must not endure it,
there may be found a perverse joy
in watching the struggle for survival.
flavourtext:MavenTrial.Text.zh:
對於那些不能忍受的人，
可能會發現不正當的喜樂
看著掙扎求生。

en: "Through thick and thin,
blood and bone,
a peaceful life
is one I can't condone."
- Tukohama, Father Of War
flavourtext:MercilessArmament.Text.zh:
"千回戰場，
血骨交織，
平凡人生，
是我無法赦免的結。"
-圖克哈瑪，戰爭之父

en: The Necropolis holds the darkest secrets of our religion,
lies that were never meant to be unearthed.
flavourtext:NecropolisResearch.Text.zh:
墓園藏著我們宗教最黑暗的秘密，
那些不應被揭露的謊言。

en: Before the Goddess, nothing remains hidden.
Adversity reveals old flaws and new strengths.
flavourtext:OfferingDedication.Text.zh:
在女神面前，沒什麼好隱瞞的。
逆境揭示了舊的缺陷和新的優勢。

en: The Goddess abides a kingdom beyond compare,
should you meet her challenge.
flavourtext:OfferingGift.Text.zh:
女神奉行超越比較的王國，
你敢向她的挑戰嗎？

en: It is time for the Goddess to give her final verdict.
Your fate rests in her even hands.
flavourtext:OfferingToTheGoddess.Text.zh:
該是女神做出最後判決的時刻。
你的命運掌握在她公平的雙手。

en: You may appeal to the Goddess for another verdict,
but justice favours only the truly worthy.
flavourtext:OfferingTribute.Text.zh:
你可以向女神乞求另一項審判，
但正義只支持真正有價值的人。

en: "The Order tried for centuries to shield the world from chaos.
But chaos is natural. It is a tool, like any other, with which to
shape our destinies." - The Lifegiver's Manifesto
flavourtext:OrbOfVeiledChaosFlavour.Text.zh:
"秩序嘗試了幾個世紀，以保護世界免受混亂。
但是混亂是自然的。 與其他工具一樣，
它是塑造我們命運的工具。" - 予生者的宣言

en: <size:27>{As Kaom slew the last of his kin,
something deep inside him broke.
And through the cracks, corruption,
pure and black, spread forth.}
flavourtext:PrideBeforeTheFall.Text.zh:
<size:27>{當岡姆手刃了他僅存的族人
他內心最深處的某些東西也跟著破碎
從這破碎的裂痕中，開始腐敗
純粹的黑暗，開始蔓延}

en: The Maven knew nothing of mercy
until she herself needed it.
flavourtext:PrimordialWatchstone1.Text.zh:
在她自己需要它之前，
釋界對憐憫一無所知。

en: The Elder fed on all that gave life meaning
until it encountered an unbreakable bond.
flavourtext:PrimordialWatchstone2.Text.zh:
尊師以所有賦予生命意義的東西為食，
直到遇到不可攻破的命定。

en: From beyond the stars, they near, hungry
and intent. Their challenge echoes with the
authority of masters beyond comprehension.
flavourtext:PrimordialWatchstone3.Text.zh:
自群星彼岸而來，它們逼近，飢渴而堅決。
他們的挑戰回聲迴盪，帶著那種難以理解之主宰的權威。

en: Though the cosmos may be filled with horrors,
and countless eyes and maws set upon us with hunger,
one insignificant speck has not yet had her say.
flavourtext:PrimordialWatchstone4.Text.zh:
縱使宇宙充滿恐怖，
無數雙眼與巨口饑餓地凝視著我們，
仍有一粒微不足道的塵埃，尚未道出她的話語。

en: Mouth of the Masses, whose greatness spreads by our breath and touch,
who feeds the starving with the starved, the strong with the weak.
flavourtext:ProphecyFragment1.Text.zh:
群眾之口，力量透過我們的氣息和觸碰漫延，
以肌餓者餵食肌餓，以弱小者餵食強壯。

en: Lord of the Wild, of the feral and frenzied,
of the uncivilized, the untamed, the untouched.
flavourtext:ProphecyFragment2.Text.zh:
原野、野性、暴怒、
野蠻、狂野、蠻橫之王。

en: The Infinite Mind, unbound by the tethers of sanity,
whose thirst for knowledge is all-consuming,
whose every word stands our hair on end.
flavourtext:ProphecyFragment3.Text.zh:
無限的心智，脫離理智的繫繩，
它為知識的渴望所消耗殆盡，
它的每個字皆令人毛骨悚然。

en: She of Many Bodies, whose very flesh unites all,
whose dark whispers draw forth our souls, unfettered.
flavourtext:ProphecyFragment4_.Text.zh:
眾多的軀體，她的血肉集合了所有，
她黯黑的輕語不受約束地引出了我們的靈魂。

en: Nobility once thought to capture the Basilisks and keep them as exotic pets.
This only served to fatten the vileness of their hearts, and with a hateful
acid that festered inside, the creatures became soured to their very bones.
flavourtext:QuestA9Ingredient2.Text.zh:
貴族曾將巨蟒做為寵物。
這令牠們心中充滿了惡劣，
憎恨的強酸潰爛著，深入骨隨。

en: Distilled from naked ambition and unfettered obsession,
the Allflame emanates a silvern warmth like no other,
and engulfs those moths fool enough to embrace it.
flavourtext:QuestAllflame.Text.zh:
淬鍊自純粹的執著和野望，
不滅之火同樣溫暖，投射銀白光芒
撲火飛蛾依舊會自取滅亡。

en: "Worry not for the heathens. They are devoid of soul.
Made vessels of wrath, they are damned by holy design."
- High Templar Avarius
flavourtext:QuestAvariusStaff_.Text.zh:
"不用為異教徒擔心。他們已經沒有了靈魂。
僅是憤怒的容器，受到聖潔的詛咒。"
-聖宗伊爾莉斯

en: "A stranger's kiss on a moonlit night.
Dost thou believe in love at first sight?"
flavourtext:QuestBestelManuscript.Text.zh:
「月光下獻上的陌路熱吻，
你難道會相信這是誓言，就憑這唇痕？」

en: "May the lubbers feel fear in their
nethers, and may our blades follow."
- Rot-tooth's Rallying Cry
flavourtext:QuestBlackFlag.Text.zh:
「讓那些鼠輩嚇得屁滾尿流、轉身便逃，
讓我們的刀刃尾隨而至、殺個精光！」
- 「落嘴齒」的戰吼

en: "The spider is not defined by how
it lives, but by how it kills."
- Inquisitor Maligaro
flavourtext:QuestBlackVenom.Text.zh:
「有些人區分蛛類的方式是看牠有幾對足，
但最好辨認的是牠如何殺戮。」
- 審判者馬雷葛蘿

en: "One should not entice the storm; one cannot invite the storm, or give warrant
to its tyrant-soul. We survive only by appeasing the storm, with gifts and
offerings of adoration. We hope that, in its mercy, it shall pass us by."
- Tempestology of the Maraketh, Repudion IV
flavourtext:QuestBottledStorm.Text.zh:
"不能誘惑風暴；不要邀請風暴，
不要指使它暴君般的靈魂。我們存活，
僅因我們安撫它，雙手奉獻祭品，
希望在它的憐憫之下能迅速通過。"
－馬拉克斯風暴學家，雷普帝昂四世

en: The Emperor honours Hector Titucius as Supreme Servant.
"Strength in purpose is strength in deed."
flavourtext:QuestBust1.Text.zh:
大帝冊封赫克特．提圖瑟為護國大將，並讚頌道：
「師出有名，才能力克強敵！」

en: The Emperor honours Gaius Sentari as Supreme Servant.
"A man's thoughts are his shackles. A man's thoughts are his wings."
flavourtext:QuestBust2.Text.zh:
大帝冊封蓋厄斯．山特立為護國大將，並讚頌道：
「思維雖然礙手礙腳，也能讓人如虎添翼。」

en: The Emperor honours Marceus Lioneye as Supreme Servant.
"The road to Glory is paved with Sacrifice."
flavourtext:QuestBust3.Text.zh:
大帝冊封穆希爾斯．獅眼為護國大將，並讚頌道：
「犧牲才能換來榮耀興盛。」

en: The King looked upon images swirling atop the ancient stone dial.
"You look peaceful" he told his bride-to-be, "So peaceful, asleep in our wedding bed."
But in phantasm, she did not slumber, and what he saw was not a place for dreams,
rather, a wooden box... about to be closed and lowered into earthy depths.
- Maraketh Legend
flavourtext:QuestCalendar.Text.zh:
國王注視著盤旋於古老石盤上方的畫面。
"你看上去真祥和"他對著準新娘說著，
"祥和的睡在我們的新婚床上"幻象中是這樣的。
但她並非沉睡，而他看到並非夢境之地，
而是一具木箱，即將關閉，即將入土。
-馬拉克斯傳說

en: Though its power has been shared, there
is still more the Apex might unlock.
flavourtext:QuestCombinedAmulet.Text.zh:
如果你尋覓榮耀之途
那麼，它會引導你踏上頂尖之路。

en: "It is a cruel joke that
Man was born with more
Intent than Life."
- Malachai
flavourtext:QuestDaressoGem.Text.zh: 「人生何其殘酷諷刺啊，生年縱有限，欲念無窮盡。」- 瑪拉凱

en: "Man is blinded by the mud of his corporeal self. Only
through the transformation of the material into the
spiritual can we hope to taste the full body of life."
- Malachai the Soulless
flavourtext:QuestDecanter.Text.zh:
「人類的潛能因為肉體的泥淖而陷入盲目，
唯有解放物質的桎梏、奔向靈魂的正途，
才能體會人生真實的感觸。」
- 超靈者瑪拉凱

en: While this artefact resonates with power,
it is simply a piece in a larger puzzle.
flavourtext:QuestDexAmulet.Text.zh: 這塊古物散發出神秘的力量，似乎指引著迷失的方向。

en: Beneath the Leviathan's shadow,
in the boundless dark,
its many limbs stretch upward...
flavourtext:QuestDucat1GraspingDeep.Text.zh:
在利維坦的陰影之下，
無垠黑暗之中，
牠無數的肢體向上延伸……

en: Each accursed union begot stranger forms.
Elongated necks, membranes, even tails...
flavourtext:QuestDucat2FoulKin.Text.zh:
每一次受詛咒的結合，都孕育出更加詭異的形體。
伸長的脖頸、薄膜，甚至尾巴……

en: The Brine King had found, within all humanity,
a dark truth waiting to claw itself free...
flavourtext:QuestDucat3TsoathasGift.Text.zh:
海洋王在所有人類之中，
發現了一個等待破繭而出的黑暗真相……

en: Creatures perished in droves,
drawn to that verdant glow.
Yet their bones swam away...
flavourtext:QuestDucat4UndeadSea_.Text.zh:
生物成群死去，被那翠綠光芒
吸引而來。然而，
牠們的骸骨卻游離而去……

en: Not a soul stepped foot on the isle,
for shelled monstrosities skittered about its shores...
flavourtext:QuestDucat5EucaridIsle.Text.zh:
無人敢踏上那座島嶼，
因為披甲的怪物正沿著海岸竄行……

en: Still they follow her siren's song.
Deemed unworthy, left to die, unwilling to accept fate...
flavourtext:QuestDucat6FallenStars.Text.zh:
他們依舊追隨她的塞壬之歌。
被視為螻蟻、被棄置等死，卻不願接受命運……

en: Its corrugated surface brings a strange tingle
to the fingertips. This is no mere decoration.
flavourtext:QuestGlyph1.Text.zh:
指尖觸碰到表面波紋，就會感到詭異的陣刺痛；
這東西絕不是普通的裝飾物。

en: When put to the ear it whispers not of
the sea, but long dead incantations.
flavourtext:QuestGlyph2.Text.zh: 放在耳邊不會聽見海風陣陣，只會聽見幽幽咒語，死氣沉沉。

en: Its pleasing sheen remains even in shadow,
as if it were somehow lit from within.
flavourtext:QuestGlyph3.Text.zh:
即使放在暗處，還是會散發動人光澤，
彷彿內部就會發光。

en: An open palm raised in peace,
cut down by the slaves of war.
flavourtext:QuestGoldenHand.Text.zh:
太平盛世，舉手舒掌，
奸雄亂世，金手斷葬。

en: "A boy becomes a man when he has faced the animal
in his heart and wet the forest floor with its blood."
- Azmeri Proverb
flavourtext:QuestGreustNecklace.Text.zh:
「面對野獸的男孩將迎接成年的頂戴，
他將盡一切所能，以對方的鮮血作為頂天立地的憑證。」
- 阿茲莫里諺語

en: "What we steal in life we repay in death."
- Karui Proverb
flavourtext:QuestHinekorasHair.Text.zh: 「生前怎麼種，死後怎麼栽」- 卡魯諺語

en: "A Virtue Gem is a raging thunderstorm imprisoned within a single raindrop.
Infernal Talc simply lets the storm out." - Malachai the Soulless
flavourtext:QuestInfernalTalc.Text.zh:
「古靈寶石是禁錮於滴狀晶石的狂怒風暴，
使用煉獄之粉就能釋放那股風暴。」 - 超靈者瑪拉凱

en: Segregated by treachery, this artefact
longs to be reunited with her sisters.
flavourtext:QuestIntAmulet.Text.zh:
背信棄義，導致支離破碎，
這塊護符依舊渴望破鏡重圓。

en: "Fear becomes Hatred.
Hatred becomes Fury.
Thus is Man transformed
from Martyr to Maker."
- Malachai
flavourtext:QuestKaomGem.Text.zh: 「懼生恨、恨化怒，讓世人不再犧牲獻身，反倒自詡為神。」- 瑪拉凱

en: "Weakness must be purged lest it
poison the blood of all Karui."
- Prayer to Tukohama
flavourtext:QuestKaruiEye.Text.zh:
但古云：「懦弱者沒有生存的價值，
讓他們繼續生存只會讓全族向入侵者歸降。」
-圖克哈瑪祈禱語

en: Wrought from blood and gold, Innocence fashioned a weapon of tempered purity,
capable of banishing darkness, and bringing order to the chaos in men's hearts.
flavourtext:QuestKitavaKey.Text.zh:
善以鮮血和黃金鑄造出純粹的正義，
可用來鎮壓黑暗、將混沌化為清晰。

en: My organs tether me to mortality
like a chain. This chain holds me
from my true potential.
flavourtext:QuestMalachaisEntrails.Text.zh: 我的器官使我和死亡連結。這阻礙了我真實的力量。

en: My heart forces blood through my veins.
But one who may bleed may die, and
death is no fitting end to genius.
flavourtext:QuestMalachaisHeart.Text.zh: 我的心臟迫使著血液在血管中流動。但任何會流血之物皆會死。死亡不是天才的終點。

en: My lungs breathe the same air as
the foolish and the weak. May I be
yet another step removed from them.
flavourtext:QuestMalachaisLungs.Text.zh: 我的肺和傻子、弱者吸著同樣的空氣。讓我來成為除去他們的步驟。

en: "Certain maps can only be rendered in the most vivid of viscera."
- Inquisitor Maligaro
flavourtext:QuestMaligaroMap.Text.zh:
「想前往異界領域，有時需要搭上人體最寬敞的溝渠。」
- 審判者馬雷葛蘿

en: Doctor "Shaky Hands" Opden travelled with only the
finest medicines and antidotes... and a curiously
generous supply of opiates.
flavourtext:QuestMedicineChest.Text.zh:
「抖不停」歐普登信奉
「工欲善其事，必先利其器」的格言，
他的藥箱裡帶著各式頂級藥物...以及滿滿的鴉片。

en: "We shall peer at these cosmic wonderments as they
wake and writhe within that deep and nameless dark."
- Vilenta, 'Miasmeter: A Thesis'
flavourtext:QuestMiasmeter.Text.zh:
「讚嘆宇宙的奇蹟，
它們隔著廣袤的黑暗與萬物連繫。」
- 范尼達《腐化能量計理論》

en: "Moonlight is a wise mother. The moon which bathes us in soft,
cooling light, does so with the intent of illuminating our paths.
Moonlight is wisdom. Moonlight is life."
- The Lunar Verses
flavourtext:QuestMoonOrb.Text.zh:
「月光宛如慈母，涼爽的光芒呵護我們的肌膚，
指引旅行者的路途！
月影是哲理的化身，我們將跟隨祂的腳步。」
- 月影神詩篇

en: "The cool blanket of shadows preserves our treasures."
- Inquisitor Maligaro
flavourtext:QuestObsidianKey.Text.zh:
「徜徉在陰影中，便無需擁寶自重。」
- 審判者馬雷葛蘿

en: "The Vaal were even more steeped in gem culture than
our Emperor and his 'Gemlings'. It's an obsession
as old as civilisation itself."
- Icius Perandus
flavourtext:QuestPage1.Text.zh:
「瓦爾對寶石文化的嚮往
更勝於古靈使徒和聖上，
其執念如寶石文化般悠久頑強。」
- 伊席厄斯．普蘭德斯

en: "A communion... but with what? By all accounts,
it wasn't God that the Vaal were trying to reach."
- Icius Perandus
flavourtext:QuestPage2.Text.zh:
「令人費解的是...這交誼祭典究竟是與誰互通？ 
瓦爾意欲接觸的存在絕非善類。」
- 伊席厄斯．普蘭德斯

en: "A waking Nightmare.
Madness of the mind?
Or madness of the flesh?"
- Icius Perandus
flavourtext:QuestPage3.Text.zh:
「甦醒的影魔 
是那噬靈精魄， 
還是滅門血禍？」
- 伊席厄斯．普蘭德斯

en: "Siosa, your Slavery will cause them to overlook you.
Your Karui Way will guide you.
Your Humanity will shame us all."
- Icius Perandus
flavourtext:QuestPage4.Text.zh:
「薩歐賽，你身為奴隸，不可能受到重視，
卡魯之道卻鍛造出你的堅定意志。 
讓你這般勇士，讓我們愧對人世。」
- 伊席厄斯．普蘭德斯

en: The withering glare of corruption, made
corporeal and pellucid in crystal.
flavourtext:QuestPoisonGem.Text.zh:
在腐敗、死寂的雙眼中，
殘破、靜謐的軀體格外沉重。

en: Maligaro loved his tools, and took great
pains to keep them excruciatingly sharp.
flavourtext:QuestPoisonSpear.Text.zh:
馬雷葛蘿對銳器情有獨鍾，
苦心孤詣讓武器更鋒利，讓敵人更痛苦。

en: Famous for her many lovers, those that did not
come willing to Atziri, came by liquid persuasion.
flavourtext:QuestPotion.Text.zh:
為她的許多戀人而聞名，
那些沒有因阿茲里前來的人們，
最終也受到了液體的勸說。

en: Machinery makes the minions.
Minions make the master.
flavourtext:QuestRibbonSpool.Text.zh:
此物編織了諸多奴僕，
奴僕成就了其上領主。

en: "And how shall we know a sekhema worthy of rule?
By the anointing of the Great Roc, under whose wings we grow and soar."
- Maraketh Coronation Ritual
flavourtext:QuestSekhemaFeather.Text.zh:
「我們要如何知道絲克瑪有能力治理? 
膜拜神聖的大鵬，他的羽翼庇護我們成長和翱翔」
 - 瑪拉克加冕儀式

en: To enter a city's bowels is to be
privy to its best-kept secrets.
flavourtext:QuestSewerKeys.Text.zh:
踏入城市的下水道溝渠
說不定會與深藏的秘密巧遇。

en: From Weylam to Meredith:
I shall love thee as I love the sea.
flavourtext:QuestSilverLocket.Text.zh:
從威廉到梅雷迪思都說
「對你的愛跟大海一樣」

en: Garukhan sought madness and knowledge amongst the billowing clouds of a
blackened sky. A vulture of pride, she would not be refused, and so the
stratosphere divulged unto her eldritch secrets of its tumultuous past.
flavourtext:QuestStormSword.Text.zh:
卡洛翰在昏暗奔騰的雲層中尋求瘋狂和知識。
一隻驕傲的禿鷹，她不會被拒絕，
平流層洩露了她怪異的秘密，她癲陡的過去。

en: A relic of a sundered relationship,
it awaits reconciliation with its kin.
flavourtext:QuestStrAmulet.Text.zh:
情誼破裂，唯留碎片悼念
這塊護符期盼來日重修舊好。

en: "The sun is a devoted mother. She casts her golden blessings on
the crops of the pious and makes barren the fields of heresy.
Sunlight is belief. Sunlight is life."
- The Solar Verses
flavourtext:QuestSunOrb.Text.zh:
「日耀是個意志堅定的母親，將黃金般的祝福賜
予虔誠者豐盈的豎琴，對異端者降下貧瘠的烙印。
日耀是一種生命的信念，而不是迷信。」
- 日耀神詩篇

en: "T'gnagn iia y r'ngusla ph'tu Tsoatha nga mekghul'an."
- Indecipherable verse
flavourtext:QuestTeardrop.Text.zh:
"T'gnagn iia y r'ngusla ph'tu Tsoatha nga mekghul'an."
 - 無法辨認的經文

en: Eyes blazing with holy flame, the Pilgrim saw
a great palace descend from the burgeoning sky,
its gates barred against the unfaithful.
flavourtext:QuestTemplarCourtKey.Text.zh:
朝聖者以火炎般的雙眼凝視著
宏偉的宮殿，磅礡的氣勢令人為之震懾，
並拒絕來訪的不信者。

en: Essence of pure thaumaturgy.
Apply with trepidation.
flavourtext:QuestThaumeticSulphite.Text.zh:
奇術的純粹精華
其中添加恐懼不安

en: A craftswoman's ode to
fresh hope, a new love.
flavourtext:QuestTolmanBracelet.Text.zh:
謹以此鐲，工匠歌頌著嶄新的希望，
與初萌的愛戀夢想。

en: God will only offer the door.
Man must choose whether to open it.
flavourtext:QuestTowerKey.Text.zh:
老天只提供門扉契機，
還要由人來選擇開啟。

en: "The belly cannot hunger for what the eyes cannot see."
- Karui Proverb
flavourtext:QuestTukohamasTooth.Text.zh: 「肚皮不能容忍眼前無法看見之物」- 卡魯諺語

en: "One day you eat the fish. One day you feed the fish."
- Karui Proverb
And mounting her mighty Roc, Garukhan, holy queen of the sky,
descended upon her enemies and their armies of darkness.
flavourtext:QuestWingsOfVastiri.Text.zh:
卡洛翰騎上她的巨鷹，
凌空而下，直取敵人的性命。

en: <size:27>{Fire filled the sky that night
Chaos reigned
Where the shards fell
All was destroyed
-Jozen Kasigi, retelling an urban legend of the Cataclysm}
flavourtext:RainOfChaos.Text.zh:
<size:27>{當夜烈焰瀰天、一片混亂
碎片掉落之處，全數毀滅殆盡
-喬森卡西吉，重述巨變的都市傳奇}

en: A location revealed with
no informant to blame.
flavourtext:RandomContentBetrayal.Text.zh:
一處被揭露的地點，卻無任何
告密者可去責怪。

en: An invitation to join a scheme
already plotted.
flavourtext:RandomContentBlueprintWing.T.zh:
一份加入一場早已策劃好之
陰謀的邀請函。

en: The harvest appears unkempt,
its crops unruly.
flavourtext:RandomContentHarvestGrove.Te.zh:
這場收成顯得雜亂無章，
其作物更是野蠻生長。

en: They cannot truly settle, when
adventure keeps calling.
flavourtext:RandomContentLogbook.Text.zh:
當冒險的召喚不斷迴盪，
他們便永遠無法真正定居。

en: The wanderer waits where
the water flows.
flavourtext:RandomContentNamelessSeer.Te.zh:
流浪者在流水潺潺
之地靜候。

en: The ghostly visage of Cadiro
glitters in gold.
flavourtext:RandomContentPerandus.Text.zh:
卡迪羅的虛空幻象
閃爍著金色光芒。

en: One small sliver of that
primordial lake.
flavourtext:RandomContentReflectingMist..zh:
那座原初之湖的
一絲微小碎片。

en: An empty hall, but for a
choice left by its patron.
flavourtext:RandomContentUniqueVaalSacri.zh:
一座空曠的大廳，唯有其主人
留下的一項抉擇。

en: Outside of time, she offers
wares to challenge Order.
flavourtext:RandomContentVaalTrader.Text.zh:
在時間之外，她販售著足以
挑戰秩序的貨品。

en: In the alleys of Sarn, one
can place their bets.
flavourtext:RandomContentVentorsStrongbo.zh:
在薩恩的暗巷中，人們可以
下定他們的賭注。

en: He shattered Her smile
Scattered the fragments like ash
All she did was laugh
flavourtext:Rebirth.Text.zh:
他粉碎她的笑容
把碎片擊碎成灰燼
而她笑看一切

en: All we hold dear awaits us.
We must merely reach out.
flavourtext:ReliquaryVaultFlavour.Text.zh:
我們所珍視的一切都在等待著我們。
我們只需伸手觸及。

en: "Our first Prototype. Proof that it can be done.
The Templars will give us everything we need,
now... but we must keep our true goal secret."
flavourtext:Ring11x.Text.zh:
"我們的第一個原型機。證明這一切確實可行。
聖堂會提供我們所需的一切，
至少……暫時如此。但我們必須將真正的目標保密。"

en: "Shavronne held Sanity in her right
hand and Revelation in her left.
Brutus chose the left hand."
- Kadavrus, Surgeon to the Umbra
flavourtext:Ring13.Text.zh:
「薛朗的右手捧起理智、
左手掌握啟示，
但布魯特斯選擇了左手物事。」- 烏姆布拉的外科醫師凱達弗斯

en: The four bloods of Wraeclast
run deep and vibrant.
flavourtext:SacredGroveFlavour.Text.zh:
瓦爾克拉斯的四種血脈
深沉而鮮明地流淌著。

en: Belief and despair battle eternal.
Truth and heresy are one.
flavourtext:SanctuaryMapFlavour.Text.zh:
信念與絕望永恆交戰。
真理與異端本為一體。

en: Mundus noster cecidit. Daemones ubique sunt. Librum
hunc in sacrarium conicio, ut forte alius viam inveniat...
flavourtext:SanctumKeyNonQuest.Text.zh:
我們的世界已經崩壞。惡魔無處不在。
我將這本書投入聖所，或許其他人能找到出路...

en: Hoc sciendo scribo ut verba mea perdant animam
meam eternam. Mihi credendum est quod novus
deus meus non sit tam divinus quam ipse petit...
flavourtext:SanctumKeyQuest.Text.zh:
在我寫下這段文字的時候，我知道我的話語將使我
失去永恆的靈魂。我必須相信，我的新神並不像
他聲稱的那樣神聖...

en: As the hordes of bone and blood and foul magic surge across the Vastiri Plains,
the scant survivors of our akhara agree to your alliance, ash-scarred Ahkeli.
Disorder means death. Order may mean life.
flavourtext:ScarabAbyss1.Text.zh:
隨著成群的骨頭，鮮血和骯髒的魔法在瓦斯特里平原上激增，
我們的血脈的倖存者很少同意你的聯盟，灰燼痕蹟的阿卡莉。
疾病意味著死亡。 秩序可能意味著生命。

en: Your golems and your leadership have slowed the tide of death, Clayshaper.
The relics of power you bid us find have kept the Vastiri Plains from the brink
of oblivion. The defences of the Maraketh will hold.
flavourtext:ScarabAbyss2.Text.zh:
你的魔像和你的領導放慢了死亡的潮流，塑泥者。
你競爭我們發現的力量遺物使瓦斯特里平原免於
被遺忘的邊緣。 馬拉克斯的防禦會保持。

en: The Winter of the World has ended at the hands of the Three Sisters. We lay this scarab
upon your ancient grave in thanks for your efforts, Honoured Founder. As you hoped,
the fate of your people will never befall another.
flavourtext:ScarabAbyss3.Text.zh:
世界的冬天已經在三姐妹的手中結束了。尊敬的創始人，我們感謝您的努力，
將這聖甲蟲放在你的古老墳墓上。正如你希望的那樣，
你們人民的命運永遠不會降臨。

en: The Abyssals creep forth by night and by storm. Their eons underground were not
a respite, but an amassing, and now they number beyond comprehension.
flavourtext:ScarabAbyss4.Text.zh:
深淵在夜晚和暴風雨中蔓延。它們的地下世代不是喘息的機會，
而是一種積聚的力量，現在它們的數量超出了人們的理解範圍。

en: Feuding Ezomytes slaughtered your kin, young Agnar, but we pulled you
from the flames. The Order of the Djinn is your clan now.
flavourtext:ScarabBeasts1.Text.zh:
年輕的艾格納，世仇艾茲麥屠殺你的親人，但我們讓你
遠離戰火。巨靈教團現在是你的家族了。

en: None among us understand the beasts of this world better than you,
honoured Agnar. You will root out the mysteries of wild-artefacts.
flavourtext:ScarabBeasts2.Text.zh:
忠心的艾格納，我們之中沒有人比你更了解這個世界的野獸。
你將會揭開這野性聖物的神秘之處。

en: The Order was your clan in life, Agnar, Beastmaster, but the First Ones call
back their favoured son. The gift of their Visions will pass to another.
flavourtext:ScarabBeasts3.Text.zh:
野獸專家艾格納，教團過去是你的家族，但初始者喚回
他們最喜愛的兒子。他們幻視的天賦將會轉移至其它人。

en: Without an experienced Beastmaster to find them new realms,
the First Ones' ravaging hunt brings them ever closer to Wraeclast.
flavourtext:ScarabBeasts4.Text.zh:
在沒有有經驗的野獸大師幫他們找尋新的地域，
初始者肆虐般的狩獵使他們離戰爭破滅越來越近了

en: Without an experienced Beastmaster to find them new realms,
the First Ones' ravaging hunt brings them ever closer to Wraeclast.
flavourtext:ScarabBeasts4a.Text.zh:
在沒有有經驗的野獸大師幫他們找尋新的地域，
初始者肆虐般的狩獵使他們離戰爭破滅越來越近了

en: Without an experienced Beastmaster to find them new realms,
the First Ones' ravaging hunt brings them ever closer to Wraeclast.
flavourtext:ScarabBeasts4b.Text.zh:
在沒有有經驗的野獸大師幫他們找尋新的地域，
初始者肆虐般的狩獵使他們離戰爭破滅越來越近了

en: Without an experienced Beastmaster to find them new realms,
the First Ones' ravaging hunt brings them ever closer to Wraeclast.
flavourtext:ScarabBeasts4c.Text.zh:
在沒有有經驗的野獸大師幫他們找尋新的地域，
初始者肆虐般的狩獵使他們離戰爭破滅越來越近了

en: Without an experienced Beastmaster to find them new realms,
the First Ones' ravaging hunt brings them ever closer to Wraeclast.
flavourtext:ScarabBeasts4d.Text.zh:
在沒有有經驗的野獸大師幫他們找尋新的地域，
初始者肆虐般的狩獵使他們離戰爭破滅越來越近了

en: We pulled you from the raging ocean, young Dhunan,
but we cannot return you to your home. The Order of the Djinn
offers you a place on Wraeclast.
flavourtext:ScarabBlight1.Text.zh:
們把你從洶湧的大海中拉了出來，年輕的杜南，
但是我們無法將你送回破石堡。 巨靈教團
為你提供了瓦爾克拉斯上的一席之地。

en: For using the techniques of your homeland to contain
the fungal plague, honoured Dhunan, you shall lead the war
to eliminate it and end the century-cycle of infestation.
flavourtext:ScarabBlight2.Text.zh:
尊敬的杜南因使用家園的技術
來控制真菌災，您將領導這場戰爭以消除它，
並結束世紀的侵擾。

en: Be at rest, Blightmaster Dhunan, on the distant shores of
your home. A dangerous expedition, but one worthy for
he who gave his life to cleanse Wraeclast.
flavourtext:ScarabBlight3.Text.zh:
在你家遙遠的海岸上，休息吧，凋零大師杜南。
這是一次危險的探險，但對他獻出生命來
清洗狂暴者來說，這是值得的。

en: The fungal plague returns, and its roots have adapted.
The undiscovered Blightheart that Dhunan theorised
must still exist somewhere, yet none remain
with the skill to see to its destruction.
flavourtext:ScarabBlight4.Text.zh:
黴菌瘟疫回來了，其根源已經適應。
杜南理論化的未被發現的枯萎之心
必須仍然存在於某個地方，
但沒有一個人擁有看到其毀滅的能力。

en: The Ember-dwellers sought to throw you to their volcanic god, young Omid,
but we caught you instead. The Order of the Djinn is your tribe now.
flavourtext:ScarabBreach1.Text.zh:
餘燼居民想要把你獻祭給他們的火山神，年輕的歐米德，
我們會抓住你。現在巨靈教團是你的兄弟姊妹。

en: We task you, honoured Omid, with the investigation of this mysterious
'Xoph' and artefacts related to rifts in the boundaries of our world.
flavourtext:ScarabBreach2.Text.zh:
忠心的歐米德，我們交付你任務來調查這神秘的索伏
和關於我們世界交界裂痕的聖物。

en: Omid, Master Researcher, has left a final commandment upon his death:
the world must never know.
flavourtext:ScarabBreach3.Text.zh:
研究大師，歐米德，他在死去時留下最後遺言：
絕不能公諸於世。

en: The Master Researcher's final commandment has failed.
The High Templar has seen the truth of our situation,
and the world will be undone by his fear.
flavourtext:ScarabBreach4.Text.zh:
首席研究員的最後誡命失敗了。
聖宗看見了我們處境的真相，
他的恐懼將摧毀世界。

en: You were a casualty of callous Karui warfare, ageless Narumoa, but the Order
mended your wounds. You are bound to us now by your own code.
flavourtext:ScarabDivinationCards1.Text.zh:
長生者那魯莫阿，你是冷寫卡魯鬥爭下的受難者，
教團治癒你的傷痛。現在你與我們被你自己的原則緊緊纏繞著。

en: Though your peers fear you, Narumoa, the elders have decided that your
second sight is ideal for handling all artefacts that seek to subvert Fate.
flavourtext:ScarabDivinationCards2.Text.zh:
那魯莫阿，雖然你的同儕都畏懼你，但長老們認為你千里眼的能力
是的不錯的人選來處理所有試圖破壞命運的文物。

en: Your centuries of service have been invaluable to us, Narumoa. Go now,
return to Hinekora, and join your ancient kin in the halls of the dead.
flavourtext:ScarabDivinationCards3.Text.zh:
那魯莫阿，你數個世紀的服侍對我們來說是無價的。現在
回歸悉妮蔻拉，在亡魂之殿加入你古代的至親。

en: Hinekora has sent the world another herald, but this hatungo walks another path.
We are left blinded, and subject to the vagaries of Fate.
flavourtext:ScarabDivinationCards4.Text.zh:
悉妮蔻拉向世界發出了另一個先驅，但是這頭仇恨走了另一條路。
我們被蒙蔽了雙眼，並遭受命運的變幻莫測。

en: Your visions led the Azmeri down into a world left abandoned by the Vaal.
They cast you out, young Egrin, but the Order of the Djinn accepts you.
flavourtext:ScarabElderRares1_.Text.zh:
你的幻視引導你的部落至這個被瓦爾遺棄的世界，
年輕的伊格林，他們將你驅逐，但巨靈教團張開雙臂歡迎你。

en: Speaker of unclean truths, Egrin of the Dark Between Stars.
We curse you whose soul echoes the madness of the void!
flavourtext:ScarabElderRares2_.Text.zh:
不潔真理的演講者，暗星相鄰之伊格林。
我們詛咒你的靈魂在這虛空中發瘋的回響！

en: Egrin of the Dark Between Stars, Forger of the Sealing Blade,
let your name be redeemed by your unexpected sacrifice.
flavourtext:ScarabElderRares3.Text.zh:
封印之劍的贗造者，暗星相鄰之伊格林，
用你超乎預期的犧牲贖回你的名聲吧。

en: We are all equally fools for our childish notions.
That dread force Decay cannot be defeated by self-sacrifice.
flavourtext:ScarabElderRares4.Text.zh:
對於我們幼稚的觀念，我們都是傻瓜。
那種可怕的腐朽之力不能以自我犧牲來擊敗。

en: Your ancestry has been much maligned by history, young Sarina Titucius,
but to the Order of the Djinn, you are born anew.
flavourtext:ScarabHarbinger1.Text.zh:
年輕的賽琳娜．提圖庫斯，你的祖先受到歷史的嚴重汙衊，
但是對於巨靈教團來說，你重獲新生。

en: For deciphering the language of the inscrutable ones, honoured Sarina,
we charge you with investigating their intent in our land.
flavourtext:ScarabHarbinger2.Text.zh:
尊敬的賽琳娜，為了破譯那些難以理解的語言，
我們要求你調查他們在我們土地上的意圖。

en: For your valour beyond the Gate, Sarina Titucius, we honour you with the first
Gilded Scarab awarded while its recipient still lives. Remain vigilant.
flavourtext:ScarabHarbinger3.Text.zh:
賽琳娜．提圖庫斯，你在大門外的英勇行為，我們用第一隻鍍金聖甲蟲
榮耀你，即使他的宿主仍活著。 保持警惕。

en: The thousand year truce has faltered, for the inscrutable ones have imprisoned their own God.
Should they invade again, there will be no warning.
flavourtext:ScarabHarbinger4.Text.zh:
千年的停戰已經動搖了，因為那些無法捉摸的人已經監禁了他們的上帝。
如果他們再次入侵，將不會發出警告。

en: Your faith and our Order are not in opposition, young Eutychus.
Let this be the start of a new era of cooperation.
flavourtext:ScarabLegion1.Text.zh:
你的信仰和我們的教團不是反對的，年輕的猶圖克斯。
讓這成為合作新時代的開始。

en: As our hand in the Chamber, we grant you, Deacon Eutychus,
access to a domain we lack the resources to explore.
flavourtext:ScarabLegion2.Text.zh:
教執猶圖克斯，身為議會的一員，我們授權你，
前往我們缺乏資訊的領域探索。

en: Given the fate of Deacon Eutychus and the men under Cardinal Sanctus Vox,
let none dare the Domain, lest they too feed that vile hunger eternal.
flavourtext:ScarabLegion3.Text.zh:
鑑於教執猶圖克斯和大主教桑特斯瓦克斯之下人的命運，
不要讓任何人敢於這個領域，以免他們過於飢餓永恆。

en: As the passage between Wraeclast and the land beyond time's reach is torn open,
we stand on the precipice of eternal war.
And no one remains to hold us back.
flavourtext:ScarabLegion4.Text.zh:
隨著瓦爾克拉斯通往超越時間束縛之地的通道被扯開，
我們站在永恆之戰爭的危險之境。
沒有人可以再阻擋我們了。

en: Consider yourself an orphaned Eternal no longer, young Betucia.
The Order of the Djinn is your family now.
flavourtext:ScarabMaps1.Text.zh:
年輕的貝蒂西亞，不再覺得自己是個永恆的孤兒。
巨靈教團現在是你的家人。

en: For your loyalty and valour, honoured Betucia, we are proud to put
the requisition of dream-artefacts in your capable hands.
flavourtext:ScarabMaps2.Text.zh:
衷心的貝蒂西亞，為了你多年的忠誠和勇氣，我們很自豪地把這個
徵用的夢幻藝品放在你的巧手中。

en: Betucia, Bearer of the Sealing Blade, the Order of the Djinn survives
because of your sacrifice, but will be forever wounded by your loss.
flavourtext:ScarabMaps3.Text.zh:
封印之刃的受難者，貝蒂西亞，巨靈教團
因你的犧牲得以存活，但會因你的受損而永遠負傷。

en: The Sealing Blade has been removed, and the agent of Decay
shall feed upon this world until nothing remains but dust.
flavourtext:ScarabMaps4.Text.zh:
密封刀已被移走，腐敗的代理人
必以這個世界為食，直到塵土飛揚。

en: We pulled you from the piled dead, young Ixchel, while your people were going mad
with fear. The gods may have vanished, but the Order will watch over you now.
flavourtext:ScarabMetamorph1.Text.zh:
我們從堆積如山的屍骸中救出了你，年幼的伊克契爾，
那時你的人民正因恐懼而陷入瘋狂。神靈或許已經消逝，
但秩序從今往後將守護著妳。

en: For infiltrating the Priesthood of Yaomac and returning with their sleeping form,
Ixchel, we honour you. Your next task must be to infiltrate the Temple of Chaos.
flavourtext:ScarabMetamorph2.Text.zh:
伊克契爾，為了表彰妳滲透堯馬克祭司階層並帶回其沉睡化身的功績，
我們在此對你致敬。妳的下一個任務，將是滲透混沌神廟。

en: It was our error, Ixchel Godstealer, that led to your fate. Chaos is not asleep,
thus not a god, and for your eternal suffering, you have our eternal remorse.
flavourtext:ScarabMetamorph3.Text.zh:
那是我們的過錯，奪神者．伊克契爾，才導致了你的命運。
混沌並未沉睡，因此祂並非神靈；對於你永恆的受難，我們抱持著永恆的悔恨。

en: The silent war of shadows and struggle must be set aside.
Order and Chaos must ally against the coming tide.
flavourtext:ScarabMetamorph4.Text.zh:
暗影與鬥爭的無聲戰爭必須暫且擱置。
秩序與混沌必須結盟，共同抵禦即將到來的浪潮。

en: Your people no longer walk this continent, young Revna,
but the Order of the Djinn will give you a new home.
flavourtext:ScarabPerandus1.Text.zh:
你的族人不再在這片大陸上行走了，年輕的蕾芙娜，
但巨靈教團會給你一個新家。

en: As you delve into the mysteries of this world, apprentice Revna,
remember to learn from the past, not be consumed by it.
flavourtext:ScarabPerandus2.Text.zh:
當你深入探索這個世界的奧秘時，學徒蕾芙娜，
記住要從過去吸取教訓，不要被它吞噬。

en: We lay you to rest in the forest deep, Runesmith Revna, so that you may be
forever hidden from the stars which so terrified you in your final days.
May the secret you took to your grave be lifted from your burdens.
flavourtext:ScarabPerandus3.Text.zh:
我們讓你安息在森林深處，符文匠蕾芙娜，這樣你
就可以永遠遠離那些在你最後的日子裡讓你害怕的星星。
願你帶進墳墓的秘密從你的負擔中解脫出來。

en: Darkness surges in the shadows of the past. Ancient evils stir. The stars
watch, forever aloof, forever menacing. None remain who know the
secret, so we are defenseless in the face of the unknown.
flavourtext:ScarabPerandus4.Text.zh:
黑暗在過去的陰影中湧動。古老的邪惡在攪動。星星
注視著，永遠冷漠，永遠來勢洶洶。沒有人知道秘密，
所以我們在未知面前毫無防備。

en: The Peak-dwellers saw you as impure, young Qianga, but the Order of
the Djinn sees you as all the stronger for your uniqueness.
flavourtext:ScarabShaperRares1.Text.zh:
年輕的琴嘉，山峰居民視你為不純淨者，但
巨靈教團因你的獨特性將你視為強者。

en: Bold dreamer, Qianga of the Stars, she of the Celestial Cold! These titles
we bestow upon the one among us whose soul speaks to the ineffable.
flavourtext:ScarabShaperRares2.Text.zh:
眾星琴嘉，勇敢的夢想者絢麗星空冷如她！這些，
和其他的頭銜，我們賜予我們之中靈魂與不可言說之物交談。

en: Qianga of the Stars, Deliverer of the Sealing Blade to the Watchers, go now, and
let your half-dreamt life be troubled by nightmares of achromic hunger no more.
flavourtext:ScarabShaperRares3.Text.zh:
眾星琴嘉，封印之刃的救贖者給我們的盟友了腐朽的守望者，走吧，
讓你半夢想的生活成為天堂並且不再受到飢餓的噩夢所困擾。

en: The Watchers have gone silent, yet they scream still.
Something lurks among the stars of our dreams, knocking at the door,
whispering with the voices of long lost friends...
flavourtext:ScarabShaperRares4.Text.zh:
守望者一直保持沉默，但他們仍在尖叫。
我們夢寐以求的東西潛伏在門口，
用久違朋友的聲音正低語著...

en: Your outlaw camp abandoned you when their surprise attack failed, young Rindwik.
Now that you know we exist, we cannot let you go. You have two choices.
flavourtext:ScarabStrongbox1.Text.zh:
年輕的萊恩維克，當他們的突襲擊敗時，你的法外陣營就拋棄你了。
既然你知道我們存在，我們就不能讓你離開。你有兩個選擇。

en: Your people were renegades, Rindwik, but you have proven your loyalty.
You will lead the martial defence of our expeditions.
flavourtext:ScarabStrongbox2.Text.zh:
萊恩維克，你的人民叛變了，但你已經證明你的忠誠。
你將帶領我們的征戰對進行軍事防禦。

en: Master Warrior Rindwik fell to one opponent alone: old age.
Only the greatest soldiers can say as much.
flavourtext:ScarabStrongbox3.Text.zh:
大戰士萊恩維克獨自落到了一個對手手上：衰老。
只有最偉大的戰士才能這樣說。

en: In the absence of a strong martial presence, the renegades rise once more.
Their poisons threaten to cloud the land.
flavourtext:ScarabStrongbox4.Text.zh:
在沒有強大的軍事存在的情況下，叛軍再次崛起。
他們的毒藥威脅著土地。

en: As the first Brinerot to join the Order, you have much to prove,
young Raethan. We are confident you will succeed.
flavourtext:ScarabSulphite1.Text.zh:
做為第一個加入教團的布琳洛特，你有相當多可以證明，
年輕的瑞森。我們很信任你會成功的。

en: For harnessing and controlling the power of lightning, you, Raethan,
are now charged with researching this new energy.
flavourtext:ScarabSulphite2.Text.zh:
駕馭且受控的雷電之力，你，瑞森，
現在開始負責研究可以用此新能量。

en: Let him not be called Raethan the Betrayer. His discovery was too important
to keep locked away. Now, for good or ill, it is in civilisation's hands.
flavourtext:ScarabSulphite3.Text.zh:
不要稱呼他為背叛者瑞森。他的發現太重要
以至於不能被隱藏。不管好與壞，現在已經落入人民的手中了。

en: Madness marches in machine form.
Harnessed lightning, grim faces, and cold ambition abounds.
Civilisation will be its own undoing.
flavourtext:ScarabSulphite4.Text.zh:
瘋狂以機器形式前進。
充滿了閃電、冷酷的面孔和殘酷的野心。
文明將消滅自己。

en: Young Tsarsk, you were a broken and forgotten child lying glassy-eyed
in a flesh-pit in Trarthus, but the Order found and cleansed you.
flavourtext:ScarabTorment1.Text.zh:
年輕的札克斯，你是一個被背叛且被遺忘的孩子，倒落在
在特拉特斯的一個屍坑，但是教團發現並淨化了你。

en: Your tortured soul long kept you isolated from your peers, Tsarsk, but has attracted
new kindred in kind. You are tasked with appeasing these anguished spirits.
flavourtext:ScarabTorment2.Text.zh:
札克斯，你飽受折磨的靈魂，使你被你的同儕孤立，但也吸引了
新的志同道合的同類。你的任務是安撫這些痛苦的精神。

en: Though you were swallowed by your own darkness, you saved countless others
from eternal misery, young Tsarsk. You were not nothing, as you feared.
flavourtext:ScarabTorment3.Text.zh:
雖然你被自己的黑暗所吞噬，但你也拯救無數的其他人
免於萬劫不復的苦難，年輕的札克斯。你擔心，你不是一無是處。

en: Without a speaker of the dead, the countless anguished spirits only grow in number.
They have no voice, and no hope. The sun darkens with each passing year.
flavourtext:ScarabTorment4.Text.zh:
沒有替死者發聲的人，無數痛苦的靈魂只會增加。
他們沒有聲音，也沒有希望。太陽一年比一年黑。

en: The Maraketh left you to die alone in the desert, young Sumei, but we
saw the potential in you. The Order of the Djinn is your akhara now.
flavourtext:ScarabUniques1.Text.zh:
年輕的休美，馬拉克斯放你獨自一人在沙漠等死，但
我們看見你的潛力。巨靈教團現在是你的血脈了。

en: As the best of our lorekeepers, honoured Sumei, it is now your task
to investigate the mysterious duplication of artefacts of power.
flavourtext:ScarabUniques2.Text.zh:
忠心的休美，作為我們最優秀的知識學家，現在由你來調查
文物神祕複製體的力量。

en: Go to your rest now, Sumei, Master Lorekeeper. The Order shall keep
contained the terrible secret that burdened your final years.
flavourtext:ScarabUniques3.Text.zh:
知識學家休美，你現在去休息吧。教團會一直
守護你最後幾年所承受的可怕祕密。

en: The books were burned, and the scribes set themselves aflame.
What secret so terrible could they have discovered?
Though centuries have passed, we must investigate this for ourselves.
flavourtext:ScarabUniques4.Text.zh:
書被燒掉了，文士自焚。
他們會如何發現如此可怕的秘密？
儘管已經過去了幾個世紀，但我們自己必須為此進行調查。

en: For aeons, ancient constructs have lain dormant,
but now their designs are under your control.
flavourtext:SentinelController.Text.zh:
萬古以來，古老的裝置一直處於沉睡，
但現在他們的設計在你的控制之下。

en: You must let me go, my daughter...
I am but a ghost, now. A memory...
flavourtext:ShaperAtlasNodeFlavour.Text.zh:
你必須放我走，我的女兒…
我如今不過是一縷幽魂。一段回憶…

en: Enter the crucible. The nexus of
nothingness and equilibrium of eternity.
flavourtext:ShaperFragment1.Text.zh: 試煉之地，永恆和無盡的交叉，虛無的平衡點。

en: Enter the crucible. The nexus of
nothingness and equilibrium of eternity.
flavourtext:ShaperFragment2.Text.zh: 試煉之地，永恆和無盡的交叉，虛無的平衡點。

en: Enter the crucible. The nexus of
nothingness and equilibrium of eternity.
flavourtext:ShaperFragment3.Text.zh: 試煉之地，永恆和無盡的交叉，虛無的平衡點。

en: Enter the crucible. The nexus of
nothingness and equilibrium of eternity.
flavourtext:ShaperFragment4.Text.zh: 試煉之地，永恆和無盡的交叉，虛無的平衡點。

en: I spent my life shining a light on truth...
but some things should remain in darkness,
locked away for all eternity.
flavourtext:ShaperKey.Text.zh:
我用盡一生和為真相…
但有些事情應該就此封印，
永不見於世。

en: "...It wasn't long before we were met by the Shade itself.
The very essence of the Elder, demanding of me in visions to
tell it why I had returned. But before I could answer,
Venarius stepped forward and greeted the phantom..."
flavourtext:ShaperMemoryFragment10_1.Tex.zh:
"…不久之前我們遇見了陰影本身。
每個尊師的精神，用視線要求我
告訴它我為什麼會回來。但在我回答前，
維那利斯走上前去迎接那個幻影…"

en: "...Before we knew it, we stood at the base of that blasphemous effigy.
"Pull the sword from my chest." The Elder imposed, and Venarius didn't hesitate.
The earth shook in the face of the Elder's reunion with its body. The true scope of the
Elder befell the High Templar and his men, and as it began to feed, I began to run..."
flavourtext:ShaperMemoryFragment10_2.Tex.zh:
"…在我們明白發生什麼事前，我們都站上了褻瀆肖像的底部。
"從我的胸前拔出劍。"尊師強調，維那利斯絲毫沒有猶豫。
大地在尊師重組它的身體面前震動。當尊師的真實範圍
壟罩在聖宗和他的手下，並開始進食時，我開始逃跑…"

en: "...I fear this to be the end. Not just the end for me, but the end of all things.
The Elder has been freed. Soon it will feast on me... on the rest of the world.
It was too late for me. The Elder had to be stopped. I knew of the shaping powers.
Only I could have a hope at defeating the Elder..."
flavourtext:ShaperMemoryFragment10_3.Tex.zh:
"…我擔心這將會是結局。不僅是我的結局，萬物也都會被終結。
尊師被釋放了。很快的它將會吞噬我…和剩餘的世界。
對我來說太遲了。尊師必須被阻止。我知到塑造的力量。
只有我有希望能夠擊敗尊師…"

en: "...A golden machine was found broken in the ruins of Wraeclast.
Believing it to contain some dark infernal secret,
High Templar Venarius asked that I restore it
and weaponize whatever powers it might contain..."
flavourtext:ShaperMemoryFragment1_1.Text.zh:
"…在殘破的瓦爾克拉斯找到了壞掉的黃金機器。
相信他潛藏了些暗黑地獄的秘密，
聖宗維那利斯要求我將它復原
並武裝它可能包含的力量…"

en: "...Though the device seemed to be mostly functioning,
something important appeared to be missing...
...I worked tirelessly in search of answers, until finally,
at the base of that cruel device, I fell into a deep, deep sleep..."
flavourtext:ShaperMemoryFragment2_1.Text.zh:
"...雖然個裝置大部分好像都在運作，
但某些重要的東西似乎消失了…
…我不知疲憊的找尋答案，終於，
在那殘酷裝置的基底上，我沉沉的進入睡眠中..."

en: "...I awoke in the most beautiful of places, and as I wandered this strange new land,
I felt a growing sense of realization that I was not alone.
A Shade, a whisper of embodied smoke, spoke to me through thoughts and pictures.
I found myself enthusiastically volunteering information in detail of Oriath..."
flavourtext:ShaperMemoryFragment3_1.Text.zh:
"…我在最美的地方醒了過來，當我漫步在這陌生的新大陸上，
我感覺越來越熟悉且知道我並不孤單。
迷霧具體化陰影、呢喃，通過思想與畫作與我溝通。
我發現自己熱切地想從奧瑞亞知道更詳細的資訊..."

en: "...The Shade knew of the device - a doorway between my world
and the dreamlands. It offered to help me rebuild the missing part,
to create a conduit between this beautiful land and Oriath.
All that the Shade asked of me was to return the favour..."
flavourtext:ShaperMemoryFragment4_1.Text.zh:
"...陰影知道裝置的事了 - 是我的世界
和夢幻大陸的大門。它提供我幫助，重建遺失的部分，
在這個美麗的土地和奧瑞亞建立一條通道。
陰影所有的付出，是要求我可以給予回報..."

en: "...Every night, I found myself asleep at the foot of the strange device,
awoken to the reality of another world within my own.
The Shade taught me how to shape and build things from my imagination,
how to transport such phantasmagorical treasures back into the world of man..."
flavourtext:ShaperMemoryFragment5_1.Text.zh:
"…每晚，我發現自己在陌生的裝置下睡著了，
喚醒了另一個世界真實的我。
陰影教會了我如何從我想像中塑造和創造事物，
如何將這些幻想的財富搬回人們的世界…"

en: "...The missing part of the great device had finally been formed.
The Shade requested its one favour. I was shown images of the past,
the Shade as King of the dreamlands, the hateful Watchers of Decay...
It led me deep into a cave, to a statue pierced by a sword..."
flavourtext:ShaperMemoryFragment6_1.Text.zh:
"這偉大的裝置遺失的部分終於被成形了。
陰影請求一個幫忙。我被顯示了過去的影像，
陰影是夢幻大陸的統治者，憎恨腐朽的守望者…
它讓我深深地陷入了一個山洞，一座被劍刺穿的雕像..."

en: "Pull the blade from my chest. Free me!" the Shade imposed.
But doubt entered my mind, and the Shade flew into a fury!
I felt my mind torn asunder as images of murder and mutilation were forced upon me.
I fled in a panic, cursing myself for ever trusting such a strange creature so blindly..."
flavourtext:ShaperMemoryFragment7_1.Text.zh:
"從我的胸前將劍拔出。感受我！" 陰影強調。
但我開始懷疑，陰影憤怒了！
我覺得自己的思想被撕裂，謀殺和殘害的影像被強加在我身上。
我驚慌地逃跑，咒罵自己盲目的信任這樣一個奇怪的生物…"

en: "...Months have now passed since the Shade revealed its true nature.
Each morning, I lock myself inside my study, searching for some knowledge
that might save us. I have found at last, some information on the Watchers of Decay.
The truth is so unutterable that I hesitate, even now, to write it down..."
flavourtext:ShaperMemoryFragment8_1.Text.zh:
"…自從陰影顯露出它的真面目後已經過了幾個月了。
每個早上，我把自己鎖在書房，搜尋著可能
拯救我們的知識。終於我找到了些關於腐朽的看守者的資訊。
真相是那麼的難以形容，以至於我現在猶豫地記錄下來…"

en: "...They called it the Elder. A creature of malignant madness... it cannot be killed.
The Watchers built the device to lock tight its kingdom, bringing with them the
blade - 'Starforge'. A weapon to give the Elder eternal rest. But the Shade...
I must find a way to put a stop to it before it finds a path to freedom..."
flavourtext:ShaperMemoryFragment8_2.Text.zh:
"…他們稱呼它為「尊師」。一種瘋狂邪物的生物…它無法被殺死。
守望者建造這個裝置是為了封鎖它在自己的國度中，帶來了他們的
劍 - '核星'。讓尊師可以永久休息的武器。但是陰影…
在它找到解放之路前，我必須要找到方法來阻止它…"

en: "...I've spent every waking hour since, trying to find a way to end this unholy Elder.
Within my secret study, I've begun work on a device of my own, tinkering and shaping.
When I'm finished, this Elder will never bother our world again.
The creature cannot be killed, but maybe... it can be exiled..."
flavourtext:ShaperMemoryFragment9_1.Text.zh:
"…我每刻清醒的時分，都在找可以終結那邪惡尊師的方法。
在我秘密的研究中，我開始製作自己的裝置，修補和塑造。
當我完成時，尊師將無法再打擾我們的世界了。
那個生物或許無法被剷除，但可能…它可以被流放…"

en: "...Lack of progress on the device has given the High Templar cause for suspicion.
Clapped in irons, I was lead off to the Theopolis prisons for my insubordination.
I must find my way from these chains at all costs. The Elder is coming for us.
Only I can save us from this blasphemy that will soon befall Oriath..."
flavourtext:ShaperMemoryFragment9_2.Text.zh:
"…裝置的進度緩慢開始讓聖宗有了懷疑。
因為我的不服從，被鐵鍊綁住帶往費歐普羅斯的監獄。
我必須用盡一切方法逃離這枷鎖。尊師快要來了。
只有我能拯救大家免於遭受即將降臨在奧瑞亞的褻瀆…"

en: "...Venarius, that bastard... he marched me through the streets.
His men beat me within an inch of death... I... I told him everything.
He demanded that I take all of us into the dreamlands, to meet with the Elder.
Using the device, we stepped through, setting foot in the Atlas of Worlds..."
flavourtext:ShaperMemoryFragment9_3.Text.zh:
"...維那利斯那個渾蛋…他讓我遊街示眾。
他的人毆打我瀕臨死亡…我…我告訴了他一切。
他要求我把所有人都帶進夢幻大陸，會會尊師。
使用裝置，我們跨了過去，並站上了異界輿圖…"

en: Their whims left unknown,
Their life left for others.
flavourtext:ShardOfFate.Text.zh:
他們的幻想依然成謎
他們的性命為他人而犧牲

en: What remains when all
else is stripped away?
flavourtext:SirusAtlasNodeFlavour.Text.zh:
當一切
都被剝離殆盡後，還剩下什麼？

en: He sought to be the best,
but lost his family.
flavourtext:SirusFragment1.Text.zh:
他想成為最好的人，
卻失去了家人。

en: He sought God,
but lost himself.
flavourtext:SirusFragment2.Text.zh:
他尋求上帝，
卻迷失了自己。

en: He sought a kingdom,
but lost his people.
flavourtext:SirusFragment3.Text.zh:
他想建構王朝，
卻失去了他的子民。

en: She sought to bring salvation,
but lost her compassion.
flavourtext:SirusFragment4.Text.zh:
她尋求帶來救贖，
卻失去了她的同情心。

en: Wield the gifts of Beidat, luminary of the pale unseeing,
whose honeyed words bore tunnels through pliant minds.
flavourtext:SkillGemPactOfBeidat.Text.zh:
揮舞貝達特的恩賜吧，牠是蒼白盲目者
的引路星辰，其甜言蜜語在順從的心靈中鑿出了隧道。

en: Offer yourself to Ghorr, the gluttonous, the cage of
flesh trapping souls in the cycle of consumption.
flavourtext:SkillGemPactOfGhorr.Text.zh:
將你自己奉獻給暴食者戈沃，
那座將靈魂困在吞噬循環中的血肉之牢。

en: Unleash the fury of K'Tash, incarnation of hate.
Endless bodies burn beneath the flames of his pursuit.
flavourtext:SkillGemPactOfKtash.Text.zh:
釋放克塔什的憤怒，牠是仇恨的化身。
無數軀殼在牠追尋的烈焰下燃燒殆盡。

en: Call upon Lycia, conduit of the Scourge. She forfeit
her soul for the power to condemn lies told by bones.
flavourtext:SkillGemPactOfLycia.Text.zh:
召喚災禍的媒介利希亞。
她出賣了自己的靈魂，換取了譴責白骨所言之謊的力量。

en: 'Lightning never strikes the same place twice'
is really just wishful thinking.
flavourtext:StruckByLightning.Text.zh:
閃電絕不會落在同樣地點'
只是因為你太樂觀。

en: Velka reached out her hand. One touch and she
folded, screaming, clawing desperately at her back
as the crustaceous gift burst itself from her spine.
flavourtext:SupportGemAbyssalWell.Text.zh:
維爾卡伸出手。僅僅一觸，她便
蜷身倒下，尖叫著，絕望地抓撓自己的背，
任由甲殼般的恩賜自她脊椎爆裂而出。

en: Those citizens of Oriath touched by the
roving storms died most horrible deaths.
flavourtext:SupportGemAnnihilation.Text.zh: 那些被漫遊風暴所觸及的奧瑞亞公民，皆死於極度淒慘的境地。

en: "The history of Wraeclast is marked by bloody conflicts. The rise
and fall of empires. Man slaughtered man, never suspecting the
madness lurking under the surface might not have been innate."
flavourtext:SupportGemBloodsoakedBanner..zh:
「瓦爾克拉斯的歷史滿是血腥衝突：帝國的興起與覆滅。
人類之間互相屠殺，卻從未懷疑那潛伏於表面之下的瘋狂，或許並非天生。」

en: "Prove yourself! Are you a knave, or a knight?
I shall know by the strength of your blows!"
flavourtext:SupportGemCastOnWardBreak.Te.zh: 「證明你的能耐！你是宵小，還是騎士？ 我將從你揮擊的力量中見真章！」

en: The Black Sekhema was a formidable fighter
alongside her dekhara, but she was unstoppable
when she fought atop her trusted mount, Shiyo.
flavourtext:SupportGemCompanionship.Text.zh: 漆黑絲克瑪與她的部下並肩作戰時 已是一名令人敬畏的戰士，但當她騎乘 在忠誠的坐騎熙優背上戰鬥時，更是勢不可擋。

en: "I have a recurring nightmare... I run...
I scream... but only the dead hear me..."
flavourtext:SupportGemCongregation.Text.zh: 「我總做著同一個噩夢……我奔跑…… 我尖叫……但只有死者能聽見我的聲音……」

en: "The science is... incomprehensible at best. Nearest I can tell, the Arcana exhibits
a blast of wrath once it has been fully charged, and when directed at the Elder
will force it to take on the form it held before it entered our dimension."
flavourtext:SupportGemCooldownRecovery.T.zh:
「這門科學……往好聽說也只能稱作難以理解。我能判斷的是，秘能一旦完全充盈，
便會釋放出一陣憤怒的爆發；而當它被導向尊師時，將迫使其顯現出
在進入我們的維度之前所擁有的形態。」

en: The ancient golem of bone climbs ever upward.
Its body is an engine. Its eyes are fuel.
flavourtext:SupportGemCrystalfall.Text.zh:
由枯骨組成的古老魔像不斷向上攀爬。
它的軀體是一具引擎。它的雙眼則是燃料。

en: "Beidat is the lesser of three evils. The other two desire only
to consume us, but under him, there is a chance to survive...
a chance to serve... if you can prove yourself useful."
flavourtext:SupportGemCullTheWeak.Text.zh: 「貝達特是三害之中較輕的。另外兩者只渴望 將我們吞噬，但在他麾下，還有一絲生存的機會…… 一絲侍奉的機會……只要你能證明自己的價值。」

en: "The world will never know our sacrifice, but
we will stand and fight for as long as it takes!"
flavourtext:SupportGemDivineSentinel.Tex.zh: 「這個世界永遠不會知曉我們的犧牲，但 無論要付出多少時間，我們都會挺身奮戰到底！」

en: "Although we are two bodies, we are of one mind, one heart, drifting
through the cosmos, in search of purpose. The moment we cross paths,
both fleeting and eternal, our eyes are opened to our potential."
flavourtext:SupportGemEclipse.Text.zh:
「雖然我們是兩具身軀，卻共享意識與心臟，漂流於宇宙之間，尋找目的。
當我們的道路交會，那一刻既短暫又永恆，我們的雙眼便被開啟，看見自身的潛能。」

en: "You were the best of us, Sirus. Fighting alongside
you made me better. I will always miss you."
flavourtext:SupportGemEdify.Text.zh: 「你是我們之中最優秀的，賽勒斯。與你並肩作戰 讓我變得更強大。我會永遠想念你。」

en: Even trapped in stone, the Elder's shadow lingered
in their hearts and coiled around their dreams.
flavourtext:SupportGemEldritchBlasphemy..zh: 即使被封印於石中，異界尊師的陰影依然 在他們心中徘徊，並纏繞著他們的夢境。

en: "Oh yes, K'Tash understands you. It has a keen swarm-mind
somewhere within its multitudes. It hears your pleas, but
ignores them... because it hates you with a burning fury."
flavourtext:SupportGemFissure.Text.zh:
「噢是的，克塔什懂你。在牠龐大的群體之中，
藏著某種敏銳的蟲群心智。牠聽得見你的懇求，但
卻視而不見……因為牠對你懷著熾熱的狂怒。」

en: "Words without thought drive us
to claw and scrabble in the dirt,
seeking respite found only in pain."
flavourtext:SupportGemFoulgrasp.Text.zh:
「未經思考的言語驅使我們
在泥濘中掙扎，尋求僅能在痛苦
中找到的慰藉。 」

en: Her understanding of the Atlas was not innate. The
more committed she became to understanding it,
the more the knowledge weighed on her.
flavourtext:SupportGemFrostmage.Text.zh:
她對輿圖的理解並非與生俱來。
她越是投入去理解它，那份知識便越發沉重地壓在她身上。

en: Champions of the Tangle are driven to seek
sustenance for their master; should they fall
behind, they would soon be consumed as well.
flavourtext:SupportGemGluttony.Text.zh: 吞噬天地的勇士們受到驅使，不斷為他們的 主人尋找養分；若他們稍有懈怠， 很快便會淪為被吞噬的下場。

en: "I believe the Halls of the Dead are secretly a
training ground. One day, we will be called
forth to stand and fight against a great tide."
flavourtext:SupportGemGreaterAncestralCa.zh: 「我相信亡者之殿暗地裡是一座訓練場。總有一天，我們將被喚起 去挺身對抗那龐大的狂潮。」

en: "We are all connected. Each of us burns with the same fire.
Queen Hyrri knew that... she chooses to battle still, somewhere
beyond Hinekora's sight. There must be a very good reason."
flavourtext:SupportGemGreaterChain_.Text.zh: 「我們皆緊密相連。每個人心中都燃燒著相同的火焰。 希里女王深知這一點……但她仍選擇在悉妮蔻拉 視線之外的某處繼續戰鬥。這肯定有十分充分的理由。」

en: A High Templar's fear consumed her entire life,
so she cast aside her own, to do what must be done.
flavourtext:SupportGemGreaterDevour_.Tex.zh: 聖宗的恐懼吞噬了她的一生， 因此她將生死置之度外，去行當行之事。

en: Lioneye earned his moniker by killing
three men with a single arrow.
flavourtext:SupportGemGreaterFork.Text.zh: 獅眼曾以一箭射殺三人之舉， 贏得了這個稱號。

en: "Accusations fly. Sinner! Heretic! I am but an initiate, and my patron urges
silence. We will keep our heads down while one High Templar supplants
another. It's all about power, my patron whispers, and we have none..."
flavourtext:SupportGemGreaterKineticInst.zh: 「指控滿天飛。罪人！異端！我只是個學徒，而我的庇護者敦促我 保持沉默。當一位聖宗取代另一位時，我們必須低下頭來。 這一切都關乎權力，我的庇護者低聲說道，而我們手無寸鐵……」

en: Zana watched in awe as her father spoke. With each word,
he seemed to grow larger and more frightening, drawing
increasingly fervorous responses from his rapt audience.
flavourtext:SupportGemGreaterMultistrike.zh: 札娜敬畏地看著父親發言。隨著每一句話， 他的身軀似乎變得更為龐大且駭人，從全神貫注的 聽眾中，引發了越來越狂熱的迴響。

en: The echoes of lost loved ones surrounded her,
maddeningly close, but forever out of reach.
flavourtext:SupportGemGreaterSpellCascad.zh:
逝去親人的迴響縈繞著她，
近在咫尺卻又遙不可及，令人抓狂。

en: She gazed into the mirror...
and the mirror gazed back.
flavourtext:SupportGemGreaterSpellEcho.T.zh: 她凝視著鏡子…… 而鏡子也凝視著她。

en: "True power grows with patience. You must nurture it.
You learn what it needs. You provide. You wait. Only
then, when it is ripe, does it yield its fruits."
flavourtext:SupportGemGreaterUnleash.Tex.zh: 「真正的力量伴隨著耐心成長。你必須培育它。 你得了解它的需求。給予供給。然後等待。唯有 如此，當它成熟之際，才會結出豐碩的果實。」

en: Catarina envisioned a Wraeclast of disparate societies united.
That diversity would empower the Syndicate - and the increased
number of dispensible bodies was a convenient coincidence.
flavourtext:SupportGemHarrowingThrong.Te.zh: 卡塔莉娜設想著一個各方社會團結一致的瓦爾克拉斯。 這種多樣性將使密教的力量更加壯大——而那與日俱增、 可供消耗的屍體數量，不過是個帶來便利的巧合罷了。

en: "Your wards and your charms are meaningless
to one who knows your true name."
flavourtext:SupportGemHexpass.Text.zh: 「對於知曉你真名的人來說， 你的結界與護符皆毫無意義。」

en: "A warlock like myself knows that even the most abominable
plagues are part of the cycle of life and death. From that ruination,
new life will emerge, and that life will kill, and so on..."
flavourtext:SupportGemHextoad.Text.zh:
「像我這樣的術士都能明白，即使是最可憎的
瘟疫也是生死輪迴的一部分。從那毀滅之中，
新的生命將會誕生，而這生命又會帶來死亡，如此循環往復…”

en: "We spill forth, cleaving our flesh
to theirs, until we become one."
flavourtext:SupportGemHiveborn.Text.zh:
「我們傾瀉而出，血肉相連，
直至融為一體。 」

en: "The direct approach failed. So be it. In my crusade
to protect Wraeclast, I must take... a longer view."
flavourtext:SupportGemInvention.Text.zh: 「直接的手段失敗了。也罷。在我保護瓦爾克拉斯 的聖戰中，我必須把眼光……放得更長遠。」

en: "She fled from the prison of her birth, drawn by the breaking
of that great Silence. At that moment, the universe was changed,
and walls that were once impenetrable became brittle.
A fortress became a shell, and she alone escaped."
flavourtext:SupportGemInvertTheRules.Tex.zh:
「她逃離了她誕生的牢籠，受到那偉大寂靜的
破滅所牽引。在那一刻，宇宙發生了異變，
曾經堅不可摧的高牆變得脆弱不堪。
堡壘淪為空殼，唯有她獨自逃出生天。」

en: "They cast me into a pit of vipers, and
that is where I found my true self."
flavourtext:SupportGemLethalDose.Text.zh: 「他們將我擲入毒蛇坑中， 而那正是我尋得真實自我的地方。」

en: "My master enjoys the strange, and the unexpected.
I'm sure you can think of a few ways to entertain them."
flavourtext:SupportGemMachinations_.Text.zh: 「我的主人喜歡怪誕與出人意表的事物。 我相信你能想出一些法子來取悅祂。」

en: The dominance of the Templars left an indelible mark.
Zana would ever after stand guarded in their presence.
flavourtext:SupportGemMagnetism.Text.zh: 聖堂教團的統治留下了不可磨滅的印記。 此後，札娜在他們面前總是保持著戒備。

en: Catarina envisioned a Wraeclast of disparate societies united.
That diversity would empower the Syndicate - and the increased
number of dispensible bodies was a convenient coincidence.
flavourtext:SupportGemMinionPact.Text.zh:
卡塔莉娜曾設想過一個將無數異質社會融合為一的瓦爾克拉斯。
這種多樣性將賦予永生密教強大的力量——而那些隨之增加、
可供隨意消耗的軀殼，不過是一個便利的巧合罷了。

en: No walls can stand against its gaze. No fortress,
no cave, no mountain. Better to die fighting.
flavourtext:SupportGemOverheat.Text.zh: 沒有任何高牆能抵擋牠的凝視。沒有堡壘、 沒有洞穴、也沒有高山。不如戰死沙場。

en: "My people refused to take part in the ills of Wraeclast.
They were called primitives by some, and cowards by
others... but they are gone, and we still remain."
flavourtext:SupportGemPacifism.Text.zh: 「我的族人拒絕參與瓦爾克拉斯的種種罪惡。 他們被一些人稱為原始人，又被另一些人 視為懦夫……但那些人已然消亡，而我們依然長存。」

en: A vast pillar of hands embraces a charred sky.
Within burns a beam of purest heat.
flavourtext:SupportGemPyre_.Text.zh: 巨大的群手之柱擁抱著焦黑的天際。 其中燃燒著最純粹的炙熱光束。

en: Her bitterness blinded her to the true price of immortality.
Let Wraeclast burn and be devoured, she told herself...
and only herself, for centuries without end.
flavourtext:SupportGemScornfulHerald_.Te.zh: 她的苦澀使她對永生的真正代價視而不見。 讓瓦爾克拉斯燃燒殆盡、被吞噬吧，她告訴自己…… 且只有她自己，在無盡的數個世紀中獨語。

en: Let the eternal scream within
flow from your weeping blood.
flavourtext:SupportGemTransfusion.Text.zh: 讓深藏於內的永恆尖嘯 從你悲泣的鮮血中流淌而出。

en: It was a delicate balancing act for Malachai to ensure the loyalty
of his three students - each as ambitious as they were depraved.
flavourtext:SupportGemUnholyTrinity.Text.zh: 對馬拉凱來說，確保他三名學徒的忠誠 是一項微妙的平衡之舉——他們每一個人都如其野心般墮落。

en: Under Atziri, sacrifice was a ruthless and efficient science.
Her people were willing to give everything... and they did.
flavourtext:SupportGemVaalSacrifice.Text.zh:
在阿茲里的統治之下，獻祭是一門殘酷而有效率的學問。
她的人民願意奉獻一切…而他們也確實做到了。

en: "If Chaos offers you a deal, challenger,
think deeply before you accept."
flavourtext:SupportGemVaalTemptation.Tex.zh: 「若混沌向你提出交易，挑戰者， 在接受前務必三思。」

en: The Elder's influence yet lingers
in the darkest corners of Wraeclast.
flavourtext:SupportGemVoidShockwave.Text.zh:
尊師的影響力依然縈繞在
瓦爾克拉斯最黑暗的角落。

en: "Not even stopping to look behind, I dove through the shimmering window...
With not a minute to waste, I took a nearby tool and jammed it into the infernal
device, where it hummed, ominously entrenched in my laboratory floor."
flavourtext:SupportGemVoidstorm.Text.zh:
「我甚至沒有停下回頭看一眼，便縱身躍入那扇閃爍的窗口……
一刻也不能浪費，我抓起手邊的工具，猛力插入那邪惡的裝置之中。
它嗡鳴作響，帶著不祥的氣息，牢牢嵌在我實驗室的地板裡。」

en: Uhtred was remembered as a traitor, but it was he that unearthed
the only way out. The survivors found themselves in an unfamiliar
forest.  Strangely, a third were not present, including Uhtred himself.
flavourtext:SupportGemWard.Text.zh: 烏特雷作為叛徒被銘記，但正是他發掘了 唯一的出路。倖存者們發現自己身處於一座陌生的森林中。詭異的是，有三分之一的人不知所蹤，包含了烏特雷自己。

en: "I know where we found our belief in
the First Ones. I see it every time I walk
the untouched forests and hills. The
primordial world is still here. With us."
flavourtext:Talisman1_1.Text.zh:
"我知道我們對初始者的信仰源自何處。
每當我走在未受侵擾的森林與山丘間，
我都能看見它。那原始的世界
依然存在。與我們同在。"

en: "Lysanda and her Knights brought the
settling clans to what would become
Ezomyr... but there was one beast against
which even they could not stand."
flavourtext:Talisman1_10.Text.zh:
"萊珊德菈和她的騎士們帶著前來
定居的氏族來到了未來的艾茲麥……
但那裡存在著一隻巨獸，
一隻連他們也無法抗衡的巨獸。"

en: "A great headless monstrosity with arms like
teeth stalked the lands they hoped to settle.
No other weapon would find purchase. They
surrounded it with fire, burning it for days."
flavourtext:Talisman1_11.Text.zh:
"一隻巨大的無頭怪物，長著如牙齒般的手臂，
在他們希望定居的土地上遊蕩。其他武器
都無法對它造成傷害。於是他們用烈火
將其包圍，足足焚燒了數日之久。"

en: "With the headless beast incinerated, the
settlers rejoiced, and began building homes.
They would soon find that this hostile land
had more insidious ways of rejecting them."
flavourtext:Talisman1_12.Text.zh:
"隨著無頭巨獸被燒成灰燼，
定居者們歡欣鼓舞，並開始建造家園。
但他們很快就會發現，這片充滿敵意
的土地，有著更隱蔽的方法來排斥他們。"

en: "We held our trust in the First Ones long
before we learned runes. Long before we
were shown the ways of cities and roads."
flavourtext:Talisman1_2.Text.zh:
"早在我們學會符文之前，我們就對初始者
抱持著信任。早在我們被指引城市
與道路的運作方式之前，便是如此。"

en: "This land was always harsh and brutal,
ever seeking ways to kill and maim us.
We had to grow and change to survive,
but each clan had its own ideas how..."
flavourtext:Talisman1_3.Text.zh:
"這片土地向來嚴酷而殘暴，無時無刻
不在尋找殺戮與殘害我們的機會。為了
生存，我們必須成長與改變，但每個
氏族對於如何改變，都有各自的想法……"

en: "A great rift formed, between clans,
between families. Those that remained
resolved to endure times of struggle,
if it meant we could keep our ways."
flavourtext:Talisman1_4.Text.zh:
"一條巨大的裂痕在氏族之間、在家族
之間形成。那些留下來的人決心忍受
掙扎的歲月，只要這意味著我們能
保留自己的生活方式。"

en: "Those that departed sought the way of
cities and roads. Theirs would be a path
fraught with danger and hardship, as they
set out to find and build a new home."
flavourtext:Talisman1_5.Text.zh:
"而那些離開的人，則去追尋了城市
與道路的道路。當他們出發去尋找
並建立新家園時，他們的旅途
將充滿危險與艱辛。"

en: "When they set out to find and build
Ezomyr, they encountered creatures of
deadly variety and intent. Many died,
for none yet knew how to fight back."
flavourtext:Talisman1_6.Text.zh:
"當他們出發尋找並建立艾茲麥時，
他們遭遇了各式各樣帶有致命意圖
的生物。許多人因此喪生，因為
當時還沒有人知道該如何反擊。"

en: "Lysanda of Myr was but a girl on that exodus.
Ezomyr almost met its end before it began...
but she could not hear that deadly lure. She
took the Siren's head with her bare hands."
flavourtext:Talisman1_7.Text.zh:
"在內遷的旅途中，米爾的萊珊德菈
還只是個女孩。艾茲麥甚至在建立之前
就差點迎來終結……但她對那魅惑的歌聲
置若罔聞。她徒手摘下了海妖的頭顱。"

en: "It turned out, Lysanda made for an excellent
vanguard - a light, evasive girl who could scout
and lead the way. The people came to see her
as their guide, their hope, and then... their leader."
flavourtext:Talisman1_8.Text.zh:
"事實證明，萊珊德菈成了極其優秀的前鋒—
一個身手輕盈、擅長閃躲的女孩，能負責
偵察並在前引路。人們開始將她視為他們的
嚮導、他們的希望，接著……成為他們的領袖。"

en: "Those that swore loyalty to Lysanda, that
forged ahead with her to clear the way.
became known as the first Knights...
armoured, battered, and courageous."
flavourtext:Talisman1_9.Text.zh:
"那些向萊珊德菈效忠、與她一同
前行開路的追隨者，後來被稱為
第一批騎士……他們身披盔甲、
飽受摧殘卻無所畏懼。"

en: "The clans had travelled to their new home
united, and they did love Lysanda, but some
men must go their own way. Those that braved
the inland sea settled the Isles of Skothe."
flavourtext:Talisman2_1.Text.zh:
"各氏族團結一致地遷徙到了他們的新家園，
他們也確實愛戴萊珊德菈，但有些人註定
得走自己的路。那些勇闖內海的人，
最終在斯科提群島定居了下來。"

en: "The journey was over, the land was being
secured, and the foundations for the first city
had been laid. Winter hit them with horrible
fury, sent not by nature, but by a curse."
flavourtext:Talisman2_2.Text.zh:
"旅程已經結束，土地正逐步被掌控，
第一座城市的基石也已奠定。然而，
冬季卻以可怕的狂暴之姿席捲而來—
那並非源自大自然，而是來自一場詛咒。"

en: "Against the Winter Curse, only the forges of
runesmiths could stand. The people huddled,
shoulder to shoulder, while those within were
pressed against the fires, screaming in agony."
flavourtext:Talisman2_3.Text.zh:
"面對凜冬詛咒，唯有符文鐵匠的鍛爐
得以抗衡。人們肩並肩地擠在一起，
而留守在內的人則緊貼著烈火，
在痛苦中痛苦哀號。"

en: "And still the Winter Curse raged in through
every window and every door. The fathers
and mothers of those within let themselves
freeze solid, sealing the gaps with their lives."
flavourtext:Talisman2_4.Text.zh:
"而凜冬詛咒依舊穿透每扇窗戶
與每道門戶瘋狂肆虐。屋內為人
父母者任由自己凍成冰雕，
用他們的生命封死所有的縫隙。"

en: "The night refused to end, and the Winter Curse
howled. The people wailed, and Lysanda raged.
It was then that the sky tore open, unleashing
a saviour fury... at the behest of the Druids."
flavourtext:Talisman2_5.Text.zh:
"黑夜拒絕結束，凜冬詛咒在狂風中咆哮。
人們哀慟哭求，而萊珊德菈盛怒無比。
就在那時，天空被撕裂開來，
在德魯伊的請求下，釋放出了救世主的憤怒。"

en: "The Druids emerged from the forests to greet
and warn the new settlers. This was an ancient
land full of mysteries and dangers. Lysanda sent
her best men to study and learn with them."
flavourtext:Talisman2_6.Text.zh:
"德魯伊從森林中現身，前來迎接並警告
新定居者。這是一片充滿未知謎團與危險
的古老土地。萊珊德菈派出了她最優秀
的人手，前去與他們一同研究並學習。"

en: "As the Ezomytes of Myr prospered, they
needed more and spreading lands. Queen
Lysanda led the ongoing campaign to
slaughter every last creature of darkness."
flavourtext:Talisman2_7.Text.zh:
"隨著米爾的艾茲麥人走向繁榮，
他們需要更多且更廣闊的土地。
萊珊德菈女王領導著持續進行的征討，
誓要屠盡最後一隻黑暗生物。"

en: "Each new valley, each new grove, held new
dangers. Many Knights paid the price. Lysanda
had never been known for her beauty, but she
bore a new scar each season, earned gladly."
flavourtext:Talisman2_8.Text.zh:
"每一個新的山谷、每一片新的樹林，都潛藏著
新的危險。許多騎士為此付出了代價。萊珊德菈
從不以美貌聞名，但她每個季節都會
增添一道新的傷疤，且承受得心甘情願。"

en: "Romance never interested Queen Lysanda,
but her advisors insisted heirs were needed.
To spite them, she took the Hag's only son as
her Consort - a quiet, pale, and strange man."
flavourtext:Talisman3_1.Text.zh:
"萊珊德菈女王對浪漫情愛從未感過興趣，
但她的顧問們堅持需要繼承人。
為了氣他們，她娶了巫婆唯一的兒子
作為她的王夫——一個沉默、蒼白且古怪的男人。"

en: "Queen Lysanda's spiteful choice of Consort
spited only herself. Alasdair was unlike any
man she had ever met. It was not long before
the trumpets sounded for the Royal Wedding."
flavourtext:Talisman3_2.Text.zh:
"萊珊德菈女王出於惡意挑選王夫的決定，
最終只氣到了她自己。阿拉斯代爾與她
見過的任何男人都不同。沒過多久，
宣告皇家婚禮的號角便吹響了。"

en: "The Royal Wedding of Lysanda of Myr
lasted for a full month. The hunts were
vigorous, and the meat and drink flowed
freely for all. There was much rejoicing."
flavourtext:Talisman3_3.Text.zh:
"米爾的萊珊德菈的皇家婚禮足足持續
了一整個月。狩獵活動熱烈地進行著，
肉品與美酒對所有人無限供應。
到處都充滿了歡慶的氣氛。"

en: "But there were some who could not forget
the horrors of the Winter Curse, and of the
Hag that had sent it. Alasdair dropped his
wine goblet, and fell to the ground, choking."
flavourtext:Talisman3_4.Text.zh:
"但有些人依舊無法忘記凜冬詛咒
的恐怖，以及降下這場詛咒
的巫婆。阿拉斯代爾掉下了他的
酒杯，倒在地上，痛苦地窒息著。"

en: "There followed a time of fear and fire.
None would speak against their fellows.
None would say who had poisoned him.
Lysanda's justice was swift and brutal."
flavourtext:Talisman3_5.Text.zh:
"隨之而來的是一段充斥著恐懼
與烈火的時期。沒有人願意指控
自己的同胞，也沒有人願意說出
是誰毒殺了他。萊珊德菈的審判迅速且殘暴。"

en: "In the years that followed, Queen Lysanda
poured herself into the long and brutal task
of securing the lands of the Ezomytes of Myr.
Every fell beast, every creature, had to die."
flavourtext:Talisman3_6.Text.zh:
"在隨後的幾年裡，萊珊德菈女王全心
投入於鞏固米爾艾茲麥人領土
這項漫長且殘酷的任務中。
每隻凶猛的巨獸、每種生物，都必須死。"

en: "The Blue Knight stood against the swarm,
icy and unassailable. His identity was not
known, and he never removed his helmet.
Glimpses were caught of piercing blue eyes."
flavourtext:Talisman3_7.Text.zh:
"藍色騎士隻身對抗著巢群，冰冷
且堅不可摧。他的身分無人知曉，
也從不摘下頭盔。人們偶爾只能
隱約看見那雙銳利的藍色眼睛。"

en: The wolf greeted the king,
In the light of the harvest moon.
The wolf offered the strength of the wild,
And the king paid for it in blood.
flavourtext:Talisman4.Text.zh:
狼在滿月的月光下
像王表示了敬意
狼獻出了野性的力量
而王獻出了他的血

en: "With the Winter Curse held at bay, Lysanda
and her Knights pursued the fell power that
had sent it... a Hag who made her lair in a
Tower that was ancient beyond ancient."
flavourtext:Talisman5_1.Text.zh:
"隨著凜冬詛咒被成功遏制，萊珊德菈
和她的騎士們開始追獵降下這股
邪惡力量的源頭……那是一名將
巢穴築在極其古老之塔中的巫婆。"

en: "Ezomyr grew on a foundation of
choice. Its climate was chosen. Its
animals were chosen. For once,
Wraeclast was not harsh, but kind."
flavourtext:Talisman5_10.Text.zh:
"艾茲麥建立在"選擇"的基石之上。
它的氣候是經過選擇的，它的動物
也是經過選擇的。瓦爾克拉斯
破天荒地不再嚴酷，而是展現出溫柔的一面。"

en: "The sea calmed, and contact was
renewed with the Isles of Skothe.
It was said that Craiceann had
given a blessing to the people."
flavourtext:Talisman5_11.Text.zh:
"大海恢復了平靜，與斯科提群島
的聯繫也得以重啟。
據說，奎爾珊向人民賜予了祝福。"

en: "The Spiders that had been driven
back by the Blue Knight now sought
peace and cooperation. It was said
that Fenumus had commanded it."
flavourtext:Talisman5_12.Text.zh:
"那些曾被藍色騎士擊退的蜘蛛，
如今開始尋求和平與合作。
據說，這是菲恩絲所下達的旨意。"

en: "The skies were clear and blue, yet
brought rains when needed. It was
said that the people had proven
themselves to Saqawal and his flocks."
flavourtext:Talisman5_13.Text.zh:
"天空晴朗蔚藍，卻能在需要時
降下甘霖。據說，人民已經向
斯卡沃及其羽族證明了自己。"

en: "Forty-six years into her reign, Lysanda
slew the last deadly creature. She smiled,
took a wineskin, and rode off into the forest.
One last hunt, it was said. Farrul would stalk
by her side, in this life... and the next."
flavourtext:Talisman5_14.Text.zh:
"在統治的第四十六年，萊珊德菈擊殺了
最後一隻致命生物。她微微一笑，帶上
一皮囊的酒，騎馬奔向森林深處。
據說，那是最後一次狩獵。費爾羅將
在她身旁隨行，不論在今生……還是來世。"

en: "There are some stories that may never
be known, never be heard. But to history,
I say, let it be known the the Ezomytes
of Myr persevered... and built a home."
flavourtext:Talisman5_15.Text.zh:
"有些故事或許永遠不會為人所知、
永遠不會被聽聞。但對於歷史，
我說，讓世人知道米爾的艾茲麥人
堅持了下來……並建立了一個家園。"

en: "They bound the Hag of the Winter Curse
and set her alight, to no avail. Her cackle
was gleeful and wicked. Even if they slew
her, she boasted, she had many daughters..."
flavourtext:Talisman5_2.Text.zh:
"他們捆綁了降下凜冬詛咒的巫婆
並將她點燃，卻無濟於事。她的笑聲
充滿了幸災樂禍與邪惡。她狂妄地宣稱，
即便他們殺了她，她還有無數個女兒……"

en: "Lysanda roared, and hacked the Hag apart
limb by limb, not stopping until the deed
was done. Her daughters, however, were
spared... and tasked with service and duty."
flavourtext:Talisman5_3.Text.zh:
"萊珊德菈怒吼著，將巫婆斬首並將其
肢解，直到大功告成才停下手來。
然而，巫婆的女兒們卻得以倖免……
並被賦予了服侍與盡忠的職責。"

en: "With the Hag's daughters easing the climate,
an age of plenty and bounty began. Lysanda
revived the Phaaryl tradition of the hunt,
so the people never forgot their roots."
flavourtext:Talisman5_4.Text.zh:
"隨著巫婆的女兒們讓氣候變得溫和，
一個富足與豐收的時代拉開了序幕。
萊桑達復興了法瑞爾的狩獵傳統，
好讓人民永遠不忘自己的根。"

en: "The first city was completed, and others sprouted.
The clans came together to declare Lysanda of Myr
the Queen. Henceforth, they became known as the
Ezomytes of Myr, and their numbers swelled."
flavourtext:Talisman5_5.Text.zh:
"第一座城市完工了，其他城市也如雨後春筍
般湧現。各氏族聚集在一起，宣布
米爾的萊珊德菈為女王。從此以後，
他們被稱為米爾的艾茲麥人，人口也隨之暴增。"

en: "There began an eternal summer, as the
daughters of the Hag perfected their mastery
of the Tower. The forests became as gardens.
The hungry had only to pick a fruit and eat."
flavourtext:Talisman5_6.Text.zh:
"一場永恆的夏天就此展開，因為巫婆
的女兒們完美地掌握了那座古塔
的控制權。森林變得如同花園一般。
飢餓的人只需摘下果實便能享用。"

en: "Twenty-two years into Lysanda's reign, the
Spiders swarmed from out of the dark. Her
Knights were ill-equipped for this foe, and
the people fled in droves, seeking safety."
flavourtext:Talisman5_7.Text.zh:
"在萊珊德菈統治的第二十二年，
蜘蛛從黑暗中成群湧出。她的騎士
們對這種敵人缺乏應對手段，
人民紛紛成群逃竄，尋求避難所。"

en: "As deadly and dangerous creatures were
culled, the Queen chose to leave those
that were docile or beauteous. Tide pools
became known as places of wonder."
flavourtext:Talisman5_8.Text.zh:
"隨著致命且危險的生物被捕殺殆盡，
女王選擇留下那些溫馴或美麗的物種。
潮間帶也因此成為了令人驚嘆的奇景勝地。"

en: "Decades into Lysanda's reign, the
lands of the Ezomytes of Myr slowly
became known as Ezo De Myr, and
then simply Ezomyr. And so it was."
flavourtext:Talisman5_9.Text.zh:
"在萊珊德菈統治數十年後，米爾艾茲麥人
的土地漸漸被稱為埃茲．德．米爾，
接著便簡稱為艾茲麥。事情就此定調。"

en: From the heart of the Tangle, the Eater of Worlds
reaches out for control of the Atlas.
flavourtext:TangleBossKeyFlavourText.Tex.zh:
吞噬天地從纏結的中心
伸出手來控制輿圖。

en: The Infinite Hunger awaits in a cosmic stomach where
whole civilisations are digested - but do not die.
flavourtext:TangleKeyFlavourText.Text.zh:
無限飢餓在消化整個文明的
浩瀚宇宙中等待著—但不要死。

en: "When one stares into the depth of the flavour text
file, one will gain no knowledge, only an addiction
to speculation." - Maligaro, Grand Trolllord
flavourtext:TestUniqueRing1.Text.zh:
「望向奇聞軼事的核心，
你會尋覓那智慧的拓印，
那樂趣總是讓人上癮。」 - 魔主馬雷葛蘿

en: "Some see our mortal flesh as a limitation. I see it as an opportunity for vast, miraculous improvements."
- Shavronne of Umbra
flavourtext:TheAesthete.Text.zh: "一般人只把人的肉體視為障礙和界限。我則認為它是朝向偉大進化的機會。" - 烏姆布拉的薛朗

en: <size:28>{I gave my mind without a fight,
The twelfth hour I lost control.
The day is gone but there is light,
eyes that glow like red-hot coal.}
flavourtext:TheArmyOfBlood.Text.zh:
<size:28> {我沒有掙扎的就放棄了我的想法，
我失去控制十二小時。
一天就這樣過去但仍有光線，
那些發出像熾熱煤的眼睛。}

en: Justice comes swift
Equal to the crime
Revenge is a gift
Life for a life
Eye for an eye
flavourtext:TheAvenger.Text.zh:
正義迅得伸張
新罪接踵而至
復仇雪恨，如獲至寶
以命償命，以眼還眼

en: <size:31>{"When Voll spared Malachai, accepting his aid in pursuit of Purity, the strongest faith was infected by Corruption and made brittle as glass."
- Victario, the People's Poet}
flavourtext:TheBrittleEmperor.Text.zh: <size:31>{「當福爾饒恕瑪拉凱，讓他協助進行『淨化』，最堅定的信念便已遭受腐化，變得如玻璃般易碎。」- 人民詩人維多}

en: From death, life.
From life, death.
The wheel turns,
and the corbies wheel overhead.
flavourtext:TheCarrionCrow.Text.zh:
從生到死。
由死至生。
輪軸轉動，
烏鴉盤旋。

en: <size:31>{My son, you lost your way before you arrived.
To never lose you again,
I make a path in my heart.}
flavourtext:TheCartographer.Text.zh: <size:31>{找路的要訣就是將你所經之路畫成地圖。}

en: The First Ones
may be blasphemy,
but they are
powerful blasphemy.
flavourtext:TheCursedKing.Text.zh:
初代們
或許是種褻瀆，
但他們是
強大的褻瀆。

en: With staff in hand
and wrath in heart,
your soul and corpse
shall surely part.
flavourtext:TheDarkMage.Text.zh:
法杖在手
怒火在心，
靈魂身軀
分離注定。

en: <size:28>{Scaly beast of the skies,
watching with his golden eyes.
Shadow that blocks out the sun,
it's too late for you to run.}
flavourtext:TheDragon.Text.zh:
<size:28>{天空中佈滿鱗片的野獸
用它金黃的雙眼靜觀四方
當你進入它影子的範圍裡
那就一切都太遲了。}

en: <size:29>{A dark note drips
from the dreamer's lips,
A honeyed melody.
We stand, we fall
on his beck and call,
for in his dream we're free.}
flavourtext:TheDreamer.Text.zh:
<size:29> {黑暗的筆記
從夢者的嘴唇滴下，
甜蜜的旋律。
我們站立，我們跌倒
他的召喚和呼喚中，
在他的夢中我們是自由的。}

en: <size:28>{Crimson rubies, drops of vigour,
flowing through my veins,
flesh like coal, try to crush me,
diamond is what remains.}
flavourtext:TheEndurance.Text.zh:
<size:28>{艷紅珠寶，有如血氣，
暢流於吾脈，
身體有如媒礦，嘗試碾碎我，
殘留的便是堅鑽}

en: Weaving the six,
a serpent stands tall.
Wearing a crown,
the thousand petals call.
flavourtext:TheEnlightended.Text.zh:
蜿蜒詭譎，
毒蛇直立待發；
頭戴冠冕，
花瓣成千綻放。

en: <size:30>{"Long ago, people looked to the stars, believing they influenced us. Soon, it will be us who influence the stars."
- Doryani, Queen's Thaumaturge}
flavourtext:TheEthereal.Text.zh:
<size:30>{"很久以前，人們仰望群星，相信著它們正影響著我們。很快的，我們將會成為影響群星的人們。"
- 多里亞尼，女王的奇術師}

en: Some powers are far too great even for the
gods of old.
flavourtext:TheEyeOfTheDragon.Text.zh: 某些力量的存在，即使對於古老神祉來說也過於強大。

en: <size:31>{Your era is now,
your power unwavered,
soon we will see
who the gods truly favoured.}
flavourtext:TheFiend.Text.zh:
<size:31>{現今你稱霸為王，
你的力量絲毫未減，
但我們即將見識到，
誰才是眾神所眷顧之人。}

en: Sturdy and strong,
grown from the stream.
The Flora that live here,
A combatant's dream.
flavourtext:TheFlorasGift.Text.zh:
強壯勇猛，
順流而來，
此地之卉，
吾士之志。

en: Formless might,
Wild beauty tamed,
The brine of gods,
The seas restrained.
flavourtext:TheFormlessSea.Text.zh:
無形的力量，
馴服狂野之美，
神祇的海水，
拘束八方海域。

en: "Masters of wit, strength and cunning. To survive the harsh winters, you must be like the fox."
- Ezomyte Proverb
flavourtext:TheFox.Text.zh:
"要在寒冷的冬天求生，你必須有像狐狸般的智慧、狡猾以及力量。"
- 艾茲麥族方言

en: The thumb turns down
and the crowd roars,
they want death
and the blood is yours.
flavourtext:TheGladiator.Text.zh:
當那拇指朝下
觀眾狂吼轟然，
全場渴切殺戮。
唯你流血受難。

en: <size:30>{Taste not of their
forbidden fruit.
Theirs is a harvest of
the darkest kind,
twisted, rotten and
damned for eternity.}
flavourtext:TheHarvester.Text.zh:
<size:30>{不要嘗試
禁忌果實。
他們正收割著
黑暗的一族，
扭曲，腐敗以及
受到永恆之詛咒。}

en: "How many lives have you consumed?"
"How many times have you blinked?"
flavourtext:TheHunger.Text.zh:
「你奪走多少生命？」
「你已眨眼了幾回？」

en: <size:30>{"Greetings! Just because you think I'm greedy doesn't mean I'm not willing to share. You'll just have to kill me first."
-Grandmaster Dy'Ness}
flavourtext:TheImmortal.Text.zh:
<size:30>{"你好！你以為我是個貪婪的人不代表我就不願意分享。你只要先把我殺了就可以了。"
 - 元帥．死王}

en: Jump right in,
But beware
Of things broken
Or beyond compare.
flavourtext:TheInventor.Text.zh:
立刻投身創造吧
但請務必留意
毀壞破損之物
無與倫比之物。

en: <size:19>{Fourfold the refrain, fortissimo cheer.
One hundred rent twain, naught left for a bier.
The song rattles on, though hollow a bit.
See the hope is gone, no prize shall ye get.}
flavourtext:TheIronBard.Text.zh:
<size:19>{四部副歌，最高音呼聲嘹亮。
百分之百分裂，無遺體之物。
歌聲繼續，雖然有點虛無。
希望已經消失，你將得不到任何獎賞。}

en: <size:25>{Summoned for the King's desire,
soon applause came from the court.
However insanity was his only sire,
so the King's reign was cut short.}
flavourtext:TheJester.Text.zh:
<size:25>{因王的旨意而被召喚
宮殿中掌聲響起；
然而，瘋狂才是他們真正的王，
王的皇冠已易主。}

en: <size:25>{"To know for what you fight. To get up again when you've been struck down. To outmanoeuvre someone faster, trick someone smarter, crush someone stronger. That's what it takes to claim the crown."
- Daresso, the King of Swords}
flavourtext:TheKingsBlade.Text.zh: <size:25>{「要瞭解自己為何而戰，要屢敗屢戰，智取更為迅捷之人，騙過更為聰慧之人，擊潰更強大之人。欲得皇冠，便須如此。」- 鬥劍之王德瑞索}

en: <size:27>{Thy knee shall bend
in shifting dark,
thy blade shall serve his vigil.
Thy oath shall bind thee
to his mark,
thy flesh shall bear his sigil.}
flavourtext:TheLordInBlack.Text.zh:
<size:27>{你的膝為了在黑暗中迅敏的移動而彎曲，
你的刃為了你而守衛。
你的誓言將連結你和他的印記，
你的身軀將註記著他的的魔符。}

en: Embrace the Light,
Await the Morrow,
No more Spite,
And no more Sorrow.
flavourtext:TheLunarisPriestess.Text.zh:
擁抱光明，
等待明日，
不再怨恨，
並不再悲傷。

en: A ruler is only as powerful as he is wealthy.
Control the coin, control the empire.
flavourtext:TheMayor.Text.zh:
一個統治者只有他有錢才有力量。
控制財富，控制帝國。

en: <size:26>{Embrace death to honour the lost,
no fear in life no matter the cost.
With one of all we are,
and all of one we trust,
throughout past, present and future... be just.}
flavourtext:TheOneWithAll.Text.zh:
<size:26>{接受死亡，紀念逝者
生無畏懼，不計代價。
我們各為個體，
我們全都相信， 
過往、現今與未來...正義得以伸張。}

en: <size:27>{God had forsaken the land
And Victario wept.
Corruption consumed the land
And Victario's tears turned to blood.}
flavourtext:ThePoet.Text.zh:
<size:27>{神已遺棄此地
維多淌淚哀泣
腐敗吞噬大地
維多縱已淚竭，仍泣血不止。}

en: To protect her mansion, she would cut a deal with anyone. Anything.
Something answered.
flavourtext:ThePriceOfProtection.Text.zh:
為了保護她的豪宅，她會與任何人達成協議。任何事情。

有解答了。

en: The power of the world,
lies upon your hands.
