"Experiment 22A: Rhoas, when deprived of water, secrete a most delightfully potent toxin."
- Maligaro
flavourtext:TheRabidRhoa.Text.zh:
"實驗 22A：抽乾水分的恐喙鳥會釋出一種絕妙的毒素"
- 馬雷葛蘿

en: <size:29>{A mind as quick as lightning,
fists as hard as stone,
a heart that burns with fury,
and eyes that chill to the bone.}
flavourtext:TheRiteOfElements.Text.zh:
<size:29>{思考像閃電一樣迅速，
拳頭像石頭一樣堅硬，
心臟憤怒的燃燒著，
眼神寒冰刺骨。}

en: In combat, a warrior must first be resourceful,
and second, decisive.
flavourtext:TheRuthlessCeinture.Text.zh: 在戰鬥中，勇士們必須足智多謀，手起刀落。

en: <size:29>{Three men travel
through the gate;
they carry a protective ward.
A faction conspires
against their fate,
but magic unravels the sword.}
flavourtext:TheSigil.Text.zh:
<size:29>{三人成行
穿越拱門
攜手守護
支派陰謀
命運相斥
揭示之劍}

en: <size:26>{At the beck and call
of The Siren's hand,
winter ravages
the trembling land,
and the weight of ice that binds
will break the strongest of minds.}
flavourtext:TheSiren.Text.zh:
<size:26>{唯命是從，
海妖之手，
寒冬肆虐，
大地撼動，
積冰沉重，
能摧毀最堅強的意志。}

en: If you beckon the
Lord of Lightning,
do not be surprised
when you are struck.
flavourtext:TheStormcaller.Text.zh:
若你召喚了
雷霆之神，
當你被雷劈時
也別覺得驚訝。

en: "He might be lacking in vision, but his virtuosity is undeniable."
- Malachai, on Maligaro
flavourtext:TheSurgeon.Text.zh:
"他或許缺乏遠見，但他的眼光確實卓越。"
- 瑪拉凱對馬雷葛蘿評語。

en: A lucky number
For us all
To help us through
The perils told.
flavourtext:TheSurvivalist.Text.zh:
一個幸運數字
從天而降
帶領我們 
突破險境

en: <size:26>{Many were slain by the sword king
Their blood decorating his ring
Those who retreated were slaughtered
Those who fought bravely were honoured}
flavourtext:TheSwordKingsSalute.Text.zh:
<size:26> {許多人被劍王殺死
他們的血液裝飾他的戒指
那些退後的人被屠殺了
那些勇敢地奮鬥的人被受敬重}

en: <size:31>{"Mastery of thaumaturgy is like any other pursuit; it requires dedication and sacrifice. Sometimes several sacrifices."
- Shavronne of Umbra}
flavourtext:TheThaumaturgist.Text.zh: <size:31>{"奇術就像世上其他的技藝一樣。它必須透過犧牲才能有所專精，有時候甚至是無以計數的犧牲。" - 烏姆布拉的薛朗}

en: <size:31>{Sometimes an apprentice becomes a master through countless hours of hard work and practice.
Sometimes it happens by force.}
flavourtext:TheTraitor.Text.zh:
<size:31>{有時候見習者透過不斷的努力而成為大師。
有時候是透過強大的力量。}

en: Two sides of a coin;
Heads for a friend,
tails a foe;
Gemini toss up
flavourtext:TheTwins.Text.zh:
雙面銅板；
人頭為友，
反之為敵；
雙子之擲

en: "Fear controls the masses."
- Laszlo, the Scourge
flavourtext:TheTyrant.Text.zh:
"恐懼支配眾人"
- 拉茲羅, 災禍之源

en: <size:29>{"Fate was always my nemesis...
But it didn't stop me then, and it won't stop me now."
- Kjetilbrann, The Undaunted}
flavourtext:TheUndaunted.Text.zh:
<size:29> {“命運總是我的剋星...
但它那時並沒有阻止我，現在也不會阻止我。“
- 無畏的傑特布蘭恩}

en: On the 21st of Eterni,
two become one,
their light outshines
the setting sun.
flavourtext:TheUnion.Text.zh:
恆曆二十一日，
兩人合而為一， 
屋中燈光明耀，
更勝落日餘暉。

en: <size:26>{The villain strikes,
the world is torn.
A war begins, a hero is born,
The nemesis sets the sky alight.
A hero's sacrifice
sets everything right.
- Drake's Epitaph}
flavourtext:TheValkyrie.Text.zh:
<size:26>{邪惡侵襲，撕毀了大地。
戰爭四起，造就了英雄，
復仇之火點燃夜空。
英勇奉獻將永熄業火。
- 德雷克之墓}

en: "The most valuable treasures should be hidden in plain sight."
- Ina, Keeper of Goods
flavourtext:TheValleyOfSteelBoxes.Text.zh:
"視若無睹的地點，暱藏寶藏的最佳選擇。"
- 寶物管理員殷娜

en: <size:30>{Can you hear the siren's calls,
Just beyond the sea?
A voice which hearts
of men enthralls,
I too am hooked to thee.}
flavourtext:TheVast.Text.zh:
<size:31>{你是否聽見了那迷人的呼喚
就在那大海的彼端
一個深入人心
擄獲所有男人的魅曲
而我，也已經深深陷入。}

en: To cure the Goddess,
and break the chains of corruption,
you must shatter the world.
flavourtext:TheWarlord.Text.zh:
" 要治癒女神，
斷開腐敗的連結，
你必須擊碎世界。"

en: <size:31>{Strange eyes on top of spines
Gaze beyond the veil of time
Deep down below the mines
A dream of crimson and of grime}
flavourtext:TheWatcher.Text.zh:
<size:31>{冠刺頂端的詭異眼球
看穿時空迷濛
礦場的地底深處尚有
緋紅的塵封之夢}

en: <size:30>{A weapon, a shelter, a prison.
The web's purpose changes
with the spider's needs.
A lesson we should
take to heart.}
flavourtext:TheWeb.Text.zh:
<size:30>{武器，避難所，監獄。
蛛網的用途不斷改變
因應著蜘蛛的需要。
一堂課題
需要我們用心學習。}

en: <size:27>{A wanderer in the wild strives
Against countless foes he survives
A fool pursues a quest contrived
By the gift of the witch, alive.}
flavourtext:TheWitch.Text.zh:
<size:27> {流浪者在野外努力奮鬥
對抗無數的敵人，他倖存下來
一個傻瓜追求一個任務
由女巫的禮物，活著。}

en: "Don't worry, I know what I'm doing."
- Toggo's Last Words
flavourtext:TreasureHunter.Text.zh:
"別擔心，我知道我在做什麼"
- 特格的遺言

en: They took pride in all that they built, considering each new
temple a testament to the gods... and then, to themselves.
flavourtext:TrialMasterFragment1.Text.zh:
你離開時流血而精疲力竭，但勝利了。
你已經戰勝了。

en: Delving into the mysteries of existence, they deciphered
the secret laws of nature... and then, harnessed them.
flavourtext:TrialMasterFragment2.Text.zh:
你破碎的身體被遺忘了，
只滋養著蟲群。

en: Not content to live in harmony with the world, they strove
to understand it, to improve it... and then, to master it.
flavourtext:TrialMasterFragment3.Text.zh:
凡人終其一生都在想，哪一種命運
將屬於他們。混沌樂於
知道答案：所有人。

en: They collaborated with each other and with nearby peoples,
at first sharing, teaching... and then, dominating.
flavourtext:TrialMasterFragment4.Text.zh:
你踉踉蹌蹌地走開，為你的失敗感到尷尬。
你唯一的安慰獎就是你的生命。

en: "Only after one forsakes rage, can true power be found."
- Sekhema Asenath
flavourtext:TurnTheOtherCheek.Text.zh:
"唯有遺忘憤怒，方能獲得力量。＂
- 絲克瑪．安賽娜絲

en: The cold light of today can never compete
with the shining golden aura of yesteryear.
flavourtext:UberBenevolenceVaultKey.Text.zh: 「今日的冷光，永遠無法與昔日的金輝比擬。」

en: When memories become twisted by a corrupted mind,
history is rewritten, time after time.
flavourtext:UberBossKeyCortex.Text.zh:
當記憶被汙染的心靈扭曲時，
歷史就會一次又一次地改寫。

en: At the core of the mass, a fierce hunger seethes,
as the Tangle's champion devours a myriad of worlds...
flavourtext:UberBossKeyEater.Text.zh:
在群眾的核心，強烈的飢餓燃燒著，
當纏亂的冠軍吞噬了無數的世界……

en: Constellations are systematically incinerated
in the wake of an ever-expanding archive of minds.
flavourtext:UberBossKeyExarch_.Text.zh:
隨著思想檔案的不斷擴大，
星座被焚毀。

en: A single act of love and defiance
may cascade destruction across the cosmos.
flavourtext:UberBossKeyShaper.Text.zh:
愛與反抗的單一行為
可能會在整個宇宙中造成毀滅性的破壞。

en: Agony born of ennui.
Hate born of love.
flavourtext:UberBossKeySirus.Text.zh:
厭倦產生的痛苦。
恨生於愛。

en: A void where only terror and emptiness exists;
those who attempt to struggle only hasten the assimilation
flavourtext:UberBossKeyUberElder.Text.zh:
一片虛無，僅有恐懼與空虛；
試圖掙扎之人只會加速同化

en: That which could not be digested
remains lost within, the buried remnants
of whole cultures, of entire worlds.
flavourtext:UberEaterOfWorldsKey.Text.zh:
無法消化的東西遺失在其中，
整個文化、整個世界
的埋藏遺跡。

en: Surrounded by comfort and kindness
all we see are the enemies of the past.
flavourtext:UberIgnoranceVaultKey.Text.zh:
「縱使被溫柔與安逸所包圍，
 我們眼中仍只看見昔日的敵人。」

en: Champions of her collection may take what
they wish, so long as they use it to entertain her...
flavourtext:UberMavenKey.Text.zh:
她收藏的冠軍可以拿走他們想要的，
只要他們用它來娛樂她…

en: Time sweeps us further and further away
from the moments in which they lived.
flavourtext:UberNeglectVaultKey.Text.zh:
「時光將我們不斷推離，
 遠離那些他們曾活過的瞬間。」

en: Minds are not the only thing
the Cleansing Fire keeps eternal...
flavourtext:UberSearingExarchKey.Text.zh:
心靈並不是淨化之火
保持永恆的唯一東西…

en: Step into the inner sanctum of the minds of old
Enter a realm untouched even by starlight
Through transcendence, bend reality to your will.
flavourtext:UberShaperKey.Text.zh:
走進古人心靈的內心聖殿
即使進入星光未能觸及的領域
通過超越，讓現實屈服於你的意志。

en: There is a place, a state of being,
where all that you love forgets you.
flavourtext:UberSirusKey.Text.zh:
有一個地方，一種存在狀態，
你所愛的一切都會忘記你。

en: I have already lost more
than you shall ever possess.
flavourtext:UberVenariusKey.Text.zh:
我失去的
比你擁有的還要多。

en: Though flesh may decay, and bones turn to dust, the spirit fades not.
Floundering eternal in pools of tranquil dark.
flavourtext:Unique340Reliquary.Text.zh:
雖然肉體可能腐爛，骨頭變成灰塵，但精神卻沒有消失。
在寧靜的黑暗中掙扎著永恆。

en: You are slow, foolish and ignorant.
I am not.
flavourtext:UniqueAmulet1.Text.zh:
眾人遲鈍昏庸，愚昧無知。
唯我迅捷聰穎，博學睿智。

en: The world is but a piece of parchment, blank and symmetric.
We label each side: one Good, one Evil; one Black, one White.
The divine truth, however, is that both are one and the same.
-Jaetai, Vaal Advisor
flavourtext:UniqueAmulet10.Text.zh:
世界宛若張羊皮紙。
空白對稱，毫無參差；
標記左善右惡，上黑下白，
惟神聖真理亦善亦惡，亦黑亦白。
-雅台，瓦爾參謀

en: "A rare unequivocal success, Prototype #11 causes wounds to heal so quickly
the type Delta test subject actually survived the entire testing regimen."
flavourtext:UniqueAmulet10x.Text.zh:
"難得明顯的成功了，原型 #11 導致傷口癒合得如此之快
δ 類型的測試對象，實際上在整個測試方案中都存活了下來。"

en: "Marylene stroked the medallion at her breast
before every duel and every cast of the die."
- Victario, the People's Poet
flavourtext:UniqueAmulet17.Text.zh:
「瑪莉琳總是在決鬥前
總是輕撫胸前的榮耀輝記，呼喚奇蹟顯現。」 
- 人民詩人維多里奧

en: The maidens of court swoon to see
the challengers crushed at your feet.
flavourtext:UniqueAmulet2.Text.zh:
殺敵致勝歷百戰，
常得佳人帶笑看

en: As you have lived, so you shall die
forever trying to keep up with me.
Your blood on these hands of mine
forever makes me the public enemy.
flavourtext:UniqueAmulet20.Text.zh:
你曾活著，但必須死；
唯有如此才能夠趕上我的步伐。
我的雙手，染滿吾血；
即使化為眾人之敵也甘之如飴。

en: A shimmering symbol of Purity, clear as water,
but I know better than most how quickly
Purity can succumb to Corruption.
How quickly water turns to blood.
- Victario, the People's Poet
flavourtext:UniqueAmulet22.Text.zh:
此為純淨象徵，清澈若水
但我比誰都還清楚明白
轉瞬之間，純淨成腐敗
須臾之時，清溪成血河
- 人民詩人維多里奧

en: In my dream, a voice spoke to me. It said:
'My reach knows no bounds.
All that is pure is destined to rot.
All that lives is destined to serve.'
- Doryani, Queen's Thaumaturgist
flavourtext:UniqueAmulet23.Text.zh:
迷夢之際，耳語響起
「吾土無邊，吾國無際
純淨之物註定朽腐
天下蒼生終為我奴」
- 女王的奇術師多里亞尼

en: Shackled fires dance about;
Might within from force without.
flavourtext:UniqueAmulet24.Text.zh:
圍攻的火焰群聚
團結之力為外力而生

en: Combat is simple.
Keep your blood in.
Take theirs out.
flavourtext:UniqueAmulet25.Text.zh:
其實戰鬥相當單純
守護好自己的鮮血
奪取他人的鮮血，如此而已。

en: When slaughtered flesh falls silent,
the soul may yet scream on.
flavourtext:UniqueAmulet26.Text.zh:
當被殘殺的肉體墜入寂靜
靈魂可能尚在尖叫

en: "I offer to you an eternal oath
that binds your heart to mine;
a bond that not even death will break.
Will you accept?"
- Daresso, to his beloved
flavourtext:UniqueAmulet27.Text.zh:
"讓我為妳獻上一份永恆的誓言
將妳的心與我的心緊緊相依；
這份死亡都無法抹滅的牽連
妳是否會與我相守相憐？"
- 德瑞索，致愛人

en: Those who dwell in the deep freeze
enjoy a special kind of madness.
flavourtext:UniqueAmulet28.Text.zh:
那些藏匿在寒冰深處的人們
享受著一份特殊的瘋狂

en: Those who dwell in the deep freeze
enjoy a special kind of madness.
flavourtext:UniqueAmulet29.Text.zh:
那些居住冰冷深處的人
享受著一份獨特的瘋狂

en: "Researcher Graven spent eleven hours suffering electrocution in the lab
before he was found. Prototype #14 somehow kept him from dying."
flavourtext:UniqueAmulet29x.Text.zh:
"研究員格雷文在被發現前在實驗室
承受電擊長達 11 小時。原型 #14 不之怎麼不想讓他死。"

en: "I touched #2993, and I saw... how blind we've been. The visions
weren't the future. They were the past! Our 'unforeseen
consequences' have already been happening!"
- Researcher Graven
flavourtext:UniqueAmulet31x.Text.zh:
我觸碰 #2993，然後我看到…我們有多盲目。這些畫面
並不是未來。它們是過去！
我們的『意外後果』已經在發生！
- 研究員格雷文

en: Each death witnessed is a valuable lesson,
and what use is knowledge if it is not put into practice?
flavourtext:UniqueAmulet33.Text.zh:
每個死亡皆見證了一個寶貴的課堂，
知識若不使用便如同烏有。

en: "...and so He said: 'Let only the good meet my gaze'
and no eye met His. So He called down the cleansing flames
and let black smoke sweep the Sinners away."
- Book of Innocence
flavourtext:UniqueAmulet35.Text.zh:
"「純潔之人迎接我的目光」他說道...卻絲毫感受不到視線。
他便喚下淨化之火，一陣黑煙席捲並帶走了罪人。"
- 純淨之書

en: Friendship worth its weight in gold,
a treasure every day.
I thought together we'd grow old,
until fate pulled you away.
flavourtext:UniqueAmulet36.Text.zh:
友情似金，
珍藏每日。
欲白頭偕老，
嘆命運無情。

en: His is our heart.
To its beat we all are driven.
flavourtext:UniqueAmulet37.Text.zh:
他的心跳，使我們受到驅策。

<default>{此物品能夠透過索伏的祝福改造}

en: We are his blood.
Through us he carries his burning message.
flavourtext:UniqueAmulet38.Text.zh:
我們是他的血肉。
透過我們，他散播炙熱的啟示。

en: We wait, still as the dead,
to join the great avalanche.
It is said to make you invisible when the Great
Spirit comes to take you on your final journey.
flavourtext:UniqueAmulet4.Text.zh:
傳說亡靈使者攝魂之際，
配此護符使你隱身欺敵。

en: A single moment sets in motion an eternal fall,
beneath which all are buried.
flavourtext:UniqueAmulet40.Text.zh:
剎那便能造就無盡毀壞，
一切將受掩埋。

en: When she of many mouths spoke,
we bowed in awe and were crushed.
flavourtext:UniqueAmulet41.Text.zh:
逢伊開口，
眾人躬敬，
慘遭毀滅。

<default>{此物品能夠透過艾許的祝福改造}

en: But the fool did not bow.
The fool stood and questioned.
And the fool was unwritten.
flavourtext:UniqueAmulet42.Text.zh:
愚人未躬不敬，立於疑惑。
始終他立於疑惑。

en: "He does not love. He does not feel regret or remorse.
He does not think about consequences, only possibilities.
If that does not describe a monster, tell me: what does?"
- Archbishop Geofri
flavourtext:UniqueAmulet44.Text.zh:
"他無法愛，感受不到悔恨。
從不思考後果，只看見機會。
如果這不是形容一個怪物，
請告訴我：該怎麼形容？"
-大主教吉爾菲

en: Though its body was locked in stone,
its essence wandered the infinite,
learning, and preparing.
flavourtext:UniqueAmulet45.Text.zh:
雖然它的身體被囚禁在石頭裡，
它的本質仍穿梭於無垠，
不斷學習和準備。

en: There is no darker void than the hollow
ache of love disremembered...
flavourtext:UniqueAmulet45Uber.Text.zh:
沒有比被遺忘的愛情空洞
更黑暗的空虛了…

en: The seed of life, saved and savoured.
<default>{This item can be transformed on the Altar of Sacrifice along with Vial of Sacrifice}
flavourtext:UniqueAmulet48.Text.zh:
生活的種子，保存和品嚐。

<default>{此物品可與獻祭之罈於獻祭之壇上改造}

en: "Shoot first, ask no questions."
- Karui wisdom
flavourtext:UniqueAmulet5.Text.zh:
「無需多問，先發制人。」
- 卡魯的戰爭哲學

en: "Did we make this? Why do we have no record of it?
We were warned that there would be consequences..."
- Administrator Qotra
flavourtext:UniqueAmulet50.Text.zh:
"我們做了這個嗎？為什麼我們沒有任何記錄？
我們被警告過會有後果…"
- 主管卡特拉

en: The leash of the lifegiver
binds in both directions.
flavourtext:UniqueAmulet51.Text.zh:
予生者之鎖鏈
羈絆著兩個方向。

en: It was not his fearlessness or ferocity, nor his tactical genius,
it was his leadership that earned Aul, the Last King, his crown.
flavourtext:UniqueAmulet53.Text.zh:
這不是他的無畏或兇猛，或者他的戰術天才，
正是他的領導力贏得末代的國王漢恩的王冠。

en: Time, like light, can be refracted into all its myriad colours.
The first shade is beautiful, but the last will drive the unwary insane.
flavourtext:UniqueAmulet54.Text.zh:
時間就像光一樣，可以被射成五花八門的顏色。
第一道陰影很美麗，但最後一道卻使人心瘋狂。

en: "The type Delta test subjects could have escaped with the power offered by
Prototype #15, but they suddenly chose to murder each other instead..."
flavourtext:UniqueAmulet55x.Text.zh:
"δ 測試對象的類型本可以通過
原型 #15，但他們突然選擇互相謀殺…"

en: "Hyrri and her arrows broke the sacred code, damning herself.
Kaom seized her sacrifice, and in doing so, seized victory."
- Lavianga, Advisor to Kaom
flavourtext:UniqueAmulet56.Text.zh:
"西里和她的箭矢打破了神聖的暗號，使她被詛咒。
岡姆趁著她犧牲，趁勝追擊，獲得了勝利"
- 岡姆軍師拉維安加

en: "I stood upon the tower's edge, and saw that we had cracked the sky.
There is nowhere we can run that our sins will not find us now."
- Researcher Arn, last recorded words
flavourtext:UniqueAmulet57x.Text.zh:
我站在塔的邊緣，看到我們已經撕裂了天空。
現在我們無處可逃，我們的罪行將找到我們。
- 研究員昂恩，最後的紀錄

en: Burned rhoa's eye and goatman's beard do demand:
Leave behind those lazy bones;
Dance, ye dead, at my command!
flavourtext:UniqueAmulet58.Text.zh:
燒焦的恐喙鳥的眼睛和羊人的鬍子確實需要：
留下那些懶散的骨頭；
你死了，按我的命令跳舞吧！

en: "In testing, Prototype #9 had no effect on fired arrows. However,
an unknown spell did destroy the entire firing chamber."
flavourtext:UniqueAmulet5x.Text.zh:
測試階段時，原型 #9 對燃燒的箭矢沒有效果。但，
一個未知的咒術摧毀了整個燃燒中的教堂。"

en: For how little time they had together,
their love was all the more powerful.
flavourtext:UniqueAmulet64.Text.zh:
他們在一起的時間很少，
他們的愛更加強大。

en: "Remain poised. Remain balanced. Keep all the emotions of a lifetime caged.
Let only your enemies see the truth of your rage."
flavourtext:UniqueAmulet65.Text.zh:
"保持鎮定。保持平衡。保持一生的所有情感。
只讓你的敵人看到你憤怒的真相。"

en: The time is nigh.
War has come.
We dream as one.
flavourtext:UniqueAmulet67.Text.zh:
時間快到了。
戰爭來了。
我們夢想成為一體。

en: That winter, scorched refugees emerged from the shrine,
speaking only in strange tongues. They prayed to a new
symbol of power, not out of love, but out of fear.
flavourtext:UniqueAmulet68.Text.zh:
那個冬天，被燒焦的難民從神社里出來，
只說奇怪的語言。他們向一個新的權力象徵祈禱，
不是出於愛，而是出於恐懼。

en: A single facet contains the wisdom
of countless disintegrated worlds.
flavourtext:UniqueAmulet69.Text.zh:
一個層面，
蘊含著無數瓦解世界的智慧。

en: Maligaro did the cutting... at her request.
In the new void, a malevolent power emerged.
flavourtext:UniqueAmulet72.Text.zh:
馬雷葛蘿做了切割...應她的要求。
新的虛空之中，出現了一股惡毒的力量。

en: Beidat made false promises to many denizens,
converting only one into a conduit through
which Wraeclast might be consumed.
flavourtext:UniqueAmulet73.Text.zh:
貝達特向許多居民作出虛假承諾，
只成功說服了一人成為管道，透過這個管道
瓦爾克拉斯特得以被吞噬。

en: "Atziri ordained that we exploit the weaknesses inherent in our slaves.
With relish, we did exactly as she instructed."
- Guatelitzi, Architect of Flesh
flavourtext:UniqueAmulet74.Text.zh:
"阿茲里命令我們利用奴隸天生的弱點。
我們津津樂道地按照她的指示去做。"
- 血汗建師瓜特利斯

en: The farmer was struck again and again, but he refused to stay down.
Astonished, the raiding warlord ordered the man's family spared.
flavourtext:UniqueAmulet76.Text.zh:
農夫一次又一次地被打倒，但他拒絕倒下。
令人驚訝的是，劫掠的領袖下令不傷害那個人的家人。

en: Geomancy offered a safer way to use the Tears...
but most Maji rejected that temptation as well.
flavourtext:UniqueAmulet77.Text.zh:
占地術提供了一種更安全的方式來使用這些眼淚… 
但大多數魔法師也拒絕了那種誘惑。

en: "You grew up an orphan, and for that, you blame me.
Fair enough. So... why not let me erase that pain from your mind?
Then we can all stand united against the demons at the door..."
flavourtext:UniqueAmulet79.Text.zh:
「你幼時無人依靠，你為此對我深惡痛絕。
情有可原……那麼……何不讓我消弭你內心的痛苦？
如此，我們便能齊心對抗來犯的惡魔……」

en: Mindless rage will shake the world,
Cunning lies will bend it.
Reckless haste will break the world,
And into darkness send it.
flavourtext:UniqueAmulet8.Text.zh:
盲目的憤怒引起紛爭，
狡詐的謊言讓戰火停歇；
無知的莽撞造成仇恨，
而無盡黑暗將吞噬一切。

en: "In a time of great need, the tale-man sacrificed his very
body to bring forth the waters of victory and salvation."
flavourtext:UniqueAmulet81.Text.zh:
"在極度危急的時刻，說書人犧牲了自己的肉身，
召喚出勝利與救贖之水。"

en: We cannot hide from the wounds of youth.
They fuel the fires within, driving us on.
flavourtext:UniqueAmulet83.Text.zh:
我們無法逃避年少時的傷痕。
它們燃起心中的烈火，推動我們不斷前行。

en: Hills of stark and jagged white it walks,
scratching your ribs without, within.
The Fiend has naught but Empty Eyes,
though sees you, it does, indeed.
flavourtext:UniqueAmulet84.Text.zh:
「牠行走於嶙峋蒼白的山丘之上，
 爪刃劃過你的肋骨——內外皆然。
 那魔物空無一物的雙眼，
 卻的確看見了你。」

en: "We fought the Abyssals, too. That's the part they leave out.
Khatal was Faridun... and for saving all their lives, the Maraketh
made him drink the enemy's blood. He melted from the inside out."
- Toryal, of the Afarud
flavourtext:UniqueAmulet85.Text.zh:
"我們也與深淵族戰鬥過。這部分他們從不提起。
卡塔爾是法里登……而為了拯救他們所有人的性命，
馬拉克斯逼他飲下敵人的血。他從內部開始融化。"
- 阿法魯德的托亞爾

en: Betrayal bites cold as a southerly wind,
Thunder heralds the coming storm,
On her day of mutiny, the Rotmother sinned,
A brother burned, a bond forsworn
flavourtext:UniqueAmulet87.Text.zh:
背叛之噬，冷冽如南方吹來的疾風，
怒雷作響，預告著風暴即將來臨。
在她發動叛變的那一天，腐母犯下了罪孽，
兄長慘遭焚燒，誓言與羈絆就此背棄。

en: Forged from the blood of countless wars,
its thirst has only begun.
flavourtext:UniqueAmulet9.Text.zh:
以無數戰事的鮮血鑄成，
對死亡的飢渴油然而生。

en: A glimpse of victory
is all you need to win.
flavourtext:UniqueAmuletVictor1.Text.zh:
捕抓那關鍵一瞥，
是獲勝所需唯一。

en: They say a lifetime of wisdom is carried
in every skin the great beasts shed.
flavourtext:UniqueBelt1.Text.zh:
據說巨獸每次脫皮稅變
都累積畢生智慧，變得更加老練。

en: "A legion of forty soldiers attempted to break into Outpost Five and
steal Prototype #659. What do they know that we do not?"
flavourtext:UniqueBelt10x.Text.zh:
"一大批四十名士兵試圖闖入前哨五號並
偷走原型 #659。他們知道我們不知道什麼？"

en: "I cannot fathom the mysteries of Prototype #16. It did nearly nothing until I
brought it to [RESTRICTED]. It makes no sense!"
- Researcher Graven
flavourtext:UniqueBelt11x.Text.zh:
我無法理解原型 #16 的奧秘。直到我幾乎什麼都沒做
將其帶到[限制閱讀]。這沒有道理！" 
- 研究員格雷文

en: "Our genius will pave the way forward.
May all who are worthy be improved!"
- Inquisitor Maligaro
flavourtext:UniqueBelt12.Text.zh:
「那群天才們會將崎嶇前路鋪平；
願所有值得的人都能向前邁進。」
- 審判者馬雷葛蘿

en: In battle, virtue matters not.
Only victory.
flavourtext:UniqueBelt13.Text.zh:
在戰場上，什麼都是假的。
只有勝利才是真的。

en: With her cold resolve
And burning sacrifice
The Eternal twins arose.
flavourtext:UniqueBelt14.Text.zh:
她以冷酷堅毅
獻上熊熊燔祭
永恆雙子，降生落地。

en: Our forefathers danced and drank and ate their fill
and did not honour the First Ones for their gifts.
So the First Ones filled the sky with fire.
flavourtext:UniqueBelt15.Text.zh:
我們的先祖們盡情飲酒狂歡
毫不重視初代所留下的禮物
因此初代將天空佈滿了火焰

en: After the Great Fire, the land lay barren
and our forefathers grew weak.
Mother Gull took pity on them
and gave them grain and water.
flavourtext:UniqueBelt16.Text.zh:
大火之後，大地貧瘠
我們的先祖開始衰頹
迷霧之母憐憫著他們
因此賦予了水和穀物

en: But the grain grew twisted and the water turned dark
and those who partook of Mother Gull's gift
birthed monsters that fed
on the flesh of one another.
flavourtext:UniqueBelt17.Text.zh:
但穀物開始扭曲，水開始變黑
而那些受迷霧之母恩賜的人們
生出了一群群的怪物
只能同類相食的可悲怪物們

en: "They say a draught of fine spirits will ward off
the elements and promote a longer, merrier life.
I have found this to be true on all counts."
- Zerphi of the Vaal
flavourtext:UniqueBelt18.Text.zh:
＂它們說靈魂們會聚集成河
朝向更長，更美好的永恆
我發現這千真萬確。＂
- 瓦爾的澤佛依

en: "The power of rebirth rivals that of immortality."
- Icius Perandus, Antiquities Collection, Item 3
flavourtext:UniqueBelt19.Text.zh:
"重生之力堪比長生不老。"
- 伊席厄斯．普蘭德斯，古物收藏家，物品編號 3

en: Few men cast a longer shadow
than the Great Meginord of the North.
flavourtext:UniqueBelt2.Text.zh:
北方的梅吉諾德帶來揮之不去的陰影
他的恐怖無人能比

en: A single step forward
Snap free from the prison
Reborn into freedom eternal
flavourtext:UniqueBelt20.Text.zh:
向前一步
脫離牢籠
重生於永恆自由

en: Vaal bloodpriests were among the earliest intellectuals on record.
It was they who found that a newly freed soul would
desperately cling to any other source of life.
flavourtext:UniqueBelt21.Text.zh:
瓦爾血祭師，知識的先驅者。
靈魂竭盡其能，依偎於任何生命。
正是由血祭師們所發現。

en: "Curious. The test spike penetrated the subject's flesh, but the chest wound
was not as deep as expected. There is something here..."
flavourtext:UniqueBelt21x.Text.zh:
"奇怪。測試的尖刺穿透目標的肉體，但是胸部的傷口
沒有預期的深。裡面有東西…"

en: "Some blows must be evaded. Some blows must be endured.
The trick is to tell them apart."
- Daresso, the Sword King
flavourtext:UniqueBelt22.Text.zh:
"有些攻擊必須閃躲。
有些攻擊必須承受。
區分兩者是訣竅所在。"
-鬥劍之王德瑞索

en: You were always there, by my side,
whether we sat or played.
Our friendship was a joyful ride,
I wish you could have stayed.
flavourtext:UniqueBelt23.Text.zh:
無論玩耍、發愣，
你一直都在我身旁。
友情多麼美好，
多麼希望你能留下。

en: All creatures have the potential for greatness
or unequivocal failure.
flavourtext:UniqueBelt24.Text.zh:
一切生物皆有潛力成就偉業，
當然失敗的潛力也不在話下。

en: With the patience of a prowling lion,
the Shade watched the Scholar.
flavourtext:UniqueBelt26.Text.zh:
潛伏的獅子有耐心的，
陰影中看著學者。

en: Hold in your hand the darkness
and never will the light blind you.
flavourtext:UniqueBelt27.Text.zh:
將黑暗握於掌中，
光明將不再刺眼。

en: What started as a desire to feed
became a desire to learn...
flavourtext:UniqueBelt28.Text.zh:
是什麼開始作為豢養的願望
成為學習的願望...

en: For the Vaal, the relationship between slave and master
was as intimate and volatile as that of lovers.
flavourtext:UniqueBelt29.Text.zh:
在瓦爾時代，主僕之間的關係
就像情侶般既親蜜又不穩定。

en: A large enough debt turns even a friend
into an enemy, and the Perandus family
had more debtors than anyone.
flavourtext:UniqueBelt3.Text.zh:
欠下巨債不還，就連朋友也會反目成仇
而普蘭德斯家族欠下世間最多的債。

en: As a gift or as punishment,
the Empire will have your blood.
<default>{This item can be transformed on the Altar of Sacrifice along with Vial of Consequence}
Death is your most important duty.
Face it, or curse your bloodline for all eternity.
flavourtext:UniqueBelt31.Text.zh:
死亡是你最重要的任務。
接受它，或是永世詛咒你的血繼。

en: "Recommend extreme caution on any prototypes that can lead to a chain reaction
of deaths. Lab Twelve has been lost to the flames."
- Lead Researcher Ksaret
flavourtext:UniqueBelt33x.Text.zh:
“對於任何可能導致連鎖反應的原型，建議格外小心
死亡。 實驗室12已經失火了。"
- 首席研究員卡薩雷特

en: "This will help with the pain.
One for you... and one for me."
- Doctor 'Shaky Hands' Opden
flavourtext:UniqueBelt39.Text.zh:
“這將有助於減輕痛苦。
一個給你...一個給我。"
- 「抖不停」歐普登

en: Kaom's strength was rivaled only by
the great Meginord of the north.
flavourtext:UniqueBelt4.Text.zh:
岡姆的勇猛威震天下，
唯有北方的梅吉諾德能與他一較高下。

en: The burden falls heaviest not on those that died,
but on those that did not.
flavourtext:UniqueBelt41.Text.zh:
負擔不重於未死者，
而未負重者。

en: Mortal pleasures can hold back the memories,
but a hollow soul can never be healed.
flavourtext:UniqueBelt44.Text.zh:
凡人的享樂可以擋住回憶，
但空洞的靈魂永遠無法治愈。

en: "A man confronted with sufficient adversity
may ascend to unprecedented heights
and triumph over his coddled rivals."
- Weylan the Ezomyte
flavourtext:UniqueBelt45.Text.zh:
一個面臨足夠逆境的人
可以攀登到前所未有的高度，
並戰勝那些被寵壞的競爭對手。
- 艾茲麥韋蘭

en: "Put your faith in me.
Our god demands it."
- High Templar Maxarius
flavourtext:UniqueBelt46.Text.zh:
"相信我，
我們的神要求如此。"
- 聖宗領導人瑪薩里歐斯

en: For centuries, he burned in an unending
nightmare of lava and flame... but he endured.
flavourtext:UniqueBelt47.Text.zh:
幾個世紀以來，他在無盡的熔岩
和火焰的惡夢中燃燒... 但他堅持了下來。

en: Knowing what will happen
and knowing when it will happen
are two very different things.
flavourtext:UniqueBelt48.Text.zh:
知道會發生什麼
和知道它何時發生，
是兩件完全不同的事情。

en: There is an ebb and flow to all things,
tangible to those who watch and wait.
flavourtext:UniqueBelt49.Text.zh:
萬物皆有潮起潮落，
觀察等待之人肉眼可見。

en: "I come from a long line of scholars, poets, and artists.
You can imagine how little we leave our children...
My father only gifted me one thing: for good or ill,
I don't know when to quit."
- Victario Nevalius, the People's Poet
flavourtext:UniqueBelt50.Text.zh:
「我一脈相承自無數的學者、詩人和藝術家。
你能想像我們留給孩子們的東西遠遠不夠……
我的父親只給了我一個念頭：無論健康或疾病，
我不知道抽身的時機。」
——維多里奧·涅瓦里烏斯，國民詩人

en: When all else was burning and overrun,
she held the bridge to the very end.
"I weep not for myself, but for the truth of what we are.
It rots away inside all of us, the darkness within. They blame
me, but I am merely the prophet, the one who sees the black."
flavourtext:UniqueBelt52.Text.zh:
"我並非為自己而哭泣，而是為我們本質的真相。
它在我們所有人之內腐朽，那股內在的黑暗。
他們責怪我，但我不過是先知，是那個看見黑暗之人。"

en: Motion, purpose... craft. The fruits of my mind laboured
to build my wildest imaginings, never tiring, never faltering.
Life... or something like it, engineered in its image.
flavourtext:UniqueBelt54.Text.zh:
動機、使命……技藝。我心中的果實努力地
打造我最瘋狂的想像，從不疲倦，從不動搖。
生命……或類似生命的東西，以它的形象而創造。

en: "When we first saw the Sun, our eyes were not above,
but on her. She was the burning heart of fury, and the
dead turned to flee. We drove them beneath for all time."
flavourtext:UniqueBelt55.Text.zh:
"當我們首次看見太陽時，目光並非望向天空，
而是注視著她。她是燃燒的狂怒之心，
亡者轉身逃竄。我們將他們驅逐至下方，永世不得翻身。"

en: "I staggered on, dying of thirst... I thought I found respite,
but no... it was a pit of newborns... dry and hollow...
and they screamed still, begging me for vengeance..."
flavourtext:UniqueBelt56.Text.zh:
"我踉蹌前行，幾乎渴死…我以為找到了救贖，
但不…那是一個新生之物的深坑…乾涸而空洞…
它們仍在尖叫，向我哀求復仇…"

en: A pact is a debt which both sides repay. For a human to
barter an alliance in their favour... extraordinary.
flavourtext:UniqueBelt57.Text.zh:
誓約是一筆雙方皆需償還的債務。一介凡人
若想在交易中占得便宜……簡直是不可思議。

en: The sun's fury, trapped
in pillars of blazing light,
Explodes from its cage.
flavourtext:UniqueBelt6.Text.zh:
熾熱毒辣的烈日
困在出一道道奪目光柱裡，
在其中爆炸燃燒。

en: "A man's soul rules from a cavern of bone, learns and
judges through flesh-born windows. The heart is meat.
The head is where the Man is."
- Lavianga, Advisor to Kaom
flavourtext:UniqueBelt7.Text.zh:
「骨骼是靈魂的居所，
血肉是精神和世界交流的窗口， 推動一切的力量就在心窩。
即使有了這些，失去了頭腦就沒有自我。」
- 岡姆軍師拉維安加

en: "A type Delta test subject escaped with Prototype #18. He was last seen
ten times the height of a man and crashing straight through walls."
flavourtext:UniqueBelt7x.Text.zh:
一名類型為δ 的測試對象逃脫了原型 #18。
他最後一次被看見是一個人的身高的十倍，撞破牆。

en: "She begged the Earth to spare her Son;
Out of love the Earth agreed.
To the other Elements she did not speak
And out of spite They plotted."
- Berek and the Untamed
flavourtext:UniqueBelt8.Text.zh:
「她乞求土靈留下孩子，
母愛感天動地，土靈答應饒他不死。
其他元素之靈卻感到不受重視，
於是策畫詭計，謀害其子。」
- 貝雷克及抗馴者

en: "You can invite them but you can never be
sure who will come knocking."
- Doryani, Queen's Thaumaturgist
flavourtext:UniqueBelt9.Text.zh:
「你可以送出誠摯的邀請，
但無從得知造訪的是何方嘉賓。」
- 女王奇術師多里亞尼

en: The bindings of the victorious
wrap around the throats of the defeated.
flavourtext:UniqueBeltDemigods1.Text.zh:
勝者眾志成城
敗者獨自扼腕

en: The victorious know only leadership,
the rest only servitude.
flavourtext:UniqueBodyDemigods.Text.zh:
勝者只知統治
其餘只知服侍

en: Hyrri loosed a barrage of arrows,
tipped with a poisoned hatred
only oppression can ferment.
flavourtext:UniqueBodyDex1.Text.zh:
西里的箭雨呼嘯而來，
矢鋒劇毒命中要害，
留下冰冷遺體訴說悲哀。

en: We dance in the white, like water,
colliding as many and emerging as one.
We share one space,
speak one voice,
act through one body.
A flawless crystal.
Brittle.
flavourtext:UniqueBodyDex11.Text.zh:
共享的空間，
共同的發言，
同個個體我們行動。
無瑕的水晶。
脆而不堅。

en: "This is what I've been trying to tell you. This prototype
was different before. Now, it's always been this way!"
- Researcher Graven
flavourtext:UniqueBodyDex11x.Text.zh:
"這就是我一直試圖告訴你的。這個原型以前是不同的。
現在，它一直都是這樣的！"
- 研究者格雷文

en: Feed a beast and it will not hunt.
Protect it and it will not fight.
Ferocity must be learned, not taught.
It is suffering that forges the greatest warriors.
flavourtext:UniqueBodyDex12.Text.zh:
餵食一隻野獸，牠將不會狩獵。
保護牠，牠不會戰鬥。
兇猛必須體會而來，而不是教導。
最偉大的戰士同時也經歷過最多苦難。

en: "Yes, a catastrophic storm erupted, and yes, they screamed for me
to stop the experiment... but you know how I am with screams."
- Researcher Olesya, on #2999 and the loss of Outpost Eight
flavourtext:UniqueBodyDex1x.Text.zh:
是的，一場災難性的風暴爆發了，而且是的，他們對我尖叫
要停止實驗...但你知道我對尖叫的態度。
- 研究員奧莉西亞，#2999和失落的8號哨站

en: Forget your kite shield. Just put the biggest man
in the field between you and the archers.
flavourtext:UniqueBodyDex5.Text.zh:
與其依靠那薄弱的護盾， 
何不迎擊勁敵，近戰箭手。

en: Shedding away her regal past,
she forged a new destiny.
Sacrificing the ephemeral joys of man,
she embraced the eternal grasp of nature.
Seizing her one true wish,
she found peace at last.
flavourtext:UniqueBodyDex6.Text.zh:
他人撫慰，僅得苦痛暫緩，
回歸自然，方是永恆終站。

en: "I carry neither food nor drink. I rely on the charity
of my fellow wayfarers. Dead men are generous men."
- Taruk of the Wildmen
flavourtext:UniqueBodyDex7.Text.zh:
「我不會前去尋水覓食，
畢竟還有那斷了氣的同伴遺愛人世。」
- 野人塔盧克

en: Do not hide your flaws, your cracks,
mend them, and display them proudly.
For it is these that set us apart.
flavourtext:UniqueBodyDex8.Text.zh:
不要掩藏你的弱點、缺陷，
改善它，然後引以為傲的展現。
我們因此脫穎而出。

en: Curse their vile Council,
They cast me aside as if I am some bastard child.
If they only knew the power I possess.
flavourtext:UniqueBodyDex9.Text.zh:
詛咒他們卑劣的議會。
他們把我當成雜種小孩將我排除在外。
他們並不知道我擁有的力量。

en: "...The discomfort shown by the others is amusing, but none
can deny that my work has made quite the splash..."
- Maligaro's Journal
flavourtext:UniqueBodyDexInt1.Text.zh:
「...眼見他人受罪，我心欣喜難掩；
我所造成的苦難絕對不容否認...」
- 馬雷葛蘿日記

en: The First of the Sky was the Last of the First.
It was he who showed us that our limits are self-imposed,
that what we take for law may just be an illusion.
flavourtext:UniqueBodyDexInt10.Text.zh:
初始之天最後的初始者。
是他讓我們知道我們的限制都是自己加諸的，
我們付諸律法可能僅僅是幻想。

en: "The form of this replica came to me in a troubled dream.
I do not believe we should ever allow it to be used."
- Researcher Arn
flavourtext:UniqueBodyDexInt11x.Text.zh:
"這個複製品的形式在一個陷入困境的夢中找上了我。
我認為我們永遠都不應允許使用它。"
- 研究員昂恩

en: He may have returned from the frozen southern reaches,
but that doesn't mean he ever truly escaped them.
flavourtext:UniqueBodyDexInt12.Text.zh:
他可能已經從冰凍的南方河段回來了，
但這並不意味著他曾經真正擺脫過他們。

en: The Oriathans built their empire on naval mobility, which allowed
them to wage war wherever their enemy was weakest.
flavourtext:UniqueBodyDexInt13.Text.zh:
奧瑞亞人建立帝國在海上機動性之上，
他們在敵人最弱的地方發動戰爭。

en: Within each of us exists a being of pure malice,
held back only by the lies we tell ourselves.
flavourtext:UniqueBodyDexInt14.Text.zh:
我們每個人中都存在著純潔的惡意，
只有我們自言自語的謊言阻止了它。

en: Those devoted to the Dreamer pursue
perfection of the body and the will.
flavourtext:UniqueBodyDexInt16.Text.zh:
那些幻夢者的忠誠信徒
追求肉體和意志的完美。

en: Eaten away by anxiety and fear,
nothing remained but the void.
flavourtext:UniqueBodyDexInt17.Text.zh:
受焦慮和恐懼吞噬，
唯有虛空獨自留存。

en: When the throat roars,
As eyes weep,
When the hand grips hard
With trembling fingers,
When belly twists
Yet legs stand strong,
That is the work
Of the Defiant Heart.
flavourtext:UniqueBodyDexInt2.Text.zh:
喉嚨嘶吼，
雙眼淚流，
兩手緊握，
十指顫抖，
腹部曲扭，
仍然屹立不休，
問其原因為何?
傲骨絕不屈合。

en: Use the dead to stave off death,
An armour of bones and rot.
Hanging on with bated breath,
One lapse and all for naught.
flavourtext:UniqueBodyDexInt3.Text.zh:
以亡魂礙阻死亡，
以屍骸護佑己身；
屏息凝神，奮戰苦撐，
稍有失誤，前功盡淪。

en: "Further research must be done on Prototype #282.
There is power here, if it can be tapped."
flavourtext:UniqueBodyDexInt3x.Text.zh:
"必須對原型 #282 做進一步的研究。
如果可以利用，就有力量。"

en: "Every life is a story.
If you're not writing your own,
you'd better know who's writing it for you!"
- Victario, the People's Poet
flavourtext:UniqueBodyDexInt4.Text.zh:
「人生如戲。倘若寫劇本的不是你自己，最好弄清楚誰是執筆之人。」
- 人民詩人維多里奧

en: Don't hesitate; bring death to all, conclusively and swiftly,
or they will give you the same treatment.
flavourtext:UniqueBodyDexInt6.Text.zh:
不容遲疑；迅速確切的將死亡帶給一切，
否則，他們也會為你帶來死亡。

en: Ask any tracker and they'll tell you:
the most dangerous animals
are the ones who don't bother to hide.
flavourtext:UniqueBodyDexInt8.Text.zh:
問問任何一位追蹤者，
他們都會和你說：最危險的動物，
根本不屑隱藏自己的蹤跡。

en: "Eyes of black, three by three, staring ever darker into me..."
- Researcher Arn
flavourtext:UniqueBodyDexInt9x.Text.zh:
"黑眼睛，三三分，黑暗地凝視著我…" 
- 研究員昂恩

en: Shavronne's apparel became ever more extravagant
as her body and soul became ever more corrupted.
flavourtext:UniqueBodyInt1.Text.zh:
薛朗的肉身跟靈魂墮入魔道，
衣著妝扮越發奢華花俏。

en: The quickest way to understand
your own strengths and weaknesses
is to walk in the skin of another.
flavourtext:UniqueBodyInt10.Text.zh:
了解自己優缺點
最快的方式就是
進入別人的身軀

en: Renowned by those distinguished,
Exalted by the few.
He skulks in darkness,
and watches from beneath the city.
flavourtext:UniqueBodyInt11.Text.zh:
聞名於傑出之眾中，
崇高於少數之中。
躲藏於黑暗之中，
在城市底下監視著。

en: Whiff of cold, tiny spark, faintest flicker in the dark.
Embers swirl, ice takes form, sky exposed - Death's perfect storm.
Frost and thunder, flames shine bright, ruin walks the land tonight.
By your hand they dance and bend, wield them and brook no end.
flavourtext:UniqueBodyInt12.Text.zh:
冷颼颼，小火花，微弱閃爍於暗中。
餘燼轉，冰凝固，完美天空死亡風。
冰與雷，火焰輝，廢墟滿地佈今夜。
手中繚，舞蹈繞，執掌揮舞不停歇。

en: We happily give our limbs.
A net woven to keep safe the bones of the Lords.
The Lords are chosen so carefully.
Only they may grace His flesh.
flavourtext:UniqueBodyInt14.Text.zh:
君王們必須仔細選擇，
唯有他們能夠接受他的恩典。

en: As she was sentenced to death, Doedre was silent.
As she was tied to the stake, Doedre was silent.
As the flames licked away her life, Doedre was silent.
But Wraeclast had not heard the last of her.
flavourtext:UniqueBodyInt15.Text.zh:
當她被宣判死刑時，德瑞沉默不語。
當她被綁在木樁上時，德瑞沉默不語。
當大火吞噬她的生命時，德瑞沉默不語。
但瓦爾克拉斯從未聽過她。

en: He took me by my hand, promised me power beyond compare.
But I did not do it for power.
I did it for love.
And I'd do it again in an instant.
flavourtext:UniqueBodyInt16.Text.zh:
他牽著我的手，承諾會給予我無窮進的力量。
但我不是為了力量才這麼做。
是為了愛。
若能重來一次我還是會這麼做。

en: The First of the Night was the first explorer
It was she who first braved night's terrors
and found comfort in silence and solace.
flavourtext:UniqueBodyInt17.Text.zh:
初始之夜是第一位冒險家
她是第一個冒著夜晚的恐懼
並在寧靜中找到撫慰。

en: In their crimson nightmare, the Vaal are still sacrificing themselves to her glory and beauty.
They stab their own hearts and cry out in ecstasy, only to rise again.
flavourtext:UniqueBodyInt18.Text.zh:
在緋紅的午夜，瓦爾人仍奉獻著他們自己給女王永有光輝與美貌。
他們刺穿自己的心臟並發狂的吼叫，只為了能再次復興。

en: Exceptional men and women of strong will can flicker a spark,
but something much greater is needed to unleash the wildfire of true divine flames.
flavourtext:UniqueBodyInt19.Text.zh:
具有強烈意志的優秀男女可以閃爍火花，
但需要更強大的東西來釋放真正聖火的野火。

en: When I finally rejected my faith entirely, my stagnant belief
became thick white blood, as choking as it was nourishing.
flavourtext:UniqueBodyInt22.Text.zh: 當我將信仰拒於門外時，停滯的信念變成了濃稠的白色血液，令人窒息，卻滋養著我。

en: My Soul is your Strength
My Price is your Blood
flavourtext:UniqueBodyInt3.Text.zh:
我的靈魂將引導你勇闖天涯，
但是必須以鮮血做為代價。

en: "Researcher Graven's request to wear Prototype #2998 in
place of his standard lab attire is... granted."
- Lead Researcher Ksaret
flavourtext:UniqueBodyInt3x.Text.zh:
研究員格雷文要求穿戴原型#2998代替
他的標準實驗室服裝...被允許。
- 首席研究員卡薩雷特

en: Despair hums, softly, deadly, in the bones of my enemies.
Eyes will burn, and souls wither, as they bask in my radiance.
flavourtext:UniqueBodyInt4.Text.zh:
在敵人骸骨之中，悠悠吟唱，鎮魂安靈 
在我的榮光之中，怒目灼燒，靈魂凋零。

en: The night of a thousand ribbons
To remember the day of a thousand flames
When Sarn burned
And was born again
flavourtext:UniqueBodyInt5.Text.zh:
白晝千火祝融滿城燒
夜裡千人喪服齊哀悼
此日，薩恩滅亡傾城
此時，薩恩浴火重生

en: The greatest mistakes cause suffering
long after they have been made
flavourtext:UniqueBodyInt7.Text.zh:
最嚴重之過犯，讓人吃苦受難。
即使事過境遷，依然陰魂不散。

en: When dead men rise and darkness falls
Only faith can be your walls
Walls of Light, not of brick
Twice as strong and twice as thick
flavourtext:UniqueBodyInt8.Text.zh:
亡者出墓，黑暗驟降
以此信仰，作汝護牆
光之護牆，非以磚造
更為厚實，更為牢靠。

en: Reap what others have sown
Muster them from their graves
Parade them for your pleasure
Zealots in mortis enslaved
flavourtext:UniqueBodyInt9.Text.zh:
莫讓前人耕耘回歸塵土
休使讓學問埋入墳墓
呼喚前人出墳闊步，
奴役亡軀，踏上狂熱征途。

en: The warrior who
fears will fall.
flavourtext:UniqueBodyStr1.Text.zh:
勇鬥之魂無堅不摧，
懦弱之心退縮避畏。

en: The First of the Deep was the First of All.
It was He who conquered the waves,
who stood guard as land rose from sea.
flavourtext:UniqueBodyStr10.Text.zh:
初始深淵只是開始。
是他征服了浪濤，
守護陸地抬升時免於大海的侵害。

en: The Trickster God turned the very Day and Night against each other.
What hope have you?
flavourtext:UniqueBodyStr11.Text.zh:
詐欺之神讓日夜對抗。
你能有什麼希望。

en: The Maji were forbidden from touching virtue gems...
so their practical warriors employed geomancy instead.
flavourtext:UniqueBodyStr14.Text.zh:
聖賢被禁止觸碰古靈寶石…
因此，他們的實戰戰士轉而使用地占術。

en: "Useless for our purposes, but perhaps we can sell Prototype #5
to an archmage to fund other experiments."
flavourtext:UniqueBodyStr1x.Text.zh:
"對我們的目標沒幫助，但也許我們可以出售原型 #5
來資助其他實驗。"

en: Tears of blood, aching heart,
My dear Isildria must depart.
flavourtext:UniqueBodyStr3.Text.zh:
破碎的心靈淌著血，
我心愛的伊席德莉亞在此永別。

en: Give me neither havens nor solace;
They are for the weak and frightened.
Instead, light the path to greatness,
So that I may begin my bright pursuit.
flavourtext:UniqueBodyStr4.Text.zh:
切莫賜予天堂或藉慰；
我並非軟弱膽怯之輩。
點亮去路，邁向宏偉，
我才能展開壯志追隨。

en: Some would question if the risk was worth it.
The rest were already dead.
flavourtext:UniqueBodyStr5.Text.zh:
有些人會質疑冒這風險是否值得。
其他人則早已死去。

en: "The Virtue Gems are a gift from the land,
our land, and we will not let our gifts
be destroyed by savages."
- Marceus Lioneye
flavourtext:UniqueBodyStr6.Text.zh:
「古靈寶石出自我等故土， 
莫讓野人毀此珍稀寶物。」
- 馬爾賽斯．獅眼

en: "The Council have a great many secrets.
Some are better kept that way, Cospri."
- Mauritius, the Iron Heart
flavourtext:UniqueBodyStr9.Text.zh:
"議會有著許多不可告人的秘密。
有些最好永遠不被公諸於世，卡斯普里"
- 鋼鐵之心，馬里求斯

en: There is no safer place
Than the Belly of the Beast
flavourtext:UniqueBodyStrDex1.Text.zh:
如果你覺得保命奮戰太過沉重，
不如就讓巨獸吞入腹中。

en: "There's nothing like imminent death
to galvanize one's purpose in life."
- Malachai the Soulless.
flavourtext:UniqueBodyStrDex2.Text.zh:
「看看那轉瞬的安息，
我想不出更好的結局與之相比。」
- 超靈者瑪拉凱

en: "When your back is against the wall,
And your opponent is bleeding you dry,
There is only one appropriate response:
Unbridled, overwhelming violence."
- Daresso, the Sword King
flavourtext:UniqueBodyStrDex3.Text.zh:
「當你身後已無退路，
對手進逼招招狠毒，
身陷危機，唯有一途
就是渾身絕技盡出，」
- 鬥劍之王德瑞索

en: "The Consort of Chaos descended,
swiftly, brutally, artfully, she consumed the living,
leaving naught behind but a Rosemarie bloom,
to celebrate the massacre."
- Blass, explorer, hunter, adventurer
flavourtext:UniqueBodyStrDex4.Text.zh:
「作為混沌災星的配偶，
她迅速、殘酷、狡猾的屠虐生命。
除了香氣，走過不留一絲痕跡。
以此，來慶祝那大屠殺。」
- 探險家、獵人與冒險者 布拉斯

en: The truth lies inside every man, if you dig around.
Many a confession was found in the bowels of Axiom.
flavourtext:UniqueBodyStrDex5.Text.zh:
每個人的背後都藏著一份真實，
只要你挖的夠深。
坦白都藏於那真實的最深處。

en: Swift and silent.
One strike, one corpse.
flavourtext:UniqueBodyStrDex6.Text.zh:
迅速且安靜
一次出擊，一具屍體

en: The First of the Plains was the First of the Hunt
It was she who showed us that there is honour
in waiting in the shadows and picking your moment.
flavourtext:UniqueBodyStrDex8.Text.zh:
初始之地是第一個獵人
是她像我們展現這裡的榮耀
在黑暗中等待著你的到來。

en: "Attempt #120: the prototype has finally achieved power similar to the original
without breaking all the bones of the test subject. A rousing success."
flavourtext:UniqueBodyStrDex8x.Text.zh:
測試 #120：原型終於獲得了與原始版本相似的功能
而不會破壞測試對象的所有骨骼。 令人振奮的成功。

en: "The Greatwolf is with us! Gaius Sentari
flees! Let us give chase, for today, my
brothers and sisters, we are finally free!"
flavourtext:UniqueBodyStrDex9.Text.zh:
巨狼與我們同在！蓋厄斯‧山特立已逃！
追擊吧，我的兄弟姊妹們——
今日，我們終於獲得自由！

en: "When you have nothing to hide,
you have nothing to fear."
- Atziri, Queen of the Vaal
flavourtext:UniqueBodyStrDexInt1.Text.zh:
「光明磊落者無所畏懼。」
- 瓦爾女王阿茲里

en: Destined for sacrifice,
they were dressed in garments
that blurred the lines between this world
and the next.
flavourtext:UniqueBodyStrDexInt2.Text.zh:
注定要犧牲，
他們穿著衣裳
這模糊了這世和來世的
界線。

en: Although a great leader during the war,
Voll proved disastrous in times of peace.
flavourtext:UniqueBodyStrInt1.Text.zh:
福爾驍勇善戰，登基稱王
奈何治國無方，終至滅亡

en: A general may carry his men to greatness,
or be dragged beneath the mire by their burden.
flavourtext:UniqueBodyStrInt10.Text.zh:
一位將軍可以會把他的人帶到偉大的位置，
或者因為他們的重擔而被拖到泥淖之下。

en: Shrouded in seed, a conduit of contagion,
yet the source of septicity remains unknown.
<default>{This item can be anointed by Cassia}
"This was the first step in some grand design,
lost to the ages, now ours to decipher."
- Dominus, High Templar
flavourtext:UniqueBodyStrInt14.Text.zh:
"這是許多偉大做的第一步，
失傳數載，現在為我們破譯。"
- - 聖宗領導人神主

en: Seek not to avoid the mortal pains of this world.
In flagellation, there lies freedom from temptation.
flavourtext:UniqueBodyStrInt15.Text.zh:
不要試圖避免這個世界的人間疼痛，
而要在苦行中尋找擺脫誘惑的自由。

en: "We huddle in the fading light of our candles,
begging the darkness to leave us in peace...
but what if we joined Him, and left fear behind?"
flavourtext:UniqueBodyStrInt16.Text.zh:
"我們擠在逐漸微弱的燭光中，乞求
黑暗留給我們一片安寧……但如果
我們加入祂，將恐懼拋諸腦後呢？"

en: "Prototype #7 achieved even greater injury responsiveness than expected,
though at considerable cost to the long-term survival rate of the user."
flavourtext:UniqueBodyStrInt2x.Text.zh:
"原型 #7 的傷害對應能力甚至超出了預期，
儘管以高昂的代價損害了用戶的長期生存率。"

en: When Solaris closes her burning eye
At the end of time,
the world will perish in ice.
flavourtext:UniqueBodyStrInt3.Text.zh:
太陽神闔閉火瞳
時空自此告終，
世界凍亡寒冰之中。

en: . . . and the Light faded and hope waned
Zahndethus cast aside his faith
and embraced the darkness.
flavourtext:UniqueBodyStrInt4.Text.zh:
...迫切絕望，光明消亡
札德圖斯拋棄自身信仰
落入黑暗深淵萬丈

en: Only light may banish the shadows from this land
And the black lies wrapped around your heart
flavourtext:UniqueBodyStrInt5.Text.zh:
唯有曙光能驅逐陰影
使黑暗謊言不再蒙蔽人心

en: Faith does not make us invulnerable.
It makes us immortal.
flavourtext:UniqueBodyStrInt7.Text.zh:
信念無法讓我們刀槍不入
但它卻能讓我們永不止息

en: Fragile is the vessel that holds the soul.
Wrap it in cloth, seal it tight.
For once the seal is broken, the contents are lost forever.
flavourtext:UniqueBodyStrInt8.Text.zh:
包覆靈魂的脆弱軀體。
以布包裹，密封。
一旦封印瓦解，內容將永遠遺失。

en: When it comes to finding a use for surplus,
a rich man has within himself
boundless creativity.
flavourtext:UniqueBodyStrInt9.Text.zh:
談到盈餘的用途時，
富人在自己內心
有著無限的想像力。

en: "Better... stronger... more vital... and then... failure. Always, failure.
What key fundamental secret are we missing?"
flavourtext:UniqueBodyStrInt9x.Text.zh:
“更好...更強...更重要...然後...失敗。總是失敗。
我們缺少什麼關鍵的基礎秘密？"

en: "Every day we choose safety or knowledge.
Live and stagnate, or risk death for truth.
I would rather see the end of the Vaal
than help it tread water."
- Doryani, Queen's Thaumaturgist
flavourtext:UniqueBootsDIY.Text.zh:
"每天，我們在安全與知識中抉擇。
生活、停滯，否則冒險死亡或真相。
我寧願看到瓦爾終結，也不願幫助它履於薄冰。"
-女王奇術師多里亞尼

en: The Goat King knew not of war,
of the lands and laws he trampled.
The Goat King knew only joy
at turning life to ash.
flavourtext:UniqueBootsDex10.Text.zh:
何謂戰爭，何謂罪行，
何謂踐踏的大地和法律，
羊蹄之王只喜愛將生命化成灰燼。

en: A secret is a weapon your enemies do not have.
When the First of the Plains hunted, she moved in silence and acted quickly.
To do otherwise is to arm your foes.
flavourtext:UniqueBootsDex13.Text.zh:
秘密是你最大的武器。
當初始之地狩獵時，她悄然無聲的行動。
否則你的敵人就會警覺了。

en: The High Priests ensured the loyalty of their slaves by habituating
them to narcotic stimulants with lethal withdrawals.
flavourtext:UniqueBootsDex14.Text.zh:
大祭司通過使他們習慣於致命性的麻醉興奮劑，
從而確保了他們對奴隸的忠誠。

en: The inferno surged past, devastating Stridevolf, but the Maraketh
warrior somehow remained. Soot-blackened and resolute, she
grinned. In that moment, the bandit king knew true despair.
flavourtext:UniqueBootsDex15.Text.zh:
地獄般的火焰猛然襲來，摧毀了斯特里德沃夫，但這位瑪拉凱斯戰士
卻奇蹟似地倖存下來。她滿臉灰塵卻毫不動搖，露出了一抹微笑。
就在那一瞬間，土匪之王感到了真正的絕望。

en: Alive but not unscathed, Victario fled
as slaughter blossomed at the gates.
flavourtext:UniqueBootsDex3.Text.zh:
血腥殺戮在門前爆發
維多死裡逃生，毫髮無傷。

en: "Sharks thrash and swirl
To the pounding drum of their frenzied hearts
As they dance in the waters red."
-Lavianga, Guardian of the Karui Way
flavourtext:UniqueBootsDex4.Text.zh:
「獵鯊嗅到遠方那一道傷，
立即前來躍向那奄奄一息的心臟，
最終留下一抹血水盪漾。」
- 卡魯之道守護者拉維安加

en: "Death can be outrun with these, but beware!
In running from death, you may forget to live."
- Icius Perandus, Antiquities Collection, Item 202
flavourtext:UniqueBootsDex5.Text.zh:
"用這些可以跑得過死亡，但要小心！
在逃避死亡的過程中，你可能會忘記活著。”
- 伊席厄斯．普蘭德斯，古物收藏家，物品編號 202

en: "Those who dance are considered insane
by those who cannot hear the music."
- Atziri, Queen of the Vaal
flavourtext:UniqueBootsDex7.Text.zh:
「未聞樂音的平凡人
當然會認為起舞的人理智太過放任。」
- 瓦爾女王阿茲里

en: Move in with haste.
Strike quick, strike hard.
Vanish like smoke in the wind.
flavourtext:UniqueBootsDex9.Text.zh:
迅速地移動。
靈敏出擊，沉重一擊。
像煙霧般消散在風中

en: "The test subject nearly escaped, but the poison gas
system in the hallway functioned as expected."
flavourtext:UniqueBootsDex9x.Text.zh:
"測試對象險些逃脫，但毒氣
系統在走廊正常運作。"

en: Blazing body, shining bold.
Dance beneath the orb of gold!
flavourtext:UniqueBootsDexInt1.Text.zh:
貴體耀、惜資穎，
豪門權勢試真金。

en: Relentlessness. Nothing more, nothing less.
<default>{This item can be anointed by Cassia}
flavourtext:UniqueBootsDexInt10.Text.zh:
冷酷無情。不多也不少。

<default> {此物品可被卡西亞抹油}

en: "Suppression troop seven, the 'Glowering Faithful,' managed to fell the escaping
test subject by timing their arrows between his explosive dashes."
<default>{This item can be anointed by Cassia}
Every glorious conquest
stands astride innocent bones.
flavourtext:UniqueBootsDexInt11.Text.zh:
每一次光榮的征服
踐踏於無辜的骸骨上。

en: A multitude of beings share a wretched existence
irrevocably bound together in perpetual torture.
flavourtext:UniqueBootsDexInt12.Text.zh:
眾生共享一個悲慘的存在，
在永恆的折磨中不可挽回地聯繫在一起。

en: "Follow me if you desire better for yourself, and for your
families. Follow me if you hunger for more than this!"
flavourtext:UniqueBootsDexInt13.Text.zh:
「如果你渴望增進自身與家人，請跟隨我。
如果你渴望更多，更要跟隨我！」

en: "Bored gods won't give you any favours."
- Maraketh proverb
flavourtext:UniqueBootsDexInt2.Text.zh:
「不取悅神便無法蒙獲神恩。」
- 馬拉克斯諺語

en: Those Theopolis fatcats put a price on our heads.
Let's see what they'll pay for their own.
flavourtext:UniqueBootsDexInt4.Text.zh: 費歐普羅斯的胖貓們懸賞我們的首級。讓我們看看他們自己的首級值多少。

en: Step into the void
and experience true freedom.
flavourtext:UniqueBootsDexInt5.Text.zh:
踏入無盡虛空，
感受真實自由。

en: "Test subject was able to walk into the walls of his chamber after breaking a rabbit's neck.
He was not fast enough, however. Suggest we begin excavation to retrieve prototype."
flavourtext:UniqueBootsDexInt5x.Text.zh:
"測試對像在打破兔子的脖子後能夠走進他的房間的牆壁。
但是他不夠快。 建議我們開始挖掘以恢復原型。"

en: When the fires spilled out of the mountain, The First of the Night wove a net
and was carried into the night on its hot winds.
Though we cannot live without danger, we can learn to live with it.
flavourtext:UniqueBootsDexInt7.Text.zh:
當火焰從山上濺出來時，初始之夜張開網
並將炎熱的風帶入夜晚。
雖然我們沒有辦法脫離危險的生活，但我們可以學會與它共存。

en: Facing their death,
the mind of a sacrifice
retreats into instinct and madness.
<default>{This item can be transformed on the Altar of Sacrifice along with Vial of the Ritual}
flavourtext:UniqueBootsDexInt8.Text.zh:
面對他們的死亡，
犧牲的意志
退縮成直覺和瘋狂。

<default>{此物品可與儀式之罈於獻祭之壇上改造}

en: Facing their death,
the mind of a sacrifice
retreats into instinct and madness.
flavourtext:UniqueBootsDexInt8Royale.Tex.zh:
面對他們的死亡，
獻祭的心
會退回到本能和瘋狂中。

en: Only a fool seeks meaning
in a life so fleeting.
flavourtext:UniqueBootsDexInt9.Text.zh:
只有愚者追求意義
在這短暫的生命。

en: In their hour of desperate need, the Knights of the Sun
called out for aid... and the Black Scythe answered.
flavourtext:UniqueBootsExpedition1.Text.zh:
她所領導的地方，
她忠誠的人跟隨，
甚至死亡。

en: Where others would retreat when vulnerable,
Olroth the Gallant fought deeper into battle.
flavourtext:UniqueBootsExpedition2.Text.zh:
其他人在脆弱時會撤退的地方，
英勇的奧爾羅斯在戰鬥中戰鬥得更深入。

en: Shavronne raced to Brutus' side,
her last hope against the Karui tide.
flavourtext:UniqueBootsInt3.Text.zh:
薛朗趕至布魯特斯身邊
負隅頑抗，對抗卡魯族的刀劍。

en: The dead man walks where
the living fear to tread.
flavourtext:UniqueBootsInt4.Text.zh:
亡者徘徊之處，
生人退避卻步。

en: "Outpost Twelve has been abandoned. On the bright side, I expect the plague of apparitions
to serve as ample defence for the relics we left behind."
- Administrator Qotra
flavourtext:UniqueBootsInt4x.Text.zh:
前哨十二站已被廢棄。光明的一面，我希望幻影之災
為我們留下的遺物提供充分的防禦。"
- 主管卡特拉

en: "They say that you should take life's troubles in your stride.
Some men have a longer stride than others."
- Gaius Sentari
flavourtext:UniqueBootsInt5.Text.zh:
「世人總說邁出腳步才能解問題，
但有些人就是無法一蹴而及。」
- 蓋厄斯．山特立

en: To fight an enemy on their lands is a tactical mistake.
Make those lands your own, and the mistake becomes theirs.
flavourtext:UniqueBootsInt6.Text.zh:
在敵人的領地作戰是個重大的失策。
將領地占為己有，那麼失策的就是敵人了。

en: The quick die young, the brilliant go mad,
and the powerful stand alone in a wasteland of their own creation.
flavourtext:UniqueBootsInt7.Text.zh:
迅速之人死得早，聰明之人容易瘋
而強大之士獨自在廢土中自立自強

en: Though the path we walk is the same,
each journey is different.
flavourtext:UniqueBootsInt8.Text.zh:
雖然我們走在同樣的道路上，
每個旅途卻是不同的。

en: "Prototype #56 was deemed safe, but judging by Administrator Qotra's new hustle
and improved ability to micromanage us, I'm not so sure."
- Researcher Graven
flavourtext:UniqueBootsInt8x.Text.zh:
"原型 #56 被認為是安全的，但由主管卡特拉的新忙判斷
並提高了對我們進行微管理的能力，我不確定。"
- 研究員格雷文

en: The mocking wind, a shielding spell,
The haunting screams, a maddening hell.
flavourtext:UniqueBootsStr1.Text.zh:
惡風襲擊，召出護身寶具，
尖嘯不息，目睹烈刑惡獄。

en: When the land rose above the sea, The First of the Deep did not move.
When the sky turned to fire, The First of the Deep did not perish.
We must remember our place, and play to our strengths.
flavourtext:UniqueBootsStr10.Text.zh:
當陸地抬升高於大海時，初始深淵並無所動。
當天空布滿戰火時，初始深淵並無消逝。
我們必須記住我們的定位，盡我們所長。

en: Centuries ago, there existed a unique grove imbued with ancestral fire.
As with all things, the Karui used its wood for war.
flavourtext:UniqueBootsStr11.Text.zh:
幾個世紀以前，有一個充滿祖先火焰的獨特小樹林。
就像所有事情一樣，卡魯用它的木材進行戰爭。

en: In a void strewn with incandescent stardust,
the emissary of flame traverses interplanetary space
consuming the knowledge of fallen civilisations.
flavourtext:UniqueBootsStr12.Text.zh:
在一片佈滿熾熱星塵的虛空中，
火焰使者穿越星際空間，
消耗墮落文明的知識。

en: Where he tread, disintegrating storms of lightning
and death laid waste to all around him.
flavourtext:UniqueBootsStr14.Text.zh: 閃電與死亡的風暴摧枯拉朽，將他所踏之處的一切夷為平地。

en: Our home was swallowed beneath
the great mountain for our complacency.
Now we must prove our value to the Molten One
by sating his hunger for life.
flavourtext:UniqueBootsStr3.Text.zh: 家園被我們自滿之山吞噬。現在必須滿足熔岩者對生命的飢渴來證明我們的價值。

en: We leave a trail, that we may know
where never we will return.
flavourtext:UniqueBootsStr7.Text.zh:
我們預留蹤跡，
避免重蹈覆轍。

en: "Researchers will please refrain from combining our prototypes with existing relics
of power. The temptation is obvious, but the results can be... unpredictable."
- Administrator Qotra
flavourtext:UniqueBootsStr7x.Text.zh:
"研究人員將避免將我們的原型與現有的權力遺跡相結合。
誘惑是顯而易見的，但結果可能是……不可預測的。"
- 主管卡特拉

en: Stand and lead the righteous pride,
Fight till death, never hide.
flavourtext:UniqueBootsStrDex1.Text.zh:
壯志豪情戰歌唱，
正面交鋒、絕不躲藏。

en: "Twelve dead, and the seventh lab cannot be entered for several years.
Prototype #12 is a 'success,' if we can ever reach it."
flavourtext:UniqueBootsStrDex1x.Text.zh:
"十二人喪生，並且第七實驗室無法進入幾年。
如果我們能夠達到，原型 #12 就是一個「成功」的。"

en: "Sirrius flew on wings of light, faster than wind, faster
than thought. But try as he might to outrun the darkness,
it was there, at every turn, waiting for him."
- Azmerian legend
flavourtext:UniqueBootsStrDex2.Text.zh:
「西里烏斯超越狂風，力振光輝雙翼
穿越沉靜思緒， 在他挑戰凌駕黑暗之際，
那暗影總是無所不在，四處遷移。」
- 阿茲莫里傳說

en: "A lick of shadow may ease
the petty frictions of one's life."
- Inquisitor Maligaro
flavourtext:UniqueBootsStrDex3.Text.zh:
「落入黑暗之中
讓人忘卻生命中的無謂爭吵。」
- 審判者馬雷葛蘿

en: The cursed ghosts march forever,
On their hopeless last endeavour.
flavourtext:UniqueBootsStrDex4.Text.zh:
受詛亡魂永世行軍，
踏上必敗無疑的遠征。

en: Corruption sweeps across this land,
but our bloodline is clear.
It is our duty to keep it so.
flavourtext:UniqueBootsStrDex5.Text.zh: 汙染散遍此地，我們的血族確保持清澈。這是我們的職責。

en: A bird, too heavily laden, cannot take flight.
The First of the Sky teaches us to put aside our possessions
so that we may live more freely.
flavourtext:UniqueBootsStrDex6.Text.zh:
鳥如果負重過重，則無法飛翔。
初始之天教導我們把我們的佔有慾拋開
這樣我們能活得更自在。

en: All that was loved, all that was hated -
naught remains but ash.
flavourtext:UniqueBootsStrDex7.Text.zh:
所有被愛，被恨的人-
沒有灰燼，只有灰燼。

en: Pray that the flames find fascination,
for the true end follows when the great eye closes.
flavourtext:UniqueBootsStrDex8.Text.zh:
祈求火焰能著迷，因為當大眼閉上時，
真正的結局隨之而來。

en: All your tomorrows lie ahead of you,
unknown and snarled to the very last.
flavourtext:UniqueBootsStrDex9.Text.zh:
你的所有明天都在你面前，
未知而錯綜複雜，直到最後。

en: Tempest's power given form,
Flee before the walking storm.
flavourtext:UniqueBootsStrInt1.Text.zh:
風暴成形，初生乍現，
伺機而動，逃出生天。

en: Alberon walked among the accursed,
and they welcomed him.
flavourtext:UniqueBootsStrInt2.Text.zh:
阿爾貝隆踱向詛咒之淵，
而那狐群狗黨露出巴結的嘴臉

en: "Starving test subject became completely incapable of exerting force.
However, after being fed, he began to poison everything he touched..."
flavourtext:UniqueBootsStrInt2x.Text.zh:
"飢餓的測試對像變得完全不能施加力。
然而，在被餵飽之後，他開始中毒他所碰到的一切…"

en: To extend your life as long as possible
is to extend all the maladies that come with it.
flavourtext:UniqueBootsStrInt4.Text.zh:
延長你的壽命
一併延長伴隨著的疫病。

en: The Master of a Million Faces lived by one
simple ethos: why make the effort, when
you can simply mimic what others have?
flavourtext:UniqueBootsStrInt5.Text.zh:
百萬面孔之主生活在一種簡單的信仰中：
為什麼要努力，當你可以簡單地
模仿別人的成就呢？

en: "See without doubt, slay without hesitation."
- Marceus Lioneye of Sarn
flavourtext:UniqueBow1.Text.zh:
「定睛瞄準；毫無遲疑，果斷放箭，轉瞬滅敵」
- 薩恩的穆希爾斯．獅眼

en: The eldritch storm descended upon us, and bruised lightning
rained down. Metal withered and flesh melted before its
arcane power. There was no escape, no shelter. Only despair.
flavourtext:UniqueBow10.Text.zh:
奇異風暴在我頭頂籠罩，
雷霆風暴在我眼前宣洩
秘術讓手上的金屬熔解、生命零凋，
奔逃無路、求助無門！絕望永不止歇...

en: "Toasted or frozen
Or twitching in the light
I'm not fussy
And neither is Death."
- Koralus Doomfletch
flavourtext:UniqueBow11.Text.zh:
「儘管劫運當頭，飽受苦楚，
吾僅留心於手中把握之物，
如同所招致的死亡般，沉默而專注。」
- 「毀滅之弦」寇拉盧斯

en: "Exiled to the sea; what a joke.
I'm more free than I've ever been."
- Captain Weylam "Rot-tooth" Roth of the Black Crest
flavourtext:UniqueBow13.Text.zh:
海上流亡？簡直笑話。
我得到了前所未有的自由。
- 船長．威廉 "爛牙" 黑峰上的羅斯

en: The Eternals commanded an army that need not eat, sleep, or breathe
without the usual depravities of necromancy.
flavourtext:UniqueBow14.Text.zh:
不朽帝國不用喚醒死者的巫術就能指揮著
一批不需要吃飯、睡覺，甚至呼吸的部隊

en: "Admittedly lacking the finesse of the fabled original,
Prototype #4 achieved identical results through brute force alone."
flavourtext:UniqueBow14x.Text.zh:
"誠然缺乏傳說中的原版，
原型 #4 僅僅通過蠻力就獲得了相同的結果。"

en: Night's frost becomes morning's dew
Darkness cleansed, pure and new.
flavourtext:UniqueBow15.Text.zh:
夜晚的冰會化為清晨的露水
連黑暗也能被淨化，純淨嶄新

en: "The wild takes care of its own."
- Hyrri of the Karui
flavourtext:UniqueBow2.Text.zh:
「荒野自有生存之道。」
- 卡魯族的西里

en: Through droughts, fires, floods and frost,
the ancient giants stand resolute,
while deep in the rich, dark earth,
their grasp stretches ever farther.
flavourtext:UniqueBow20.Text.zh:
經歷乾旱、祝融、洪水和霜凍
古代巨人屹立不搖
在最深、最黑暗的地底
他們仍持續往前

en: Their last thoughts were not of their friends,
or their families, or their homes.
Their last thoughts were untethered from reality,
and bathed in fear and ferocity.
flavourtext:UniqueBow21.Text.zh:
他們最後所思不是他們的朋友，
他們的家庭、或他們的家園。
他們最後所思被現實釋放，
並沉浸在恐懼和兇惡中。

en: "There were no survivors. It had only been fired twice."
- Order of the Djinn inscription
flavourtext:UniqueBow22.Text.zh:
"它只發射兩次。無人生還。"
- 巨靈教團－題詞

en: To eat, to feast, to forget the horror of endless agonising existence
if but for a moment... only to disgorge and do it all again...
flavourtext:UniqueBow23.Text.zh:
吃飯、大餐、忘記無盡痛苦存在的恐懼，
只要片刻…只是吐出，然後再做一遍…

en: "I loosed a volley of arrows into the heart of the man
who slew my beloved. There was no satisfaction, no
healing, no revenge. There was only... emptiness."
- Chieftainess Ahuana of the Ramako Tribe
flavourtext:UniqueBow24.Text.zh:
"當我向殺害我所愛之人的內心
發射一串箭矢時，並沒有任何滿足、療癒
或復仇。只有...空虛。"
- 雷默科部落女酋長阿呼阿娜

en: Fear flies by night,
a bone, cold as death,
all that remains
of hope's whisper.
flavourtext:UniqueBow25.Text.zh:
「恐懼在黑夜中飛掠，
那骨頭，冷若死寂，
是希望低語中
僅存的殘響。」

en: "So long as a single flame flickers, our akhara lives.
And when there is nothing left to give to the fire,
we shall burn the enemy for warmth!"
- Varashta, the Winter Sekhema
flavourtext:UniqueBow26.Text.zh:
"只要仍有一縷火焰閃爍，我們的血脈便仍然存續。
而當再也沒有什麼能獻給火焰之時，
我們便燃燒敵人來取暖！"
— 瓦拉什塔．冬之絲克瑪

en: "Hope? There is no such thing! We are all rotting flesh,
stuck here on this world to torture each other. Hope
is a mistake, and we will show you its folly."
- Batoor, of the Afarud
flavourtext:UniqueBow27.Text.zh:
"希望？那種東西並不存在！我們全都是腐爛的血肉，
被困在這個世界上彼此折磨。希望
本身就是一種錯誤，而我們將向你證明它的愚蠢。"
— 阿法魯德的巴托爾

en: The mournful music of the strings,
The creaking arch, the arrow sings.
A choking cry, a rattled breath,
The Reaper's Song, the Harp of Death.
flavourtext:UniqueBow3.Text.zh:
萬里征途撫弦悼，
號角起、羽矢嘯，唯聞百里傷殘號；
一世戰魂撥琴梢，
生靈息、干戈倒，只望七步亡魂招。

en: "The rain of a thousand quills that whittle
present into past, life into death."
- Rigwald of the Ezomytes
flavourtext:UniqueBow4.Text.zh:
「萬矢齊發，戰事皆往，生者皆亡。」
- 艾茲麥人瑞佛

en: "How did you manage to lodge arrows in every single test subject
and researcher in Lab Three simultaneously?"
- Doctor Bircus
flavourtext:UniqueBow4x.Text.zh:
"如何設法同時在三個實驗中的
每個測試對象和研究人員中放置箭頭？"
- 醫生比爾庫斯

en: "The Spirit of War knows nothing of good and evil.
It knows only destruction."
- Sekhema Asenath
flavourtext:UniqueBow5.Text.zh:
「戰爭惡火不分善惡，
只想毀滅世間一切。」
- 絲克瑪．安賽娜絲

en: As a soldier you want to get close to enemy archers.
That is not the case when fighting the Maraketh.
flavourtext:UniqueBow6.Text.zh:
一般而言，應付弓箭手的最佳對策就是貼近作白刃戰；
但這不適用於馬拉克斯的弓箭手身上。

en: Mark us with mercy, then press on with care,
Execute us steadily, notch away at our despair.
flavourtext:UniqueBow7.Text.zh:
瞄準時心懷慈悲，放箭時全神貫注
將我們一擊斃命，讓我們不再受苦。

en: "How did you manage to lodge arrows in every single test subject
and researcher in Lab Three simultaneously... again?"
- Doctor Bircus
flavourtext:UniqueBow7x.Text.zh:
"你如何同時在實驗室三中的
每個測試對象和研究人員中刺入箭呢？"
- 醫生比爾庫斯

en: Centuries of development in steel armoursmithing
turned the armies of the Eternal Empire
into very effective lightning rods.
flavourtext:UniqueBow8.Text.zh:
鍛鋼鑄簇數世紀，
保衛帝國禦侵襲，
電光疾矢瞬滅敵。

en: "Beware. Prototype #91 is haunted by a strange miasma,
an odour of evil. Nothing can shield the senses."
- Researcher Arn
flavourtext:UniqueBow9x.Text.zh:
"要小心。原型 #91 被一種奇怪的蟲，
一種惡臭所困擾。沒有什麼可以掩蓋感官的。"
- 研究員昂恩

en: "Political power is an illusion.
Popular power is fickle.
Financial power is real and loyal."
- Cadiro Perandus, Lord of the Coin
flavourtext:UniqueChest1.Text.zh:
權幻名虛何足道，
唯有錢貲萬年行。
- 大財主卡迪羅．普蘭德斯

en: A captain's first love is his ship.
They either die together,
or forever linger apart.
flavourtext:UniqueChest10.Text.zh:
船長的初戀，他心愛的船。
一同沉入大海，或永遠徘徊。

en: "Treasure that which the Ancestors have gifted you.
For it can be gone between one breath and the next."
- Lavianga, Advisor to Kaom
flavourtext:UniqueChest2.Text.zh:
「須知祖宗遺緒難守易失，
點滴絲毫望君珍之重之。」
- 岡姆諫臣拉維安加

en: "A fool steps into the unknown.
An explorer finds his way back again."
- Malachai, Thaumaturge Laureate
flavourtext:UniqueChest3.Text.zh:
「愚者行事，霧中跌宕
智者行事，躊躇自得」
- 首席奇術師瑪拉凱

en: What is stronger, the stone or the wind?
Look to the east. Do you see a single stone still standing amongst the dunes?
- Sekhema Deshret
flavourtext:UniqueChest4.Text.zh:
何者為強，石或風？
向東方看去。你有看到任何一塊石頭豎立於沙丘中嗎？
- 絲克瑪迪虛瑞特

en: An era so ingrained with decadence, greed and cruelty
that even the graves of murderers were gilded.
flavourtext:UniqueChest5.Text.zh:
一個根深蒂固於衰敗，貪婪，和殘酷的年代
甚至殺人犯的墳墓上都鍍了金。

en: Little makes it across the dry plains
to the foot of the mountain alive.
The mountain dwellers ensure nothing reaches the top.
flavourtext:UniqueChest6.Text.zh:
幾乎無人能活著穿過乾枯之地
到達山腳之下。
山裡的居民更確保著無人能夠到達山頂。

en: The caustic fumes that rise from the caldera
kill nearly everything downwind eventually.
The Redblade, however, just go mad.
flavourtext:UniqueChest7.Text.zh:
火山口飄散的腐蝕雲霧
最終殺死了下風處的所有生命。
然而紅刃只是變的瘋狂。

en: For generations, the gentle Pondium tides
sheltered the smugglers, murderers and thieves,
and let their resentment and population flourish.
flavourtext:UniqueChest8.Text.zh:
世世代代以來，龐迪姆溫柔的潮汐
藏匿著盜賊、走私、殺人犯，
使他們的人口和怨恨逐漸繁榮。

en: As if pulled by divine strings,
the powerful are drawn to the powerful,
breaking any morals and laws that might stand in the way.
flavourtext:UniqueChest9.Text.zh:
像是被神聖之繩牽繫著，
強大的力量被強大的力量吸引，
打破任何道德和法律的阻礙。

en: Just an ordinary barrel, used to store sensible objects.
Not swarms of things.
flavourtext:UniqueChestBarrel1.Text.zh:
只是個平凡的木桶，裝著一些世俗之物
絕對，絕對沒有一些讓人頭皮發麻的蟲群

en: The champions rest now, free from pain,
Their souls ascend to the sun.
Some parting gifts are all that remain,
Their eternal vigil is done.
flavourtext:UniqueChestGrandmaster1.Text.zh:
英雄們皆已安息，遠離傷痛，他們的靈魂已昇華進烈陽之中。
永恆的守護已經結束，遺留下的是感謝勇士們的獎勵。

en: The objects Oba valued more than his life,
sealed from the corruption that ultimately took it.
flavourtext:UniqueChestMap9.Text.zh:
歐霸所珍惜之物更勝其生命，
因此將其於崩毀之前封印永存。

en: Prospero smiles upon you, fair traveller.
Step close, take a chance, and try fortune's fare!
flavourtext:UniqueChestVentors.Text.zh:
普洛斯彼羅正對著你微笑，美麗的旅人。
走近一步，碰碰運氣，來試試命運的款待吧！

en: Whispered memory,
A shimmer in the darkness.
Forgotten no more.
flavourtext:UniqueClassicMap1.Text.zh:
回憶中的輕聲細語，
彷彿黑暗中的光輝，
不再受到世人遺忘。

en: The darkest clouds clashed and coupled,
giving birth to four lightning children of hate.
flavourtext:UniqueClaw1.Text.zh:
烏雲密布，相互碰撞交疊
激發出四道仇恨的雷電。

en: What drives us to kill, to carve and to shred?
What drives us to drink the seething souls of the dead?
What drives us to love and to hold, but still go amiss?
What drives us to leave this world for the Abyss?
flavourtext:UniqueClaw10.Text.zh:
是什麼讓我們殺戮、追獵？
是什麼讓我們渴求喝下亡者的靈魂？
是什麼讓我們珍惜，卻又在流亡？
是什麼讓我們遠離塵世，墜入深淵？

en: "Test subject was able to survive the entire process simply by shouting epithets at
the researcher. Researcher's feelings were slightly injured."
- Researcher Graven
flavourtext:UniqueClaw10x.Text.zh:
"測試對象僅需對研究人員大喊大叫就可以在
整個過程中倖存下來。研究人員的感覺受到了輕微傷害。"
- 研究員格雷文

en: Terror doesn't make you jump.
Terror makes you run.
flavourtext:UniqueClaw13.Text.zh:
恐懼不會讓你跳起
恐懼讓你拔腿奔跑

en: Grip the frozen steel, feel it numb you.
Wield the cold touch of death like
a splinter of your own shattered heart.
flavourtext:UniqueClaw14.Text.zh:
握緊冰凍的鋼鐵，感受麻木。
支配冰冷的死亡之觸，
像是你碎裂的心臟之碎片。

en: With increasing mastery over death
comes an increasing desire for it.
flavourtext:UniqueClaw15.Text.zh: 當越能掌握死亡，也意味著你更加地渴望它。

en: She carries us and nurtures us
until we must feed upon each other.
She carries us and nurtures us
until we must feed upon each other.
flavourtext:UniqueClaw16Royale.Text.zh:
她承載著我們，養育著我們，
直到我們必須以彼此為食。

en: She thinks and we act.
She acts and we think.
Fragments of the whole that washes clean the skies.
flavourtext:UniqueClaw17.Text.zh:
她的思想，使我們動作。
她的動作，使我們思考。
完整的碎片洗淨天空。

en: To discover how cruel nature can be,
you need only shake the wrong branch.
flavourtext:UniqueClaw18.Text.zh:
要知道大自然是多麼無情，
你只需要搖動錯的枝幹。

en: Fear blisters the heart and thins the blood.
Fear squeezes lungs and sets the guts to fester.
Fear is the wound left untended.
flavourtext:UniqueClaw2.Text.zh:
恐懼讓心臟為之奔騰、血液化為濁流，
肺囊因此瑟縮、胃袋滿溢腥臭，
恐懼彷彿那置之不理的腐爛傷口。

en: "For the life of the flesh will always be in the blood."
- Atalui, Vaal Priestess
flavourtext:UniqueClaw3.Text.zh:
「血流殆盡，肉體必滅。」
- 瓦爾女祭司

en: "An absurdly vicious weapon in the hands of our test subjects. It seems to
channel the desperate will to live. Intriguing."
- Researcher Olesya
flavourtext:UniqueClaw4x_.Text.zh:
"在我們的測試人員手中，這是一種荒謬的惡性武器。
它似乎在引導人們拼命生存的意願。有趣。"
- 研究員奧莉西亞

en: It's cold and dark where the leviathan sleeps.
Colder and darker than death.
- Old Sailor's saying
flavourtext:UniqueClaw5.Text.zh:
海怪潛伏在黑暗冰冷的海底，
牠的恐怖更勝死亡的氣息。
- 老水手的叮嚀

en: "When the hyena howls thrice
death is sure to follow."
-Maraketh Wisdom
flavourtext:UniqueClaw6_.Text.zh:
「當鬣狗發出三聲嗥叫，
獵物必定無法逃脫死亡的煎熬。」
- 馬拉克斯人古老智慧

en: Tread lightly, lest their vigil find you.
Speak softly, lest their reason fend you.
Cut gently, lest their spirit haunt you.
flavourtext:UniqueClaw7.Text.zh:
躡手躡足，莫讓夜衛發現你。
低聲細語，莫讓他人頂撞你。
輕柔奪命，莫讓冤魂糾纏你。

en: There are two things to know about fighting:
When to swing like crazy, and when to run.
flavourtext:UniqueClaw9.Text.zh: 戰鬥兩項要領：適時狂攻、適時逃跑。

en: There is no price you can give eternal life
that some would not pay.
flavourtext:UniqueCorruptedJewel11.Text.zh:
永生若有代價
人人皆願支付。

en: "You know what to do with this, don't you?" - Researcher Graven
"Kill test subjects for their vitality?" - Researcher Olesya
"That is not what he meant." - Researcher Arn
flavourtext:UniqueCorruptedJewel14x.Text.zh:
"你知道該怎麼做，不是嗎？"- 研究員格雷文
"殺死受試者以檢查他們的生命力嗎？"- 研究員奧莉西亞
"那不是他的意思。"- 研究員昂恩

en: "Release the type Delta test subjects. Unseal all prototype lockers.
Arm yourself! I know that, as researchers, you've never had to fight
before, but they're coming to kill us all. It's resist or die!"
- Lead Researcher Ksaret, two hours post-Incident
flavourtext:UniqueCorruptedJewel16x.Text.zh:
"釋放 Delta 測試對象。解封所有原型儲物櫃。
武裝自己！我知道，作為研究人員，
你們以前從未必須戰鬥，但他們正來殺我們。要麼反抗，要麼死亡！"
- 首席研究員卡薩雷特，在事件發生兩小時後

en: "Our defenses are failing at Outpost One. We can't hold out much
longer. All outposts, abandon your stations! Escape while you can!"
- Lead Researcher Ksaret, three hours post-Incident
flavourtext:UniqueCorruptedJewel17x.Text.zh:
"一號哨站的防禦正在失敗。我們無法再堅持多久。
所有哨站，放棄你們的崗位！趁你們還能逃走！"
- 首席研究員卡薩雷特，在事件發生三小時後

en: "The suppression troops have stopped responding to my orders.
I'm no longer in charge, and I likely never truly was... I suspect
they're already coming for us."
- Lead Researcher Ksaret, one hour post-Incident
flavourtext:UniqueCorruptedJewel18x.Text.zh:
"鎮壓部隊已經不再回應我的命令。
我不再掌握局勢，而且我很可能從未真正擁有過…我懷疑
他們已經來找我們了。"
- 首席研究員卡薩雷特，在事件發生一小時後

en: The Vaal used human sacrifice to power their empire.
They, too, eventually sought means to
make their machines run more efficiently.
flavourtext:UniqueCorruptedJewel4.Text.zh:
瓦爾人以活人獻祭，祈求天佑帝國。
但最終還是背棄神祈，全心改良戰爭機械。

en: Atziri went to great lengths to ensure her immortality,
but nothing is eternal.
flavourtext:UniqueCorruptedJewel5.Text.zh: 阿茲里費盡多年心血，力求長生不死，奈何萬物終有窮盡。

en: In their final days, every crime was punishable by death.
Atziri's empire ran on blood, but the blood was running dry.
flavourtext:UniqueCorruptedJewel6.Text.zh: 罪愆之罰，即為滅亡。阿茲里以殺戮流血鞏固帝國，奈何血已漸漸流盡。

en: Even a millennium later, Atziri's presence
casts a shroud over Wraeclast.
flavourtext:UniqueCorruptedJewel7.Text.zh:
即使千年過後，阿茲里的存在
依然為瓦爾克拉斯帶來死亡陰霾。

en: "The Vaal left a thousand warnings behind.
We ignored every single one."
- Siosa, the Last Scholar
flavourtext:UniqueCorruptedJewel8.Text.zh:
「瓦爾人種種警告言猶在耳。
只是我們一概充耳未聞。」
-末代學者薩歐賽

en: Few living things survived the cleansing flames.
Those that did thrived...
And changed...
flavourtext:UniqueCorruptedJewel9.Text.zh:
淨化火炎燒夷，活物倖存無幾
終得生生不息…發生變異…

en: Divine intervention feels better
when you do it yourself.
flavourtext:UniqueDagger1.Text.zh:
替天行道，大快人心，
親手除惡，更是快意。

en: A tap on the shoulder
A peck on the cheek
A sip of your wine
So red and so sleek
flavourtext:UniqueDagger11.Text.zh:
拍肩、
啄頸、
啜酒、
紅潤滑順之酒

en: "I'm a painter, and crimson is my chosen hue."
- Coralito, Brotherhood of Silence
flavourtext:UniqueDagger12.Text.zh:
「吾乃畫者，深紅為吾所選擇之顏料」
- 寂靜聯盟克拉里多

en: "Prototype #131 must never be allowed near anyone who bears a wound, no
matter how slight. Even a tiny cut makes it exponentially more dangerous."
flavourtext:UniqueDagger12x.Text.zh:
"原型 #131 絕對不允許在任何有傷口的人附近，無論
有多輕。即使很小的切口也會使其成倍增加危險。"

en: Love only death
For she shall never let you go.
flavourtext:UniqueDagger13.Text.zh:
愛上死亡吧
因為她絕不會放你走的

en: The Maraketh fear very little,
but they dare not whisper the name
of the demon that flies on Winter's gales.
flavourtext:UniqueDagger17.Text.zh:
馬拉克斯族驍勇善戰
但他們仍無法講出在寒冷疾風中
飛翔的惡魔名諱。

en: Lava bled from the earth and,
after a time, cooled and hardened.
The world protecting its beating heart
with a thick, black scab.
flavourtext:UniqueDagger18.Text.zh:
大地流著岩漿的血，
時間將它，冷卻和凝固。
世界用厚厚、發黑的痂
保護著它跳動的心臟。

en: "Researchers will refrain from scaring each other by firing ice spears while holding
Prototype #141. Sooner or later, someone's going to lose an eye."
- Administrator Qotra
flavourtext:UniqueDagger19x.Text.zh:
“研究人員將避免在手持時發射冰矛來互相驚嚇
原型 #141。 遲早有人會因此失明。"
- 主管卡特拉

en: The shadow warrior moves like the wind;
his strikes land long after he is gone.
flavourtext:UniqueDagger20.Text.zh:
影子武士像風一樣運動；
他走了很久以後罷工就降落了。

en: "That bronze girl sure knows how to cut someone down to size!"
- Bertrand the Plush
flavourtext:UniqueDagger21.Text.zh:
"那個青銅女孩肯定知道如何將某人切成小碎塊！"
– 長毛貝特朗

en: That which we cannot forgive
harms all those we hold dear.
flavourtext:UniqueDagger22.Text.zh:
那些我們無法原諒的，
終將傷害我們所珍視的一切。

en: Unwieldy and garish became graceful
and deadly in Ungil's nimble hands.
flavourtext:UniqueDagger3.Text.zh:
藉由恩吉的矯健身手，
劣劍頑鐵也能成殺人利器。

en: "Recommend further production of Prototype #122. It makes
an ideal weapon for our suppression troops and guards."
flavourtext:UniqueDagger3x.Text.zh:
“建議進一步生產原型 #122。
是我們鎮壓部隊和後衛的理想武器。"

en: A heart can be stabbed by thoughts,
If your mind is sharp enough.
flavourtext:UniqueDagger4.Text.zh:
銳利思維讓秘密無法躲藏，
甚至足以刺探欺瞞的心臟。

en: "There is something incredibly satisfying about impaling test
subjects with Ethereal Knives. Perhaps it is the sound -
the spell, the screams, or both."  - Researcher Olesya
flavourtext:UniqueDagger4x.Text.zh:
"用空靈刀刺穿測試對像有些令人難以置信的滿足。
也許是聲音-咒語，尖叫聲或兩者都有。"
- 研究員奧莉西亞

en: Maligaro considered his work an Art,
and his subjects his canvas.
flavourtext:UniqueDagger5.Text.zh:
馬雷葛蘿自認筆下盡出絕世藝術，
千萬臣民皆為他精緻畫布。

en: A fang of hellfire, chip of frost,
Lightning flickers, blade embossed.
With dagger clenched, into the fray!
Or draw it out, and cast away.
flavourtext:UniqueDagger6.Text.zh:
煉獄內火海冰霜，
電光閃動，刀劍雕妝。
匕首磨損，緊握不放！
抽刀出鞘，棄之一旁。

en: Calling it poison would imply
that it was even edible.
flavourtext:UniqueDagger8.Text.zh:
毒發身亡的獵物
經過妥善的處理也能成為美味的食物。

en: Nothing is pure.
Slice open the Innocent
And spill a thousand Sins.
flavourtext:UniqueDagger9.Text.zh:
純潔，是個用來欺騙世人的詞彙。
一旦將那聖潔的假象切開，
你將見識到漫無邊際深沉無比的黑暗。

en: Into darkness, horror, madness...
So goes the descent.
flavourtext:UniqueDescentBelt1.Text.zh:
邁入那黑暗、驚懼、瘋狂...
來生將謹記不忘。

en: Into darkness, horror, madness...
So goes the descent.
flavourtext:UniqueDescentBow1.Text.zh:
邁入那黑暗、驚懼、瘋狂...
來生將謹記不忘。

en: Into darkness, horror, madness...
So goes the descent.
flavourtext:UniqueDescentClaw1.Text.zh: 黑暗、驚懼、瘋狂...乃墮落之真諦。

en: Into darkness, horror, madness...
So goes the descent.
flavourtext:UniqueDescentDagger1.Text.zh:
邁入那黑暗、驚懼、瘋狂...
來生將謹記不忘。

en: Into darkness, horror, madness...
So goes the descent.
flavourtext:UniqueDescentHelmet1.Text.zh:
邁入那黑暗、驚懼、瘋狂...
來生將謹記不忘。

en: Into darkness, horror, madness...
So goes the descent.
flavourtext:UniqueDescentOneHandAxe1.Tex.zh:
邁入那黑暗、驚懼、瘋狂...
來生將謹記不忘。

en: Into darkness, horror, madness...
So goes the descent.
flavourtext:UniqueDescentOneHandMace1.Te.zh:
邁入那黑暗、驚懼、瘋狂...
來生將謹記不忘。

en: Into darkness, horror, madness...
So goes the descent.
flavourtext:UniqueDescentOneHandSword1.T.zh: 黑暗、驚懼、瘋狂...乃墮落之真諦。

en: Into darkness, horror, madness...
So goes the descent.
flavourtext:UniqueDescentQuiver1.Text.zh:
邁入那黑暗、驚懼、瘋狂...
來生將謹記不忘。

en: Into darkness, horror, madness...
So goes the descent.
flavourtext:UniqueDescentShield1.Text.zh:
邁入那黑暗、驚懼、瘋狂...
來生將謹記不忘。

en: Into darkness, horror, madness...
So goes the descent.
flavourtext:UniqueDescentStaff1.Text.zh:
邁入那黑暗、驚懼、瘋狂...
來生將謹記不忘。

en: Into darkness, horror, madness...
So goes the descent.
flavourtext:UniqueDescentTwoHandSword1.T.zh:
邁入那黑暗、驚懼、瘋狂...
來生將謹記不忘。

en: Into darkness, horror, madness...
So goes the descent.
flavourtext:UniqueDescentWand1.Text.zh:
邁入那黑暗、驚懼、瘋狂...
來生將謹記不忘。

en: Fairgraves' trusty tricorne accompanied him far across
the seas, deep under the ground, and even beyond death.
flavourtext:UniqueDexHelmet1.Text.zh:
費爾的皮帽陪他飄洋過海，
即使入土為安，依然伴其屍骸。

en: Give of your heated passions.
Give of your cold resolve.
You will be repaid.
flavourtext:UniqueDexHelmet2.Text.zh:
投注炙熱感情。
秉持不移堅定。
迎向燦爛光明。

en: Give a man a fish, and you can feed him for a day.
But give a fish a man, and you can feed it for a month.
flavourtext:UniqueFishingRod1.Text.zh:
人以魚為食，僅能止飢一餐；
魚以人為飼，足可飽食數日。

en: He cast far into the ocean
And tore out her heart.
flavourtext:UniqueFishingRod2.Text.zh:
他深入遠洋
撕裂了她的心

en: Knowledge is fermented in pain and loss
Distilled with reflection
To quench the thirst of those
who dream of enlightenment
flavourtext:UniqueFlask1.Text.zh:
苦痛失去，智慧得以發酵
回想省過，智慧得以蒸餾
凡渴慕啟悟者
得以一嚐鎮渴

en: Let blood sear in your veins,
Let the pain push outwards and turn away your enemy's blows.
flavourtext:UniqueFlask10.Text.zh:
讓你的血液在血管中沸騰
讓肉體的痛楚揮發，將敵人的攻擊化為烏有

en: To achieve godhood, they would cast off all that god has gifted us.
Mortality, compassion, even the sanctity of flesh.
- High Templar Voll
flavourtext:UniqueFlask13.Text.zh:
要成神，必先棄神之賜
生命、心靈、和神聖的軀體
- 聖宗福爾

en: As man sins,
God weeps.
"Success! Prototype #54 has tapped into that sliver of divinity that exists within.
Faith fuels the flesh, and the flesh fuels the fire..."
flavourtext:UniqueFlask15x.Text.zh:
"成功！ 原型 #54 已進入存在於其中的神聖碎片。
信仰助長了肉體，肉體增長了火…"

en: "Proof that if you devote yourself to a god of death,
you may be spared from its wrath."
- Icius Perandus, Antiquities Collection, Item 408
flavourtext:UniqueFlask16.Text.zh:
"證明如果你獻身於死神，
你可能會免受其憤怒。"
- 伊席厄斯．普蘭德斯，古物收藏家，物品編號 408

en: Travelers of the deep wood speak of a witch
whose ale provides a different kind
of liquid courage.
flavourtext:UniqueFlask18.Text.zh:
叢林深處的旅人述說著女巫
她釀的酒能給你特別的
借酒壯膽之勇氣。

en: "Think of those that cursed us, judged us,
and burned our sisters upon the pyre.
Think of their names as you drink,
and even their children will feel what we do to them today."
-Vadinya, to her coven
flavourtext:UniqueFlask19.Text.zh:
"想起詛咒、批判我們的人，
將我們架上柴堆焚燒的兇手，
想起他們的名子，喝下吧！
令他們的子孫也能感受到，
今日回敬他們的苦痛。"
- 瓦蒂雅

en: "Nobody will listen to me, because I'm the only one that sees it.
Nothing left to do now but drink until this world makes sense."
- Researcher Graven
flavourtext:UniqueFlask19x.Text.zh:
"沒有人會聽我說的話，因為我是唯一看到它的人。
現在唯一的事情就是喝酒，直到這個世界變得有意義。"
- 研究員格雷文

en: Doedre Darktongue knew the Way of the Thaumaturge.
In order to receive, one must give... without hesitation.
flavourtext:UniqueFlask2.Text.zh:
德瑞．黑暗之舌深諳奇術的協奏曲：
追求力量的共鳴，獻祭絕不能猶豫。

en: All things must die.
Whether you burn out or explode is up to you.
flavourtext:UniqueFlask20.Text.zh:
燃燒始盡、爆炸，
一切必須毀滅。

en: And from the ashes he rose, like a black cloud.
The Sin of one became the Sin of many.
flavourtext:UniqueFlask21.Text.zh:
餘燼中他升起，黑霄漫佈。
獨自的罪過成為眾人的惡行。

en: The summer sun dries the soil and burns the leaves.
The autumn rain extinguishes the flames.
The spring bloom shades the wet earth.
Nature is an eternal tug of war.
flavourtext:UniqueFlask22.Text.zh:
夏日炎陽，曬乾了樹葉、
燃燒了大地，則由秋雨澆熄，
而春天的綻放陰晦了濕土。
大自然，永恆的競爭。

en: "What cruelty it is, that to be judged a success,
such great work must go uncredited."
- Coralito, Brotherhood of Silence
flavourtext:UniqueFlask23.Text.zh:
"這麼完美的作品，為了成功，
無法歸功於任何人，是多麼的殘酷，"
沉默兄弟會，克拉里多

en: Freedom is for the privileged, even in death.
<default>{This item can be transformed on the Altar of Sacrifice along with Vial of the Ghost}
flavourtext:UniqueFlask25.Text.zh:
自由是特權，即使是死亡。

<default>{此物品可與亡靈之罈於獻祭之壇上改造}

en: "What care have I for their pain? They're already dead."
- Atalui, Vaal Priestess
flavourtext:UniqueFlask26.Text.zh:
"我對他們的痛苦有何關係？他們已經死透了"
- 阿特路伊瓦爾女祭司

en: Olroth the Gallant,
tireless and true,
he fights for me,
he fights for you!
flavourtext:UniqueFlask29.Text.zh:
勇敢的奧爾羅斯，
不知疲倦和真實，
他為我而戰，
他為你而戰！

en: "Kaom fought and killed for his people.
Kaom bled for his people.
And so the people gave, the people bled,
So their King might go on."
- Lavianga, Advisor to Kaom
flavourtext:UniqueFlask3.Text.zh:
「岡姆為人民奮戰、殘殺、
甚至不惜讓身體任刀刃踐踏；
子民的榮譽心因此萌芽，
跟隨君王征服天下。」
- 岡姆軍師拉維安加

en: Uhtred and his priests drank of the skies
to empower runes... and themselves.
flavourtext:UniqueFlask30.Text.zh:
烏特雷和他的牧師喝了天空
來增強符文…還有他們自己。

en: Nothing endures. All things end.
Then, they begin again.
flavourtext:UniqueFlask31_.Text.zh:
沒有什麼是長久的。一切都會結束。
然後，他們又開始了。

en: Vorana trained her mercenaries
thus: strike true and survive.
flavourtext:UniqueFlask32.Text.zh:
沃拉娜如此訓練她的傭兵：
真正做到，並生存下來。

en: They were bred in a cosmic ocean of raw creation.
Feasting and drinking of the milk of the mother,
they fought to the death for every last drop.
flavourtext:UniqueFlask33.Text.zh:
它們是在原始創造的宇宙海洋中培育出來的。
大吃大喝，喝母乳，
每一滴都拼到死。

en: Ennui prevailed, until inspiration sparked
a mote of flame, kindled by fury
and all in his path were obliterated.
flavourtext:UniqueFlask34.Text.zh:
無趣佔了上風，直到靈感點燃了一顆火焰，
被憤怒點燃，擋在他面前的一切
都被抹殺了。

en: "To proclaim a vision of the future is to make it so,
for those that have the will, and the way!"
- High Templar Andronicus
flavourtext:UniqueFlask35.Text.zh:
「擁有過人意志和手段，方能化願景為真實！」
- 聖宗安羅尼庫斯

en: "Let us share our thirsts. Yours, for power,
and mine, for death. A stable alliance,
so long as you never speak my name..."
flavourtext:UniqueFlask36.Text.zh:
「讓我們共享渴望吧。
 你的，是對力量的渴求；
 而我的，是對死亡的饑渴。
 這將是穩固的同盟——
 只要你永遠別呼喚我的名字……」

en: There was no grand contest or battle with Tasalio that day.
Captain Brinehook Vex drank and sang merry with Karui warriors
on the high seas. Only later did he realise who he had met.
flavourtext:UniqueFlask37a.Text.zh:
那天，與塔薩里奧之間並沒有什麼盛大的競賽或戰鬥。
布琳霍克．維克斯船長與卡魯戰士們在公海上
開懷暢飲、高歌歡慶。直到後來，他才意識到自己遇見了誰。

en: On that fateful day, beset by tempest, Captain Brinehook Vex
came face to face with the blustering Karui god of thunder,
Valako himself. A wager was had, and a wager was won.
flavourtext:UniqueFlask37b.Text.zh:
在那命運攸關的一天，風暴大作，布琳霍克．維克斯船長
與狂暴的卡魯雷神—瓦拉庫本人面面相覷。
他們立下了賭注，而賭注贏了。

en: "When the Ancestors fill your cup,
It is only good manners to drink your fill."
- Lavianga, Advisor to Kaom
flavourtext:UniqueFlask4.Text.zh:
享受先祖的賞賜時
忌貪嗔痴。」
- 岡姆軍師拉維安加

en: "Death needs not your understanding. It needs only your loyalty."
- Atziri, Queen of the Vaal
flavourtext:UniqueFlask5.Text.zh:
「死亡不求你的理解，它只需要你的奉獻。」 
- 瓦爾女王阿茲里

en: "Yesterday I was clever, so I wanted to change the world.
Today I am wise, so I am changing myself."
-Rumi of the Vaal
flavourtext:UniqueFlask7.Text.zh:
「我曾自視甚高，想要改變這個世界；
如今我已看清，於是試圖改變自己。」
- 瓦爾之魯米。

en: "The most terrifying split second of my life."
- Researcher Graven
flavourtext:UniqueFlask7x.Text.zh:
"我一生中最恐怖的瞬間。"
- 研究員格雷文

en: A sip will freeze your lips,
A swig will chill your heart,
A glass will still your soul.
flavourtext:UniqueFlask8.Text.zh:
淺抿一滴，雙唇發紫；
深飲一口，心臟凍結；
乾盡一杯，靈魂寂滅。

en: A sprinkle of hunger, a spoonful of menace
and three generous cups of Might.
