flavourtext:UniqueFlask9.Text.zh:
過程宛若烹飪：撒上一些飢餓，倒入一匙威脅
再加上三杯滿滿的淫威。

en: Though the battle has been long,
Victory is at hand.
flavourtext:UniqueGlovesDemigods1.Text.zh:
久戰不懈
戰事最終必將告捷。

en: Of ancient giants, none remain,
Their only trace is timeless pain.
flavourtext:UniqueGlovesDex1.Text.zh:
遠古巨人早已蕩然無存，
唯留千秋哀痛，萬世傷痕

en: Maligaro operated effortlessly,
with great speed and terrible consequences.
flavourtext:UniqueGlovesDex2.Text.zh:
馬雷葛蘿奇術出眾卓越，
無比迅捷，帶來無盡浩劫。

en: The fury of the forge determines
the ferocity of the metal.
flavourtext:UniqueGlovesDex3.Text.zh: 鍛冶熱度決定劍身的銳度。

en: Land and sea did not dissuade,
nor did the Kelpie's maw;
the wild beast crossed half the world
to sate his hungry claw.
flavourtext:UniqueGlovesDex4.Text.zh:
陸地與海洋，或是凱爾派的巨口，
都沒有加以勸止；
野獸橫渡了半個世界，
僅為了填充他飢餓的尖爪。

en: Under its influence, shards of metal take on a life of their own, wriggling into flesh,
burrowing into organs, and exploding outwards in search of other victims.
flavourtext:UniqueGlovesDex6.Text.zh:
在金屬碎片的影響下，它們變成了自己的生命，變成肉體，
鑽入器官，然後向外爆炸以尋找其他受害者。

en: Members of the House Azadin are trained from birth to join the
family profession. The target changes, but the job's always the same.
flavourtext:UniqueGlovesDex7.Text.zh: 愛札丁家族自幼便接受本家的專業訓練。雖然追尋的目標有所不同，從事的行業始終如一。

en: "Our flesh is mere machinery;
chemicals and mechanisms.
Drink deeply. Fuel the fire."
flavourtext:UniqueGlovesDex8.Text.zh:
「我們的軀體不過是機械；
化學物質和機構組成由火焰驅動。」

en: A single lightning strike fells a man.
A single knife stroke fells an empire.
flavourtext:UniqueGlovesDexInt1.Text.zh:
一道雷擊，一人命殞魂殆，
一劍穿心，一國改朝換代。

en: A burden shared is a burden made lighter.
The First of the Night teaches us that our burdens
are not just ours to bear, but ours to use against oppressors.
flavourtext:UniqueGlovesDexInt10.Text.zh:
分擔一些重擔使這的重擔輕了一點。
初始之夜教導我們，我們的重擔
不僅僅是我們要承受，也可以用來對抗壓迫者。

en: Great works take time.
<default>{This item can be transformed on the Altar of Sacrifice along with Vial of Dominance}
flavourtext:UniqueGlovesDexInt11.Text.zh:
慢工出細活。

<default>{此物品可與統御之罈於獻祭之壇上改造}

en: Biology is but a machine, begetting effusion of energies;
death is but a curse, that can be given... or reversed.
flavourtext:UniqueGlovesDexInt15.Text.zh:
生物學只是一種機器，能夠積聚能量;
死亡只是一種詛咒，可以給予...或者反過來。

en: "We have methods of interrogation the Inquisitors only dream of."
- Marcus, Brotherhood Liaison
flavourtext:UniqueGlovesDexInt17.Text.zh:
"我們有審訊官夢寐以求的審訊方法。"
- 兄弟會密探馬克思

en: A legion of lives claimed
by the shards of obliterated worlds.
flavourtext:UniqueGlovesDexInt19.Text.zh:
大量生命被
毀滅世界的碎片奪去。

en: The fundamental forces of our world are secrets
to be uncovered by the intelligent and the capable.
Like all secrets, they, too, can be stolen.
flavourtext:UniqueGlovesDexInt20.Text.zh:
我們世界的基本力量
是需要由聰明和有能力的人揭示的秘密。
就像所有秘密一樣，它們也可以被竊取。

en: Napuatzi was meant as a sacrifice to the snakes.
Instead, they offered themselves... as weapons.
flavourtext:UniqueGlovesDexInt21.Text.zh:
納普阿茲本該成為獻祭於蛇的祭品。
 然而，牠們卻獻上自己……化為武器。

en: We moved to be close, yet grew no closer, since the
Breaking of the Sun. We clung to the feet of the Lords,
wailing, weeping, begging for unity. Now, they heed.
flavourtext:UniqueGlovesDexInt22.Text.zh:
「自從太陽破碎之後，
 我們試圖靠近，卻始終無法更近。
 我們匍匐在諸王的腳下，
 哭喊、哀求、乞願著再度合一。
 如今——他們回應了。」

en: The roar of the heavens
Strikes more than fear
Into the hearts of Man
flavourtext:UniqueGlovesDexInt3.Text.zh:
天庭狂嚎震怒
神罰永不饒恕
人心恐懼無助

en: The cards don't choose life and death
That's up to the player.
flavourtext:UniqueGlovesDexInt4.Text.zh:
手中牌無法決生死
局中人方能定死生。

en: "As the serpent shuns thought,
It shuns fear.
It strikes with the speed of wrath
And the skill of compulsion."
- Deshret, The Red Sekhema
flavourtext:UniqueGlovesDexInt5.Text.zh:
「當巨蛇不再多慮，
牠變得無所畏懼。
憤恨難平，迅速殺敵：
展現氣血狂怒的戰技！」
- 赤血絲克瑪迪虛瑞特

en: What is fear but a snuffed torch
and death in the wind?
flavourtext:UniqueGlovesDexInt6.Text.zh:
隨風散播的燎原之火與死亡陰影，
帶來的唯有恐懼。

en: "Decomposition takes hold too quickly!
No, if we are to keep the specimen in perfect shape,
we must begin the process before expiry."
flavourtext:UniqueGlovesDexInt7.Text.zh:
"腐敗分解來的過於迅速！
不，若我們要將實驗體維持在最佳狀態，
我們必須在期限內開始處置。"

en: Reaching nature's limits,
many sought power in the unnatural.
flavourtext:UniqueGlovesDexInt9.Text.zh:
達到自然的極限，
尋求非自然的力量。

en: Those heroes that set foot on Wraeclast found
themselves changing, only subtly at first...
flavourtext:UniqueGlovesExpedition1.Text.zh:
那些踏上瓦爾克拉斯的英雄們發現
自己發生了變化，只是一開始是微妙的…

en: For forty-two nights, the Feller of Heroes challenged
the next greatest warrior to a one-on-one duel.
None could match his might.
flavourtext:UniqueGlovesExpedition2.Text.zh:
四十二個晚上，英雄的伐木者向下一位
最偉大的戰士發起了一對一的決鬥。
沒有人能與之匹敵。

en: Xibaqua's treachery was met with divine fury.
One by one, the gods reclaimed their flesh,
until all that remained was a droplet of pure light:
The first Vaal.
flavourtext:UniqueGlovesInt10.Text.zh:
賽巴昆的背叛遭到了聖怒。
眾神一個接一個地喚回他們的肉體，
直到剩下的只是一縷純光：
初始瓦爾。

en: He reached for his home one last time, a shining jewel among the stars...
only to watch in horror as it ruptured and shattered under a tide of limbs.
flavourtext:UniqueGlovesInt11.Text.zh:
他最後一次伸手去他的家，星星中的一顆閃亮的寶石…
只是驚恐地看著它在四肢的潮汐下破裂和破碎。

en: "You'll feel no pain. All you have to do is run toward
High Templar Andronicus, and we'll let your family go."
- Morengen, of the Brotherhood of Silence
flavourtext:UniqueGlovesInt12.Text.zh:
「你不會感到疼痛。只要朝聖宗安羅尼庫斯跑去，我們就會放過你的家人。」
- 沉默兄弟會的摩倫根

en: While Doedre lacked Maligaro's sense of style,
she surpassed her master in pure malevolence.
flavourtext:UniqueGlovesInt2.Text.zh:
德瑞雖無馬雷葛蘿的才思，
卻能善用她天生的毒刺。

en: "You shall hang, in blissful agony, on my every note."
- Kalisa, Prima Donna of Sarn
flavourtext:UniqueGlovesInt4.Text.zh:
「在座諸君何其有幸，聽我唱出每個音符，
讓你們受盡痛苦，願意慷慨赴死。」
- 薩恩名伶卡莉莎

en: "Our superiors were getting anxious for results, and lowered security standards.
A single attempt of a spell with this unexpected power destroyed an entire floor."
flavourtext:UniqueGlovesInt4x.Text.zh:
"我們的上級對結果感到焦慮，並降低了安全標準。
用這種未知的力量進行的一次咒術，摧毀了整層樓。"

en: Death is beautiful. Let not the elements
mar it with their clumsy ways.
flavourtext:UniqueGlovesInt5.Text.zh:
靈魂的脫升何其光采炫目，
別讓元素色彩來畫蛇添足。

en: Death does not remove you from our grasp.
Death only brings you closer.
flavourtext:UniqueGlovesInt7.Text.zh:
死亡不會使你逃離我們的魔爪。
死亡只會使你更加接近。

en: "I feel altered when Administrator Qotra wears these gloves.
Somehow, I find that disturbing."
- Researcher Arn
flavourtext:UniqueGlovesInt7x.Text.zh:
"當主管卡特拉戴上這些手套時，我感到改變了。
不知何故，我感到不安。"
- 研究員昂恩

en: "Nothing is more natural than competition.
One feasts, another starves.
One blossoms, another withers.
And one cannot catch the golden sunlight
without casting a bitter shadow."
- Cadiro Perandus
flavourtext:UniqueGlovesInt8.Text.zh:
"沒有甚麼比競爭來的自然。
一個人享受大餐，另一個人飢餓著。
一個開花，另一個凋零。
想要捉住黃金光芒，就必然會投射陰暗。"
-卡迪羅普蘭德斯

en: "There seems to be some innate relationship between the forces of
chaos and cold. Perhaps we should consult an occultist."
flavourtext:UniqueGlovesInt8x.Text.zh:
“力量之間似乎存在某種先天的關係
混亂和寒冷。 也許我們應該諮詢神秘學家。"

en: "One coy look. One blown kiss. One word spoken.
One night I wish I'd forget."
flavourtext:UniqueGlovesInt9.Text.zh:
”一個靦腆的樣子。一個飛吻。一個被說出的字。
一個我希望遺忘的夜晚。“

en: Why cling to your sanity? It offers you nothing.
Surrender to me, and I will grant you everything.
flavourtext:UniqueGlovesStr1.Text.zh:
遷就理智，你將一無所獲，
屈服於我，你將收穫豐碩。

en: The first Karui born on the fringes of the Vaal empire
developed a blood fever born of corruption.
flavourtext:UniqueGlovesStr10.Text.zh:
出生在瓦爾帝國邊緣的
第一波卡魯人因腐敗而灑熱血。

en: Lost in a sea of limbs and screaming faces, they claw
for any fleeting pleasure which might dull the pain.
flavourtext:UniqueGlovesStr11.Text.zh:
迷失在四肢和尖叫的面孔的海洋中，
他們抓住任何可能減輕痛苦的短暫快樂。

en: Forged from the heart of the densest star,
your courage will fail long before it does.
flavourtext:UniqueGlovesStr13.Text.zh:
由密度極高的星體鑄成，
你的勇氣相形見絀。

en: "The long and venerable lineages of the Oriathan nobility tended
to produce Admirals with, shall we say... quick tempers."
flavourtext:UniqueGlovesStr14.Text.zh:
「奧瑞亞貴族悠久且受尊敬的血統所培養出來
的將軍們往往都……脾氣不太好。」

en: The Cyclops of Trarthus became the star
of the Oriath Arena, but he was merely
biding his time, waiting for his chance...
flavourtext:UniqueGlovesStr15.Text.zh:
"「特拉特斯的獨眼巨人成了奧瑞亞競技場的明星，
但他只是在等待時機，
等待屬於他的那一刻……」"

en: Ride with pride,
strike with vengeance,
live with honour.
flavourtext:UniqueGlovesStr2.Text.zh:
引領榮耀跨上戰鞍，
擊敗仇人，使其落入黑暗，
立下戰果光輝燦爛。

en: "The heart is the herald.
It will tell me when it is best to strike."
- Atziri, Queen of the Vaal
flavourtext:UniqueGlovesStr3.Text.zh:
「心臟是最佳傳令官，
讓我知道何時該出擊迎戰。」
- 瓦爾女王阿茲里

en: "One of our researchers cut himself on Prototype #2,
and he has not stopped screaming for months..."
flavourtext:UniqueGlovesStr3x.Text.zh:
"我們的一位研究人員專注於原型 #2，
他已經好幾個月沒有停止尖叫了…"

en: Doryani's ingenuity raised the Vaal Empire
to unprecedented heights. His curiosity
reduced it to ruins and bones.
flavourtext:UniqueGlovesStr4.Text.zh: 多里亞尼精密的設計讓瓦爾帝國達到前所未有的高峰。但好奇心使它淪落為遺跡和白骨。

en: "I like my vassals at sword point,
but my enemies as close as the hilt."
- Emperor Chitus
flavourtext:UniqueGlovesStr5.Text.zh:
「寡人處處提防，就算封臣也得距離一劍之遙，
豈料仇敵宛若劍柄，早已潛伏身旁。」
- 切特斯大帝

en: Izaro was slow to see the treachery growing in his own court
and powerless to stop it once he had;
a captain sailing his own ship into rocks.
flavourtext:UniqueGlovesStr6.Text.zh:
伊澤洛緩緩的發現背叛在他心中慢慢茁壯
並無力抵擋；
將船駛向礁石的船長。

en: With unending determination and resolve he destroyed first the gates,
then the constructs guarding the tomb on the other side.
flavourtext:UniqueGlovesStr7.Text.zh:
他抱著無止盡的決心首先摧毀了大門，
接著摧毀了門後守護著墳墓的建築。

en: The monstrous men of yore used bows too,
theirs were just bigger.
flavourtext:UniqueGlovesStr8.Text.zh:
怪物似的約爾人同樣使用弓箭，
只是比較大把。

en: The stone that stays in the waves soon crumbles to sand.
The First of the Deep teaches us to watch the tides
and choose our moments to move wisely.
flavourtext:UniqueGlovesStr9.Text.zh:
留在海浪中的石頭很快就會磨成碎片。
初始之潭教導我們觀看潮汐
並明智地決定我們的行動。

en: A soft caress in dead of night,
that slips about the neck, so tight.
flavourtext:UniqueGlovesStrDex1.Text.zh:
靜夜青鱗現迷蹤，
影中吐息殺意重。

en: A hungry beast wastes no energy.
Every strike, no matter how small, must work towards victory.
The First of the Plains teaches us
that the largest prey can still be whittled away.
flavourtext:UniqueGlovesStrDex10.Text.zh:
一隻飢餓的野獸不會浪費一絲力量。
牠的每一擊無論多小，都是牠致勝的關鍵。
初使之地教導我們
再大的獵物也有辦法削弱牠。

en: The last gasp is not always one's final act.
<default>{This item can be anointed by Cassia}
flavourtext:UniqueGlovesStrDex13.Text.zh:
最後一次喘息並不總是最後一次。

<default>{此物品可被卡西亞抹油}

en: Try as you like to hide the
blood on your hands.
You'll still know the truth.
flavourtext:UniqueGlovesStrDex14.Text.zh:
想怎麼隱藏你手上的血
就試試吧。你還是會
知道真相的。

en: There is no greater thrill than leaping into combat,
slashing and hewing with utmost abandon.
flavourtext:UniqueGlovesStrDex15.Text.zh:
沒有比跳入戰鬥，全神貫注地揮舞著武器
更令人興奮的事情了。

en: "The gems are strangely human at times.
They simply love to be held."
- Doryani, First Seer to the Queen
flavourtext:UniqueGlovesStrDex4.Text.zh:
「古靈寶石擁有人性的一面：
它們喜愛擁抱生命，為人所用。」
- 女王首席預言者多里亞尼

en: What is greed but trading a mountain of death
for a sliver of life?
flavourtext:UniqueGlovesStrDex5.Text.zh:
無數殺戮只為找出生存意義
除卻貪婪尚有何物？

en: Your lies are our strength.
Your threats are our laughter.
Your hate is our infinity
The fire rises!
flavourtext:UniqueGlovesStrDex6.Text.zh:
汝之謊言，余之力量。
汝之威嚇，余之歡笑。
汝之憎恨，余之無盡。
火焰竄升！

en: Those who witness the shimmering scales of the wyrm
know only fear for the rest of their lives.
Fortunately, the rest of their lives
can be measured in seconds.
flavourtext:UniqueGlovesStrDex7.Text.zh:
那些目睹過讓人顫慄的冰霜巨龍
只能永遠活在恐懼的陰影下
然後，幸運的是
他們的餘生也只剩下幾秒鐘而已

en: "A master artist takes his time when he's painting.
Unfortunately, my kind doesn't often have that luxury."
- Coralito, Brotherhood of Silence
flavourtext:UniqueGlovesStrDex8.Text.zh:
"藝術大師作畫時，時間並不是問題。
可惜，我們這類人時常沒有如此奢侈的選擇"
- 寂靜聯盟．克拉里多

en: "Ever watched a man crush another man's skull?
Hard to feel hope after that."
flavourtext:UniqueGlovesStrDex9.Text.zh:
"你看過人的頭顱被另一個人粉碎嗎？
看過後很難再感受到希望。"

en: A sacrifice of blood calls forth His vengeance.
Let the righteous become the Hand of God.
flavourtext:UniqueGlovesStrInt12.Text.zh:
獻血使他報仇。
讓義人成為上帝的手。

en: To drive back the darkness, to bring peace,
we must fight side by side as brothers.
flavourtext:UniqueGlovesStrInt13.Text.zh:
為了擊退黑暗，並帶來和平，
我們必須如同手足般並肩作戰。

en: What is freedom but a clean slate
in an unclean world?
flavourtext:UniqueGlovesStrInt2.Text.zh:
「神乃至高無上之主，
而吾則為其下之首。
汝，將永不受吾憐憫。」
- 聖宗領導人神主

en: Far south, the winter crawls under the skin.
Below the snow, adrift wanderers sleep.
flavourtext:UniqueGlovesStrInt3.Text.zh:
南行千里，徒見凜冽冰原疆域，
下掘三尺，唯有迷途旅者遺軀。

en: "I ask not for understanding,
only for forgiveness
for what I am about to do.
There will be blood on these shackles yet."
- Anonymous carving, Axiom Prison.
flavourtext:UniqueGlovesStrInt4.Text.zh:
「我不奢望世人諒解，
唯求上蒼赦免我身罪孽；
我即將犯下殘酷謬行
讓此地枷鎖染血。」
- 禁靈之獄內無名刻字

en: By my hand, the inert is given life.
By my hand, that which rots is reborn.
There is nothing that cannot be changed.
Nothing.
flavourtext:UniqueGlovesStrInt5.Text.zh:
左手，賦予生命。
右手，毀天滅地。
掌握一切，
毫無例外。

en: You do not cease to be when you die
any more than the caterpillar ceases to be when it cocoons.
Come, let me show you.
flavourtext:UniqueGlovesStrInt6.Text.zh:
毛蟲結蛹並不代表他不再存在，
你的死亡也不代表你不再存在。
來，讓我給你展示。

en: "Prototype #73 is a near perfect opposite of the original. Perhaps our failures
are due to some unknown polarity we have yet to discover."
flavourtext:UniqueGlovesStrInt6x.Text.zh:
"原型 #73 與原始原型幾乎完全相反。也許我們的失敗
是由於我們尚未發現某些未知的極限。"

en: When the inferno spread across the land,
it was the First of the Sky who singed his feathers
as he brought the flames to a standstill.
flavourtext:UniqueGlovesStrInt7.Text.zh:
當獄火遍佈整的大陸，
是初始之天詠唱他的飛羽
將烈焰止息。

en: "You covet the strength of your peers, mortal?
Perhaps it can be yours, if you are willing to make an offering of their blood..."
- Vaal Myth of the Third Snake
flavourtext:UniqueGlovesStrInt9.Text.zh:
"凡人，你貪圖你同伴的力量？
也許它可以是你的，如果你願意提供他們的血…"
- 第三隻蛇，瓦爾神話

en: "If Jamanra has been resurrected the way so many other ancient heroes have returned,
then perhaps I can convince him to rise up and unite the Faridun once more!"
flavourtext:UniqueHeistContract1.Text.zh:
如果賈嫚拉以許多其他古代英雄復活的方式複活，
那麼也許我可以說服他站起來，再次團結法里登！

en: "Some of my inventions don't live up to their names, but some work all
too well. Let's hope that the Unbreakable is the former, not the latter."
flavourtext:UniqueHeistContract2.Text.zh:
"我的某些發明不辜負自己的名字，但是有些發明做得很好。
我們希望不破者是前者，而不是後者。"

en: "A part of me still believes I can convince Nashta to give up her rebellious ways and come home. That part
of me will forever be nine years of age, futilely chasing her as she runs off into the dunes yet again."
flavourtext:UniqueHeistContract3.Text.zh:
"我的一部分仍然相信我可以說服納什塔放棄她的叛逆方式並回家。
我的那部分將永遠九歲，在她再次進入沙丘時徒勞地追逐她。"

en: "There can be no freedom
while hate still reigns."
flavourtext:UniqueHeistContract4.Text.zh:
"仇恨仍然統治著，
沒有自由。"

en: "If Admiral Darnaw is stupid enough to send orders to his fleet members
and not expect us to steal them, then he deserves what's coming to him!"
flavourtext:UniqueHeistContract5.Text.zh:
"如果達爾奈上將足夠愚蠢，無法向其艦隊成員發送命令，
而又不希望我們偷他們的命令，那麼他應得的是一切！"

en: "The Vox speak in threats.
We will answer them with action."
flavourtext:UniqueHeistContract6.Text.zh:
"維克斯在語帶威脅。
我們將採取行動來回答他們。"

en: The champion's name echoes through time,
drowning out the whispers of the defeated.
flavourtext:UniqueHelmetDemigods1.Text.zh:
冠軍的名字隨著時間而迴響，
淹沒了被擊敗的低語。

en: Ancient worshippers of the Greatwolf were overtaken
by a ravenous hunger for all things mystical.
flavourtext:UniqueHelmetDex11.Text.zh:
大狼的古代崇拜者
被對所有神秘事物的貪婪所取代。

en: "The storm... that lightning... I'd be dead if I hadn't...
but it was cold. Ice cold! It's not what we think, and
the plan won't work! Where's Arn?! I have to tell him!"
- Researcher Graven, infirmary report
flavourtext:UniqueHelmetDex2x.Text.zh:
"那場風暴…那道閃電…如果我沒有…
我早已死去，但那是冰冷的。冰冷至極！這不是我們所想的，而且
計劃行不通！昂恩在哪裡？！我必須告訴他！"
- 研究員格雷文，病房報告

en: There was no hero made out of Starkonja's death,
but merely a long sleep made eternal.
flavourtext:UniqueHelmetDex4.Text.zh:
斯塔空加死去，並未造就英雄豪傑，
只是永遠長眠冥界。

en: Nature respects the strong
And paints the snow red
With the blood of the weak
flavourtext:UniqueHelmetDex5.Text.zh:
自然滋養著強悍的靈魂，
雪地染上鮮紅的血痕─
那是孱弱者的犧牲。

en: "Test subject walked right through the poison gas defenses, and attempts to slow her
failed. Suppression troop six, the 'Furious Flagellants,' have been sent to intervene."
flavourtext:UniqueHelmetDex5x.Text.zh:
"測試對像走過了毒氣防禦系統，並試圖減緩她的失敗。
已派出了第六支鎮壓部隊，即“狂暴鞭笞＂進行干預。"

en: A lad with no fear of the pest
Let rats fill his helmet in jest
When they picked his skull clean
Where his head should have been
Was naught but a vermin-filled nest!
flavourtext:UniqueHelmetDex6.Text.zh:
不怕鼠輩的小卒
把死者頭盔塞滿老鼠
當老鼠啃光此人顱骨
原本項上人頭之處
空虛惡臭，鼠輩滿住！

en: Though we are individual, we share the same plight.
The First of the Sky teaches us that unity and selflessness,
not division and greed, is what will carry us upwards.
flavourtext:UniqueHelmetDex8.Text.zh:
雖然我們是獨立的個體，但我們也有相同的困境。
初始之天教導我們團結與無私，
而不是分裂與貪婪，這樣我們才能前進。

en: The villagers seared the blight with cold, but it only bloomed countless spears.
<default>{This item can be anointed by Cassia}
flavourtext:UniqueHelmetDex9.Text.zh:
村民們用冰霜灼燒了凋落，但它只開了無數的刺矛。

<default>{此物品可被卡西亞抹油}

en: It was a sliver of Malachai's soul
that animated the first Eternal Guardian.
flavourtext:UniqueHelmetDexInt1.Text.zh:
瑪拉凱的魂魄碎片，
喚醒第一位永恆守衛。

en: It is a fool who strikes the turtle's shell.
The First of the Plains teaches us to exploit weaknesses,
and where no weakness can be found, to create one.
flavourtext:UniqueHelmetDexInt10.Text.zh:
哪個傻子想要打破烏龜的殼。
初始之地教導我們要利用弱點，
若沒有發現弱點，就要自己創造機會。

en: Sing with me one last duet,
the curtain closes nigh.
Join me in a quiet song,
Before we all must die.
flavourtext:UniqueHelmetDexInt11.Text.zh:
和我一起唱最後一首二重唱，
隨著閉幕靠近。
和我一起唱一首寧靜的歌，
在我們死之前。

en: "The more the warrior understood Tangmazu's gift, the less the mask aided him.
His dreams were filled with divine laughter."
- Tenth Song of the Islands
flavourtext:UniqueHelmetDexInt12.Text.zh:
"戰士越了解湯馬祖的禮贈，偽裝幫助他就越少。
他的夢想是個天大的笑話。"
- 島國十歌頌

en: Through vision coloured by burning rage and icy hate
peers a visitor from a realm of ill intent...
flavourtext:UniqueHelmetDexInt13.Text.zh:
通過憤怒和冰冷的仇恨使視覺變色
從惡意的領域凝視著訪客…

en: Man retains sanity and strives toward civilisation
only under the blessed veil of ignorance.
flavourtext:UniqueHelmetDexInt16.Text.zh:
人只有在蒙昧無知的情況下，
才能保持理智，為文明而奮鬥。

en: The High Templar sought sight beyond the mortal plane.
He feared no pain but that of touching greatness,
only to let it slip through his grasp.
flavourtext:UniqueHelmetDexInt18.Text.zh:
神主試圖尋求超越凡人疆界的遠見。他無懼
任何痛苦，唯獨恐懼那與偉大僅有一線之隔，
卻又任其從指縫間溜走的絕望。

en: "Prototype #412 seems to bear much in
common with Thought Extractor technology."
flavourtext:UniqueHelmetDexInt2x.Text.zh:
"原型 #412 似乎與思想萃取技術
有很多共同點。"

en: "It is the Gull that delivers Man unto Ancestor.
The consumer of our flesh. The seeder of our
souls unto the earth. We give the Gull his life.
The Gull gives us our Way."
- Lavianga, Advisor to Kaom
flavourtext:UniqueHelmetDexInt3.Text.zh:
「遨翔的海鷗導引著先祖之途，
讓那殘缺、無用的軀體回歸塵土。
即使人生本是虛無，
卻也不應陷於迷霧。」
- 岡姆軍師拉維安加

en: "The ice seared his naked feet
As the lightning stilled his heart,
But it was the flames upon his lover's face
That roused him to vengeance."
- From 'The Three Dragons' by Victario of Sarn
flavourtext:UniqueHelmetDexInt4.Text.zh:
冰霜嚴寒，他的赤足傷痕佈滿，
雷霆萬鈞，他的心念無法動彈，
惡火猛烈，情人容顏化為飛灰，
此時他才終於奮起復仇，猛攻不退。
- 薩恩的維多里奧著作「獵龍記」

en: "A queen should be seen, admired, but never touched."
- Atziri, Queen of the Vaal
flavourtext:UniqueHelmetDexInt5.Text.zh:
「女王者，可敬觀崇拜而不可褻玩焉。」
- 瓦爾女王阿茲里

en: A lightless world
a silent reign
two sightless eyes
feed on your pain.
flavourtext:UniqueHelmetDexInt6.Text.zh: 無光之界，無聲之域，一雙無視線的眼睛，啃食著你的痛楚。

en: Branded a heretic for your beliefs,
You stand alone against many.
May the truth that fuels their anger,
Carry your blade into their hearts.
flavourtext:UniqueHelmetDexInt7.Text.zh:
為你的信念烙上異教徒的紋路
你隻身抵抗天下眾人
但願他們怒火的真相
能帶領你的劍刃直入他們的心臟

en: Men always fell for her honeyed eyes,
and broke when they hit the ground.
flavourtext:UniqueHelmetDexInt9.Text.zh:
男人總為了她美麗的雙眸傾心，
再將他們向地面狠狠砸碎。

en: Cadigan the Third ruled dispassionately
through the iron might of artifice.
flavourtext:UniqueHelmetExpedition2.Text.zh:
卡迪根三世透過
鋼鐵的詭計冷靜地統治。

en: An angry god is one thing,
but you should really fear a god
with an unpredictable sense of humour.
flavourtext:UniqueHelmetInt10.Text.zh: 神的憤怒是一回事，但你應該害怕神無法預測的幽默感。

en: You think we do not know.
We know all that you think.
flavourtext:UniqueHelmetInt11.Text.zh:
你以為我們不知道。
我們洞悉你的全部。

en: The impediments of flesh are weak.
The air we breathe knows no such boundaries.
I exhale, and you inhale,
and inexorably we inch towards oneness.
flavourtext:UniqueHelmetInt12.Text.zh:
肉體的障礙很薄弱。
我們呼吸的空氣就沒有這樣的界限。
我呼氣，你吸氣，
毫不含糊地朝一體邁進。

en: Countless men proclaimed themselves the masters of death,
and each one succumbed to it.
flavourtext:UniqueHelmetInt13.Text.zh:
數不清的人宣稱自己為死亡的主宰，
然而最後皆屈服於死亡。

en: Where the body's limits begin,
the mind's limits end.
flavourtext:UniqueHelmetInt14.Text.zh:
肉體的界限開始時，
心智將不再受限。

en: Gleeful are the few
who bask in the blood of the many.
flavourtext:UniqueHelmetInt15.Text.zh:
少數歡樂
建立在多數人的鮮血上。

en: A hunter uses everything at their disposal.
The First of the Night did not hold back her venom.
She used it to weaken her enemies,
and used her enemies to strengthen her many children.
flavourtext:UniqueHelmetInt16.Text.zh:
獵人用盡一切手段。
初始之夜沒有保留她的毒素。
她將它用來弱化她的敵人，
再用她的敵人來增強她許多的後代。

en: "Feel the pain of ancient wounds.
Feel the doom of dying souls."
flavourtext:UniqueHelmetInt17.Text.zh:
"感受古老傷痕之痛
感受瀕死之靈的厄運"

en: Young Napuatzi was thrown into the pits, an unwilling sacrifice,
but the offer of her blood was refused.
She rose from the pit alive and anew.
A Leader. A Conquerer. A Viper.
flavourtext:UniqueHelmetInt21.Text.zh:
年輕的納普阿茲被丟入坑中，這是場非自願的獻祭，
但她的鮮血被拒絕。
她從坑中復活並重生。

一個領袖。一個征服者。一隻毒蛇。

en: The villagers seared the blight with lightning, but it only forked into countless tendrils.
<default>{This item can be anointed by Cassia}
flavourtext:UniqueHelmetInt23.Text.zh:
村民們用雷電灼燒了凋落，但它只分叉成無數的捲須。

<default>{此物品可被卡西亞抹油}

en: Where that searing dawn fell, silence reigned.
We sought the shadows, but none remained.
flavourtext:UniqueHelmetInt25.Text.zh:
灼熱的黎明降臨的地方，一片寂靜。
我們尋找陰影，但沒有留下。

en: Bold and beautiful, a castaway
Hemmed and hawed, for her to stay
Oh, what I'd give for one more day
For she's the one that got away
-Franklin
flavourtext:UniqueHelmetInt26.Text.zh:
大膽而美麗，一個漂流者
邊走邊走，讓她留下來
哦，我願意多付出一天
因為她是那個逃脫的人
- 富蘭克林

en: "Hate? You speak to me of hate? You have no idea what your persecution inflicts.
How it chokes the heart. Withers the soul. Judge me, and you judge yourself."
- Saresh, last words, to Sekhema Orbala
flavourtext:UniqueHelmetInt28_.Text.zh:
「仇恨？你竟然和我談仇恨？看來你對自己施加的迫害一無所知。
它緊縛我的心臟、讓我的靈魂凋零。審判我，也代表著審判你自己。」
- 薩雷許對絲克瑪奧爾巴拉的最後一段話

en: Many still hold the belief that the fossilised bones
of Vaal sacrifices have magical properties.
flavourtext:UniqueHelmetInt6.Text.zh:
許多人相信瓦爾獻祭犧牲者的骸骨
有著奇異的魔力，但在祭壇只有樹倒草枯。

en: Turning, gazing, blinking,
behold the eyes of void.
Burning, razing, drinking,
your mind is destroyed.
flavourtext:UniqueHelmetInt7.Text.zh:
轉動、凝視、連連眨眼，
你注視虛幻之眼。
燃燒，夷平、痛飲若狂，
你已經喪心病狂。

en: "The sharper the pain, the sharper the mind.
A curious paradox."
- Shavronne of Umbra
flavourtext:UniqueHelmetInt8.Text.zh:
「肉體的苦痛換來清晰的腦袋。
真是個有趣的悖論。」
- 烏姆布拉的薛朗

en: A scar of the flesh you'll never forget,
A scar of the mind you'll never remember.
flavourtext:UniqueHelmetInt9.Text.zh:
軀體傷疤，難以忘懷，
心靈創痕，不成罣礙。

en: Centuries of servitude, a day
of glory, an eternity of death.
flavourtext:UniqueHelmetStr1.Text.zh:
榮華富貴享萬日，
過眼雲煙又一世。

en: We may fight, and we may die, but in these
moments of blood and battle, we truly live.
flavourtext:UniqueHelmetStr10.Text.zh:
我們可能會戰鬥，我們可能會死去，
但在這些鮮血與戰鬥的時刻，我們真正活著。

en: Kaom ordered the desecration of the Empire's dead.
There would be no rest or honours for the wicked.
flavourtext:UniqueHelmetStr12.Text.zh:
岡姆下令褻瀆帝國的亡者。
惡人們不配得到安息或榮譽。

en: When you have slain all of your enemies,
what is left to fear?
flavourtext:UniqueHelmetStr3.Text.zh: 除去所有的敵人之後，還剩下什麼會讓你感到恐懼？

en: "While Prototype #3 does imbue its wearer with strength to match the original,
the first researcher to don it burst into flames when he walked into sunlight..."
flavourtext:UniqueHelmetStr3x.Text.zh:
"雖然原型 #3 確實使佩戴者的力量與原始的相符
第一個這樣做的研究員在走進陽光下就燃燒起來…"

en: Our skin turns to ash
and we are swallowed by his brilliant red light.
flavourtext:UniqueHelmetStr4.Text.zh:
籠罩在他的紅色光輝之下，我們的肌膚化成了灰燼。

<default>{此物品能夠透過索伏的祝福改造}

en: "The Emperor's trusted surgeons are not the only ones who
practice the dark arts. Some of us are just more discreet."
flavourtext:UniqueHelmetStr6.Text.zh:
"接觸黑暗藝術的醫生，並非只有帝王信賴的。
我們僅是較為低調罷了。"

en: The villagers seared the blight with fire, but it only spread like dancing flames.
<default>{This item can be anointed by Cassia}
flavourtext:UniqueHelmetStr7.Text.zh:
村民們用火灼燒了凋落，但它只是像跳舞的火焰一樣蔓延開來。

<default>{此物品可被卡西亞抹油}

en: A cacophony of battle cries
Reverberate through time and space
Inflicting pain beyond measure
flavourtext:UniqueHelmetStr9.Text.zh:
戰鬥的吶喊聲
穿越時空迴響
造成無法估量的痛苦

en: As the fiery remnants of our outpost were subsumed into the caldera,
a thunderous voice echoed across the barren landscape,
"Your fragility is your folly. May others rise where you have fallen."
- El'Abin, Bloodeater
flavourtext:UniqueHelmetStrDex10.Text.zh:
當我們前哨站的火熾殘餘物被火山口吞噬時，
一聲雷鳴般的聲音在荒涼的土地上回蕩，你的脆弱是你的愚蠢。
在你倒下的地方，或許會有其他人崛起。
- 嗜血者伊蘭雅本

en: The Raven Trickster made no move to defend himself.
He merely grinned... and the foolish warrior charged.
flavourtext:UniqueHelmetStrDex11.Text.zh:
烏鴉詭計師毫不設防。
他只是咧嘴一笑…而愚蠢的戰士發動了攻擊。

en: The Decay infects thought itself, leaving nothing
but hollow husks filled with virulent void...
flavourtext:UniqueHelmetStrDex12.Text.zh: 腐化感染了思想本身，徒留充斥著劇毒的空洞軀殼……

en: Swift as thought are the actions of Man
when borne on wings of divine providence.
flavourtext:UniqueHelmetStrDex2.Text.zh:
天意命定如羽翅
讓人行動更加電掣風馳。

en: "What lies beneath your feet?!"
"Sacred ground, watered with tears of blood!"
flavourtext:UniqueHelmetStrDex4.Text.zh:
「汝足下所踏何處？」
「此乃血淚澆灌之聖地。」

en: All that was left of the Iron King was his bleached skull.
Yet it was all the Iron King needed.
flavourtext:UniqueHelmetStrDex5.Text.zh:
堅鐵之王只餘下他那蒼白的頭骨，
不過，這也是他唯一想留在身邊的遺物。

en: The beasts we fear the most
are the ones who dwell in total darkness.
flavourtext:UniqueHelmetStrDex6.Text.zh: 遁形黑暗之中的猛獸最為讓人恐懼。

en: When you're on the run,
look only to yourself for survival.
flavourtext:UniqueHelmetStrDex7.Text.zh:
當你奔跑時，
為了存活專注於你自己吧。

en: The single well-placed arrow that changes the world
must be preceded by ten thousand practice shots.
flavourtext:UniqueHelmetStrDex9.Text.zh:
改變世界的單個位置正確
的箭必須先進行一萬次練習。

en: "The craven mind is sharp with self interest.
The honourable mind is much easier to manipulate."
- Malachai the Soulless
flavourtext:UniqueHelmetStrInt1.Text.zh:
「怯懦者自私自利，刁難棘手，
求榮者視死若歸，更易左右。」
 - 超靈者瑪拉凱

en: Your memories are a bridge to the past.
Let no one cross.
flavourtext:UniqueHelmetStrInt10.Text.zh:
你的記憶就像是通往過去的橋梁。
別讓任何人通行。

en: The eyes of the living hold a glimmer of hope.
Don't waste it.
flavourtext:UniqueHelmetStrInt11.Text.zh:
生者眼中帶有微光。
別浪費了。

en: When the rains come, we cower beneath shelter.
The First of the Deep teaches us
that we should seek no shelter but ourselves.
flavourtext:UniqueHelmetStrInt12.Text.zh:
當雨來臨時，我們躲在避難所下面。
深潭教我們的第一課
我們只能相信我們自己。

en: Our flesh is our most sacred gift.
Taint it not with the occult.
<default>{This item can be transformed on the Altar of Sacrifice along with Vial of Summoning}
From the flesh of the gods, Xibaqua was born.
From the carnage of Xibaqua, we were born.
It is our duty to return to the gods what was once theirs.
flavourtext:UniqueHelmetStrInt14.Text.zh:
從神的肉身上，賽巴昆誕生了。
從賽巴昆的屠殺中，我們誕生了。
我們有責任龜還曾經屬於神的東西。

en: You will know if your subjects follow you from fear
or respect when you have your first moment of weakness.
If it's the former, they will tear you into pieces like rabid dogs.
flavourtext:UniqueHelmetStrInt15.Text.zh:
當你有第一個弱點時，你會知道你的臣民
是否因恐懼而跟著你或是尊敬。
如果它是前者，他們會把你像狂犬病一樣撕裂。

en: "I believed I understood Prototype #112 quite fully, until a test subject
with Azmeri ancestry donned it. I will be haunted by the results
for the rest of my life."  - Researcher Graven
flavourtext:UniqueHelmetStrInt18x.Text.zh:
“我相信我完全理解原型 #112，直到擁有阿茲莫里血統的
測試對象將其戴上為止。我一生的結果
都會困擾我。" - 研究員格雷文

en: The line that divides hope and fear,
life and death, crowd and mob,
is as thin as a whisper.
flavourtext:UniqueHelmetStrInt19.Text.zh:
劃分希望和恐懼的界限，
生與死，人群和暴民，
像耳語一樣稀薄。

en: In the battle for honour, Geofri won.
Not so, the battle for survival.
flavourtext:UniqueHelmetStrInt2.Text.zh:
吉爾菲奮不顧身，捍衛榮耀護自尊，
其榮其尊永長存，奈何人已成亡魂。

en: "Her sisters eternally fought for that shining apex in the skies,
but Viridi instead found strength in humility."
- Azmerian Creation Myth
flavourtext:UniqueHelmetStrInt20.Text.zh:
"她的姐妹們為在天空中閃閃發亮的頂點而
進行了永恆的戰鬥，但是維里迪卻發現自己謙卑。
- 阿茲莫里《創生之紀》

en: Primordial rage slumbers, waiting for the call
of the stars to return and swallow the world.
flavourtext:UniqueHelmetStrInt21.Text.zh:
原始的憤怒沉睡，等待星星的召喚
返回併吞噬整個世界。

en: There is power in hunger, though it will
consume all that you have... and more.
flavourtext:UniqueHelmetStrInt22.Text.zh:
飢餓中蘊藏著力量，不過它將
吞噬你的一切……甚至是你本身。

en: The pain of solitude can be endured, but
the pain of heartbreak might just destroy us.
flavourtext:UniqueHelmetStrInt24.Text.zh:
「孤獨的痛尚可忍受，
 但心碎的痛，足以將人徹底摧毀。」

en: "I don't judge who you are, Saresh. I judge what you do. True leadership
comes from fighting alongside those you command, from elevating them,
and sharing the glory of victory. This, you will never understand."
- Sekhema Orbala, to be crowned Garukhan
flavourtext:UniqueHelmetStrInt25.Text.zh:
"我不評斷你是誰，薩雷許。我只評斷你所為。
真正的領袖，源自與所率之人並肩作戰，在戰火中提升他們，並共享勝利的榮耀。
而這一切，你永遠無法理解。」
—— 絲克瑪‧奧爾巴拉，加冕為卡洛翰之前"

en: A lich may lust for vengeance, power,
darkness, or dominion, but it is their
nature. They can never be satisfied.
flavourtext:UniqueHelmetStrInt26.Text.zh:
巫妖或許渴望復仇、權力、
黑暗或統治，但這就是牠們
的天性。牠們永遠無法被滿足。

en: The seeds of greatness are planted in darkness,
Watered by suffering,
Tended by desperation,
And bloom steel flowers of victory.
flavourtext:UniqueHelmetStrInt4.Text.zh:
偉業種籽，栽於黑暗，
蒙受苦難澆灌，
遭到絕望照管，
方能綻放勝利的鐵花瓣。

en: "Prototype #722 might look like a helmet, but I believe it to be something else
entirely. The visions it shows the wearer... are beyond mortal endurance..."
flavourtext:UniqueHelmetStrInt4x.Text.zh:
"原型 #722 可能看起來像頭盔，但我認為它完全是另外一回事。
它向穿戴者展示的幻象...超出了凡人的承受力…"

en: Tukohama, Tawhoa and Kitava went to the lake to fish.
Tawhoa weaved a net to catch the fish,
Tukohama built a fire to cook the fish,
and Kitava swallowed the entire lake, fish and all, with a single gulp.
flavourtext:UniqueHelmetStrInt6.Text.zh:
圖克哈瑪、塔華、奇塔弗去湖邊釣魚。
塔華編織了漁網，方便抓魚。
圖克哈瑪生了火，方便烤魚。
奇塔弗一口把湖給喝了。

en: A strong pair of legs may carry you far,
but a silver tongue and a few brutes
can take you to the edge of the world.
flavourtext:UniqueHelmetStrInt7.Text.zh:
強健的雙腿，可以帶你走遠。
但強健的口條加上幾名畜生，
可以帶你到世界盡頭。

en: Greatest is the Brine King's domain,
and every day it grows a little greater,
not through force, but patience.
flavourtext:UniqueHelmetStrInt8.Text.zh:
海，領域中的王者。
領土隨著每日擴張，
但靠的並非力量，而是耐性。

en: "To touch it is to be overwhelmed with the need to carve your name into history.
A face no one remembers, yet once you have seen it, you will never forget."
- Icius Perandus, Antiquities Collection, Item 48
flavourtext:UniqueHelmetStrInt9.Text.zh:
"處碰他，你將會被想揚名歷史的慾望所吞沒。
一張沒人記得的臉，一旦見了面，你將永遠無法忘記"
-伊席厄斯．普蘭德斯，古物收藏家，物品編號 48

en: To stand triumphant you must serve
no master other than your own ambition.
flavourtext:UniqueHelmetWreath1.Text.zh:
為求永勝不敗
就要遵從內心野望，百戰不殆。

en: The second trial brought most to their knees.
But not you.
flavourtext:UniqueHelmetWreath1v2.Text.zh:
第二道試煉讓眾多的挑戰者屈膝投降，
但是你卻舊屹立不搖。

en: Lift it lightly, don it slow.
The spikes point out and in, you know.
flavourtext:UniqueIntHelmet1.Text.zh:
輕輕拿起，緩緩戴上。
冠刺鋒利，非血即傷。

en: Asenath's mind was as quick and nimble
as the fingers that drew her bowstring.
flavourtext:UniqueIntHelmet2.Text.zh:
安賽娜絲速決機智，
十指靈巧，張弓放矢。

en: "It takes true strength to hold power,
and my grip grows tighter by the day."
- Emperor Chitus
flavourtext:UniqueIntHelmet3.Text.zh:
「君臨四海從未一蹴可及，
統治萬民亦須恩威並濟。」
 - 切特斯大帝

en: In the end, time comes for all of us.
It just comes for some much sooner.
flavourtext:UniqueJewel1.Text.zh: 「死亡，不一定恆亙之痛」-烏姆布拉外科醫生凱達弗斯

en: At night, as a young Daresso shared his bed with a woman whose name he could not recall,
his thoughts remained in the one place he called his own: The Grand Arena.
flavourtext:UniqueJewel100.Text.zh:
年輕的德瑞索與女子共享夜晚，
但他的思緒卻停擺著，
在大競技場。

en: The infamous Weylam Roth was never afraid
to push the boundaries of Templar authority,
and was never deterred when the Templar pushed back.
flavourtext:UniqueJewel101.Text.zh:
惡名昭著的威廉羅斯，
對於神主權威他從不畏懼，
即使引發神主的反制，也改變不了他。

en: Izaro gave rise to Chitus.
Chitus gave rise to Voll.
None could know how it would end.
None could stop it.
flavourtext:UniqueJewel102.Text.zh:
伊澤洛使切特斯崛起。
切特斯使福爾崛起。
無人能知如何終止，
也無人能夠阻擋。

en: Exposure led to the deaths of many slaves.
And it was the duty of slaves to bury the dead in the frozen ground.
A growing circle of misery and death
that the elite were all too happy to sustain.
flavourtext:UniqueJewel103.Text.zh:
長期的曝露使許多奴隸死亡。
在其他奴隸埋葬同胞的同時，
苦痛與悲楚迅速的傳染，
然而主人們樂於維持。

en: The Cataclysm was but the first act in a play of horrors.
The dead lingered, and the living began to rot.
flavourtext:UniqueJewel104.Text.zh:
災變僅是悲劇的開始。
亡者生，生者亡。

en: "Rage, malice, hunger - some traits are more easily carried across the barrier of death."
- Kadavrus, Surgeon to the Umbra
flavourtext:UniqueJewel105.Text.zh:
"憤怒與飢渴--某些特徵即便死後也能夠留存。"
- 烏姆布拉醫師．凱達弗斯

en: Of the elements at the thaumaturgist's disposal, lightning remained the least understood.
The simple passage of energy from one to another could result in profound power, or rapid death.
flavourtext:UniqueJewel106.Text.zh:
奇術師支配的元素中，雷電聞知尚淺。
迅速的接收此能量，能短暫獲得力量，
但也能立即置你於葬身之地。

en: Sarn's crematorium, built amidst the city's slums,
coated the nearby shanties in a film of ash.
The dwellers grew ill, sputtering and coughing,
and in this way the crematorium guaranteed it would have many customers.
flavourtext:UniqueJewel107.Text.zh:
薩恩的火葬場，建立於貧民窟，
使得附近棚寮覆蓋層層灰燼。
使得居民病瘁四起，咳嗽、濺嘶，
使得火葬場更加興旺。

en: "Would you leave an orchard of apples to rot unharvested?
A cemetery is no different."
-Kadavrus, Surgeon to the Umbra
flavourtext:UniqueJewel107b.Text.zh:
"你會放任整個莊園的蘋果腐爛嗎？
墓園也是一樣的道理。"
-烏姆布拉的外科醫師凱達弗斯

en: The Eternal Empire gave few freedoms to the Ezomytes, but fostered their talents as archers.
At auction, an Ezomyte slave's value was only as good as their aim.
flavourtext:UniqueJewel108.Text.zh:
不朽帝國賦予了艾茲麥人一點自由，
同時將他們的天賦培育成了弓箭手。
在拍賣場上，艾茲麥奴隸的價值和他們的準度成正比。

en: "The swallow flew fast and took many turns,
spilling a seed where no plant had grown before.
This seed grew and grew until the desert became fertile and abundant.
Your mind is like this seed."
- Maraketh Proverb
flavourtext:UniqueJewel11.Text.zh:
「燕鳥疾飛，盤旋不離，
撒落孤種，落入荒地。
盎然生長，終成沃壤。
人心種籽，別無兩樣。」
─馬拉克斯人諺語

en: In the years that followed the twisted sky,
cold winds cloaked Wraeclast in snow.
The pure-white blanket masked a black heart
that lay dormant deep beneath the earth.
flavourtext:UniqueJewel110.Text.zh:
隨著扭曲的天空的那一年，
冷風為瓦爾克拉斯披上了純白的毯子，
蒙上了隱藏在地下的深處那黑色的心。

en: The skilled know how to learn.
The talented know who to learn from.
flavourtext:UniqueJewel111.Text.zh:
熟練者懂得學習。
天才懂得從誰身上學習。

en: "Twelve test subjects were expended in the production of Prototype #800.
Was it worth the expense? Only time will tell."
flavourtext:UniqueJewel111x.Text.zh:
“十二個測試目標可以製作一個原型 #800。
值得花這筆錢嗎？ 只有時間證明一切。"

en: Candles with the brightest light
Bring life to death and day to night.
But lovely as the glow may seem,
Their light is fleeting, as a dream...
flavourtext:UniqueJewel114.Text.zh:
蠟燭有著最亮的光芒
將生帶至死、晝帶至夜。
但就像那動人的光輝，
他們的光稍縱即逝，像夢一樣…

en: One by one, they stood their ground against a creature
they had no hope of understanding, let alone defeating,
and one by one, they became a part of it.
flavourtext:UniqueJewel115.Text.zh:
一個接一個，他們駐守陣地對抗怪物
他們沒有理解的希望，更不用說打敗，
再一個接一個，他們成就了它。

en: We are born raw and untested, and we are shaped by life.
<default>{This item can be transformed on the Altar of Sacrifice along with Vial of Transcendence}
flavourtext:UniqueJewel116.Text.zh:
我們生於樸素、未經世事，並藉由生活雕琢我們。

<default>{此物品可與超越之罈於獻祭之壇上改造}

en: Though the body rots, the spirit lives on.
<default>{This item can be transformed on the Altar of Sacrifice along with Vial of Transcendence}
flavourtext:UniqueJewel117.Text.zh:
雖然屍體腐爛，但精神永存。

<default>{此物品可與超越之罈於獻祭之壇上改造}

en: Any thought, no matter how fleeting, changes the thinker.
<default>{This item can be transformed on the Altar of Sacrifice along with Vial of Transcendence}
flavourtext:UniqueJewel118.Text.zh:
每個想法，無論多短暫，都牽動著思考者。

<default>{此物品可與超越之罈於獻祭之壇上改造}

en: We are as much shaped by what we do
as what is done to us.
flavourtext:UniqueJewel119.Text.zh:
我們和我們做的事情一樣
受到我們的影響。

en: Take comfort knowing that, even in death,
we may serve our Queen and fuel her empire.
flavourtext:UniqueJewel120.Text.zh:
安穩的接受它，即使是死亡，
讓我們能服侍我們的女王和茁壯她的帝國。

en: A keen mind sees what others do not,
makes connections where others do not,
and is dangerous in a way that others are not.
flavourtext:UniqueJewel121.Text.zh:
敏銳的思考看到別人所看不到的，
建立關聯在別人沒有的發現地方，
並且暗藏危險而別處沒有。

en: Kaom watched the torches patrol the top of the Watch.
He observed the lay of the beach, its barricades and rocks,
and his men in their canoes, ready to lay their lives down for him.
But when his foot hit the sand, he thought only of the fight.
flavourtext:UniqueJewel122.Text.zh:
岡姆看著火把在守望台的頂端巡邏。
他觀察躺著的海灘，它的屏障和岩石，
他的人在他們的獨木舟上，準備為他犧牲生命。
但是當他的腳碰到沙子時，他只想到了戰鬥。

en: Standing behind iron bars,
Daresso thought of his adoring fans cheering his name,
his wife's warm embrace waiting for him,
and of the celebrations that would soon be thrown in his name.
But when the arena gate lifted, he thought only of the fight.
flavourtext:UniqueJewel123.Text.zh:
站在鐵欄杆後時，
德瑞索想著他可愛的支持者歡呼著他的名，
他妻子溫暖的擁抱在等著他，
以及不久將以他的名義拋出的慶祝活動。
但是當競技場大門解除時，他只想到了戰鬥。

en: Voll stood at the gates of Sarn, and a nation stood behind him.
He thought of the righteousness of his cause,
and of the glory he would bring to the empire he would soon lead.
But as Chitus and his gemlings advanced, he thought only of the fight.
flavourtext:UniqueJewel124.Text.zh:
福爾站在薩恩的大門口，一個國家站在他身後。
他想到了他的正義，
以及他帶給他即將領導帝國的榮耀。
但在切特斯和他的寶座前，他只想到了這場戰鬥。

en: "I don't know how I know,
I just know that I know."
flavourtext:UniqueJewel125.Text.zh:
"我不知道我如何得知，
但我只知道我需要知道。"

en: In the weeks that followed the Cataclysm,
the dead began to rot and fester.
The air fouled with such concentration,
that passing birds drowned in flight.
flavourtext:UniqueJewel127.Text.zh:
在大災變之後的幾週內，
死者開始腐爛和潰爛。
空氣有著濃濁的污染，
那些路過的鳥兒在飛行中溺斃了。

en: The enslaved Ezomyte clans were not permitted to own weapons.
For years, they trained in secret, watching and waiting for the
perfect moment to reveal the true depth of the Empire's folly.
flavourtext:UniqueJewel133.Text.zh:
被奴役的艾茲麥宗族不允許擁有武器。
多年來，他們秘密訓練，觀察並等待
一個完美的時刻來揭示帝國愚蠢的真正深度。

en: Savour the bitter, cherish the sweet,
For there may never be another chance to eat.
flavourtext:UniqueJewel137.Text.zh:
嚐點苦頭，珍惜甜頭，
因為再也沒有機會開口。

en: "Try as I might, I could not escape it.
When I closed my eyes, I saw only death.
Each breath tainted with the scent of seared and smouldering flesh,
And each sound tangled with pleas for mercy."
flavourtext:UniqueJewel138.Text.zh:
盡我所能，我無法逃脫。
當我閉上眼睛，我只看到死亡。
每次呼吸都被烤焦和悶燒的肉的氣味所污染，
每一種聲音都請求與之交纏。

en: You can take the girl out of the woods,
but you can't take the woods out of the girl.
flavourtext:UniqueJewel139.Text.zh:
你可以把女孩帶出樹林，
但你不能把她內心的狂野也帶走。

en: When you get down to it, we're all really just
an unprepared meal for something or someone.
flavourtext:UniqueJewel14.Text.zh:
倘若你自省思索
我等實為俎上之肉、驚慌無措。

en: Pain is a fine motivator,
But if you seek the truth,
Fear of pain unknown has no parallel.
flavourtext:UniqueJewel140.Text.zh:
痛苦是一個很好的動機，
但是如果你尋求真相，
恐懼之痛無與倫比。

en: As the dead battered Highgate's barricades,
The Black Sekhema accepted her fate,
And stood her ground.
flavourtext:UniqueJewel141.Text.zh:
當不死族攻破統治者之殿的屏障，
漆黑絲克瑪最終接受她的命運，
並守住她的領土。

en: Maids used to threaten to send misbehaving children of
nobility to the pits beneath the Grand Arena.
For the children of slaves, it was more than just a threat.
flavourtext:UniqueJewel142.Text.zh:
女僕曾經恐嚇要把行為不正的貴族子女
送到大競技場下面的黑坑中。
對於奴隸的子女來說，這不僅僅是個威脅。

en: Once you begin to rely on your weapons,
You ensure you can't live without them.
flavourtext:UniqueJewel143.Text.zh:
一但你開始依賴你的武器，
就表示沒有它們你就無法獨活。

en: It was a great honour to fight at the front.
The few that survived the initial charge were guaranteed fame and fortune.
flavourtext:UniqueJewel144.Text.zh:
在前線戰鬥是非常榮耀。
在第一波戰役倖存下來的少數人才能得到名利和財富。

en: The sky, the land, the people burned.
What little still stood soon faced wild, battering storms.
Winter arrived suddenly and stayed for a generation.
Civilisation was not simply halted, but reversed, erased.
flavourtext:UniqueJewel148.Text.zh:
天空，土地，人民被燒毀。
仍然站著的一切很快就面臨狂野的狂風暴雨。
冬天突然來了，住了一代人。
文明不僅被制止了，反而被消除了。

en: Each blow of the hammer shapes the ingot,
each strike stretching and sharpening;
The sabre's tip reaching out, grasping for life.
flavourtext:UniqueJewel149.Text.zh:
錘子的每一次擊打都會塑造鑄錠，
每次打擊伸展和鋒利；
軍刀的尖端伸出來，奪取生命。

en: The strongest Karui tribes left the longest impressions on the land.
Their symbols served as guidance many generations
after their creators had been buried deep beneath the earth.
flavourtext:UniqueJewel15.Text.zh: 卡魯部族威震天下，世人難忘其威猛剽悍。當初創造該族符文的先人雖已亡逝多年，深埋九泉之下，符文所蘊含的知識卻仍舊引導著代代子孫。

en: Quenched, the blade hardens, becomes brittle.
The edge will not last forever,
But when it breaks, its service will continue.
flavourtext:UniqueJewel150.Text.zh:
刀片淬火，變硬，變脆。
邊緣不會永遠持續下去
但是當它破裂時，它將繼續被使用。

en: Her apprentice spends hours working the steel,
and the end result is melted for scrap.
Each one made better than the last.
Each one made more quickly.
She knows the path well.
flavourtext:UniqueJewel151.Text.zh:
她的徒弟花了數小時來做鋼鐵，
最終的結果被熔化以製成廢料。
每個人都比上一個更好。
每個人都更快。
她很清楚這條路。

en: "We awoke to a sudden jungle rupturing the valleys of our home.
Grasping limbs coiled around us, into us. We sank into each other,
then rose into the living sky. My family screams alongside me still."
flavourtext:UniqueJewel158.Text.zh:
"我們醒來時突然發現一片叢林沖破了我們家的山谷。
抓緊的四肢盤繞在我們周圍，進入我們。我們彼此沉淪，
然後升到了生命的天空。 我的家人仍然在我身邊尖叫。"

en: "We awoke to a sudden dawn cresting through the mountains.
Each peak rose into searing fire, a massive roiling tide.
A great eye gazed upon us, and we became known—utterly."
flavourtext:UniqueJewel159.Text.zh:
"我們醒來時突然發現黎明穿過群山。
每一座山峰都升起熊熊烈火，洶湧澎湃的巨浪。
一隻大眼睛注視著我們，我們—完全變得眾所周知。"

en: When you create life from nothing,
sometimes things get a little stuck in between.
flavourtext:UniqueJewel16.Text.zh:
無中生有，創造活物，
偶生異怪，半死不生。

en: The minds of those studied utterly by the Cleansing Fire
continue to think and dream and beg for silence...
flavourtext:UniqueJewel160.Text.zh:
那些被淨化之火徹底研究過的人
思想繼續思考、夢想和乞求沉默…

en: The bodies of those wholly subsumed by the Tangle
continue to merge and mutate and cry out for release...
flavourtext:UniqueJewel161_.Text.zh:
那些完全被纏結包圍的人的身體
繼續融合和變異，並呼喊著釋放…

en: Gripping the stolen Spear of Solerai in hand,
the bandit king of Stridevolf watched his enclave burn.
As foretold, the weapon was powerful beyond compare,
but using it had cost him absolutely everything.
flavourtext:UniqueJewel162.Text.zh:
握著偷來的索拉萊之矛，斯特里德沃夫的強盜之王
眼睜睜地看著他的領地燃燒起來。
正如之前所言，這把武器的威力無與倫比，
但使用它卻讓他付出了絕對的代價。

en: She was the last of countless progeny bred to test the limits of limitless power.
In the cosmic prison of her birth, her siblings fought each other to the death
for supremacy. She alone reached her limit... and broke through.
flavourtext:UniqueJewel163_.Text.zh:
她是無數為了測試無限力量的極限而培育出來的後代中的最後一個。
在她出生的宇宙監獄中，她的兄弟姐妹為了霸權而互相爭鬥。
 她一個人達到了極限…並突破了。

en: This world is not good enough for her,
so I will make a better one. Nothing
matters but the pursuit of perfection.
flavourtext:UniqueJewel164.Text.zh:
這個世界對她來說還不夠好，
所以我會做一個更好的。除了追求完美，
什麼都不重要。

en: Logic wanes in shining faith, and in rationalism, ardour dims
Thus, the cynic and the zealot are divided
But can they not be one and the same?
flavourtext:UniqueJewel171.Text.zh:
邏輯在閃亮的信仰中減弱，在理性主義中，熱情暗淡
因此，憤世嫉俗者和狂熱者是分開的
但它們不能是一回事嗎？

en: How simple a power, on which empires turn,
when one man stands firm and says, "I refuse."
flavourtext:UniqueJewel172.Text.zh:
多麼簡單的力量，帝國依靠它，
當一個人堅定地說：“我拒絕＂。

en: The true secret of the elements
is that all are one and the same.
flavourtext:UniqueJewel173.Text.zh:
元素的真正奧秘在於
所有元素都是一樣的。

en: Within a firestorm, the Thane commands the flames
Emblazoned by glory and the song of the First Ones
For the master of fire fears nothing.
flavourtext:UniqueJewel174.Text.zh:
在一場風暴中，領主指揮著火焰
被榮耀和先民之歌所裝飾
因為火的主人無所畏懼。

en: In darkest night, 'neath waxen moon
A witch snatches a boy from his room.
He wards off her hexes
The witch he perplexes
And so becomes part of her stew.
flavourtext:UniqueJewel175.Text.zh:
在最漆黑的夜晚，蠟圓的月亮下
一個女巫從他的房間裡搶走了一個男孩。
他避開了她的咒語
他迷惑的魔女
因此成為她燉菜的一部分。

en: Fellshrine stood as a holy bastion opposite the
Chamber of Sins, and all that it represented.
For one to rise, the other must fall.
flavourtext:UniqueJewel176.Text.zh:
墮道神殿就像一座神聖的堡壘，對面是
罪孽之殿，以及它所代表的一切。
一個要升起，另一個必須殞落。

en: The spirits of our ancestors guided us from the Archipelago to the continent.
Inextricably, the purity of our souls is linked to the ones who came before us.
flavourtext:UniqueJewel177.Text.zh:
我們祖先的靈魂引領著我們從群島到達大陸。
我們的靈魂純潔與先祖息息相關。

en: At the core of the warrior's spirit,
a fierce determination burns,
igniting their capacity to endure.
flavourtext:UniqueJewel178.Text.zh:
在戰士精神的核心，
燃燒著一種強烈的決心，
點燃他們忍耐的能力。

en: When you throw iron weapons against an iron wall
you only make the wall grow thicker.
flavourtext:UniqueJewel18.Text.zh:
擲此鐵械，擊彼鐵壁
深陷不拔，徒厚其壁。

en: At their height, the Vaal glittered under the sun.
A decade, a century, an aeon of prosperity...
now nothing more than a passing wonder.
flavourtext:UniqueJewel180_.Text.zh:
在巔峰時期，瓦爾在陽光下閃閃發光。
十年，一個世紀，一個劫際的繁榮…
現在只不過是一時的奇蹟。

en: It was more than luck that allowed the Perandus line
to turn even great misfortunes into golden opportunities.
flavourtext:UniqueJewel182.Text.zh:
能將巨大的災禍轉變成千載難逢的機遇，
普蘭德斯家靠的不只是運氣。

en: The future weaves ever forward, twisting into itself forever,
driven by the passions and tragedies of those who seek.
flavourtext:UniqueJewel184.Text.zh:
未來無限向前編織，永遠向自身蜿蜒纏繞，
受那些追尋者的熱情和悲劇而驅使。

en: They believed themselves courageous and selfless,
but that bravery became the doom at their door.
flavourtext:UniqueJewel185.Text.zh:
他們相信自身的英勇與無私，
然而這份勇敢卻成了敲門的厄運。

en: He lusts for retribution, but his
captors are long since dust.
flavourtext:UniqueJewel186a.Text.zh:
他渴望復仇，
但囚禁他的人早已化為塵土。

en: He lusts for the Fall of Night,
but it will cost him everything.
flavourtext:UniqueJewel186b.Text.zh:
他渴望黑夜降臨，
但這將讓他付出一切代價。

en: He lusts for power over his former
slavers, but he will never be free.
flavourtext:UniqueJewel186c.Text.zh:
他渴望凌駕於昔日奴隸主之上的權力，
但他永遠無法獲得自由。

en: He lusts for a crown and a scepter,
but he destroys all he touches.
flavourtext:UniqueJewel186d.Text.zh:
他渴望王冠與權杖，
但他卻毀滅了自己所觸碰的一切。

en: He who was made has but one desire: inflict his
malady upon the Boundless Cavern above.
flavourtext:UniqueJewel186e_.Text.zh:
被創造出來的那位僅有一個渴望：
將他的宿疾，強加於上方那座無垠洞窟之中。

en: In the end, time comes for all of us.
For some, it comes much sooner.
flavourtext:UniqueJewel1b.Text.zh:
時間終究會趕上我們。
但對於某些人，它更快的到來。

en: "True Thaumaturgy can only be learned
by the brilliant or the mad."
- Shavronne of Umbra
flavourtext:UniqueJewel2.Text.zh:
「唯一習得真奇術者
若非曠世奇才，即為瘋癲狂徒」
- 烏姆布拉的薛朗

en: "Does this jewel accomplish nothing? If only we could somehow
master cold and turn it to our own ends..."
- Lead Researcher Ksaret
flavourtext:UniqueJewel20x.Text.zh:
"這顆珠寶沒有任何作用嗎？如果
我們能以某種方式掌握冷度並將其轉變為自己的目的，那麼…"
- 首席研究員卡薩雷特

en: And lo, Nick said unto his disciples:
"It May Be Crazy Broken"
And his disciples replied
"Meh"
And made it anyway.
flavourtext:UniqueJewel22.Text.zh:
還有，尼科對他的門徒說:
"它可能被瘋狂打破"
他的門徒回答
"Meh"
而且還是做到了。

en: The first green shoots of Spring are the most resilient,
and the most vulnerable.
flavourtext:UniqueJewel24.Text.zh:
春來首發綠芽
不是最為頑強，就是最為脆弱。

en: The difference between the master and his apprentice
is what they see when they look at the same block of wood.
flavourtext:UniqueJewel25.Text.zh:
師徒之別，存乎懷中
共察一木，所念各迥。

en: "If one is an annoyance
then a hundred is a threat."
- Ancient Karui Proverb
flavourtext:UniqueJewel26.Text.zh:
「一敵侵擾，不足為懼
百軍壓境，滅族在即。」
-卡魯族古諺

en: "Take your time, make all your plans.
Then tell me which plan
pulls my axe from your ribs."
- Barkhul, the Butcher
flavourtext:UniqueJewel29.Text.zh:
「別急別急，好好策畫詭計。
我的斧頭卡在你肋骨裡
你先抽出來，再說說你有何詭計。」
-屠夫巴爾克霍

en: If you do not learn from a won battle
then you have already lost the war.
flavourtext:UniqueJewel3.Text.zh:
光是打贏戰役，而不知從中學習
還是注定一敗塗地。

en: "Curiously, as I deepen my understanding of Thaumaturgy,
I find I better understand the land we inhabit
and everything in it."
- Doryani, Queen's Thaumaturgist
flavourtext:UniqueJewel32_.Text.zh:
「奇焉偉哉，吾愈發深諳奇術，
愈發瞭解所居之地，地上萬物。」
-女王奇術師多里亞尼。」

en: Picking a lock takes an immense amount of skill and practice.
Breaking it with a hammer takes about three seconds.
flavourtext:UniqueJewel35.Text.zh:
如欲解鎖，必須技高一籌，勤練百回。
如欲毀鎖，僅需榔頭一把，短短三秒。

en: "Greatly outnumbered, Deshret dressed her personal guard
in identical garb. When the Empire rode north, Deshret and
her guard took turns revealing themselves, creating the illusion
of speed beyond the capabilities of even the Virtue Gems."
- History of the Maraketh
flavourtext:UniqueJewel36.Text.zh:
「迪虛瑞特心知雙方兵力懸殊，所以便把貼身護衛打扮得跟她一模一樣。
正當帝國軍發兵北伐，迪虛瑞特與護衛輪番在敵人面前現身，
彷彿她神速穿梭戰場，更勝古靈寶石威力，成功創造欺敵假象。」
- 馬拉克斯人史錄

en: Winter provides us with her own weapons,
hanging from the eaves of our homes.
flavourtext:UniqueJewel48.Text.zh: 隆冬賜予世人兵器，垂於家家屋簷之下。

en: Leaders are not born in times of peace.
Leaders are born in ruins and flames.
flavourtext:UniqueJewel49.Text.zh: 太平盛代無豪傑，烽火亂世生梟雄。

en: The shield crab does not leave his shell unless it is forced to,
and even then, it knows to keep its distance.
flavourtext:UniqueJewel5.Text.zh: 若非萬不得已，盾蟹絕不出殼，即便被迫離殼，也會待在附近。

en: The Azmeri ascetics learnt the power
of going without the body's ordinary cravings.
flavourtext:UniqueJewel51.Text.zh: 阿茲莫里苦行者學會擺脫肉體的常見慾念。

en: Once you understand how your body truly works
you can't help but treat it better.
flavourtext:UniqueJewel52.Text.zh: 一旦真正瞭解身體的運作方式，你就會更加善待自己的身體。

en: "Movement expends energy, but perhaps a little of that energy
can be recaptured and... reappropriated."
- Inquisitor Maligaro
flavourtext:UniqueJewel53.Text.zh: 「動能可增強能量，但或許能重獲少數能量..加以重新分配。」- 審判者馬雷葛蘿

en: The prisoners of the empire raised their shackled hands.
Begging to be delivered from Corruption.
The rebellion smote their chains,
And gave them the freedom to choose corruption for themselves.
flavourtext:UniqueJewel56.Text.zh:
帝國裡的罪犯們舉起上銬的雙手
乞求著能遠離腐化
而反抗軍斷開了他們的鎖鏈
給予他們選擇腐化的自由

en: Ondar not only betrayed his emperor,
He betrayed his friend.
And in his dying moments, Chitus ensured,
That Ondar felt the full weight of his guilt.
flavourtext:UniqueJewel57.Text.zh:
恩德不僅背叛了自己的軍王
更背叛了自己的朋友
在他臨死時，切特斯揚言
恩德親身體會了他罪惡的深重

en: With a fire burning brash in his golden eye,
Marceus fired his arrow into the pitch-dark sky,
And seared the hope of surprise,
From Kaom's skulking horde.
flavourtext:UniqueJewel58.Text.zh:
他金黃色雙眼中燃燒的烈火
穆希爾斯朝著漆黑的天空射出箭矢
將岡姆暗藏的伏兵們的
奇襲的希望抹滅殆盡

en: The Sekhema rode to the mountain,
With her tribe, devoted and strong.
And sewed shut the mouth of nightmare,
So that it would not consume her world.
flavourtext:UniqueJewel59.Text.zh:
絲克瑪的人民攀上深山
與部落一同成長，茁壯
將夢魘之門牢牢闔上
讓世界得以不被其所吞噬

en: The carpenter who picks up a blade is not mad.
He's ambitious.
flavourtext:UniqueJewel6.Text.zh: 拔刀而戰的木匠並非瘋漢，他只是不甘平凡。

en: Maligaro understood that devotion to science,
Means devotion to trial and error.
For Maligaro's errors, death was slow,
And very painful.
flavourtext:UniqueJewel60.Text.zh:
馬雷葛蘿懂得科學的進步在於犧牲
也就是對試煉和錯誤的執著
馬雷葛蘿的錯誤裡，死亡極為緩慢
並且十分痛苦

en: There's no motivation for genius
quite like desperation.
flavourtext:UniqueJewel61.Text.zh:
天才的字典裡沒有動機
如此的絕望可悲

en: When Voll took the throne,
He swore to care for the empire with eyes open.
And so he looked to the salvation of his people,
Blind to the damnation in his hands.
flavourtext:UniqueJewel62.Text.zh:
當福爾戴起了皇冠
他發誓將會明眼守護帝國
因此他積極救贖人民
卻對他所創造的惡果盲目

en: From north to south the sea of fire swept,
Rolling waves of gorging flame,
Growing taller and hungrier,
With every land they consumed.
flavourtext:UniqueJewel63.Text.zh:
由北至南的火海
滾滾烈焰如浪襲來
每吞噬完一片土地
火就更高漲，更飢餓

en: As a boy, Rigwald was taught to hunt,
Through the first snows of winter,
When beasts have gorged their fill,
And see nothing but the long slumber ahead.
flavourtext:UniqueJewel64.Text.zh:
早在男孩時，狼王就被教導著如何狩獵
過了冬天的初雪
野獸們已經填飽了肚皮
準備闔上雙眼進入長時間的鼾睡

en: The Purity Rebels fought with heart and soul,
To free their empire from corruption.
And the fires of war did merely serve,
To temper the steel of their spirits.
flavourtext:UniqueJewel65.Text.zh:
純淨反叛軍團用盡了心和靈來戰鬥
為的是將帝國從腐化中拯救出來
而戰火僅僅只是為了
弔慰他們靈魂的堅強

en: The once-glorious emperor spent his final days
imprisoned in his greatest creation;
a tool to filter out the unworthy
that pushed a monster to power.
flavourtext:UniqueJewel66.Text.zh:
曾經雄霸一方的君主
在他的親自打造的創造物中
受到監禁結束了一生；
一位僅僅只是找出無能之處
並且給了怪物無窮力量的工具人

en: A mage from the coast rode up on a broken nag, legs burnt to his bones.
Before he collapsed, he uttered:
"I watched the world we know end yesterday."
flavourtext:UniqueJewel67.Text.zh:
一名法師從海岸騎著老馬回來，腿燒傷見骨
在他要倒下前的一刻，他說道：
"我親眼見證了我們熟悉的世界在昨天崩毀了。＂

en: Chitus began to aggressively expand his empire
into neighbouring nations at great human cost.
But for absolute power, there is no price
that a Perandus won't pay.
flavourtext:UniqueJewel68.Text.zh:
切特斯開始積極地拓展帝國的版圖
吞併周圍的國家，犧牲了許多人命
但在絕對的權力前，沒有任何東西
是身為普蘭德斯人不願付出的代價

en: Lioneye's men stood at the walls,
eyeing the savages that walked the beach below.
With a single word,
a thousand bodies, and ten thousand arrows,
would litter the sands.
flavourtext:UniqueJewel69.Text.zh:
獅眼的男人們站在高牆上
凝視著下方橋上的野蠻人們
只需要隻字片語
一千具屍體和上萬支箭矢
就會灑滿在塵土上

en: The Darktongue clan has long let their undead feed at the table
with their slaves, and occasionally on them.
flavourtext:UniqueJewel7.Text.zh:
暗舌氏族總讓不死者與奴隸同桌共食
而奴隸有時也會被吞噬。

en: Long after the Karui passed through,
the whispers of those who stood their ground
at Lioneye's Watch could be heard amongst the rubble.
flavourtext:UniqueJewel70.Text.zh:
在卡魯族離開之後
那些留在原地的人的耳語聲
能在獅眼的守望裡的廢墟中細細聽見

en: Anyone can catch a lumbering beast.
Try catching a bird before it has even landed.
flavourtext:UniqueJewel72.Text.zh:
任何人都能抓住動彈不得的野獸
試試看抓住在空中飛翔的鳥兒

en: The Ezomytes have a saying:
Take everything and waste nothing.
flavourtext:UniqueJewel73.Text.zh:
艾茲麥族人說過：
拿走所有東西，不要浪費

en: "Researchers will refrain from giving test subjects virtue gems which produce traps.
We are still finding explosives in the vents months later."
- Administrator Qotra
flavourtext:UniqueJewel74x.Text.zh:
"研究人員將避免給測試對象提供會產生陷阱的寶石。
幾個月後，我們仍在通風口中發現爆炸物。"
- 主管卡特拉

en: All revere the earth they walk,
For it wields strength beyond compare,
Holds knowledge more than thought,
Stands long after all else falls.
flavourtext:UniqueJewel79.Text.zh:
敬仰他們經行的陸地，
其不可衡量的力量，
其超越常理的知識，
即使一切崩毀，仍然屹立的唯一。

en: They roamed, they fed, they grew,
Killing as they went,
Conquer though they may,
Their hearts will never be content.
flavourtext:UniqueJewel80.Text.zh:
奔走、覓食、成長，
殺戮、侵占，
卻得不到滿足。

en: "A stone is not a stone.
It is but one part of a fortress."
- Ezomyte proverb
flavourtext:UniqueJewel81.Text.zh:
"石頭不僅是石頭，
它是壁壘的一部分。"
-艾茲麥諺語

en: "Do not cause the land to stir,
It holds secrets better unknown."
- Azmerian proverb
flavourtext:UniqueJewel82.Text.zh:
"切勿干擾大地，
它將為你守密。"
-阿茲莫里諺語

en: "The summoned golems immediately battered through the chamber wall
and killed several guards, but their fury only lasted a short time."
flavourtext:UniqueJewel82x.Text.zh:
"被召喚的魔像立即穿過房間的牆壁，
殺死了幾名守衛，但是他們的憤怒只持續了很短的時間。"

en: "Kings fall, empires crumble, mortals perish.
All turn to earth and sand."
- Maraketh proverb
flavourtext:UniqueJewel83.Text.zh:
"王者殞落、帝國崩壞、
凡人消亡，亦成砂土。"
-馬拉克斯諺語

en: We flow like blood into Chayula's open mouth,
and spill into the land we have watched forever.
We coagulate; a crimson shell
that suffocates the unworthy.
flavourtext:UniqueJewel86.Text.zh: 我們凝固；腥紅外殼使不配者窒息。

en: We climb like vines up Chayula's arms,
reaching into the world that should be ours.
We take root in the dirt
and strangle those who tread upon it.
flavourtext:UniqueJewel88_.Text.zh:
我們紮根於土壤，
絞殺踏上的一切。

en: We crash against Chayula's body,
and fall like rain into the place we cannot go.
We swell and flood
and drown the undeserving beneath our might.
flavourtext:UniqueJewel90.Text.zh:
膨脹、汎濫的我們，
力使不值得的家伙溺死。

en: Malachai ran roughshod over every ethical boundary in pursuit of creating the ideal gemling.
For him, there was no doubt that the end would justify the means.
flavourtext:UniqueJewel91.Text.zh:
為了獲得完美的寶石實驗品，
瑪拉凱近乎打破了所有道德的約束。
對他而言，結果將會合理化這一切。

en: After years of subterfuge, sabotage, and sacrifice,
Sarn had become a powder keg just waiting to explode.
Finally, Victario lit the match.
flavourtext:UniqueJewel92.Text.zh:
歷經長年的詭計、破壞、奉獻，
薩恩城的民眾有如即將引爆的火藥桶。
維多里奧僅是點燃了手上火柴。

en: Even as the tide turned, and victory swiftly became impossible,
the legionnaires of Lioneye's Watch stood their ground and fought on,
every last man dying a brutal, but honourable death.
flavourtext:UniqueJewel93.Text.zh:
即使面臨絕對敗仗，
獅眼守望的每位軍人，
堅持守住家園，
殘暴但光榮的死去。

en: Cadiro watched young Chitus play in the frostbitten grass, care-free, happy,
and unburdened by the responsibility the Perandus scion would soon endure.
flavourtext:UniqueJewel94.Text.zh:
卡迪羅看著年幼切特斯無憂無慮的在霜凍的草中玩耍，
毫不受到普蘭德斯貴族即將承受的責任所影響。

en: As Malachai stepped into the Highgate mines,
cold winds billowed from the mountain above.
One final, feeble attempt to save what was meant to be eternal.
flavourtext:UniqueJewel95.Text.zh:
瑪拉凱踏入統治者之殿礦坑的同時，
山中刺骨寒風迎面襲來。
做為保衛原先永恆的事物，
最後一次，微弱的抵抗著。

en: News of Kaom's victory in the south spread quickly.
Those in support of the coming rebellion bided their time.
The rest fled like rats from a fire.
flavourtext:UniqueJewel96.Text.zh:
岡姆勝仗的消息迅速傳向了南方。
支持叛亂的人，將會珍惜他們僅存的時間。
其餘人等竄逃如烈火中的老鼠。

en: The winter that followed the Cataclysm was especially harsh.
Wraeclast's few survivors fought to the death for the last scraps of bread.
flavourtext:UniqueJewel97.Text.zh:
災變後，瓦爾克拉斯的寒冬特別的苛刻，
在邊境，生存者為僅存的糧食互相至於死地。

en: Emperor Chitus could offer you a gift with one hand,
and drive a blade into your back with the other.
His blend of brutality and charisma cultured a potent
mixture of fear and admiration among the masses.
flavourtext:UniqueJewel98.Text.zh:
一手遞出賜禮的同時，
另一手中的刀刃已深植對方背心。
這就是帝王切特斯，魅力混雜著殘暴，
使恐懼與崇敬同時萌生大眾。

en: The Maraketh knew that a mountain path
free of vegetation was cut by regular avalanches,
and so the advancing Eternals were unwittingly drawn into a deathtrap.
flavourtext:UniqueJewel99.Text.zh:
馬拉克斯人民非常清楚，
山徑無花無草為雪崩所致。
不知覺的永恆軍隊，
一步步，邁向死亡。

en: The greatest victories happen
before the battle has begun.
flavourtext:UniqueJewelLabyrinth1.Text.zh:
最完美的勝利
總發生在戰鬥之前

en: Language is a tool that can be used to build walls
or tear them down.
flavourtext:UniqueJewelLabyrinth2.Text.zh:
語言是個能築牆的工具
也是個能拆牆的工具

en: Learn as much as you can,
and surround yourself with people who know the rest.
flavourtext:UniqueJewelLabyrinth4.Text.zh:
盡可能的學習知識
然後認識那些懂你所不懂的人們

en: "Should I depart this mortal coil,
so shall all of my treasures."
- Atziri, Queen of the Vaal
flavourtext:UniqueMap1.Text.zh:
「當我的靈魂離開肉身，我的寶藏將隨我而去。」
- 瓦爾女王阿茲里

en: They flew, and leapt, and clambered over,
They crawled, and swam, and slithered under.
Still its ancient secrets await unclaimed
And of this hidden temple, only legends remain.
flavourtext:UniqueMap10.Text.zh:
他們飛翔騰躍，攀爬在上
他們匍匐群聚，蛇行在下
古老秘密依舊待人發現
隱密神廟中徒留傳奇流言。

en: For this beauty,
beauty without strength,
chokes out life.
flavourtext:UniqueMap11.Text.zh:
空有妍麗美貌
奈何無力自保
注定玉殞香消

en: So the raiders danced,
leading their foe ever west,
towards certain death.
flavourtext:UniqueMap13.Text.zh: 侵略者們擄掠燒殺，引領仇家踏向死亡。

en: The grandest and greatest ever to fight,
Divine the champions stand tall.
But match their power, best their might,
And even the immortal may fall.
flavourtext:UniqueMap16.Text.zh:
在這最為盛大及偉大的戰場，
神聖的英靈們在此屹立不搖；
面對他們壓倒性強大的力量，
是否有人能斬斷那永恆枷鎖？

en: Whispers from a world apart
Speak my name beyond the tomb;
Bound within the Maelström's heart,
Will they grant me strength or doom?
flavourtext:UniqueMap2.Text.zh:
冥府陰語聲聲喚
墳內呼喊，墳外驚聞；
漩渦浩劫步步難
我得倖存，或成亡魂？

en: The winters of my youth were cold and harsh.
We had nothing, yet to my mother's credit, I wanted for so little.
flavourtext:UniqueMap21.Text.zh:
我年輕時的冬天冷酷無情。
我們沒有任何東西，但我母親的功勞卻讓我這麼想。

en: What had seemed sacred and infallible
so quickly became flawed out of necessity.
Created from compromises. Vulnerable to mortal whims.
flavourtext:UniqueMap22.Text.zh:
看起來神聖而無懈可擊的東西
很快就變得有缺陷了。
妥協創造。 對致命的突發奇想很脆弱。

en: Without our strict rule, man's destructive side would take hold.
Our beautiful public spaces, our services for the ill and the needy,
all of it would crumble.
flavourtext:UniqueMap23.Text.zh:
如果沒有我們嚴格的規則，人類的破壞那面就會佔上風。
我們美麗的公共空間，我們為病人和有需要的人提供的服務，
所有這一切都會崩潰。

en: It was in my oath that I found peace.
In echoing marble halls I found my voice.
Before the congregation I found purpose.
flavourtext:UniqueMap24.Text.zh:
在我的誓言中，我找到了和平。
在回應大理石大廳時，我找到了自己的聲音。
在教徒面前我找到了目標。

en: Though my life is gone, my purpose is not.
My will remains, emboldened and empowered
by the righteousness of my cause.
flavourtext:UniqueMap25.Text.zh:
雖然我的生命已經消失，但我的目的並非如此。
我的意志仍然存在，有膽量和有能力
以我的正義為藉口。

en: "Did nobody think to report that we had acquired some sort of free-floating
Memory? Cease testing and lock this away immediately!"
- Administrator Qotra
flavourtext:UniqueMap25x.Text.zh:
“沒有人想到報告我們已經獲得了某種自由浮動
記憶？ 停止測試並立即將其鎖定！"
- 主管卡特拉

en: On the outskirts of Utzaal, at the Temple of Chaos,
the Trialmaster awaits your challenge.
flavourtext:UniqueMap26.Text.zh:
在奧札爾郊區的混沌神殿，
試煉大師正等待著你的挑戰。

en: To the east,
it cannot be seen.
To the west,
it cannot be touched.
To the south,
it cannot be remembered.
And to the north,
it cannot be contained.
flavourtext:UniqueMap2_13.Text.zh:
往東，你看不見它
往西，你摸不著它
往南，你記不得它
往北，你留不住它

en: Howls and laughter
They hide in the day
They smell you, they watch you
They track their new prey
flavourtext:UniqueMap2_14.Text.zh:
狼嚎和笑聲
他們在白晝下躲藏
而他們聞得到你，看得到你
他們追蹤著新的獵物

en: Forget kings and emperors;
He who holds the coin holds all the power.
flavourtext:UniqueMap2_15.Text.zh:
國王跟君主算得上什麼
手握金幣的人才能掌握天下

en: For his sins he was hunted in his sleep,
judgement wrought of twisted nightmare.
The Coward bound his dreams to stone, awaiting
another to walk the path of true atonement.
flavourtext:UniqueMap3.Text.zh:
罪孽深重，不得安眠，
難逃審判，夢魘連連。
此人懦怯，無視警夢，
等待他人，贖罪道中。

en: Please take out your blades,
your whips, and your spikes.
Class is now in session.
flavourtext:UniqueMap3_16.Text.zh:
拿出你的刀刃，
拿出你的刑鞭，
別忘了狼牙棒，
授課即將開始。

en: Some dead have long envied the living.
When given the chance, they take from us what they can.
So we offer our suffrage.
In return, they give only suffering.
flavourtext:UniqueMap3_17.Text.zh:
死者仰慕著生人，
試著奪取一切。
我們為它們祈禱，
卻只帶給自己苦難。

en: In the shadow of war,
all are eclipsed.
flavourtext:UniqueMap3_21.Text.zh: 在戰爭的陰影下，一切都黯然失色。

en: "Whatever these maps are, it is clear they are dangerous. Send in only
test subjects, no guards or researchers."
- Administrator Qotra
flavourtext:UniqueMap3_23x.Text.zh:
“無論這些地圖是什麼，顯然它們都是危險的。僅發送
測試對象，沒有警衛或研究人員。
- 主管卡特拉

en: Curious, she shook it then,
And tiny screams emerged.
Curiouser, she shook again,
And an eerie silence purred.
flavourtext:UniqueMap4.Text.zh:
她很好奇搖一搖，
從內部傳出細微叫聲。
她更好奇再搖搖，
從死寂傳出哀嚎駭人，

en: Laughs of all the twisted
Echo through these halls of gold.
In this cold forgotten void
They wander, forever uncontrolled.
flavourtext:UniqueMap5.Text.zh:
瘋人狂者哄堂大笑
在黃金大廳迴盪喧鬧。
寒冽失落的虛無之中
他們不停遊蕩，永遠失控。

en: "Suppression troop two, the 'Martyrs for Science,' were able to seal
the portals before Outpost Four was overrun. Only three men survived."
flavourtext:UniqueMap5x.Text.zh:
"鎮壓部隊第二，“科學烈士”在第四個哨所被佔領之前
能夠封鎖門戶。只有三人倖存。"

en: The Treasures of the Tides wait
in agony at the End of the World.
flavourtext:UniqueMap7.Text.zh:
遭棄水手，死不瞑目。
葬身海域，冰冷鹹苦。

en: "Here the soil is more deadly than any swing of the axe."
- Oba of the Karui, Conqueror of Corruption.
flavourtext:UniqueMap9.Text.zh:
「此處的土壤比任何揮動的斧頭更加致命。」
- 腐化征服者卡魯勇士歐霸

en: They are unforgivable sinners and fools...
We pray each Sacrato. They pray each Kaso.
They are absolutely mad!
flavourtext:UniqueMapRelicArbitraryTenet.zh:
他們是不可饒恕的罪人和愚者……
我們在每一個薩奎托日祈禱。他們在每一個卡索日祈禱。
他們真是一群瘋子！

en: Atlassian aberrations engage in a deadly dance.
Will you be joining them in the fray?
flavourtext:UniqueMapRelicDanceofDestruc.zh:
輿圖一族的異常者跳起了致命的舞蹈。
你願意與他們一起踏上戰場嗎？

en: She makes the rules up as she goes.
It was never going to be fair.
flavourtext:UniqueMapRelicDestructivePla.zh:
她一邊前進一邊制定規則。
這麼做永遠沒有公平可言。

en: You were drunk on the power of the cosmos,
until a hideous gaze settled upon you,
and tendrils began to unfurl...
flavourtext:UniqueMapRelicEldritchGaze.T.zh:
你沉醉於星宇的力量，
直至一道醜惡的目光停在你身上，
而觸手也開始蔓延而來……

en: You fight on, muscles burning, limbs leaden,
hoping for that singular moment of victory that
might finally bring relief... but it never comes.
flavourtext:UniqueMapRelicEndlessTide.Te.zh:
你奮鬥不懈、肌肉疼痛、四肢僵硬，
希望迎來勝利的那一刻終將為你
帶來一絲寬慰……但這個願望從未實現。

en: Do not doubt. Do not question.
This is the way it has always been.
This is the way it shall always be.
flavourtext:UniqueMapRelicImmutableDogma.zh:
不要懷疑，更不要質疑。
事情從始至終都是這樣運作的。
就算到世界末日也不會有所改變。

en: Travelling alone makes one an easier target?
I believe not.
Travelling alone keeps one free of distraction.
flavourtext:UniqueMapRelicLoneAdventurer.zh:
獨自旅行會成為好下手的目標？
我可不這麼認為。
獨自旅行可以排除所有干擾。

en: Shattered fragments of reality float through the void,
waiting to be shaped by your mind's desire.
flavourtext:UniqueMapRelicLucidDreams.Te.zh:
破裂的現實碎片在虛空中隨處飄流，
等待著被你心中的慾望重塑。

en: For nine hundred years, they have had no voice, no hope.
Finally, they have found a kindred soul... in you.
flavourtext:UniqueMapRelicSpeakeroftheDe.zh:
九百年來，他們未曾發聲，不抱希望。
終於，他們找到了志同道合的同類……那就是你。

en: The mists of the Atlas offer up that which you
most desire... so long as you never leave.
flavourtext:UniqueMapRelicThoroughExplor.zh:
輿圖的迷霧會實現你內心最深處的
渴望……前提是你永遠不能離開。

en: The waters of life roil and flow,
birthing horrors of flesh and marrow.
flavourtext:UniqueMapRelicWellspringofCr.zh:
生命之水翻湧流動，
誕下血肉與骨髓構成的恐懼。

en: The grave insult had to be answered; in a mystic flash,
Bardiya crossed the room and struck Cyaxan.
Thus began the War of the Great Families.
flavourtext:UniqueMercenaryBootsInt1.Tex.zh:
莫大的汙辱勢必招來禍害。
巴迪亞到房間的另一端襲擊了塞亞珊。
各大家族之戰由此而起。

en: "The followers of Light recognize Tyndarus Phrecius as
the Emperor. For siding with the rebels, you and your
brothers shall be cast out from the true faith, forevermore!"
- High Templar Andronicus, 892 IC
flavourtext:UniqueMercenaryGlovesStrInt1.zh:
「泰達魯斯．費西亞斯是光明追隨者的帝王。只要敢與反叛者站在一起，你和你的同袍將會永遠受到唯一信仰的制裁！」
- 聖宗安羅尼庫斯，恆曆 892 年

en: "Our new capital will be called Korathin.
My slaves will build it. My price is dominion...
or blood." - Keita's Proclamation, 872 IC
flavourtext:UniqueMercenaryHelmetStr1.Te.zh:
「新的都城將以科拉廷為名。
我的奴隸會建起這座城市，我將不惜以自己的領土……
或是鮮血做為代價。」
- 凱塔的宣言，恆曆 872 年

en: "Keita expects an assassination attempt by stealth or subterfuge.
I say we attack head-on, like madmen. Let the fates decide."
- Azadi, first ancestor of the House Azadin
flavourtext:UniqueMercenaryShieldDex1.Te.zh:
「凱塔預期自己會遭遇刺殺或謀害。
我們不如像狂人般一鼓作氣攻入，任由命運決定結果。」
- 愛札丁家族首位宗主愛札迪

en: Better to act without thought
than to think without action.
flavourtext:UniqueOneHandAxe10.Text.zh:
做了再說比
只說不做還要好。

en: Silence fell... we gazed upon high.
The Red Pyre flared, palms wide.
Ash-laden gales scoured our flesh.
Four screams became one roar.
flavourtext:UniqueOneHandAxe11.Text.zh:
「寂靜降臨……我們仰望蒼穹。
 赤焰怒燃，雙掌張開。
 夾帶灰燼的狂風撕磨著我們的血肉。
 四道尖嘯，化為一聲咆哮。」

en: "Nothing feels so smooth in the hand as Prototype #66.
Results like these may justify everything we do here."
flavourtext:UniqueOneHandAxe1x.Text.zh:
"沒有什麼比原型 #66 更順滑了。
這樣的結果可能證明我們在這裡所做的一切都是正確的。"

en: Born of love, forged in blood
He burned as a torch in the blackest night
She shone as ice in the winter sun
Proudly, fiercely
At their mother's side, forever.
flavourtext:UniqueOneHandAxe2.Text.zh:
生於愛，鑄於血
他如火炬點亮至黑之夜
她如冬日陽光輝映冰潔
何其自豪，何其猛烈
常伴母側，盡孝不懈。

en: The eagle knows nothing
but the scream and the strike.
flavourtext:UniqueOneHandAxe3.Text.zh:
獵鷹的生命
只有威嚇和出擊的命運

en: Relentless fury
Sunder my every foe
Fuel my boiling blood
flavourtext:UniqueOneHandAxe6.Text.zh:
怒火無盡燒夷
燃盡焚毀仇敵，
熱血沸騰不息。

en: The fastest way to a man's heart
is through his sternum.
flavourtext:UniqueOneHandAxe7.Text.zh: 直達男人心臟最快速的通道就是通過他的胸版。

en: Beneath the cold light of the moon,
the wing moves faster than the eye.
flavourtext:UniqueOneHandAxe8.Text.zh: 冰冷月光下，疾風快於眼。

en: Tear the flesh from the bone.
Turn the bone to dust.
Scatter the dust to the wind.
flavourtext:UniqueOneHandAxe9.Text.zh:
扯下骨頭上的血肉
將骨頭化為粉末
再將粉末灑向風中

en: Izaro saw himself not as a man,
but as a divine saviour trapped in a man's body.
flavourtext:UniqueOneHandClaw11.Text.zh:
伊澤洛從不把自己視為區區凡人
而是一個天上降下、受困於凡人之軀的救世主

en: "A man cowers behind his walls.
A woman carries her fortress with her.
In heart, in mind, in hand."
- Sekhema Deshret
flavourtext:UniqueOneHandClaw12.Text.zh:
"男人躲藏在牆後
女人攜帶著堡壘
在心裡、腦海裡、手裡。"
- 絲克瑪迪虛瑞特

en: "Additional test subjects approved. Determine exactly how many wounds
need to be endured to activate Prototype #612's energies."
flavourtext:UniqueOneHandClaw12x.Text.zh:
"其他測試對像已獲批准。確定需要忍受多少傷口
才能激活原型 #612 的能量。"

en: "I know how to say 'faster' and 'attack'
in Karui, Marak and Ezo."
- Voll of Thebrus
flavourtext:UniqueOneHandMace1.Text.zh:
「寡人深知卡魯族『疾行』和『猛攻』的精髓─
『迅』與『摧』。」
- 席布魯斯的福爾

en: A merciful murderer swept through the streets of Sarn
Robbing breath from the weak and worthless.
flavourtext:UniqueOneHandMace10.Text.zh:
仁慈的殺人犯掃過了薩恩的街道
奪走了衰弱和悲哀之人的氣息

en: "Three test subjects confirmed Prototype #495 creates an additional
debilitating effect from poisons. This could be very useful."
flavourtext:UniqueOneHandMace10x.Text.zh:
"三名測試對象確認原型 # 495 還產生了由
毒物引起的衰弱反應。這可能非常有用。"

en: They hoped that, trapped in its prison,
the creature would age and perish.
But time would not touch the fiend.
flavourtext:UniqueOneHandMace11.Text.zh:
他們祈求它被禁錮在監牢中，
生物會老化、消逝。
但時間卻無法觸及那個野獸。

en: "We must be ready. We are the voice of Wraeclast's vengeance,
tolling righteous fury for those who would dare invade our world!"
- Ailith, First of the Keepers
flavourtext:UniqueOneHandMace13.Text.zh:
"我們必須做好準備。
我們是瓦爾克拉斯特復仇的聲音，
為那些膽敢入侵我們世界的人，敲響正義的怒鐘！"
-初始看守者．艾里絲

en: Old Bartek still stands, but is courteously
bowing to the might of time.
flavourtext:UniqueOneHandMace2.Text.zh:
老巴爾提克依舊屹立不搖，
出於禮貌，還是向歲月鞠躬彎腰。

en: "You'll have my riches when you pry them
from my cold, dead hands!"
"That's how I prefer it."
flavourtext:UniqueOneHandMace4.Text.zh: 「若你能夠窺視我冰冷死亡之手，將獲得我的寶藏！」「這是我喜歡的方法。」

en: To neither ebb nor flow,
but weather the rising tide,
outlast, unshifting and unshifted,
until the waters recede and we stand together.
flavourtext:UniqueOneHandMace5.Text.zh:
既不隨波，亦不逐流
怒浪狂潮來襲，奮身頑抗纏鬥
縱歷艱苦，永不屈服，
浪濤終將退散，吾等屹立依然。

en: Sure, there's many a hard man out there.
But this'll soften them up.
flavourtext:UniqueOneHandMace6.Text.zh:
世上確有頑強者眾。
此物定能使其屈服。

en: "The painful memories are the easiest to recall."
- Lavianga, Advisor to Kaom
flavourtext:UniqueOneHandMace7.Text.zh:
「傷痛回憶，最難忘記。」
-岡姆參謀拉維安加

en: I suffer, I long, with thirst to slake.
Though countless corpses lie in wake.
flavourtext:UniqueOneHandMace8.Text.zh:
我受苦，我渴望，平息饑渴。
雖然躺著無數的屍體。

en: There is nothing, flesh, spirit, or stone
Free from our hunger for dominion.
flavourtext:UniqueOneHandMace9.Text.zh:
沒有任何的生物、靈魂，或是物質
能逃過我們統治的渴望

en: As a maiden I was bound; as a crone was I scorned
Promised power rarely found, delivered fury fairly thorned.
Not enough?...Fine. Now I am become both and another
To take your hand and cradle your talents, not smother
The consummate flames. So hush, dear, say not a word.
Bequeathed, betrayed...beloved. At last, I am the third.
flavourtext:UniqueOneHandSword10.Text.zh:
年少為奴，飽受箝制束縛；今為老嫗，吞忍奚落侮辱
不見自由承諾，徒聞百般嘲弄
難道老天還嫌我不夠苦?...罷也，如今韶華已逝，年邁將死
且讓我扶持你，栽培你，守護你那絕美焰火。
安靜，親愛的，什麼都別說。
我曾遭人遺棄出賣…如今終獲關愛。
我終成第三人。

en: "She's pretty, aye. So pretty you'll
want to be with her long after you're dead."
flavourtext:UniqueOneHandSword12.Text.zh: 「她的美麗讓人死後都無法離開」

en: "May the Blessed Lakishu watch our backs and our wives."
- Legionnaire Battle Blessing
flavourtext:UniqueOneHandSword13.Text.zh:
「願神聖的萊奇蘇保佑吾等與髮妻。」
- 軍團戰鬥祝福

en: "With this, I will weave the threads of fate
into a noose for our 'glorious' emperor."
- Chitus Perandus
flavourtext:UniqueOneHandSword14.Text.zh:
"有了這個，我將親手將交錯的命運
編織成給我們「賢明」的君主的上吊繩"
- 切特斯．普蘭德斯

en: Fear not death. Turn to him, face him.
And smile as he sinks his teeth
into the throats of our oppressors.
flavourtext:UniqueOneHandSword15.Text.zh:
別畏懼死亡。轉向他，面對他
當你的咽喉被牙齒深深陷入時
對你的敵人微笑吧

en: The blade thrums with wild energy
Eager for vengeance against all who walk free.
flavourtext:UniqueOneHandSword16.Text.zh:
刀鋒上狂野的能量顫動著
渴望著對那些僥倖之人復仇

en: "Test subjects were unable to strike even a motionless target.
However, when a trained guard tried it..."
flavourtext:UniqueOneHandSword16x.Text.zh:
"測試對象甚至無法擊中一動不動的目標。
但是，當訓練有素的警衛嘗試時…"

en: "Painful suicide in the hands of a fool,
Creative death in the hands of a master."
- Icius Perandus, Antiquities Collection, Item 2992
flavourtext:UniqueOneHandSword17.Text.zh:
"痛苦的自殺在傻瓜手中，
創造性的死亡在高手手中。"
- 伊席厄斯．普蘭德斯，古物收藏家，物品編號 2992

en: A sword he brought, his foes to maim and rend,
from places dark behind forbidden doors,
but night by night he woke with frighten'd roars
from ghoulish dreams, too strange to comprehend.
flavourtext:UniqueOneHandSword18.Text.zh:
他帶著把劍，將敵人肢解撕裂，
從禁忌之門後的黑暗世界，
每個夜晚在恐懼的嘶吼中驚醒
那殘忍至極的噩夢，詭異而無法理解。

en: "The night-gaunts, they fly, soaring about in darkness beyond the ken of mankind.
I hear the silent whispers of their wings as they descend, for me, for me..."
- Researcher Arn
flavourtext:UniqueOneHandSword18x.Text.zh:
"夜幕降臨，他們飛翔，在人類的籠罩之外的黑暗中。
我聽到他們降落時翅膀的無聲細語，對我來說，對我來說…"
- 研究員昂恩

en: Even from the back rows,
the whistling steel was mesmerising.
They watched the dance in the arena dust, silent as the dead.
A spell only broken by the spilling of blood.
flavourtext:UniqueOneHandSword19.Text.zh:
就算是在後排。
鋼鐵的低語一樣迷人。
他們觀賞競技場的塵土飛揚，死亡後的寂靜。
只有鮮血能夠破除的魔咒。

en: In the rift between future and past,
life passes quickly.
flavourtext:UniqueOneHandSword2.Text.zh:
古往今來，身處其中，
人生轉瞬，荏苒匆匆。

en: Quickly cooled the steel,
but never could it forget
the heat of the forge.
flavourtext:UniqueOneHandSword20.Text.zh:
鋼鐵迅速冷卻，
但無法忘卻熔爐的溫度。

en: Breathe deep, my child.
Let the frigid air engulf your soul.
Embrace the eternal cold,
And it will embrace you back.
flavourtext:UniqueOneHandSword21.Text.zh:
深呼吸，我的孩子。
冰冷的空氣吞噬你的靈魂。
投入永凍懷抱，
完全地接納你。

en: His lucky thralls dream eternal,
but we must crawl on our own.
They grow fat and ripe in slumber.
To be fed upon when he wakes.
flavourtext:UniqueOneHandSword23.Text.zh:
在睡眠中他們壯大、熟成。
做為他甦醒後的糧食。

en: "Impossibly heavy, yet the ancient edge is as keen as any modern blade's.
A reminder that, in the end, when we lie in the bellies of worms,
it is what we make that makes us."
- Icius Perandus, Antiquities Collection, Item 47
flavourtext:UniqueOneHandSword24.Text.zh:
"重的不可思議，但古老的刀鋒卻比現代來的銳利。
這提醒了我們，最終，我們會躺在蟲子的肚子裡，
我們的成就造就了我們。"
-伊席厄斯．普蘭德斯，古物收藏家，物品編號 47

en: "Your name is Demon Slayer? Really? Good name for rotgut, that."
She said: I prefer "The Goddess Of Swords". Much more dignified. And accurate.
"Demon Slayer The Cheap And Nasty it is then. Burns going down, burns coming up?"
She said: Every single time, Charan. And still...you'll bathe me, and you'll drink my love. Until you can't.
flavourtext:UniqueOneHandSword26.Text.zh:
"你的名字是惡魔殺手？真的？對劣等品來說是個好名字"
她說：我比較喜歡"女神之劍"。比較高雅和準確。
"那就是低賤骯髒惡魔殺手了。遇火而亡、遇火而生？"
她說：查蘭每一次。還有之後…你會幫我沐浴，你會飲我之愛。直到你生命終結。

en: Through countless seasons they stand, stoic,
Each season leaving its mark;
a memory written in fibrous flesh.
flavourtext:UniqueOneHandSword27.Text.zh:
經過無數的季節，他們堅忍的站著，
每個季節都留下它們的痕跡；
回憶被記錄在纖纖肉體上。

en: By wind and wing they are carried,
Their fates not theirs to control,
Yet the fates of others dragged in their wake.
flavourtext:UniqueOneHandSword28.Text.zh:
他們被風和翅膀帶領著，
他們無法掌控自己的命運，
但其他人的命運卻隨之而來。

en: Through war we found peace. Through death we found advancement.
Our ancestors did not know where their actions would take them.
Are we any better?
<default>{This item can be transformed on the Altar of Sacrifice along with Vial of Fate}
flavourtext:UniqueOneHandSword29.Text.zh:
透過戰爭我們了解和平。透過死亡我們了解進步。
我們的祖先不知道他們的行為會帶領他們何去何從。
我們有比他們更好嗎？

<default>{此物品可與命運之罈於獻祭之壇上改造}

en: Though the Vaal revered peace, it would have
been suicide for any culture to rouse them to war.
- Icius Perandus, Scholar to the Empire.
flavourtext:UniqueOneHandSword3.Text.zh:
瓦爾對外族一向以和為貴，
但如有人膽敢冒犯，必將施予無赦懲戒。」
- 帝國學者伊席厄斯．普蘭德斯

en: Doryani promises immortality, yet we build great structures,
carve magnificent works into stone, so a part of us lives onward.
A sign of faithlessness through action.
flavourtext:UniqueOneHandSword30.Text.zh:
多里亞尼允諾長生不老，我們建造了偉大的建築，
把宏偉的作品雕刻成石牆，因此我們一部份的靈魂可以繼續存活。
一種無信仰的行動表徵。

en: On the mirrored edge of infinity,
one man sinks forever into darkness,
one man rises into light.
But which one am I?
flavourtext:UniqueOneHandSword31.Text.zh:
在無限的鏡面邊緣，
一個人永遠沉入黑暗，
一個人升起亮光。
但是我是哪一個？

en: Its forging marked the melding of man
and Titan against the rising darkness.
flavourtext:UniqueOneHandSword34.Text.zh:
這件物品的鍛造標誌著人類和泰坦的融合，
以對抗不斷崛起的黑暗勢力。

en: It need not know your True Name. Our most
dearly held secrets spill forth in our blood.
flavourtext:UniqueOneHandSword35.Text.zh:
它無需知道你的真名。
我們最珍貴的秘密在我們的血液中湧現。

en: "Dread Captain's a title, boy. Taken, not earned.
From Brinehook Vex on down to the Piratebane
himself. Beware. That cutlass has no allegiance."
flavourtext:UniqueOneHandSword36.Text.zh:
"恐懼船長是個頭銜，孩子。是奪來的，而不是
賺來的。從布琳霍克．維克斯一路傳到海盜災星
本人都是如此。小心點，那把彎刀可沒有忠誠可言。"

en: Her purpose seems done; the oath is fulfilled.
Rust dulls her smirk with the last demon killed.
The embers grow dim and yet hope burns her lips:
"An old flame renewed can define our eclipse!"
flavourtext:UniqueOneHandSword4.Text.zh:
她已達成目標，信守神聖誓言。
即使殺盡惡魔，無法再展笑顏。
餘燼漸漸暗去，口中喃喃希望：
「新炎已焉燃起，我等就此消亡！」

en: "A raging Solaris seared and contorted the orb's surface.
A despairing Lunaris filled the scars with her tears.
Yet Viridi remained, trapped within, forever more."
- Azmerian Creation Myth
flavourtext:UniqueOneHandSword5.Text.zh:
「熾烈的陽光點燃大地，
朦朧的月影以淚填起那四方之隙， 
維里迪蝸居其中，只為尋找果腹殘食和蔽體薄衣。」
 - 阿茲莫里《創生之紀》

en: "Hyaon the 'Red Wolf'
Howling mad
Cloaked in blood
A banner to his legion
A terror to his foes."
- Garivaldi, Chronicler to the Empire
flavourtext:UniqueOneHandSword6.Text.zh:
「血狼海奧恩─
戰吼逞快意，軍士氣萬鈞。
血軀陣中現，諸敵自披靡。」
- 帝國紀事官 加里瓦爾迪

en: Maligaro was transformed by Raulo's love.
Thaumaturgy allowed Maligaro to return the favour.
flavourtext:UniqueOneHandSword7.Text.zh:
勞羅之愛讓馬雷葛蘿徹底改變，
他以奇術回報愛人，令其永生不死。

en: Being lost is a trick of the mind.
A man always has two directions available to him.
Forward and through.
flavourtext:UniqueOneHandSword8.Text.zh:
迷茫之時無需心煩；
謹記，以下建言對男人永遠有用：
直直向前衝。

en: She dances a dance beneath the shade,
The twilight shroud her only blade,
Who now hears her feathersteps flowing?
Beneath the stars, the moondrops glowing.
flavourtext:UniqueOneHandSword9.Text.zh:
在陰影中翩翩起舞，
在劍影中穿梭自如；
在星芒下無聲潛行，
在月影下悄然漫步。

en: "Once we armoured the test subject heavily enough to test Prototype #502, he proceeded
to fight his way out. I don't know what we expected."
- Researcher Graven
flavourtext:UniqueOneHandSword9x.Text.zh:
"一旦我們給測試對象加裝了足夠的盔甲以測試原型 #502，他就會
繼續努力。我不知道我們期望什麼。"
- 研究員格雷文

en: Stories of heroism by the victor persist,
for no one survives to contest them.
flavourtext:UniqueOneHandSwordDemigods1..zh:
勝利者的英雄故事永存，
沒人倖存下來與他們抗衡。

en: Molten feathers, veiled spark,
Hissing arrows from the dark.
flavourtext:UniqueQuiver1.Text.zh:
熾羽疾馳化濁影，
烈矢奔騰照光明。

en: The fortunate inscribe their legacy
