in the pages of history books.
The rest of us must leave our mark with our blood
or the blood of others.
flavourtext:UniqueQuiver10.Text.zh:
富裕的人們在歷史書中
寫下他們豐富的遺產
而剩下的我們只能用我們的血
或別人的血留下些什麼

en: Beaten in contest, he would try once more
Guided by magic, Magjar took aim at a dove
Saemus' gift would influence the score
Guided by darkness, Magjar spilled the blood of his love
flavourtext:UniqueQuiver11.Text.zh:
競賽中失利，他會繼續嘗試
遵隨魔法的指引，馬紮爾人瞄準白鴿
謝默斯的贈禮將影響分數
遵隨黑暗的指引，馬紮爾人灑著愛人之血。

en: If two great leaders like Lioneye and Kaom
had been on the same side of the battle,
nothing would remain unconquered.
flavourtext:UniqueQuiver12.Text.zh:
若猶如獅眼和岡姆般偉大的兩個領袖
站立於同一陣線之上，
沒有東西不被征服。

en: Midnight tinkering begets midday murdering;
a sinister shaft surreptitiously shot slays a scoundrel.
I will see them again, but not until my work is done.
flavourtext:UniqueQuiver15.Text.zh:
午夜的修補會導致正午謀殺；
一個陰險的箭偷偷地射殺了一個惡棍。
直到我的工作完成後，我會再次見到他們。

en: "The Midnight Tinkerer's aid was invaluable during our brief alliance,
but when we failed to make any progress on resurrection, he continued his search elsewhere..."
flavourtext:UniqueQuiver15x.Text.zh:
“午夜匠師的協助在我們短暫的同盟中非常寶貴，
但是當我們在復活方面沒有取得任何進展時，他繼續在其他地方搜尋...“

en: Seeing only foot soldiers, the Sarn Knights cast aside
their heavy shields... and paid dearly for their mistake.
flavourtext:UniqueQuiver2.Text.zh:
薩恩騎士只見步兵來襲，卸下重盾迎戰...
結果誤判戰局，付出慘痛代價

en: Ensconced in the pulsing core of the Beast,
Malachai reached out for control of all living things.
flavourtext:UniqueQuiver21.Text.zh:
讓自己化作巨獸核心的一部分後，
瑪拉凱企圖讓所有生命成為掌中物。

en: Enacting a grand vision requires cold-hearted sacrifice.
The loyal must be no more than fodder against the unwilling.
flavourtext:UniqueQuiver22.Text.zh:
宏偉的願景需要義無反顧的犧牲。
在爭鬥的過程中，忠僕和受使役者在戰線上並無區別。

en: "Why waste such a fine arrow on just one man?"
- Kiravi, Vaal Archer
flavourtext:UniqueQuiver3.Text.zh:
「如此精良的箭矢為何一次只用在一個人身上？真是浪費！」 
- 瓦爾箭術師奇拉維

en: "It's a rare man that has eyes in the back of his head."
- Kiravi, Vaal Archer
flavourtext:UniqueQuiver4.Text.zh:
「很少人能像背後生出雙眼一般地感應空氣的流動。」
- 瓦爾箭術師奇拉維

en: Mist of breath
Icing to lips and throat
As the warm ones choke and fall
Upon the frozen wasteland.
flavourtext:UniqueQuiver5.Text.zh:
如斯霧氣，化為冰霜刺進口鼻
那是凍原旅人窒息倒地前
最後一次的呼吸

en: A Karui woman's place was not the
battlefield, but the hearth.
Hyrri changed all of that.
flavourtext:UniqueQuiver6.Text.zh:
戰鬥非卡魯女子本份
西里破除持家傳統，
引領姐妹踏上榮耀之行

en: In this chaotic world
The rewards of the Soul
Outlast the rewards of the Flesh.
flavourtext:UniqueQuiver7.Text.zh:
於此亂世之中，
靈魂昇華遠勝肉體淬鍊。

en: "The theft of another's vitality is short-lived, but sweet.
It calls to me, bidding me abandon all other pursuits."
- Researcher Arn
flavourtext:UniqueQuiver7x.Text.zh:
"盜竊他人的活力是短期之道，但卻很甜蜜。
它呼籲我，要我放棄所有其他追求。" 
- 研究員昂恩

en: Fear not the dark, the song of night,
Hear not the arch, the falling cry.
My giving sun, fight no more,
Rest alone, my grand nightfall.
flavourtext:UniqueQuiver9.Text.zh:
黑暗降臨，夜之歌聲；
弓聲漸止，哭嚎漸生。
落日西沉，戰爭止息；
孤獨一人，暮光漸沉。

en: She paints her offer in wicked hues
An off-white grin, an elegant bruise.
To the nascent scourge she sings the ruse:
"With me in hand, what else need you use?"
flavourtext:UniqueRapier1.Text.zh:
她為貢品撒上讓人不安的光輝：
蒼白蔑笑，傷痕累累。
她想以詭計欺瞞，祭袍一揮：
「放眼天下，捨我其誰？」

en: Many a collector of rarities discovered to his dismay
that the intelligent spirit in this sword
does not like to share its master's attention
flavourtext:UniqueRapier2.Text.zh:
收藏家傷透腦筋：
附在此劍上的魂靈
對於奇珍異寶總是有求無應。

en: It doesn't matter how well the young swordsman trains.
All form and finesse are forgotten when blood first hits the ground.
flavourtext:UniqueRapier4.Text.zh:
再怎麼訓練有素的年輕戰士
在第一滴血落下時
所有學過的姿勢和技巧都將混亂

en: A single breeze blows
A hundred blades dance
flavourtext:UniqueRapier5.Text.zh:
一道輕柔微風
百刃為之起舞

en: "This is one riddle I can't solve."
- Researcher Graven
flavourtext:UniqueRapier6x.Text.zh:
"這是我無法解決的一個謎。"
- 研究員格雷文

en: The portrait reflected his pain,
a pain that she could never see.
flavourtext:UniqueRing10.Text.zh: 他在肖像中道盡辛酸苦楚，可惜佳人永遠視若無睹。

en: "Our warehouses are bursting. Our vaults are full.
But our minds are still hungry."
- Medici Perandus, Prefect to the Treasury
flavourtext:UniqueRing14.Text.zh:
「財物堆滿了金庫、 寶藏填平了秘窟，
但我們的心靈依舊遺失於慾望的迷霧。」
- 寶藏庫守備官梅迪西．普蘭德斯

en: Ming slew Tranquillity
Took Chaos for his wife
And on Her immortal finger
He placed his Heart
flavourtext:UniqueRing16.Text.zh:
明將寧靜擊斃
迎娶混沌為妻
在她那不朽的細指
明戴上真心誠摯

en: The Empress gave Romira two sons
Born of his brother's seed
Romira threw her a banquet
A perfidious meal indeed.
flavourtext:UniqueRing17.Text.zh:
皇后為羅米拉產子有二
實為兄弟之種
羅密拉為皇后設宴享樂
實為背信之諷。

en: "From Frost's ice-bound pass
Berek taunted and jeered
Until furious Flame scaled the mountain
Berek escaped through the thaw
And Frost's tortured moans."
- Berek and the Untamed
flavourtext:UniqueRing18.Text.zh:
「貝雷克佇立冰封之道，
對自己征服此地得意逍遙。
那烈炎發出尖嘯，
貝雷克卻能躲過火燒
以及冷酷的撕咬。」
- 貝雷克及抗馴者

en: "Berek hid from Storm's lightning wrath
In the embrace of oblivious Frost
Repelled by ice, blinded by blizzards
Storm raged in vain
While Berek slept."
- Berek and the Untamed
flavourtext:UniqueRing19.Text.zh:
「貝雷克凌駕風暴之巔，
懷抱一般人只敢遠觀的雪線；
踏遍冰河、放眼杳無人煙，
深夜狂風惡夢無限，
他竟睡得香甜。」
- 貝雷克及抗馴者

en: A token from the sea
A sign for Kaom
to lead his Karui to Wraeclast.
flavourtext:UniqueRing2.Text.zh:
來自海洋彼岸的信物，
呼召岡姆踏上征途。
率領血族，兵臨帝陸。

en: "With Flame licking at his heels
Berek berated the clouds
Until vengeful Storm spewed forth his rains
And Berek held on tight
As Fire screamed and steamed
And fled."
- Berek and the Untamed
flavourtext:UniqueRing20.Text.zh:
「災禍的火焰就在腳下翻滾，
貝雷克卻充耳不聞；
接著，他感受到雨水劃過風暴之後的餘溫，
於是打起精神，
卻感嘆自己無法
浴火新生。」
- 貝雷克及抗馴者

en: "Moon after moon did Berek make fools
Of the great and Untamed Three
Until malice for a Brother
Slew the hatred of the Other
And Berek did hunt
Alone and free."
- Berek and the Untamed
flavourtext:UniqueRing21.Text.zh:
「貝雷克擁有無比機智，
從他和抗馴者之間的纏鬥便可得知。
他讓那三種元素互相角力，
直到它們露出敗跡，
接著一鼓作氣
讓自己和惡夢遠離。」
- 貝雷克及抗馴者

en: On one hand, you have a choice.
On the other, you have its twin.
flavourtext:UniqueRing22.Text.zh:
一方面，你有一種選擇。
另一方面，你有兩種。

en: When the wind blows,
Know which way to bend
and watch the others break.
flavourtext:UniqueRing25.Text.zh:
聆聽風之低語，順應風勢而行。
若是不願臣服，烈風轉眼而至。

en: "As much as Prototype #20 hints at some deep alternate physics, we cannot afford
to expend any more test subjects. Experiments halted."
- Administrator Qotra
flavourtext:UniqueRing25x.Text.zh:
"原型 #20 暗示些深奧的替代物理學，我們負擔不起
花費更多的測試科目。 實驗暫停。" 
- 主管卡特拉

en: "To us mere mortals, time is slippery.
I'm just evening things out."
- Doryani, Queen's Thaumaturgist
flavourtext:UniqueRing27.Text.zh:
「對我們凡人來說，時間稍縱即逝；
我只是試著平衡罷了。」
- 女王首席預言者多里亞尼

en: A gift from Valako,
appointing Kiloava as the Herald of War.
A title Kaom claimed when he ended Kiloava's bloodline.
flavourtext:UniqueRing29.Text.zh:
一份來自瓦拉庫的禮物，
用以任命基洛瓦為戰爭先鋒。
當岡姆滅了基洛瓦一族時所被賜與之名。

en: A gift from Tasalio, God of Water,
to the chieftain Rakiata.
Kaom took Rakiata's head and hand
so that his warriors' axes might rise and fall like the waves.
flavourtext:UniqueRing30.Text.zh:
一份來自水神塔薩里奧
賜給酋長萊基亞塔。
岡姆摘下了萊基亞塔的頭顱和雙臂，
那雙能輕易璀毀岡姆將士們的手臂。

en: "Likely our closest to the original, yet Prototype #22 still falls short.
Are these objects actually somehow resisting our efforts?"
flavourtext:UniqueRing30x.Text.zh:
"最接近我們原始的版本，但原型 #22 仍然不足。
這些物體實際上是否在某種程度上阻擋我們的努力？"

en: A gift from Ngamahu,
a sign to the Karui to spread like fire.
Given to Akoya, but inherited by Kaom with the swing of his axe.
flavourtext:UniqueRing31.Text.zh:
一份來自拿瑪乎的禮物，
象徵卡魯族如野火般蔓延。
賜與阿寇亞，由岡姆與其兇斧所傳承。

en: In a blaze of glory,
An anomaly defying all odds
The "unkillable" beast met the divine
And Ventor met his latest trophy.
flavourtext:UniqueRing32.Text.zh:
至輝榮耀，劣境克敵
「不敗」怪物終遭天譴
芬多取得畢生最後勝績

en: When the axe finally fell, Seryl shared his pain,
and the last thought that flickered through his
fading mind was her broken, shattered scream.
flavourtext:UniqueRing33.Text.zh:
斧刃落下，塞里爾感受到他的劇痛，
他在恍然垂死時只聽見
塞里爾淒厲慘烈的哀嚎。

en: Forged by three brothers
so that they may recognize each other
across any distance of time or travel.
flavourtext:UniqueRing34.Text.zh: 此戒由三兄弟合力鑄造，即便物換星移、輾轉流離，他們終究能以此相認。

en: Each time, it is granted to the most senior captain of the fleet,
and each time, the ring soon washes ashore once more,
still wrapped around a severed finger.
flavourtext:UniqueRing35.Text.zh: 每次都給予最資深的船隊隊長，每次又很快的連著手指被沖刷至岸邊。

en: To ascend to leadership, the child of a Redblade warlord
must pull the band from the still-hot
ashes of their father.
flavourtext:UniqueRing36.Text.zh: 成為首領之路，紅刃霸主的小孩必須要將此環從父親滾燙的骨灰中拿出。

en: When a fallen leader's body is taken to the funeral peak,
those who seek power must ascend together.
One returns with the seal.
The rest do not return at all.
flavourtext:UniqueRing37.Text.zh:
殞落首領被送去殯葬之峰時，渴望權利者必須隨行而上。
一位將會帶著輝紋返回，其他將再也無法返回。

en: "The flames raced through Lab Five with incredible speed, but were extinguished
just as quickly. This could have been much worse."
- Lead Researcher Ksaret
flavourtext:UniqueRing38x_.Text.zh:
"火焰以驚人的速度穿越了第五實驗室，
但撲滅的速度卻很快。這種情況可能更糟。"
- 首席研究員卡薩雷特

en: A man who changes his loyalties often,
soon finds he has none.
flavourtext:UniqueRing39.Text.zh: 一個不斷轉換忠誠的人，很快就會失去忠誠。

en: Where her mouth should have been
there was only a whirling, black void.
flavourtext:UniqueRing4.Text.zh:
望向她雙頰之間，
徒見那無底深淵。

en: "This thing is not a pet. It is a parasite that feeds on the very will of its host.
Like any part of nightmare, it has found a way to make its price... acceptable."
- Malachai the Soulless
flavourtext:UniqueRing40.Text.zh:
"這可不是個寵物。它是個以宿主的意志為生的寄生蟲。
就像任何的夢魘，它找到了一個人人能接受的... 價錢。"
- 超靈者瑪拉凱

en: Within the heart of every man and woman
lies the soul of a ferocious beast.
If you cannot tame it, embrace it.
flavourtext:UniqueRing41.Text.zh:
在所有男人和女人的心中
都潛藏著一個野獸的靈魂
如果你無法馴服他，那就接納他

en: The Thaumaturgical masters of the Eternal Empire,
as unpredictable and varied as they were,
all understood one thing:
Free thinking leads to free action.
flavourtext:UniqueRing42.Text.zh:
不朽帝國的奇術大師們，
他們變幻莫測且各個多變萬化，
卻全都了解一件事：
自由的思考將引導自由的行動。

en: They wrap around you
until your blood turns as cold as theirs.
flavourtext:UniqueRing44.Text.zh: 緊緊纏住你，直至你的體溫與它相同。

en: "I don't always have a flame handy
when a fresh delinquent walks through our gates."
- Brutus, Warden of Axiom
flavourtext:UniqueRing45.Text.zh:
"必須用熱情的火迎接他們，
那些剛通過大門的新血。"
- 典獄長布魯特斯

en: A man can spend his whole life fishing
before he learns it is not fish that he seeks.
flavourtext:UniqueRing46.Text.zh:
一個人可以花費一生釣魚，
最後發現他找尋的不是魚。

en: "Prototype #8 makes it difficult to think negatively, but two fatalities
resulted when a lead researcher used an epithet in its presence."
flavourtext:UniqueRing4x.Text.zh:
"原型 #8 讓人很難消極地思考，但有兩次死亡
一位首席研究員在其上使用了一個上標的結果。"

en: Doryani stumbled into a realm of madness
And awoke its Master.
flavourtext:UniqueRing5.Text.zh:
多里亞尼誤闖狂亂之境，
狂亂帝國之王因其甦醒。

en: When your skin sloughs, and your blood cooks,
you'll wish the lightning strike had killed you.
flavourtext:UniqueRing51.Text.zh:
當你的皮膚蛻變，你的血液沸騰時，
你會希望閃電劈死你。

en: So great was the thaumaturgy of a bloodpriest's mark,
that sacrifices soon welcomed their death.
flavourtext:UniqueRing52.Text.zh:
血祭之印的魔力是如此之大，
犧牲很快就迎來了他們的死亡。

en: Fleeing the destruction set upon her home,
the Clayshaper sought safety in the clouds of ash above.
<default>{This item can be combined with a Meadow and Valley ring at a Vendor.}
Where once had stood a village, lay naught but splinters.
Some had once been her home.
Some had once been her creations.
Some had once been her family.
<default>{This item can be combined with a Mountain and Valley ring at a Vendor.}
flavourtext:UniqueRing53b.Text.zh:
曾經有一個村莊，那裡毫無價值。
有些曾經是她的家。
有些曾經是她的創作。
有些曾經是她的家人。

<default>{此物品可以在商人那與山巒和峽谷戒指合成。}

en: The river, once fertile and fresh,
and flowing briskly to the sea,
now stood, stained, at a standstill.
Dammed by the coagulating dead.
<default>{This item can be combined with a Meadow and Mountain ring at a Vendor.}
flavourtext:UniqueRing53c.Text.zh:
這條河，曾經饒裕和清新，
強烈地流向大海，
現在靜止、汙濁，死寂一遍。
被僵直的死者所詛咒。

<default>{此物品可以在商人那與草原和山巒戒指合成。}

en: The narrow path turned to rough rocks that led towards the sky.
One last obstacle in a life-long journey
to find a land they could call home.
<default>{This item can be combined with a Meadow and Valley ring at a Vendor.}
flavourtext:UniqueRing53d.Text.zh:
狹窄的通道變成了通向天空的粗糙岩石。
終身人生旅程的最後障礙
找到他們可以稱之為家園的地方。

<default>{此物品可以在商人那與草原和峽谷戒指合成。}

en: Cold winds blasted what little grew on the icy surface.
The gifts of the land lay hidden deeper,
and only patience and persistence would free them.
<default>{This item can be combined with a Mountain and Valley ring at a Vendor.}
flavourtext:UniqueRing53e.Text.zh:
寒風吹過冰冷的表面上生長的東西。
土地的恩賜埋藏得更深，
只有耐心和堅持才能解放他們。

<default>{此物品可以在商人那與山巒和峽谷戒指合成。}

en: Sheltered beneath thick ice,
the river ferried fat fish towards the sea.
But the First King knew the river's secret,
and the fish were not the only ones who grew fat.
<default>{This item can be combined with a Meadow and Mountain ring at a Vendor.}
flavourtext:UniqueRing53f.Text.zh:
掩護在厚厚的冰層下，
這條河將肥魚送往大海。
但是，第一任國王知道這條河的秘密，
魚不是唯一長胖的。

<default>{此物品可以在商人那與草原和山巒戒指合成。}

en: He surveyed his lands, green and vital,
watched with pride as his slaves quarried fine stone for his fortress,
and thanked the heavens for his many blessings.
But this pilgrimage to the peak was to be his last.
<default>{This item can be combined with a Meadow and Valley ring at a Vendor.}
flavourtext:UniqueRing53g.Text.zh:
他調查了他的土地、草地和生命，
他驕傲地看著，當他的奴隸為他的堡壘開采了精美的石頭，
並感謝天堂給他的許多祝福。
但這次登頂的朝聖將是他的最後一次。

<default>{此物品可以在商人那與草原和峽谷戒指合成。}

en: The fields were silent but for the plucking of fruits,
the rustling of leaves, and the breaking of stone.
No slave dared to speak or look the passing king in the eye.
No one... except Aul.
<default>{This item can be combined with a Mountain and Valley ring at a Vendor.}
flavourtext:UniqueRing53h.Text.zh:
田地是沉默的，但是為了採摘水果，
樹葉的沙沙作響，以及石頭的破碎。
沒有奴隸敢於說話或者看著眼中的王者。
沒人...除了奧爾。

<default>{此物品可以在商人那與山巒和峽谷戒指合成。}

en: With no stone for rebuilding, each storm took its toll on the village.
Huts eventually collapsed, their occupants injured or dead.
Bodies were left by the river, to appease the gods.
But the dead would not remain there.
<default>{This item can be combined with a Meadow and Mountain ring at a Vendor.}
flavourtext:UniqueRing53i.Text.zh:
沒有石頭建造，每場風暴都會對村莊產生影響。
小屋倒塌，他們的住戶受傷或死亡。
屍體留在河邊，以安撫眾神。
但他們不會留在那裡。

<default>{此物品可以在商人那與草原和山巒戒指合成。}

en: "Fusing the parasite with another ring has manifested unpredictable effects.
I theorise the sacrificial vessel's level of anguish is a key variable."
- Arzaak, Syndicate Researcher
flavourtext:UniqueRing55.Text.zh:
"將技生蟲與另一個指環融合表現出無法預期的效果。
我認為犧牲器皿的痛苦程度是一個關鍵變量。"
- 密教修研使，埃薩克

en: I condemned an innocent man to the pyres, but to admit this mistake is to condemn myself.
My only choice is to strive harder.
flavourtext:UniqueRing56.Text.zh:
我譴責一個無辜的人到火葬場，但承認這個錯誤就是要譴責自己。
我唯一的選擇就是努力奮鬥。

en: My subordinates circled me eternally, attuned to the slightest weakness,
ready to tear me apart for their own gains.
flavourtext:UniqueRing57.Text.zh:
我的下屬永遠環繞著我，感應了一絲絲的脆弱，
做好準備為了自己的利益而撕裂我。

en: I sacrificed a life of love for one of responsibility, so that she,
and others like her, might be kept safe.
flavourtext:UniqueRing58.Text.zh:
為了一個責任，我犧牲了愛的生命，所以她，
和其他像她一樣的人，可以受到保護。

en: I was a happy child, before the cruel truth was revealed to me.
I fight so that the children may remain ignorant.
flavourtext:UniqueRing59.Text.zh:
我曾是個快樂的小孩，直到我揭開了殘酷的真相。
我為此而站，以讓孩子們保持單純。

en: Existence is infinite
A weave of the living and dead
Beyond the understanding
Of the many mortal threads
flavourtext:UniqueRing6.Text.zh:
亙世永存 
亦死亦生
凡人庸蠢
無從解論

en: I feel the moral weight of what I must do to protect Wraeclast.
I accept my guilt without shame. It is my gift to humanity.
flavourtext:UniqueRing60.Text.zh:
我覺得保護瓦爾克拉斯必須採取道德。
我毫無羞恥地接受了我的內疚。 這是我給予人類的禮物。

en: There is a way to survive the bite of an ice snake,
but few have the resolve to attempt it.
flavourtext:UniqueRing61.Text.zh:
有一種方法可以在冰蛇的咬傷下存活下來，
但很少有人決心嘗試。

en: Those members of the Brotherhood who employ the venom of
Trarthan ice snakes must take great care with the volatile substance.
flavourtext:UniqueRing62.Text.zh:
那些僱用毒液的兄弟會成員
查爾森冰蛇必須非常小心揮發性物質。

en: Beyond the veil of death, there burns a fire
by whose light night is borne.
flavourtext:UniqueRing69.Text.zh:
除了死亡的面紗之外，還有熊熊燃燒的烈火，
燃燒著它的夜晚。

en: The ring I stole,
My finger they took,
A shrouded mind,
Cut their curses short,
As I drained their spirit
And stole their soul.
A blessing is often a curse.
flavourtext:UniqueRing7.Text.zh:
我偷了枚戒指，
被人家砍下一手指，
我心已受蒙蔽，
對其詛咒漫不在意，
我吸盡他們心神，
竊取他們靈魂。
祝福往往招致咒詛。

en: Accept the infection, let it take hold.
Then carry it far and wide.
flavourtext:UniqueRing70.Text.zh:
接受感染，讓它紮根。
然後把它帶到遠方。

en: The priest that carried Yaomac's sigil was
granted one boon by each serpentine head.
flavourtext:UniqueRing71.Text.zh:
攜帶堯馬克印記的神父
被每個蛇頭賜予了一個恩賜。

en: Those that escaped the annihilating light
sank eternally into crushing darkness.
flavourtext:UniqueRing72.Text.zh:
那些逃脫了毀滅之光的人，
將永遠沉入破碎的黑暗中。

en: Only when the mind is empty of ambition
can the cold truth of existence take hold.
flavourtext:UniqueRing73.Text.zh:
只有當心中沒有野心時，
冷酷的真相才能站穩腳跟。

en: Too much of something is bad enough;
too much of nothing is just as tough.
flavourtext:UniqueRing74.Text.zh:
太多的事情已經夠糟糕；
無所事事太多同樣艱難。

en: Enraged by the incompetence of mortals
The demon-lord opens a gateway
Unleashing a litany of pain upon the world.
flavourtext:UniqueRing75.Text.zh:
對凡人的無能感到憤怒
惡魔領主開啟傳送門
向世界釋放一連串的痛苦。

en: Innocence rose to godhood not on inspired faith,
but on the vilification and hatred of another.
flavourtext:UniqueRing76.Text.zh:
天真升為神靈，不是因為受到鼓舞的信仰，
而是因為他人的誹謗和仇恨。

en: "Slay my twin and I will inherit her wisdom.
Slay me and her life will be prolonged by my demise.
Our souls are eternally bound by the sacrifices we have made."
- High Priest Atazek
flavourtext:UniqueRing77_.Text.zh:
"殺死我的孿生姐妹，我便能繼承她的智慧。
殺死我，她的生命將因我的死亡而延續。
我們的靈魂因我們所做的犧牲而永遠地聯繫在一起。"
- 高階祭司阿塔澤克

en: The respect of Karui warriors is hard to earn,
but lasts a lifetime... and beyond.
flavourtext:UniqueRing79.Text.zh:
卡魯戰士的尊重不容易贏得，
但會持續一輩子... 甚至更久。

en: Chaos offers possibility, not outcome.
Our own imaginations ensnare us.
flavourtext:UniqueRing80.Text.zh:
混沌提供的是可能性，而不是結果。
我們自己的想像困住了我們。

en: The first Grattus patriarch had only one tell. When he
slowly turned his ring, all cowered before him.
flavourtext:UniqueRing81.Text.zh:
第一代的格拉圖斯族的唯一傳說。
每當他緩緩轉動戒指，跟前的所有人都不禁瑟縮。

en: I will build the wall that stands against the tide.
The day is coming... I have seen it.
flavourtext:UniqueRing82.Text.zh: 我會建造抵擋浪潮的高牆。那一天即將到來……我看見了。

en: And when you are no longer useful, you will
discover how much you truly mean.
flavourtext:UniqueRing84.Text.zh:
當你無法發揮作用時，你就會
發現你自己到底有多少價值。

en: I never knew fear until she was ripped away.
My promises were hollow ever after.
flavourtext:UniqueRing86.Text.zh:
在她被奪走之前，我從不知恐懼為何物
在那之後，我的承諾變得空洞不堪。

en: In truth, your terror is cold
You mask it with heat and ire
But they know.
They know.
flavourtext:UniqueRing87.Text.zh:
事實上，你的恐懼是冰冷的
你試圖用熱情和憤怒掩蓋它
但他們知道。
他們什麼都知道。

en: It is not a wound caused by an enemy that bites us twice.
It is the smile, the nod... the handshake... of a former friend.
flavourtext:UniqueRing88.Text.zh:
噬咬我們兩次的，不是敵人造成的傷口。
而是舊時朋友的微笑、點頭……還有握手……

en: By its light, Lori led her young charges to safety
and bound up their wounds.
Her sword arm was iron, yet her heart gentle
and proof against hate.
flavourtext:UniqueRing9.Text.zh:
羅瑞以明燈助人逃離死禍
為人包紮傷口。
她劍臂是鋼鐵，心是繞指柔
不念新恨舊仇。

en: "Worry not, my friend, that I tour in fineries.
The ostentation is all part of being a Perandus.
As long as I maintain my Vigilance,
nothing can harm the Empire... or me."
- Emperor Chitus, to Ondar
flavourtext:UniqueRing90.Text.zh:
「莫擔憂，故友，即便寡人用物華奢，
不過是普蘭德斯一脈一貫如此。
寡人務求兢兢業業，帝國與寡人……將永垂不朽。」
- 切特斯大帝對恩德如是說

en: Madness crawls under the skin,
bursting forth from the flesh.
flavourtext:UniqueRing91.Text.zh:
瘋狂在肌膚下蜷伏著，
等待迸發而出。

en: They seek that which lies before them, shining
Yours is a special curse, nipping at your heels
Driving you on long past agony and despair
flavourtext:UniqueRing92.Text.zh:
「他們追尋眼前那閃耀之物，
 你承受一種特殊的詛咒，時刻啃噬你的腳跟，
 驅使你前行，遠遠超越痛苦與絕望。」

en: The old wound lurks deep within,
never healing, never relenting,
making every smile half-hearted.
flavourtext:UniqueRing93.Text.zh:
「舊傷潛伏於心底深處，
 永不癒合，永不寬恕，
 令每一抹笑容都成為勉強的掩飾。」

en: They hide in deep places, and hidden places,
but stillness will find them... and bury them.
flavourtext:UniqueRing94a.Text.zh:
「他們潛伏於深處，藏身於隱秘之地，
 然而寂靜終將尋上門──並將他們埋葬。」

en: They dance and scream under the Broken Sun
as spiraling oblivion deepens into flame.
flavourtext:UniqueRing94b.Text.zh:
「他們在破碎之日下舞動、嘶嚎，
 當盤旋的虛無逐漸墜入火焰之中。」

en: They whisper in the dark, building towers of
mindless thought that seek a hollow truth.
flavourtext:UniqueRing94c.Text.zh:
「他們在黑暗中低語，築起無思之念的高塔，
 只為追尋那虛無的真理。」

en: They move and coil, gripped by painful ecstasy,
all meaning long since lost to dead-eyed lust.
flavourtext:UniqueRing94d.Text.zh:
他們扭動、盤繞，被痛苦的狂喜所攫，
 一切意義早已沉沒於那死寂的慾望之中。

en: They dream no longer, strive no longer,
feel no longer. They dream only of
continuing to dream, and know not why.
flavourtext:UniqueRing94e.Text.zh:
他們不再做夢，不再奮起，
也不再感受。
他們唯一的夢，
是能繼續做夢——
卻早已不知其所以然。

en: All gates are closed.
All dreams are silenced.
What could have been...
flavourtext:UniqueRing95.Text.zh:
萬門皆閉，萬夢皆寂。
 一切本可成真的事……

en: "Sasan tells a tale of robbery, and accosting a
Bardiyan princeling on the road. If that were
true, why hasn't he sold the damn thing already?
Why does he still wear it like a shameful secret?"
flavourtext:UniqueRing96_.Text.zh:
「薩珊講了一個關於搶劫的故事，還說他在路上攔下並勒索了一位
巴迪亞的王族小少爺。若真是如此，他為什麼還沒把那該死的東西賣掉？
又為什麼還把它戴在身上，像個羞恥的秘密一樣？」

en: "I designed this to protect you,
whatever you may face. And when
this is all over... let's talk."
flavourtext:UniqueRing97.Text.zh:
"我設計這個是為了保護你，
無論你將面對什麼。
而當這一切都結束時……我們談談吧。"

en: "Velka was a mere pirate when she ventured to Tsoatha,
a reverence for the Brine King burning in her heart.
She returned as something different. Something more.
So the legend of the Tide Witch is told."
flavourtext:UniqueRing98.Text.zh:
維爾卡前往特索塔時，不過是個凡庸的海盜，
心中燃燒著對海洋王的崇敬。
然而當她歸來時，她已截然不同。
超脫凡軀。潮汐女巫的傳奇便由此流傳。

en: The victor stands tall with hand held high,
unwavering, unblinking, unstoppable.
The road to victory is paved
with the bones of the defeated.
flavourtext:UniqueRingVictors.Text.zh: 通往勝利的道路，鋪滿敗者的屍骨。

en: Knowledge brings power, and with power you can
grab truth by the throat and shape it as you wish.
flavourtext:UniqueSceptre1.Text.zh:
知識能帶來力量，若獲此等力量
就能掌握世間真理，任憑己意塑造真理

en: "All are welcome in Hinekora's eternal home."
- Karui Proverb
flavourtext:UniqueSceptre10.Text.zh: 「在悉妮蔻拉的永恆之鄉，我們來者不拒。」- 卡魯諺語

en: Thousands gazed upon the doors of the great labyrinth,
at an Eternal Champion in steel and gold,
The first to challenge its treacherous traps.
To mark the occasion, Izaro had the Champion's remains gilded.
flavourtext:UniqueSceptre11.Text.zh:
人們凝視著大迷宮入口的那位，
由鐵和金包覆的永恆英雄，
成為史上第一位成功挑戰迷宮中可怕陷阱的英雄。
為了紀念，伊澤洛為這位英雄親手鍍上金。

en: When God forged the rules of reality,
he stated that some forces cannot co-exist.
He then made man with an unequivocal
desire to disobey.
flavourtext:UniqueSceptre12.Text.zh:
當神創造了現世的規則
祂規定了某些力量無法共存
然而他又賦予人們與生俱來
反抗規則的本性

en: In time, all becomes nothing.
We just expedite the process.
flavourtext:UniqueSceptre13.Text.zh:
對時間來說，所有事物如同無物
我們僅能加速事情的發展而已

en: Fight not the cold
Forsake hope
Be still.
flavourtext:UniqueSceptre14.Text.zh:
不用跟寒冷為敵
現在就放棄希望
接著永遠沉寂

en: "Attempt #2520: Been slaving away at this one for longer than I can remember.
Convinced this assignment is retribution from my superior..."
flavourtext:UniqueSceptre14x.Text.zh:
"測試 #2520：在這個地方被奴役的時間比我記得的要長。
深信這項工作是來自我上級的報應…"

en: After the fires swept down from the sky and swallowed the city,
all that lingered, as if locked in time,
was a memory of that which was gone, a whisper of deeds undone.
flavourtext:UniqueSceptre17.Text.zh:
在火焰從天而降，吞噬了整座城後，
剩下的，就像時間暫停似的，
已過去的回憶，撤銷作為的耳語。

en: When the world spins out of control,
the safest place to be is in the centre.
flavourtext:UniqueSceptre18.Text.zh:
當世界失控時，
最安全的地方就是中心。

en: There the weary multitude of man-kind
shall turn in their masses into the wide fire,
where the destroying flame embraces the living,
some will go up, some down, filled with misery.
flavourtext:UniqueSceptre19.Text.zh:
那裡厭倦了多數的人類
要把他們的信徒變成大火，
那裡摧毀的火焰吞噬了生靈，
有些會上升，有些會下降，充滿痛苦。

en: "Lord of Bone, Lord of Flesh, yet all that we can
master turns to ash."
- Researcher Arn
flavourtext:UniqueSceptre19x.Text.zh:
“骨肉之主，肉體之主，但我們所能
將主人變成灰燼。"
- 研究員昂恩

en: Left in her tomb by the lynch mob,
the flame inside still blazed bright after her death,
and so did hers.
flavourtext:UniqueSceptre2.Text.zh:
暴民行私刑，墓中留此杖，
火光永不滅，縱使物主亡，
魂火永不熄，即便身已葬。

en: The vastness of the cosmos holds energies beyond comprehension,
should one have the fortitude to grasp them.
flavourtext:UniqueSceptre21.Text.zh: 浩瀚的宇宙擁有超越認知的力量，要有勇氣才能掌控它們。

en: "We could rival the gods with this power, if only we had the mitigating mechanisms
to make it work. A jewel, a talisman, an armour... or the Font..."
flavourtext:UniqueSceptre21x.Text.zh:
"只要我們有緩解機制使之運轉，我們就可以
用這種力量與眾神抗衡。珠寶，護身符，盔甲…或聖水器…"

en: "And so it begins. Someone,
somewhere, is trying again...
seems mankind never learns."
flavourtext:UniqueSceptre25x.Text.zh:
"就這樣開始了。某個地方的
某個人，又在進行嘗試了……
看來人類永遠學不會教訓。"

en: Over the course of a lifetime, Cadigan the First
conquered every city-state on Middengard one by one,
continually leveraging the power of each against the next.
flavourtext:UniqueSceptre26.Text.zh:
先驅者卡迪根終其一生履行征服密登加德諸城邦的志業，
遠交近攻、合縱連橫是他所向披靡的方略。

en: A future of untold power and doom opened
before Zarokh in that moment. He realised
there was not one Time, but many...
flavourtext:UniqueSceptre27.Text.zh:
在那一刻，一個蘊含無盡力量與毀滅的未來
在澤洛克面前展開。他意識到，
時間並非只有一條，而是無數條…

en: "We Ezomytes made promises that this
Eternal God would have us break."
- Thane Rigwald
flavourtext:UniqueSceptre4.Text.zh:
「艾茲麥人堅信
永恆之主將賜下福音。」 
- 泰恩．里格沃德

en: Beneath the blue,
The stillness permits
The drowned dead
To regret their choices.
flavourtext:UniqueSceptre5.Text.zh:
藍光之底，
平靜死寂
溺者水出
悔不當初。

en: My Iron heart will beat when yours is rust.
I take your Strength, your power, your lust.
By Iron Will alone I set my mind in motion.
Through endless storms of fervent devotion.
flavourtext:UniqueSceptre6.Text.zh:
你的鐵心鏽蝕，我的鐵心跳動
我接受你的力量，權力和落空
我單憑藉鋼鐵意志，化意念為行動
通過無數熱烈奉獻的暴風

en: The result of the catalytic reaction would be either immortality for all,
or death for all. It was a risk Doryani was willing to take.
flavourtext:UniqueSceptre7.Text.zh:
「煉化」將讓所有子民長生不老，
或是體毀魂消。 無論結果如何，多里亞尼都相信這是瓦爾一族的救藥。

en: Feed on the light of the living,
Bring darkness to all I see,
Until we are one in shadow.
flavourtext:UniqueSceptre8.Text.zh:
以光明之子的生命為餌食，
將黑暗賜與吾眼所視之物，
直到我們在陰影中合而為一。

en: "A sprinkle of liquid encouragement is often required
to garnish the perfect confession."
- Brutus, Warden of Axiom
flavourtext:UniqueSceptre9.Text.zh:
「想要取得招供的最好方法，
就是灑點滾燙的液化金屬在罪犯身上。」
- 典獄長布魯特斯

en: Destruction incarnate leaves a bitter aftertaste
as one soul is imbued with remnants of another,
and the earth is salted by rivers of blood.
flavourtext:UniqueSentinel1.Text.zh:
毀滅的化身留下了苦澀的餘味，
因為一個靈魂充滿了另一個靈魂的殘餘，
大地因血河而酸澀。

en: Mechanisms gone awry, circuitry in flux.
This experiment became something truly perverse.
flavourtext:UniqueSentinel11.Text.zh:
機制出了差錯，電路不斷變化。
這個實驗變得非常反常。

en: Alone among the powers of artifice, there is one against
which the horrors of Wraeclast have never adapted.
flavourtext:UniqueSentinel2.Text.zh:
在詭計的力量中，只有一種是
瓦爾克拉斯的恐怖從未經歷過的。

en: Knowing the human body to harbour infinite potential,
she endowed her subjects with the most potent forces at her disposal,
striving invariably for improvement.
flavourtext:UniqueSentinel3b.Text.zh:
知道人體蘊藏著無限的潛力，
她賦予她的臣民以她所支配的最強大的力量，
並不斷追求進步。

en: This grotesque conglomerate is truly an abomination to behold.
You feel a strange sense of déjà vu when you gaze upon its hideous visage...
flavourtext:UniqueSentinel3e.Text.zh:
這個怪誕集團令人憎惡。
當你凝視它可怕的面容時，你會感到一種奇怪的似曾相識…

en: A fiery horror from a distant plane of existence,
it feasts upon the charred corpses subsumed by lava pits.
Don't fall in...
flavourtext:UniqueSentinel3f.Text.zh:
來自遙遠星球的熾熱恐怖，
它以被熔岩坑週圍燒焦的屍體為食。
不要掉進去…

en: He feeds on the nightmares of the Atlas' denizens.
If you fall asleep in the Atlas, he'll be waiting...
flavourtext:UniqueSentinel3h.Text.zh:
他以輿圖人民的噩夢為食。
如果你在輿圖睡著了，他會在那等著…

en: In the wake of tyranny,
The battlefields have been left barren.
flavourtext:UniqueSentinel4.Text.zh:
在暴政之後，
戰場已經荒蕪。

en: Otherworldly incantations echo across the battlefield,
And the warrior readies his blade.
flavourtext:UniqueSentinel9.Text.zh:
超凡的咒語迴盪在戰場上，
戰士準備好他的劍。

en: "With piety and justice."
- Perandus family motto
flavourtext:UniqueShieldDex2.Text.zh:
「信奉真理與正義。」
- 普蘭德斯家族教條

en: "As long as I see death in my mirror, so will Wraeclast."
- Atziri, Queen of the Vaal
flavourtext:UniqueShieldDex3.Text.zh:
「帝陸將隨我一同踏上冥河之渡。」
- 瓦爾女王阿茲里

en: Crimson burn'd the star of sadness,
All was woe that seem'd but gladness.
flavourtext:UniqueShieldDex5.Text.zh:
血煞災星現凶光
誰知惡劫吉中藏

en: The horrors we've encountered are nothing
compared to the horrors we haven't.
flavourtext:UniqueShieldDex6.Text.zh:
吾等所經歷之恐怖夢魘，
遠不如尚未見到的地獄。

en: Light as a board,
Stiff as a feather.
flavourtext:UniqueShieldDex8.Text.zh:
輕如木板，
硬如羽毛。

en: "For personal defence, Prototype #444 is fantastic. It is one hundred percent
effective seventy five percent of the time... once."
- Lead Researcher Ksaret
flavourtext:UniqueShieldDex8x.Text.zh:
“對於個人防禦，原型 #444 太棒了。它是100% 
效率、75%時間…一次。"
- 首席研究員卡薩雷特

en: One wrong step triggers destruction.
Agony slowly dominates the will to live.
flavourtext:UniqueShieldDexInt1.Text.zh: 一失足成千古恨，苦痛纏身漸消沉。

en: "Look around you. What do you see?
Corruption, perversion, sin?
No. It is progress.
You simply lack the means to see it."
- Inquisitor Maligaro
flavourtext:UniqueShieldDexInt2.Text.zh:
「看看四周，看到了什麼？
腐化、墮落與罪惡？
不，那其實是自然的演進。
你只是看不到現實罷了。」
- 審判者馬雷葛蘿

en: Izaro's insistence on using lava
resulted in some surprising material discoveries.
flavourtext:UniqueShieldDexInt3.Text.zh: 從火焰裡鍛造的東西不會被燒傷

en: "Great minds wish to reveal all the secrets of time and space.
But it does not matter. Creation, the act of Matter Metamorphosis,
is the only secret worth discovering."
- Zeel, Vaal Tinkerer
flavourtext:UniqueShieldDexInt5.Text.zh:
"偉大的心智希望可以揭開所有時間和空間的秘密。
但這無關緊要。創造物，物質變形的行為，
是唯一值得發現的秘密。"
- 瓦爾粗工席爾

en: Something within the machine never stops moving,
but Oriathan scholars dare not open it to find out why.
flavourtext:UniqueShieldDexInt6.Text.zh:
機器內的某些東西永不停止，
但奧瑞亞的學者都沒有膽量開啟它來了解為什麼。

en: The Vaal emptied their slaves of beating hearts,
and left a mountain of twitching dead.
flavourtext:UniqueShieldInt1.Text.zh:
瓦爾人挖掉奴隸的心臟
微微抽動的屍體堆積如山。

en: The heart grows slow,
the spirit grows strong.
<default>{This item can be transformed on the Altar of Sacrifice along with Vial of Awakening}
The empire is both the tree and the fruit.
It provides safe harbour as ideas grow within,
and when the time is right, the apple is picked.
The idea, and our ideals, take root.
flavourtext:UniqueShieldInt13.Text.zh:
帝國既是樹也是果實。
隨著想法的增長，它提供了安全的港灣，
當時機成熟時，挑選蘋果。
這個想法和我們的理想已經紮根了。

en: Though we live and act as individuals,
in truth, we are tethered together.
The barriers that divide us need not be broken
for our spirits to become entangled.
flavourtext:UniqueShieldInt14.Text.zh:
雖然我們單獨的生活著，
事實上，我們被束縛在一起。
分裂我們的障礙不必打破
讓我們的精神變得糾結。

en: You shall be weighed and measured. You shall be judged...
and perhaps you shall be found worthy.
flavourtext:UniqueShieldInt16.Text.zh:
你將被秤重和測量。你將被審判...
也許你值得被發現。

en: He raised the greatest army Trarthus had ever seen... against
Bardiya's orders, they ravaged and pillaged without mercy.
flavourtext:UniqueShieldInt17.Text.zh: 他集結了特拉特斯有史以來規模最大的軍隊……但他們無視於巴迪亞的命令，毫無憐憫地燒殺擄掠。

en: "This infernal imp wasn't willing to part with its piece of the Allflame.
It's taught me ways to stoke the flame. To burn unnaturally fierce.
The imp may have the Allflame, but I have the imp."
- Velka, the Tide Witch
flavourtext:UniqueShieldInt18.Text.zh:
"這隻地獄小鬼不願交出牠所持有的那一部分不滅之火。
牠教會了我如何助長火焰，讓它燃燒得更加猛烈，甚至超越自然的極限。
小鬼或許擁有不滅之火，但我擁有這隻小鬼。"
- 潮汐女巫．維爾卡

en: You carried me through life,
The least I can do is carry you through death.
flavourtext:UniqueShieldInt2.Text.zh: 汝與我同生，吾與汝共死。

en: The last thing Arimagius heard was the
jester's mocking bells in the distance.
flavourtext:UniqueShieldInt3.Text.zh:
最後在亞里瑪吉烏斯耳邊響起
遠方小丑嘲諷的鈴聲。

en: Open your eyes and you will see the cracks in your enemy's walls.
Open your mind and you will see the cracks in your enemy's plans.
flavourtext:UniqueShieldInt4.Text.zh:
張開你的雙眼，你將看到敵人防禦上的縫隙；
張開你的心眼，你將看到敵人計畫上的缺口。

en: Those who are skilled in combat do not become angered.
Those who are skilled at winning do not become afraid.
Thus the wise win before they fight,
while the ignorant fight to win.
flavourtext:UniqueShieldInt6.Text.zh:
爭戰之兵不知愠
常勝之士不知畏
賢者勝之不武
愚者武之求勝

en: Thaumaturgy has no limit.
It is our fragile reality that imposes boundaries.
flavourtext:UniqueShieldInt7.Text.zh:
魔法沒有極限
是脆弱的現實給它設下界線

en: She looked upon her reflection
and trembled, and shook,
until she was not what she saw.
flavourtext:UniqueShieldInt8.Text.zh:
面對自己的倒影
她顫抖、搖曳，
直至眼中的她不再是自己。

<default>{此物品能夠透過艾許的祝福改造}

en: She could see what she was not;
a silhouette wreathed in light.
And she was still.
flavourtext:UniqueShieldInt9.Text.zh:
靜止的身影，纏繞著光暈；
陌生的自己，映入了眼簾。

en: Marceus' unblemished shield is a testament
to his arrogance... and his fate.
flavourtext:UniqueShieldStr1.Text.zh:
穆希爾斯的華盾的戰盾映照著熱鬥的激昂，
但傲慢最終使他葬身沙場。

en: Tukohama couldn't lose a fight in his fortress,
So he carried his fortress to the fight.
flavourtext:UniqueShieldStr10.Text.zh:
圖克哈瑪深信在他的堡壘中沒有人能戰勝他，
因此他攜帶著他的堡壘前去戰場。

en: "As one of our few creations that did not cost any fatalities,
Prototype #10 bore unexpectedly positive results."
flavourtext:UniqueShieldStr10x.Text.zh:
"作為我們為數不多的不會造成死亡的創造物之一，
原型 #10 產生意外的正面結果。"

en: "It's not Karui, Azmeri or even Vaal in origin,
but one thing is certain. It is very, very old."
- Icius Perandus, Antiquities Collection, Item 46
flavourtext:UniqueShieldStr11.Text.zh:
"這源頭不是來自卡魯、阿茲莫里甚至瓦爾，
但有一件事很明顯。它非常非常古老。"
- 伊席厄斯．普蘭德斯，古物收藏家，物品編號 46

en: Lunaris crossed silently, shining and full,
Softly night left her, alone and forlorn.
Solaris rose to meet her, feeling her pull.
'Neath the midday sun, the night was reborn.
flavourtext:UniqueShieldStr12.Text.zh:
月影神悄悄的閃著微光穿過，
夜晚輕輕的離開她，孤單且淒涼。
日耀神升起見她，感受她的牽引。
在正午太陽下，夜晚靜靜重生。

en: "The newcomers warn of doom and death beyond mortal ken.
I ask, why should we fear the fire when we serve the Lord of Light?"
- Maxarius, the first High Templar
flavourtext:UniqueShieldStr13.Text.zh:
"新人警告說，末日和死亡超越了凡人的視野。
請問，我們侍奉光明之主，為什麼要怕火？"
- 初代聖宗．馬克薩留斯

en: The priests found the Great Shield the night it fell to Middengard,
but it was the smiths who delved into the secrets it held.
flavourtext:UniqueShieldStr14.Text.zh:
祭司們在大盾降臨密登加德的夜晚便找到了它，
但深入探索其中奧秘的則是工匠。

en: "A tale-woman passed through here not long ago.
Taught us a thing or two. We're not going to execute
you for what you've done... no. You've a debt to repay."
flavourtext:UniqueShieldStr15.Text.zh:
「不久前有位說書女從這裡路過。
她教了我們一些道理。
我們不會因你的所作所為處決你……不，
你有一筆尚未償還的債。」

en: A mighty bulwark, curved and strong
A dauntless wall, against the throng
All lance and arrow, knocked aside
For rout of foe, for turn of tide.
flavourtext:UniqueShieldStr2.Text.zh:
不破堡壘，抵擋萬軍，
厚實堵牆，高聳入雲；
戰槍飛箭，一律彈開，
情勢逆轉，敵軍潰敗。

en: Fire dances with those who doubt
Licks the skin and flesh from the fearful
Where there is no fear
There is no flame
flavourtext:UniqueShieldStr3.Text.zh:
猶豫遲疑，身陷惡火
膽怯畏懼，皮燒肉灼
唯有無懼無畏
方能業火中自得進退。

en: The problem with working fresh trolltimber:
by the time you've carved out one end,
the other has sprouted fresh roots!
flavourtext:UniqueShieldStr5.Text.zh: 使用新鮮松木的大問題，當你完成一頭的刻鑿時，另一頭已經長出新根！

en: We are within her reach,
and when the time is right,
she will reach into us.
flavourtext:UniqueShieldStr8.Text.zh:
位於她所及之處，
當時機到來，
她將伸出援手。

<default>{此物品能夠透過烏爾尼多的祝福改造}

en: Our hearts cry out
but are silenced by our flesh
and so we give up our flesh.
flavourtext:UniqueShieldStr9.Text.zh:
身體沉默了內心，
因此我們捨去肉體。

en: By tourney's end, Daresso bled and shivered.
Yet even accursed treachery failed to steal the champion's victory.
flavourtext:UniqueShieldStrDex1.Text.zh:
苦戰後，德瑞索淌血顫抖卻仍屹立不倒；
即使受到致命背叛，依然無損冠軍威名。

en: On the Kraken's Rot, there was no whipping.
No lashes. Only barnacle-scraping duty.
flavourtext:UniqueShieldStrDex10.Text.zh: 在"海怪腐潰號"上，沒有鞭刑，沒有鞭笞，只有刮除藤壺的苦差事。

en: We isolate ourselves to hide our long-held pain.
We lash out, when all we want is an end to loneliness.
flavourtext:UniqueShieldStrDex16.Text.zh:
「我們將自己孤立，為了掩藏那長久以來的傷痛。
我們憤怒出擊，只因渴望結束這無盡的孤寂。」

en: The thicker the shell,
the greater the beast that hunts it.
flavourtext:UniqueShieldStrDex3.Text.zh: 殼越厚重，吸引越巨大之野獸。

en: Silent, silent night,
Quench the holy light.
flavourtext:UniqueShieldStrDex4.Text.zh: 寂靜無聲之夜，將神聖之光熄滅。

en: Never let the audience know your true form. Misdirect them,
beguile them. Strike when they least expect it.
flavourtext:UniqueShieldStrDex6.Text.zh:
絕對不要讓聽眾知道你的真實形式。誤導他們，
欺騙他們。 在他們最不期望的時候罷工。

en: Judge not the weak, for
they empower the strong.
flavourtext:UniqueShieldStrDex7.Text.zh:
不要評判弱者，因為
他們賦予強者權力。

en: The Wildwood was a gift, meant as a haven
against the Winter of the World.
flavourtext:UniqueShieldStrDex9.Text.zh:
野性森林是一份禮物，
旨在成為對抗世界之冬的避風港。

en: Eternal soldiers fight for glory or death.
The Solaris Vanguard know only glory.
flavourtext:UniqueShieldStrInt11.Text.zh:
永恆的士兵為了榮耀與死亡而戰。
日曜先鋒只知道甚麼是榮耀。

en: An Emperor must conquer his own darkness
before he can act as a beacon of light.
flavourtext:UniqueShieldStrInt12.Text.zh:
在帝王可以像燈塔引導人們前
帝王一定要克服他的黑暗面。

en: Chitus' success stemmed from his cunning, taking calculated
risks so that greater dangers could be averted.
flavourtext:UniqueShieldStrInt13.Text.zh:
切特斯的成功源於他的狡猾，他冒著一定的風險，
因此可以避免更大的危險。

en: The Banished Architect sought to employ all the
darkest secrets of the Vaal... at the same time.
flavourtext:UniqueShieldStrInt15.Text.zh:
這位放逐的建築師試圖
同時利用瓦爾的所有最黑暗的秘密…。

en: Born from the marriage of ice and sky,
the aurora evokes both awe and power.
flavourtext:UniqueShieldStrInt4.Text.zh:
冰霜和夜空互映輝映，
帶來驚人的璀璨明光。

en: My bearer shall be guarded by flame,
for I am the phoenix, forever radiant in glory.
flavourtext:UniqueShieldStrInt5.Text.zh:
持此護盾，聖火護衛，
吾乃鳳凰，光燦永輝。

en: "Let the evil ones deliver their fiery darts.
This time I've put my faith in steel."
- Commander Santoni of the Damned Brotherhood
flavourtext:UniqueShieldStrInt6.Text.zh:
「惡徒竟敢如此放盪！
那麼，就領教我滿懷信仰的鋼刃。」
- 詛咒兄弟會指揮官山托尼

en: What is below is like what is above,
and what is above is like what is below,
to accomplish the miracles of one thing.
flavourtext:UniqueShieldStrInt7.Text.zh:
其上似其下，
其下若其上，
方能成奇蹟。

en: "Close to the original, and perhaps even more useful. However,
close is not what we are looking for. Keep trying."
- Administrator Qotra
flavourtext:UniqueShieldStrInt9x.Text.zh:
"接近原始版本，甚至可能更有用。但是，
結束不是我們想要的。繼續嘗試。"
- 主管卡特拉

en: Burn to cinders, scar and maim,
Rule a world, bathed in flame.
flavourtext:UniqueStaff1.Text.zh:
燃為灰燼，崩裂焚解；
斯是霸權，立於火焰。

en: The best way to gain the element of surprise,
is to let your enemy learn your plans,
and execute them - twice.
flavourtext:UniqueStaff11.Text.zh:
制勝奇襲上策：
故意暴露欲行戰術，
一波攻勢未停，一波攻勢又起。

en: Guard your darkest thoughts well, for they are
the cracks through which the Nightmare crawls.
flavourtext:UniqueStaff12.Text.zh: 冰晶無瑕，讓人心醉神迷，如今僅剩碎片

en: "God's creations always begin and end
with flames and ice.
We should count ourselves lucky when we see neither."
- Archbishop Geofri
flavourtext:UniqueStaff13.Text.zh:
「冰、火，上帝創造之萬物始末。兩者皆未見，吾輩該感到幸運。」
- 大教主吉爾菲

en: When the storm comes,
the safest place to be is the centre.
"They spent a lifetime in the service of God,
only to spend eternity in the service of me."
- Kadavrus, Surgeon to the Umbra
flavourtext:UniqueStaff15.Text.zh:
"他們竭盡一生侍奉神
卻不知這只是在永遠的服侍我"
- 烏姆布拉的外科醫師凱達弗斯

en: "Since one with knowledge of machines
might be able to bring the labyrinth to a standstill,
Izaro had us place many boobytrapped decoys.
But I know which switch brings the monster down."
- Xirgil, Trapbuilder's final words.
flavourtext:UniqueStaff16.Text.zh:
"因為任何擁有關於機器知識的人
皆有可能讓迷宮停止運作，
伊澤洛命令我們設下許多假的誘餌
但我仍然知道正確的開關是哪個。"
- 舍吉，陷阱製造師的遺言

en: "The world is not simply black and white,
it is not divided into good and evil.
But black and white, good and evil, do exist,
and we must know how to recognize them."
- Archbishop Geofri
flavourtext:UniqueStaff17.Text.zh:
"世界不單純分為黑與白，
不單純分為善與惡。
但只要黑、白、善、惡存在，
我們則須學習區分。"
-大主教吉爾菲

en: "Lab Two suffered significant structural damage in the process of creating
Prototype #77. It is, however, the closest we've come to perfection."
flavourtext:UniqueStaff17x.Text.zh:
"第二實驗室在創建原型 #77 的過程中遭受了
重大的結構破壞。但是，這是我們最接近完美的。"

en: You have been found guilty.
Let the fires cleanse you of your sins.
flavourtext:UniqueStaff18.Text.zh:
你已被認定有罪。
烈焰將洗去你的罪過。

en: Shed by the winged beast of night,
A scaly frost-encrusted thorn.
All who feel its wintry light
Shiver in pain at the frozen dawn.
flavourtext:UniqueStaff2.Text.zh:
帶翼野獸在夜裡脫胎換骨，
蛻下寒霜覆蓋的帶麟犄角。
眾人感受到凜冬寒光冷酷，
無不渾身顫抖，淒厲尖嘯。

en: "Creation is the act of making the intangible tangible.
To work backwards, to make the tangible intangible,
is to step into the mind of a god."
- Doryani, Queen's Thaumaturgist
flavourtext:UniqueStaff21.Text.zh:
"將無形化為有形是創造，
而將有形化為無形，
將更加接近上帝的思維。"
-女王奇術師多里亞尼

en: Blurred is the boundary
between creator and destroyer.
flavourtext:UniqueStaff22.Text.zh:
模糊的邊界
創造者或毀滅者。

en: There was never a simpler time.
Just simpler motivations.
flavourtext:UniqueStaff24.Text.zh:
從來就沒有單純的時代。
只有單純的動機。

en: To stand at the confluence of the elements,
the master must achieve perfect balance.
flavourtext:UniqueStaff27.Text.zh:
站在這些要素的交匯處，
主人必須達到完美的平衡。

en: Forged to rule the waves and tide
Destined to serve the monkey's paw
Strong as a tower of iron
Deft as the needle doubt
flavourtext:UniqueStaff3.Text.zh:
生來駕浪馭潮
命定臣服庸主
若鐵塔，堅韌不倒
似細針，揮動自如

en: There is no force more destructive in the heavens
than the scintillating light of utter clarity.
flavourtext:UniqueStaff30.Text.zh:
天上沒有什麼力量比無比清晰的
閃爍光芒更具破壞力。

en: Life... Death...
The whim of the cosmos.
flavourtext:UniqueStaff31.Text.zh:
生…死…
宇宙的奇思幻想。

en: For their mortal allies, the last Titans forged a mighty staff,
one that could safely hold the first unearthed virtue gem.
flavourtext:UniqueStaff32.Text.zh:
為了他們的凡人盟友，最後的泰坦鑄造了一根強大的法杖，
能夠安全地容納第一顆被挖掘出來的古靈寶石。

en: Nothingness is loathe to relinquish its grip.
Every moment is a struggle to exist.
flavourtext:UniqueStaff33.Text.zh:
虛無不願放開它的掌控。
每一刻都是存在的掙扎。

en: We shared a memory of your mother,
a memory of roses, of autumn.
One day, I will be but a memory as well,
but I will never leave your side.
flavourtext:UniqueStaff35.Text.zh:
我們共享著關於你母親的記憶，
那是玫瑰和秋日的記憶。
總有一天，我也會成為純粹的記憶，
但是我永遠不會離開你的身邊。

en: "I have risked everything. My position, my ambition, my
very life. There has to be a way to save our people. If we
must, let us tear apart the very foundations of reality!"
flavourtext:UniqueStaff36.Text.zh:
「我已賭上所有──我的地位、我的野心、甚至我的性命。
必有一條拯救我族的路。若真無他法，便讓我們撕裂現實的根基吧！」

en: Before they 'saved' their beloved leader, the Afarud
tested their ritual on a dying man... but they made
a fatal mistake. They did not bind him to an object.
flavourtext:UniqueStaff37.Text.zh:
在他們「拯救」心愛的領袖之前，阿法魯德
曾先拿一個垂死之人來測試他們的儀式……
但他們犯下了致命的錯誤。他們沒有將他束縛於某個物件之上。

en: The experienced sailor knows the true mystery of the sea:
why, on every continent, in every lagoon, does there skitter
a crab of new size and colour? Not related, not lost spawn,
but a clawed snapper all of its own make and temperament...
flavourtext:UniqueStaff38.Text.zh:
經驗豐富的水手明白大海真正的謎團：為什麼在
每塊大陸、每個潟湖，都會橫行著體型與顏色
全新的螃蟹？牠們並非近親，也非失落的子嗣，
而是完全擁有自身構造與習性的螯爪獵手……

en: You've no reason for fear when you're a root in a fen
- Old Ezomyte saying.
flavourtext:UniqueStaff4.Text.zh:
像樹根般緊攀著那滋養的淤泥時，何需害怕─團結力量大。
- 艾茲麥的古老智慧

en: "Attempt #306: The power I can sense in this ancient branch
still eludes me. Perhaps if I attach some string and a hook..."
flavourtext:UniqueStaff4x.Text.zh:
"測試 #306：在這個古老的分支中我能感受到的力量
仍然讓我難以理解。 也許如果我附上一些繩子和一個鉤子…"

en: The whispers of the dead
Carry wisdom for the living,
If you are willing to give your life
To listen.
flavourtext:UniqueStaff5.Text.zh:
亡者喃喃教誨
說與生者領會，
如願聽聞，以命相陪。

en: "To shake a hand is to double your power."
- Jaetai, Queen's Advisor
flavourtext:UniqueStaff6_.Text.zh:
「交際是鞏固權力的不二法門。」
- 女王策士傑泰

en: The right to rule demands mental acuity,
a strong arm,
And a tenacious sense of justice.
flavourtext:UniqueStaff7.Text.zh:
拳頭、正義感、激情；
身為王者三項缺一不可。

en: "Physical forces and flames seem to share some innate bond.
What logic lies beneath the veil of reality?"
flavourtext:UniqueStaff9x.Text.zh:
"物理力和火焰似乎有著某些先天的聯繫。
現實的面紗下隱藏著什麼邏輯？"

en: We wander to pass time.
We travel to fulfill.
flavourtext:UniqueStrDexHelmet1.Text.zh:
隨處漫步使我們疲乏困頓，
周遊各地讓我們增廣見聞。

en: Hrimnor's presence was as cold as ice,
but his heart burned for vengeance.
flavourtext:UniqueStrHelmet2.Text.zh:
雷姆諾看似迷茫，冷若寒霜，
實則復仇心切，熾熱生光。

en: In the light of Solaris, the shadows cower and hide.
But every night they gather and grow,
and all but the strong and the stupid
seek shelter from their grasp until daybreak.
flavourtext:UniqueTalisman1.Text.zh:
在日光的照耀下，陰影無處躲藏
但當夜幕降臨，陰影聚集而壯大
也帶來愚蠢懦弱之人
在晨曦到來前苟且偷生

en: Long ago, the ocean was a puddle where a golden fish dwelt,
who lit the ocean from within and kept the water fresh.
When the sky burned, the fish dived deep,
never to return, and the waters turned sour.
flavourtext:UniqueTalisman2.Text.zh:
很久以前，海洋曾只是一潭池泱與一條金魚，
它照亮了海洋並讓水保持清澈。
當天空燃燒了起來，金魚便深深潛入水底，
永遠不再回來，讓水變得苦酸。

en: Just as the rat cowers before the dog
and the dog cowers before Man,
so too should we cower before the First Ones
and pray we never learn of what comes next.
flavourtext:UniqueTalisman3.Text.zh:
正當老鼠屈服於狗
而狗屈服於人類
人類應當屈服於初代
並祈求永遠不用知道再下一階是誰

en: I once thought the First Ones were just
stories made to scare children.
But I've seen what they can do. I've felt it.
And now I must live with that terrible knowledge.
flavourtext:UniqueTalisman4.Text.zh:
我曾以為我們口口聲聲的初代
僅僅只是為了嚇唬小孩子的故事
但如今我見證了他們的所作所為
我將必須在這讓人恐懼的事實中活下去

en: I am but a vessel for a greater force.
It acts through me. Speaks through me.
Decides what lives and dies through me.
And will change the world through me.
flavourtext:UniqueTalisman5.Text.zh:
我只是一個為了更強大存在而活著的軀殼
它透過我行動著，透過我訴說著
並且透過我的手決定誰該活下來誰該死去
接著透過我徹底的改變整個世界

en: Life and death dance ever closer,
waiting only for the right moment.
flavourtext:UniqueTincture1.Text.zh:
生與死的舞蹈逐漸靠近，
等待著合適的時機。

en: The liquid within boils and fumes,
ready to erupt at any provocation.
flavourtext:UniqueTincture2_.Text.zh:
裡面的液體沸騰又冒著煙，
一觸即發。

en: Accept your fate, or lie, pretend.
Death collects you in the end.
flavourtext:UniqueTwoHandAce2.Text.zh:
無論接受命運，或是詐死頑抗。
你終究還是難逃滅亡。

en: One by one, Kaom slaughtered the weakest tribe
leaders until the others leapt to join his cause.
flavourtext:UniqueTwoHandAxe1.Text.zh:
岡姆屠戮，滅盡孱弱血統，
各族恐懼，造就絕對服從。

en: We feel the Mother's love
and beg to return to her womb.
At last she holds us,
and so we turn to dust.
flavourtext:UniqueTwoHandAxe12.Text.zh:
終受擁入她懷。
我們化為塵埃。

en: Hinekora bound Kitava to a rock
that Kitava could not lift with all his might.
Kitava vowed that when he broke free,
he would devour every soul in Hinekora's domain.
flavourtext:UniqueTwoHandAxe13.Text.zh:
悉妮蔻拉將奇塔弗綁在只有圖克哈瑪能搬動的巨石上，
奇塔弗向悉妮蔻拉發誓，在重獲自由之日，
他將吞噬悉妮蔻拉領域中所有靈魂。

en: "The Karui savages claim the weapon was forged by their fire god.
I'm rather inclined to believe them."
- Fairgraves, Renowned Explorer
flavourtext:UniqueTwoHandAxe14.Text.zh:
卡魯族人聲稱他的武器
是由他們的火神所鍛鑄
我認為我相信他們
- 費爾，知名探險家

en: A sharp and heavy beat,
discorded, out of tune,
when you hear it on the wind,
you know death will follow soon.
flavourtext:UniqueTwoHandAxe15.Text.zh:
尖銳沉重聲的聲響，失調失和，
風中聞聲，死亡將置。

en: War is a thriving infection.
It numbs the heart and eats away at the soul
until only emptiness remains.
flavourtext:UniqueTwoHandAxe16.Text.zh:
戰爭助長了感染。
它麻木了心靈，吃掉靈魂
直到只剩下空虛。

en: "Not all the Abyssals serve the Lich Lords.
Some serve themselves, living off stolen
flesh and bone from those they... eat."
flavourtext:UniqueTwoHandAxe18.Text.zh:
"並非所有的深淵生物都效忠於巫妖領主。
有些只為自己服務，靠著從牠們……吃掉
的受害者身上偷來的血肉與骨頭過活。"

en: Swinging through the air, it sings
of sundered, severed, missing things.
flavourtext:UniqueTwoHandAxe3.Text.zh:
揮舞戰斧，高舉砍擊
骨裂血濺，致勝斬敵

en: To cease the flow of blood is to
choke the rain in the very clouds.
Both life and land feel the thirst.
flavourtext:UniqueTwoHandAxe4.Text.zh:
不想血流成河。
就要消雲散霧，方能使雨水止勒。
世人和大地都會飢渴。

en: Bargg Wurmkin once severed the heads
of seven men in a single cleave.
flavourtext:UniqueTwoHandAxe5.Text.zh:
巴葛．烏爾姆金長刃一揮，
七條冤魂便到地獄相會。

en: "The remarkable imbalance of Prototype #848 leads to uncommon
power or speed when striking."
flavourtext:UniqueTwoHandAxe6x.Text.zh:
"原型 #848 明顯失衡會導致
打擊時功率或速度異常。"

en: "I do not believe in disguising my disappointment."
- Atziri, Queen of the Vaal
flavourtext:UniqueTwoHandAxe7.Text.zh:
「我可不想掩飾失落神情，自欺欺人。」
- 瓦爾女王阿茲里

en: Let it grow and gather inside them,
Let it flow through their veins.
Don't waste a drop.
flavourtext:UniqueTwoHandAxe8.Text.zh:
任其在體內滋生成長。
使其在血管自在流竄。
一滴血都不能浪費。

en: "Why is Prototype #67 never in the vault it should be?
Either we're keeping faulty logs, or..."
- Researcher Graven
flavourtext:UniqueTwoHandAxe8x.Text.zh:
"為什麼原型 #67 應該從未出現在金庫中？
我們要麼保留錯誤的日誌，要麼...”
- 研究員格雷文

en: A King and his people are linked together
like a soul and a beating heart.
Both can be severed by a same edge,
then forged anew.
flavourtext:UniqueTwoHandAxe9.Text.zh:
國王與子人民緊密相連，
宛若靈魂與跳動的心臟。
均能以相同鋒刃斬斷，
然後重新再造。

en: "The crack of bone, the spray of blood.
Is there sweeter music?"
- Hrimnor of the Ezomytes.
flavourtext:UniqueTwoHandMace1.Text.zh:
「碎骨濺血之聲
豈非天籟悅耳之音？」
- 艾茲麥的雷姆諾

en: "Though ingenious instruments have been found,
it seems surgery before thaumaturgy
was not so delicate."
- Icius Perandus, Antiquities Collection, Item 3546
flavourtext:UniqueTwoHandMace10.Text.zh:
"儘管發明了巧妙的工具
但似乎在奇術以前的手術
不是非常的精細呢"
- 伊席厄斯．普蘭德斯，古物收藏家，物品編號 3546

en: The sea strikes the rock relentlessly.
Whether in one day or in ten thousand years,
eventually the rock will crumble,
and the Brine King's domain will grow.
flavourtext:UniqueTwoHandMace12.Text.zh:
大海無情的拍打著岩涯，
哪怕一日萬年，石子終究會碎裂，
而海王的領域也將持續擴張。

en: Strike with the might of a falling oak,
and know that you never stand alone.
flavourtext:UniqueTwoHandMace13.Text.zh:
以橡樹砸下般的力量出擊，
要知道你絕不是孤單一人。

en: "Sacred water has no power of its own, and yet
holds the greatest strength of all... it can carry
what we give it. What we sacrifice for each other."
- Rashi, Grand Daiyata of the Sel Khari
flavourtext:UniqueTwoHandMace15.Text.zh:
"聖水本身並無力量，然而
它卻承載著最偉大的力量……
它能承載我們所賦予的一切，
以及我們彼此之間所做出的犧牲。"
- 塞爾卡里的大戴雅塔．拉希

en: "All men must drink. Deny us water,
and we shall have blood instead."
- Rukh, of the Afarud
flavourtext:UniqueTwoHandMace16.Text.zh:
"所有人都必須飲水。若你拒絕我們水，
那我們便以血代之。"
- 阿法魯德的戮克

en: "One quick tap is all the persuasion you'll need."
- Archbishop Geofri of Phrecia Cathedral
flavourtext:UniqueTwoHandMace2.Text.zh:
「與其善誘苦勸，口若懸河，
 不如二話不說，當頭棒喝。」
- 費西亞大教堂的大主教吉爾菲

en: Lumbering as a sea lion, clumsy as a berry-drunk pigeon. That was Erqi.
It mattered little. When Erqi's maul fell true, so did its target.
flavourtext:UniqueTwoHandMace3.Text.zh:
爾奇平日的笨拙惹人恥笑，
但每當他舞起巨錘，對手總是小命不保。

en: "Prototype #599 offers an incredible defensive power, but at a cost.
What underlying physics are at play here, I wonder?"
flavourtext:UniqueTwoHandMace6x.Text.zh:
"原型 #599 具有令人難以置信的防禦能力，但需要付出一定的代價。
我想知道這裡的基礎物理學在起作用嗎？"

en: "The finest prosperity grows from the direst
carnage. Such is the nature of progress."
- Doryani of the Vaal
flavourtext:UniqueTwoHandMace7.Text.zh:
「富貴總是險中求，
但財貨乃身外之物，哪會問去留。」
- 瓦爾族多里亞尼

en: His flesh had long turned to dust,
but his vengeance lived on
in every scrap of iron he touched.
flavourtext:UniqueTwoHandMace8.Text.zh: 雖然他的血肉之軀已成灰燼，但他的復仇之心在每一片觸碰過的金屬中活著。

en: "Today, clansmen, my sword is my voice!"
- Rigwald, at the Battle of Glarryn
flavourtext:UniqueTwoHandSword1.Text.zh:
「族人啊，今朝我以利劍代空言！」
- 瑞佛於格拉里恩之役

en: The cuts on my hands are a small price to pay
for the opportunity to drive my steel
beyond the flesh and into the demon's soul.
flavourtext:UniqueTwoHandSword10.Text.zh:
手上的傷痕只是微小的代價
為了驅使鋼鐵
深入血肉之軀直至惡魔靈魂。

en: Faintly gleaming in the moonlit night,
Kondo's Pride was primed to fight.
Driven by an inner fire,
bloodlust, spite and ill desire.
He swiftly moved to strike them all,
wreaking havoc like a steel squall.
flavourtext:UniqueTwoHandSword11.Text.zh:
月光下隱約的閃爍，
剛多的虛榮已蓄勢待發。
心中怒火、嗜血慾望，
恨意、歹意，成為動力，
他迅速的移動，擊倒一切，
似鋼颮一樣的帶來肆虐。

en: A weapon born of nothingness,
can only create more nothingness.
flavourtext:UniqueTwoHandSword13.Text.zh:
虛無所生的武器，
只會造成更多的虛無。

en: Green-cloaked travelers emerged from the mists, planted a tree,
and named it Lorrata. Its strongest root became a weapon...
flavourtext:UniqueTwoHandSword16.Text.zh:
披著綠披風的旅人從迷霧中走出並種下一棵樹，
他將其命名為羅瑞塔，而最堅固的樹根變成了一把武器……

en: "He speaks, he leads, he stands tall...
yet, what has he truly done, save
spill our blood in pursuit of power?"
flavourtext:UniqueTwoHandSword17_.Text.zh:
"「他言說，他領導，他屹立高處……
然而，他究竟做過什麼？
除了為了權力，灑下我們的鮮血？」"

en: "This blade, which once tasted the green ichor of Kulemak himself, is now
anathema to all life. Piece by piece, we shall steal back what we are owed..."
- Sak, of the Afarud
flavourtext:UniqueTwoHandSword18.Text.zh:
"這把曾親飲過骷髏馬克綠色靈液的利刃，現已是所有生靈的詛咒。
一片接著一片，我們將會將虧欠我們的竊回手中..."
- 阿法魯德的薩克

en: "To the Children of Winter, the Sun was but a myth. While Lundara held Kulemak
impaled, Solerai struck - not at him, but upwards. Her blade pierced the heavens,
and searing light embraced her golden armour. The Sun was real, and it was her."
flavourtext:UniqueTwoHandSword19.Text.zh: "對冬之子民而言，太陽不過是個神話。當倫達拉將骷髏馬克釘刺在地之時，索拉萊出手了——不是向他，而是向上。她的刀刃刺穿了蒼穹，灼熱的光芒擁抱了她的金色鎧甲。太陽是真實存在的，而那一刻，她便是太陽。"

en: Stoic visage, icy heart.
Life of sorrow, lived apart.
flavourtext:UniqueTwoHandSword2.Text.zh:
清心寡慾無眷念，
靜思無求斷牽連。

en: His final sensation was of the executioner's blade.
It was not cold, instead warm and reassuring,
murmuring a promise of better times ahead.
Smiling, he returned death's embrace.
flavourtext:UniqueTwoHandSword3.Text.zh:
他最後感受到劊子手的斬首刀。
刀身並不冰冷，反而令人溫暖安心，
喃喃承諾著死後的解脫。
他微微一笑，進入死神懷中。

en: The nobles wanted to take her throne.
She let the peasants take their wealth.
The peasants wanted to take her wealth.
She let the soldiers take their heads.
The soldiers wanted to take her head.
She sat on her throne and wept.
flavourtext:UniqueTwoHandSword4.Text.zh:
貴族逆反，謀奪王權。
平民領旨，奪其家園。
平民起義，覬覦王位。
將士領旨，斬殺逆賊。
將士叛變，欲斬女王。
王座垂淚，王自哀傷。

en: Heavy as guilt.
Beautiful as temptation.
Painful as betrayal.
flavourtext:UniqueTwoHandSword5.Text.zh:
罪孽之深重溺沉。
誘惑之美艷絕倫。
背叛之苦痛難忍。

en: Give yourself to the flames and your name
will burn in the minds of men forever.
flavourtext:UniqueTwoHandSword6.Text.zh:
奉獻己身，投諸火祭
汝名將受萬代流傳永記。

en: "Ice and flame antagonized in the essence of a prototype.
What once burned now chills the soul."
- Researcher Arn
flavourtext:UniqueTwoHandSword6x.Text.zh:
"冰與火焰在原型的本質上是對立的。
曾經燃燒的東西現在使靈魂感到寒冷。"
- 研究員昂恩

en: Soon, the pleas for mercy were muted.
Only one voice remained.
Laughing.
flavourtext:UniqueTwoHandSword7.Text.zh:
很快的，懇求哀祈之聲漸絕。
只剩一種聲音四處迴盪。
笑聲。

en: So the seed of hate was born,
Evil forged and Hope forsworn.
flavourtext:UniqueTwoHandSword8.Text.zh:
惡念之種不斷萌芽，
邪惡滋生希望破滅。

en: Take your partners by the hand,
Keep your steps in time.
Swing together, spin apart,
And dance with death sublime.
flavourtext:UniqueTwoHandSword9.Text.zh:
和你的夥伴手牽手，
同步你們的腳步。
一起揮舞，旋轉，
和死亡一同跳著壯麗的舞步。

en: Ambition followed progress,
Vanity followed passion,
Hubris followed intellect...
And silence followed all.
flavourtext:UniqueVaalReliquary.Text.zh:
野心跟隨進步，
虛榮跟隨激情，
傲慢自大...
寂靜隨之而來。

en: They met in secret to plan aspirations beyond all others.
Their grand dreams slowly turned into endless nightmares.
flavourtext:UniqueVaalSideAreaArchitects.zh:
他們秘密會面，計劃超越一切的抱負。
他們偉大的夢想漸漸變成了無盡的惡夢。

en: In every possibility, in every world that might have been,
Queen Atziri's mark on history was the one thing that never changed.
flavourtext:UniqueVaalSideAreaAtziri.Tex.zh:
在每一種可能性中，在每一個可能存在的世界中，
阿茲里女王在歷史上的印記是唯一永不改變的事物。

en: Those citizens of the Vaal Empire that thought they survived the
Cataclysm soon realised that they had, in fact, done no such thing.
flavourtext:UniqueVaalSideAreaEndless.Te.zh:
那些認為自己在毀滅之災中倖存的瓦爾帝國人民很快意識到，
事實上他們根本沒有這樣做。

en: Cast into darkness
And trapped for a thousand years,
The lonely moon weeps
flavourtext:UniqueWand1.Text.zh:
流放至黑暗惡地
受困千年，無從逃離，
唯有殘月獨自啜泣。

en: The Goat King drank the smoke and ate the flames
as his ruin spread across the land.
flavourtext:UniqueWand10.Text.zh: 山羊王飲煙食焰，其殘體蔓延大地。

en: We forge order from the world around us
Wielding anarchy and destruction as our tools of genesis.
flavourtext:UniqueWand11.Text.zh:
我們為世界制定規則
掌控著混亂和毀滅來創造新生

en: You can never truly tame the tempest.
You can barely even leash it.
flavourtext:UniqueWand12.Text.zh:
你永遠無法真正的馴服風暴
你連給它戴上項圈都幾乎不可能

en: Every decade, Lunaris devours Solaris
Each time, Solaris emerges from Lunaris, born anew.
flavourtext:UniqueWand13.Text.zh:
每隔十年，月亮都會吞噬太陽
然而每次太陽都會從月亮中獲得嶄新的誕生

en: "We do not command fire.
Ngamahu lends it, and Hinekora returns it."
- Lavianga, Advisor to Kaom
flavourtext:UniqueWand14.Text.zh:
我們不操控火焰
拿瑪乎為我們借來，悉妮蔻拉負責歸還
- 拉維安加，岡姆的顧問

en: We remember the stillness.
Then the great fall.
The pain of separation.
We return once more.
flavourtext:UniqueWand15.Text.zh:
我們銘記靜止。
我們銘記殞落。
我們分離的痛。
我們再度回歸。

<default>{此物品能夠透過托沃的祝福改造}

en: We fracture and splinter.
We pierce our sides.
But in the great freeze we are forged anew.
flavourtext:UniqueWand16.Text.zh:
碎裂、斷裂，
穿刺自己的身軀。
但極凍中我們將獲新生。

en: "Are we mad for attempting to build an engine out of this?
Looping cycles, power and pain..."
- Researcher Arn
flavourtext:UniqueWand16x.Text.zh:
"我們為嘗試以此為基礎製造引擎而生氣嗎？
循環循環，力量和痛苦…"
- 研究員昂恩

en: All at once, a calmness would encompass them,
and all at once, it would be torn away,
unveiling forms no sound mind could grasp.
flavourtext:UniqueWand19.Text.zh:
剎那間，冷靜包容他們，
再剎那間，它會被撕毀，
暴露的外觀沒有健全的心智可以掌控。

en: A chilling hush, a scraping sound
Of things no more entombed in ground.
A shambling horde is on its way
To crush the very light of day.
flavourtext:UniqueWand2.Text.zh:
魑魅驚魂擾生靈，
魍魎攝魄傳癘病；
精怪摧命掩泣月，
妖魔噬骨蔽殘星。

en: "Waging war is a simple matter of geometry and death."
- Trinian, Intellectus Prime
flavourtext:UniqueWand22.Text.zh:
「戰爭是幾何美學和死亡的簡單藝術。」
- 圖書館長特里尼安

en: Beyond the edge of existence, there
shines violet, naught but pain...
one lantern carries a single flame.
flavourtext:UniqueWand23.Text.zh:
「在存在的邊緣之外，
 閃耀著紫色的光——唯餘苦痛。
 一盞孤燈，只承載著一簇微焰。」

en: "Simply incredible. I caught an escaping test subject myself with
swarms of burning skulls. Delightful!"
- Researcher Olesya
flavourtext:UniqueWand2x.Text.zh:
"簡直令人難以置信。我自己被一群
逃脫的頭骨燒死了。這真是令人愉快！"
- 研究員奧莉西亞

en: "The trick is to give nothingness,
and to receive everything in return."
- Inquisitor Maligaro
flavourtext:UniqueWand3.Text.zh:
「弔詭的是他們什麼都不願付出，
卻索求一切作為回報。」
- 審判者馬雷葛蘿

en: From the smallest seeds
To the tallest redwoods,
Life endures in Wraeclast.
flavourtext:UniqueWand4.Text.zh:
至微者，須彌芥子
至偉者，參天神木，
無論微偉，皆可立足帝陸。

en: "Stone still, amidst the reeds,
breath fogging in the iron cold air.
he sits, he waits, he watches.
A piscatorial vigil, sat by the river,
his cathedral, his patience his unanswered prayer."
- Jojoba Mansell, bard, angler, adventurer
flavourtext:UniqueWand6.Text.zh:
「蘆葦叢中青石在，
刺骨寒風濛霧生；
坐守河岸靜眺望，
低語祈求天佑人。」
- 吟遊詩人、釣魚者與冒險家 
喬喬巴 曼賽爾

en: Apep's poison entraps, encircles,
and engulfs the leaking mind of Man.
flavourtext:UniqueWand7.Text.zh:
艾普之毒具有致命引力
吞噬人性理智豪不留情

en: Life persisted,
hardened, twisted.
flavourtext:UniqueWand9.Text.zh:
大難不死，心境劇變
殘酷冷血，病態曲解。

en: "Energy redirected is energy imbalanced.
Prototype #78 serves as a prime example."
flavourtext:UniqueWand9x.Text.zh:
"重定向的能量是能量不平衡的。
原型 #78 就是一個很好的例子。"

en: Those who could flee did so.
The rest fought bravely,
and died horrifically.
flavourtext:UniqueWatchstone1.Text.zh:
可以逃的早就逃了。
留下來的英勇作戰，
但卻死的淒慘無比。

en: "The village was locked within its walls,
protected from those who could do them harm,
protected from those who could save them."
flavourtext:UniqueWatchstone11a.Text.zh:
"該村莊被鎖在城牆裡，
免於那些可能傷害他們的人，
免於那些可以拯救他們的人。"

en: "Believing them to have discovered new lands,
they planted their flag in the dirt and called it their own.
A gesture not taken with a great deal of pleasure
by those who already dwelt there."
flavourtext:UniqueWatchstone11b.Text.zh:
"相信他們已經發現了新的土地，
他們將自己的旗幟插在了泥土中，並稱之為自己的。
已經住在那裡的人
不高興地比出手勢。"

en: "The first explorers took to the hills to discover the lay of the land,
and watched with wonder as the land undulated, crashed and twisted."
flavourtext:UniqueWatchstone11c.Text.zh:
"第一批探險者上山去發現這片土地，
並驚奇地看著那片土地起伏、破碎和扭曲。"

en: "Atop the highest peaks, the sunlight pierced but did not warm.
The air choked and did not nourish.
And those that made the trek realised the folly of their desire for greatness."
flavourtext:UniqueWatchstone11d.Text.zh:
"在最高的山峰上，陽光耀眼，但沒有溫暖。
空氣凝結且沒有滋養。
那些跋涉的人意識到了他們對偉大渴望的愚蠢。"

en: "Where once a mountain stood there was now but fields and dust.
One by one, the stones were moved and placed with intention,
the consequences borne by the destination and the origin."
flavourtext:UniqueWatchstone11e.Text.zh:
"曾經有一座山站立的地方現在只有田野和塵土。
一塊一塊地搬石頭，並故意將其放置，
後果由目的地和初始地承擔。"

en: "The Shade walked the land with no end in sight,
no purpose in mind,
but the one it invented to pass the time."
flavourtext:UniqueWatchstone11f.Text.zh:
"樹蔭漫步在這片土地上，沒有盡頭，
心中沒有目的，
但它是為了消磨時間而發明的。"

en: "There were seasons in this strange new place, but not of sun and snow.
Seasons of stone that rose and fell like waves.
Seasons of structure and growth and madness and chaos.
Seasons of birth and decay that seemed untethered to cause."
flavourtext:UniqueWatchstone11g.Text.zh:
"這個陌生的新地方有四季，但沒有陽光和雪。
石頭的季節像波浪一樣起伏。
塑型和成長的季節以及瘋狂和混亂的季節。
似乎不受束縛導致的出生和衰敗季節。"

en: "For a time, it was thought this place could seed an empire
greater than any in history.
The lands could be tamed, and commanded, they thought.
But control, like all things in that place, was an illusion."
flavourtext:UniqueWatchstone11h.Text.zh:
"有一段時間，人們認為這個地方可以孕育一個比歷史上
更大的帝國。
他們認為，土地可以被馴服和指揮。
但是控制，就像那個地方的所有事物一樣，都是一種幻想。"

en: They came, full of vim and vigour, to take what was not theirs.
They crashed and clamoured like waves against rocks,
and were swept back out to sea.
flavourtext:UniqueWatchstone2.Text.zh:
他們勢如破竹地襲來，奪走了所有不屬於他們的東西。
就像怒浪侵襲岩石那樣，他們肆虐叫囂著，
並將一切捲回海底。

en: The King's Eye returned from the west.
Fertile pastures lay just beyond sight.
Just a little farther, he said.
It was always just a little farther.
flavourtext:UniqueWatchstone3.Text.zh:
王的目光從西方歸來。
肥沃的草原就在前方。
就快到了，他說。
永遠都是就快到了。

en: There exists in every man and woman
a desire to push boundaries, to break new ground,
to make great discoveries,
no matter the personal cost.
flavourtext:UniqueWatchstone5.Text.zh:
每個男人和女人的心底總是存在著一種渴望
渴望進一步突破，渴望再一步創新，
渴望完成偉大的發明，
無論任何代價。

en: Conflict begets only suffering.
For some, that is by design.
flavourtext:UniqueWatchstone6.Text.zh:
衝突只會招致苦難。
對某些人來說，這是天性。

en: Does the belly swell, or the belt shrink?
To those caught between, there is no difference,
and something must soon give.
flavourtext:UniqueWatchstone7_.Text.zh:
到底是肚子變大了還是腰帶變短了呢？
對陷入其中的人來說並沒有太大的區別，
而想必其中一者很快就會習慣了。

en: In the outskirts of a lost city,
face the ultimate challenge...
flavourtext:UtzaalArena.Text.zh:
在一座失落城市的邊陲，
迎戰終極試煉…

en: Some dreams are too broken to fix.
Let broken realities lie dormant.
flavourtext:ValdoMapFlavour.Text.zh:
有些夢早已破碎得無法修補。
就讓破碎的現實沉眠吧。

en: I can find no method of destroying the dangerous contents within...
perhaps, someday, you will find a way.
flavourtext:ValdoPuzzleBox.Text.zh:
我找不到摧毀其中危險內容的方法...
也許，有一天，你會找到一種方法。

en: The memories and emotions of countless victims of the Elder,
locked in stone for eternity.
flavourtext:Watchstone.Text.zh:
無數尊師之下受難者的記憶和情感，
永遠被鎖在石頭上。

en: "When you stop viewing someone as a fellow human being,
there's little you won't do to forward your agenda.
That is what we're dealing with."
flavourtext:Whakano1.Text.zh:
"當你停止將某人視為同伴時，
你幾乎不會做任何事情來轉發你的議程。
那就是我們要處理的。"

en: "Selfishness and hate fuel these kidnappings.
It's time we find who is leading them."
flavourtext:Whakano2.Text.zh:
"自私和仇恨助長了這些綁架。
現在該找誰領導他們了。"

en: She who gazes into the
Abyss must take care...
flavourtext:ZigguratMapFlavour.Text.zh:
凝視深淵之人
務必小心…

en: The mists of the Atlas offer up that which you
most desire... so long as you never leave.
passiveskills:atlas_keystone_all_in_on_o.zh:
輿圖的迷霧之下有著你
最渴望的東西……只要你永不離開。

en: You were drunk on the power of the cosmos,
until a hideous gaze settled upon you,
and tendrils began to unfurl...
passiveskills:atlas_keystone_altars_1.Fl.zh:
你沉醉於宇宙的力量，
直到一個猙獰的目光落在你身上，
觸鬚開始捲曲…

en: You fight on, muscles burning, limbs leaden,
hoping for that singular moment of victory that
might finally bring relief... but it never comes.
passiveskills:atlas_keystone_beyond_boss.zh:
你奮戰不懈，肌肉燃燒，四肢沉重，
希望著那一刻的勝利，可能終於帶來寬慰... 
但它永遠不會來臨。

en: It takes either immense courage or unfettered masochism
to invoke unspeakable horrors, time after time...
passiveskills:atlas_keystone_eldritch_in.zh:
一次又一次地引發無法形容的恐怖
需要巨大的勇氣或不受約束的受虐狂…

en: "Supplying the Map Device with more power has... unexpected effects.
Somehow, though, I doubt you'll be deterred."
passiveskills:atlas_keystone_enhanced_ki.zh:
為地圖裝置提供更多能量有…出乎意料的效果。
不過，我懷疑你不會被阻止的。

en: A methodical explorer will find many paths
that others, in their haste, might miss.
passiveskills:atlas_keystone_full_clear_.zh:
有條不紊的探索者能夠發現
許多人匆忙之中錯過的路徑。

en: She makes the rules up as she goes.
It was never going to be fair.
passiveskills:atlas_keystone_maven_influ.zh:
她隨心所欲地制定規則。
這從來就不會公平。

en: Atlassian aberrations engage in a deadly dance.
Will you be joining them in the fray?
passiveskills:atlas_keystone_monsterdama.zh:
輿圖人民失序參與致命的舞蹈
你會加入他們的戰鬥嗎？

en: The waters of life roil and flow,
birthing horrors of flesh and marrow.
passiveskills:atlas_keystone_monsterlife.zh:
生命之水翻滾流淌，
生出血肉與骨髓的恐怖。

en: "There is none among us, neither God or Man,
that knows what we will find after death.
What better stakes for a bet could there be?"
passiveskills:atlas_keystone_necropolis_.zh:
「我們沒人曉得死後將面對什麼，
無論神或人。
還有什麼賭注比這更好呢？」

en: Some corners of the Atlas remain as they once
were, untouched by outside influences...
passiveskills:atlas_keystone_no_extra_co.zh:
輿圖的某些角落仍然保持著
原來的樣子，未受外界影響……

en: Ignore everything but your obsession, Nomad.
A mortal life is too short a season to entertain distractions.
passiveskills:atlas_keystone_notables_1_.zh:
除了你的痴迷，無視一切，游牧人。
凡人的生命太短暫了，不能讓人分心。

en: Travelling alone makes one an easier target?
I believe not.
Travelling alone keeps one free of distraction.
passiveskills:atlas_keystone_one_portal_.zh:
獨自旅行會更容易成為目標？
我不這麼認為。
獨自旅行才更不容易分心。

en: You know not what you want,
save the hunger for 'more'...
passiveskills:atlas_keystone_random_leag.zh:
你不知道自己想要什麼，
將那份飢渴留給「更多」吧...

en: Do not doubt. Do not question.
This is the way it has always been.
This is the way it shall always be.
passiveskills:atlas_keystone_ritual_sing.zh:
不要懷疑。不要質疑。
這就是一直以來的方式。
這就是將永遠持續的方式。

en: They are unforgivable sinners and fools...
We pray each Sacrato. They pray each Kaso.
They are absolutely mad!
passiveskills:atlas_keystone_ritual_vari.zh:
他們是不可原諒的罪人和愚者...
我們每個聖戒日祈禱，他們每個加索祈禱。
他們絕對是瘋了！

en: Shattered fragments of reality float through the void,
waiting to be shaped by your mind's desire.
passiveskills:atlas_keystone_rollable_va.zh:
破碎的現實碎片在虛空中飄蕩，
等待著被你心靈的渴望所塑造。

en: Embrace the journey, Nomad, for there is no destination.
This is the prime inescapable truth of eternity.
passiveskills:atlas_keystone_smallnodes_.zh:
擁抱旅程吧，游牧人，因為沒有目的地。
這是永恆的真理。

en: Darkening mists shroud the pale sky,
blurring the barrier between nightmare and dream.
passiveskills:atlas_keystone_stronger_ra.zh:
黑霧籠罩著蒼白的天空，
模糊了噩夢和夢想之間的界限。

en: For nine hundred years, they have had no voice, no hope.
Finally, they have found a kindred soul... in you.
passiveskills:atlas_keystone_torment_spi.zh:
九百年來，他們無聲無望，
終於，在你身上找到一個同類的靈魂..

en: You can feel the fungus growing in your skull,
bringing not pain, but religious ecstasy.
passiveskills:blight_special_keystone1.F.zh:
你感覺到有種真菌在你的腦內生長。
這一點都不疼痛，反而有種虔誠帶來的喜悅感。

en: What need have I for defence when my enemies
are reduced to ash and splinters?
passiveskills:eldritch_battery1142.Flavo.zh: 當我的敵人已化為灰燼與碎骨時，還有什麼好防守的？

en: Surround yourself with the dead,
so that you may avoid joining them.
passiveskills:ghost_dance_keystone2852_..zh:
讓死者包圍自己，
這樣你就可以避免加入他們。

en: Punish your enemies with the excessive cruelty of a tyrant,
then move on without a second thought.
passiveskills:impaler_keystone2780.Flavo.zh: 用暴君的殘酷懲罰你的敵人，然後不加思索地繼續前進。

en: A wooden construct, mute and blind.
But fear the wrath of shackled mind.

Your enemies will know your agony tenfold.
passiveskills:pain_attunement1178.Flavou.zh: 無需恐懼，擁抱痛苦並將其喝下；你的敵人，將會受到十倍的奉還。

coming before they're even cast.

but we are willing to bleed, and that is why we will be victorious.

Let none tell you otherwise.

你是帝國的心臟，光彩照人，一切都被您的光芒所照耀。
別讓其他人告訴你。

The pain is fleeting, but victory is forever.
passiveskills:unwavering_stance1139.Flav.zh: 堅定你的立場，孩子，信任你的直覺。疼痛是短暫的，勝利是永恆的。
